pod 4sngon 'gro'i gtam/gna' rtsom ni mi rigs srol rgyun rig gnas kyi grub cha gal chen zhig yin cing / krung hwa mi rigs kyi 'od stong 'bar ba'i rig gnas shul bzhag khrod kyi rin chen nor bu zhig yin/ de 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig tho 'god/ par skrun bcas byed rgyu ni rang re'i tang dang rgyal khab kyis mi rigs phul byung rig gnas rgyun 'dzin byed pa'i bya ba rlabs chen zhig yin pas/ rang rgyal mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong bca' khrims sogs bca' khrims dang srid jus su gsal bor gtan la phab yod cing / rim pa khag gi mi dmangs srid gzhung nas 'di phyogs kyi bya ba 'bor chen bsgrubs shing / grub 'bras g.yur du za ba blangs/ nye ba'i lo shas ring / rgyal srid spyi khyab khang nas grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom nang du 'dus pa'i rang rgyal mi rigs gna' rtsom 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig tho 'god sogs byed pa'i thad ched du yig cha phud de gtan phab gsar ba mdzad cing / blang bya gsar ba bton/ spyi khyab hru'u ci nas kyang‘‘gna' rtsom dag sgrig par skrun sgos mes rgyal gyi phul byung rig gnas shul bzhag rgyun 'dzin byas te/ krung go'i 1

pod 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos’’zhes pa'i bka' slob legs par bstsal/gong gsal dgongs don lag star dngos 'bab byed ched/nga tshos rang skyong khul gyi don dngos dang zung 'brel byas te/ ched gnyer las khungs btsugs shing / ched mkhas mi sna skong 'then dang ci nus sgos mthan rkyen bskrun pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng de'i byed ༄nus 'don skul byas te/ bya ba 'di cung snga ba'i sgo nas las 'go brtsams/nga tsho'i thog ma'i rgyus lon ltar na/ mgo log sa cha'i gna' rtsom la mtshon na thon khungs cung 'bel bo yin par ma zad/brgyud pa ring zhing / rnam grangs mang la/ khyab rgya che ba dang / nang gses rigs kyis dbye na'ang brda sprod dang / rtsom rig lo rgyus/gso rig mtshan nyid rig pa/ rtsis gzhung / nang don rig pa sogs bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi khyab khongs phal mo che zin cing / dpe rgyun dkon zhing rtsa chen du brtsi rung ba'i gna' gzhung yang mi nyung bar 'dugade phyir thog ma'i 'tshol sdud tsam gyi rmang gzhi'i steng /1993lo nas bzung ste/ mgo log sa cha'i mkhas dbang rim byon gyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs dpe tshogs kyi tshul du〈khra dge slong tshul 2

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 4khrims dar rgyas kyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs〉sogs snga gzhu ga tu deb lnga drug tsam par skrun byas te/ rgya che'i klog pa po'i spyan sngar rim par bstar bas/ kun gyi gdeng 'jog legs po byung zhing /bya ba de la 'brel yod sde khag gis mthong gzigs gnang ste/ ched gnyer las khungs dang mi sna sogs la zhing chen rim pa'i gna' rtsom 'tshol sdud myur skyob kyi bya dga' dang gzengs bstod kyi dbugs dbyung thengs du mar gnang /nye lam rgyal khab mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang gis〈krung go'i grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom spyi byang gnad bsdus〉lag star byed pa'i shar rlung gi 'gros dang bstun zhing / rang skyong khul gyi srid dbang btsugs nas lo 'khor lnga bcu 'khor bar sngon bas zhu ba'i sta gon rtsom pa dang 'brel/ khal gna' rtsom bya ba'i riri bye dmi shigazhung las khang gis sngar gyi rmang gzhi'i steng rim pa spaṭa shing gzhi rgya bskyed de/ slar yang〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig par skrun bcas byed pa'i jus gzhi gsar ba bzos pa ltar nga tshos bya ba 'di da lta dngos su lag star byed 'go brtsams pa yin/de yang nga tshos bya ba 'di nyid sgrub pa'i mdzub ston bsam blo ni tang krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi 'brel yod mdzub 3

pod 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ston la brtsi srang sgos/ mi rigs phul byung rig gnas dar spel tshogazur༄byi 05 rtsar characharadang / ma rags mthun sgral dang ra ga gnas brja ras la shugs snon byed pa dmigs 'dun du byas te/ bden 'tshol lam tshan rig dang mthun pa'i spyod stangs la brten nas sa gnas mi rigs gna' rtsom sngog 'don myur skyob byas thog mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs dpal yon 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu de yin/bya ba'i rtsa don ni chab srid 'du shes shugs dam zhing / srid jus dbye mtshams gsal bor byas te/ lo rgyus dang rtsod sgrub kyi lta ba spyad nas snyigs dor bcud len byed pa'i dus mtshungs su rig gnas kyi ngos nas snga ma'i rnam pa ji bzhin cha tshang du mtshon ci nus byed cing / spyir btang du brtsams chos la dpyad brjod ci yang byed rgyu min/gzhan yang byed sgo'i shes byar slob sbyong dang / ched las shes byar gcigs 'dzin byas te/ nan tan zhib tshags kyi bya ba'i spyod stangs la brten nas gnad sgo stangs 'dzin byas thog rgyun shes sam ched las rang bzhin gyi 'gal 'khrul g.yol ci nus byed rgyu'ang smros ma dgos/de dang mnyam du spus legs 'du shes chags par byas te/ ma 4

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 4dngul gyi mthun rkyen cung 'byor ba'i gnas tshul 'og〈dpe tshogs〉de jus 'god dang / mdun shog deb tshad/ shog spus/ ye ge'i dag tshad sogs gang rung nas de sngon las spus tshad bzang bar byas te/mig snga'i rgyal nang sa gnas bod yig dpe deb cung legs po'i gras su tshud par byed pa dmigs 'ben du byas yod/'dir cis kyang gleng dgos pa zhig ni de ring nga tshor bya ba 'di spel ba'i go skabs byung tshe/ nga tshor 'di 'dra'i rig gnas shul bzhag rgya che zhing rngams mthug pa zhig myar skyob bya ru yod zurari 1rdoX/thobasig mo rig ra mi1(〈( /bro/rdocang / mang zhag da dung mad brlag tu ma nga bar 'a la du yod pa dang de tsho'i rig gnas rin thang gi skor yin te/ de yang de sngon gyi lo rgyus su rang re gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir 'gro ba mi yi sha tshugs su skyes pa ni sus kyang bgrang du med mod/ legs par bsam na mi rigs dang mi'i rigs la 'phral yun du phan pa'i mdzad pa bzang po bskrun pa dang nyams pa med pa'i legs skyes shul du bzhag yod mkhan ni shin tu nyung ngu zhig las med na/ khong tsho ni mi yi khyu mchog dang / phul byung skyes bur bgrang ba don dang ldan te/ ji skad du‘‘mkhas pa rnams ni med na blo gros rnams nyams mi rnams 'tsho ba don yod min’’ces gsungs pa shin tu mad de/ khong tsho yod cing / khong tshos rang byung khams dang spyi 5

pod 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tshogs la thugs gzhigs yang yang mdzad pa las byung ba'i 'gro ba mi'i blo gros dang shes rab kyi mtshon byed shes rig gi legs skyes rmad du byung ba de dag yod pa dang / legs skyes de dag dus dang go mtshams kyi rgya las brgal te phyi rabs pa dag la pha nor gyi tshul du shul 'jog gnang bar brten/ nga tsho da lta dpal yon ldan pa'i spyi tshogs su 'tsho zhing / nga tshos bskrun pa'i shes rig la rmang gzhi dang khungs lung yod cing / brgyud pa dang ldan par gyur/ mkhas pa de tsho dang rig gzhung de tsho bzhugs pas rang gi rigs rgyud 'di rnams da lta brgyud pa ring la zab cing rgya che ba'i thun min rig gnas shig gi bdag por gyur yod la/ shes rig rnam par bkra ba dpal ldan 'dzam bu gling ba'i mi gral gyi star rim 'phang mi dma' bar 'tsho thub pa byung yod/de phyir mkhas pa'i dbang po rim par byon pa dag dang de dag gis mdzad pa'i legs bshad kyi glegs bam dag ni mi rigs shig dang sa gnas shig la mtshon na gzi brjid dang la rgya zhig yin 'dug la/ 'chang bar bya ba'i khyad nor dang 'phyar bar bya ba'i dge mtshan zhig yin par ma zad/ 'tsho bar byed pa'i bla srog dang khrag rgyun zhig tu smras kyang rung snyam/ 'di ltar bsam na khong sngon byon gyi mkhas pa dag rang re la bka' drin bla lhag tu che bas 6

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 4rjes su yi rang zhing snying nas bka' drin zhu 'os la/ sngon 'gro'i rtsom thung 'di yang khong rnam par dad gdung mos gus kyi yid rlabs g.yo bzhin bris pa lags/dus mtshungs su rang re gangs can pa dag la gna' bo'i dus nas bzung mkhas pa la gong bkur dang shes rig la gces thang che ba'i srol rgyun bzang po zhig yod la/ yul mgo log 'dir mtshon na'ang dgon sde dang dge 'dun pa dag gis bshad sgrub kyi ngos nas so so'i mkhas pa dang de'i brtsams chos la gtsigs su 'dzin pa tsam du ma zad/ yul khams spyi nas kyang‘‘mkhas pa yon tan ldan pa dang / skra dkar yang tsha mthong ba ste’’sogs kyis mtshon te mkhas pa dag phu dud bya ba'i yul gsum gyi gtso bo'i go gnas su bgrang ba'i srol 'dug cing / khong tsho ni legs bshad kyi 'byung gnas dang / legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba/ yi rang dang mig ltos kyi mtshon dpe zhig tu brtsi ba dang / khong tshos brtsams pa'i gsang ༄chos dag ni bslab bya'i gnas shig dang / lugs gnyis blang dor gyi tshad gzhi zhig tu brtsi bar byed/ khyim rgyud dang rus rgyud dag la mtshon na rang gi khyim rgyud du 'khrungs pa'i mkhas pa dang de'i gsung chos de tsho so so rang rang gi khyim rgyud kyi khyad nor du byas tebu rabs tsha rgyud du bsrel bar byed pa'i dar srol yod pas/ dus 7

pod 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'gyur mang po'i khrod du'ang srog dang bsdos nas srung skyob byas 'dug da lta bsam na 'di ni goms srol legs po tsam du ma zad snying stobs rigs shig gi mtshon byed du'ang rung bar snyam/de dag gi dbang gis sa gnas 'dir yang lo rgyus su mkhas pa mi nyung ba tsam byon cing / da lta'i bar 'tshol du yod pa'i legs bshad kyi bstan bcos kyang mang tsam bzhugs la/ de tsho'i thun min rin thang gi cha nas bshad na'ang lo rgyus su mgo log 'di mdo khams 'brel mtshams su chags yod pas/ mdo khams rirge gnas ma lag che ba gnyis ka gcig 'dres su song ba'i nyams shig snang la/ bod brgyud nang bstan grub mtha'i dbang du btang na'ang snga 'gyur rnying ma ba dang / ri bo dge lugs pa/ rgyal ba jo nang ba/mnyam med bka' brgyud pa sogs grub mtha' che gras phal mo che zhig yun ring mnyam gnas su chags pas/ dmangs khrod rig gnas tshun gyi rig gnas kun la sa cha gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i sger khyad cig lhag ger snang bar bsten/ rig gnas shul bzhag 'di rigs myur skyob thub pa byung na/ bod spyi'i srol rgyun rig gnas kyi dar rgyun nam brgyud pa gyes 'phel 'gro tshul dang /sa gnas thun min rig gnas grub stangs sogs zhib 'jug byed par don snying dang rin thang shin tu che bar gdon mi za la/ tha na 8

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 4bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi nang gses phyogs rer mtshon na de phyogs kyi stong cha gsab nus pa'i tshad du son pa'i rin thang yang yod par zhib 'jug mkhas dbang du ma smra/gang ltar da lta nga tshos〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'di nyid par du bskrun te mgo log gna' rtsom gyi spyi bab khyad chos dang ngo mtshar kun gyi spyan sngar bstar thub pa ni tang gi mi rigs srid jus don 'bab byung ba'i bye brag gi mtshon dpe zhig yin la/mgo log rig gnas khyab khongs kyi grub 'bras chen po zhig yin cing / krung go'i grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom bya ba'i grub 'bras kyi ya gyal zhig kyang yin pa dang / deng dus la dge ba'i mdzad bzang zhig dang / ma 'ongs par bslangs pa'i rdo ring zhig ste/ lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan pa'i bya ba rlabs che ba zhig yin pa bsnyon du med la/ sa gnas thun min rig gnas thon khungs sngog 'don sgos khyad thon rig gnas dar spel byed cing / rang skyong khul gyi rig gnas brje res dang phyi phyogs dril sgrog la shugs snon byed par mtshon na don snying chen po tshab byed gzhan du med pa zhig yod par snyam zhing / dus mtshungs su〈dpe tshogs〉'di nyid kyis rgya che'i klog pa po dang 'brel yod zhib 'jug pa dag la'ang rig pa'i longs spyod gsar ba zhig stob nus pa'i yid ches nga tshor 9

pod 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yod/de sngon gyi srid jus legs po'i go skabs ma shor bar byas te/cha rkyen zhan cing dka' tshegs che ba la ma ltos par mthun rkyen gsar gtod sgos 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig myur skyob kyi las la rang rtogs ngang zhugs nas sa gnas rig gnas shul bzhag rtsa chen dag chud zos su mi 'gro ba'i ched du 'bad pa yun ring bsten pa'i ched las don gnyer mi sna dag gis don mthun gyi bya ba mang po bsgrubs song bas/ ngas 'dir khong tshor dka' las myang song zhes zhu zhing / kho bo rang ngos kyis bya ba de la rgyab skyor dang mthun rkyen sbyor ba'ang ldog med kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis yod/'on kyang rang khul gyi gna' rtsom ma lus par yongs su myar ni ༄skyob byed rgyu da dung dus yun ring zhing dka' khag che ba'i bya ba zhig yin pas/ grub 'bras kyi rmang gzhi'i steng mu 'thud nas rgyun 'khyongs lhod med kyi bya ba 'bor chen zhig bsgrub pa la rag las yod/mjug mthar mgo log gna' rtsom bya ba legs 'grub yong zhing / grub 'bras gzengs su thon pa'i smon 'dun zhu//zhes pad ma rnam rgyal nas2003 1 1la bris/ 10

pod 4 rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/rdo grub chen kun bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang po ni/ bod kyi rus chen bzhi las a lcags 'bri yi rigs las mched pa gnubs lcags mo'i rgyud du/yab rtsod bral dus babs kyi sprul ba'i gter chen khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa rgis li gter ston zhes yongs su grags pa de dang / yum mtshan ldan ḍā ki'i rigs gyur bsod nams mtsho gnyis kyi sras sa bod rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i shing mo gling lor(spyi ༄lo1865)ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas 'bros sgang zhes grags pa'i ri zhol da lta'i mgo log pad ma rdzong gi rdzong grong gi nye 'dabs su sku bltams/ snga ma'i bag chags sad pas sku chung ngu'i dus nas yi ge dang brda sprod sogs gzigs pa tsam gyis thogs med du mkhyen/ rdzogs sprul bzhi ba mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje'i lung bstan ltar/ grub pa'i khyu mchog chen po rdo grub kun bzang 11

pod 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gzhan phan 'jigs med phrin las 'od zer gyi sku phreng gsum par ngos bzung ste rdo grub chen gyi gdan sar 'khod na'ang / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po ches brtag pa mdzad tshe gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i yang srid du grub pas/ khri chen gung thang pa'i sku skyer yang grags so//rdza stod du phebs nas 'jam dbyangs ngur smrig 'chang ba'i rnam rol chen po rdza dpal dge sprul sku o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po'i zhabs la gtugs nas chos kyi bdud rtsi bzhes pas/lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung zhing byin gyis brlabs te dgongs pa ye shes kyi klong rdol/ dgung lo brgyad du son pa chu pho sprel lor dpal sprul rin po ches da lo rdo grub sprul skus spyod 'jug gi bka' khrid gnang dgos zhes phyogs kyi slob bu mang du bsdus tshe/nye gnas 'khor dang bcas pas sprul sku khong sku na chung drags pas re zhig 'khor de lta ba la bka' khrid mi 'ong zhes nan gyis zhus pa ༄bka' bkyon gyis tshar bcad par brten/ bka' nan bzlog ma nus par rdza rgyal dgon du 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i 'khor la spyod 'jug chen mo'i bka' khrid gnang ba na/ 'khor slob kun gyi lus kyi spu long dbang med g.yo zhing / dad pa'i mchi ma sham sham 'bab pa'i tshod du chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor bas/ dpal sprul rin po 12

rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ pod 4che'i zhal nas/ rdo grub byis pa lo brgyad pas chos 'khor 'di 'dra bskor nus pa'i tshul la dpag na/ da dung lung gi bstan pa'i gnas tshad rdzogs ran mi 'dug ces thugs dgyes pa chen pos bsngags brjod kyi me tog yang yang 'thor/ snga phyir o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po dang / rdzogs sprul mi 'gyar nam ༄mkha'i rdo rje/ rgya rong nam sprul kun bzang theg mchog rdo rje/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/ kong sprul blo gros mtha' yas rdo rje 'dzin pa nyag bla gter chen/ 'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtsho sogs dam pa mang du bsten nas/ 'dul ba dbu tshad phar phyin sogs gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i zab chos spyi dang / mdo sgyu sems gsum/ bka' dgongs phur gsum/ snying thig gong 'og sogs snga 'gyur bka' babs kyi chu bo rnam bzhi dang 'brel ba'i bka' gter smin grol gyi dbang lung khrid gsum/ mdo smad rdi tsha dgon gyi mgo log sprul sku 'gya ba a lags sogs las kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i yig chas gtso byas ri bo dge ldan pa ltar gyi gzhung bka' pod lnga sogs mdor na mdo sngags gsar rnying grub mtha' ris med kyi lta grub kun la khengs pa dang skyo ngal med par thugs 'dris gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags pa ches cher rgyas/13

pod 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rab tshes lcags 'brug spyi lo1880lor mgo log pad ma 'bum dpon shog brgyad kyis ched du phul ba'i bzhugs gnas rdo yul khri zhes bya bar dgon gnas gtsang chen dngos grub dpal 'bar gling zhes bya ba gsar du bzhengs pa/ phyis ming zuraskeshugs kyis 'gyur te gsang chen dngos grub dpal 'bar gling du grags/de tsam nas dgon pa de'i g.yon ngos brdzi med bkra leb gong mar thang stong rgyal po'i lha khang du grags pa'i dben khrod cig tu sgrub pa rtse gcig mdzad pas/ tshul khrims kyi dri bsung zhim pos khor yug dus kun 'gengs la/ lhag pa'i lha la mi dang mi lab pa bzhin bgro gleng byed cing / ma gza' dam gsum mir brdzus nas glegs bam skyel 'bul byed pa/ nyin lam du ma'i sar rab gnas kyi 'bru char 'beb pa sogs mngon shes dang brdzu 'phrul la thogs pa med pa'i grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs kyang / rtag tu sbas pa'i brtul zhugs kho nar dgyes pas don gyi gsang ba sus kyang dpogs par dka'/ gzhan yang gangs ri'i ljongs su bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog dang / bka' gter rnying rgyud/ bod kyi mkhas grub ris med kyi gsung 'bum glegs bam gsar bzhengs sogs bya ba las kyi phrin las kyang rgya cher spel/mthar rab byung bco lnga ba'i zad pa me stag gi lor(1929)14

rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ pod 4/༷re/ nye ko re:bye /bye/ res/gzugs sku ba da pa sa da ngas su bsdus //lung gis zin pa'i thugs sras mgar ba mkhan po 'jigs med 'od zer dang / ser shul mkhan po/ klu shul mkhan po/ mkhan po dam chos bcas mkhan chen bzhis gtso'i rnyiḥphi dug tsha sogs yul gru kun nas slob ma mang du 'dus kyang / 'khor slob rgya cher bsdu ba sogs thun mong gi mnga' thang dang gzi byin gyi spros pa rtag tu bskyungs te bzhugs/gsung rtsom la〈rgyud ma hā yo ga'i tan+d+ra gsang ba'i snying bo de kho na nyid rnam par nges pa la zur lugs ltar gyi dgongs 'grel spyi don rin chen mdzod kyi lde mig〉dang / 〈mdo las byang chub sems dpa'i gzungs kyi rgyan rnam par bshad pa rgyal yum lus bzang mdzes byed legs bshad phreng ba〉sogs mdo sngags gzhung 'grel gyi skor dang / sgrub thabs skyed rdzogs kyi skor/ lo rgyus gtam tshogs kyi skor/ gsung mgur snyan ngag gi skor/ zhal gdams man ngag gi skor sogs gang la'ang thun mong min pa'i khyad chos rtsal du thon pa'i gsung chos pod chen bcu phrag lhag cig bzhugs pa las/gong smras〈gsang snying spyi don〉dang / 〈gzungs kyi rnam bshad〉〈gter gyi rnam bshad〉sogs la shes nas smra ba'i mkhas pa du mas bstod bsngags kyi me tog mang du 'thor/ gzangs kyi skor la rnam ༄1/

pod 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bshad 'di nyid kho na las gzhung logs su brtsams pa zhig bod na med par grags pas/ 〈gzungs rnam〉'di'i dpe zhig a mdo dge bshes 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi phyag brgyud nas kun gzigs bcu gsum pa chen po'i spyan sngar phul bas dgyes gzigs dang bsngags brjod yang yang gnang bar gsung la/ rdo grub khong rang nas kyang〈gsang snying〉dang〈gzungs rnam〉gnyis ka snying dmar rjen du bstan pa yin ces lan du mar gsung bar grags/ 〈gzungs rnam〉dang〈gter rnam〉gnyis dbyin ji sogs kyi yi ger bsgyur yod pa'ang nye lam thos so// /gzhan yang khong gi gsung chos gang la'ang rtsom nyams dang rtsom stangs kyi cha nas thun mong la rjes bzlos sa ma song ba'i khyad chos shig yod la/ snyan rtsom ༄la'ang 'gyur bag dang ro nyams gzhan dang gzhan la yong dka' ba'i cha bklags pa tsam gyis lhag ger myong thub pa zhig yod pas/gsung mgur dang / gtam tshogs khrod kyi sgrung thung dag la rtsom rig gi nyams 'gyur dang rin thang ngo mtshar ba zhig yod par sngon dang da lta'i ngag rig smra ba kun zhal gcig tu gleng ngo / /zhes pa'ang lnga rig smra ba bde legs rab rgyas su 'bod pas khul gna' rtsom gzhung las khang gis bskul ngor zla tshes dge bar 'phral mar sbyar ba'o// //16

dkar chagasngon 'gro'i gtam/ (1)rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ (11)bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig (1)bla ma'i rnal 'byor la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge/ (49)bla ma dang o rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs/ (71)mtshams sgrub zhal gdams sogs/ (88)rdo rje gzhon nu la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ (95)klong snying lo rgyus/ ( 103)rten gsum rab gnas/ (117)thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sna tshogs/ (121)yi dam zhi ba'i zin bris/ (236)rta khyung 'bar ba'i bsnyel tho/ (273)phur ba'i zin bris/ (291)srog gi zhal gdams/ (309)bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs las gsung pa'i khyim gyi dran tho/ (327)bka' brgyad bro chog (346)1

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄༅/ /dpal ldan dang po'i sangs rgyas srid pa 'dir/ /mi yi gar mdzad rdo rje'i lam ston pa/ /skal bzang mkhas pa yongs kyi mgon gcig pa/ /de la btud de gdams pa'i zar rgyan spel/ /rini rgyu ri rishāde la srid zhi'i legs tshogs thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i 'byung gnas ni bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyag gcig yin te/ des ma bstan na mtho ris su 'gro ba'i lam tsam yang legs par shes dka' na/nges legs sgrub pa'i lam lta ci smos pa'i phyir ro/ /khyad par du yang theg pa chen po'i lam bzang tshang la ma nor ba rnyed nas tshul bzhin sgrub pa ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas bzung ste brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i gdams ngag bum pa gang byor mnga' ba'i bla ma dam pa la ltos shing / de'i nang nas gsang sngags kyi lam ni bla ma las ma thob par glegs bam klog pa tsam yang byar ma gnang ste/gsang sngags rang nyid len pa ni/ /sems can dmyal ba 'ba' zhig rgyu/ /zhes so/ /de'ang bla ma las dbang lung thob nas sgrub pa rkyang pas mi chog ste/ gsang sngags byin rlabs kyi lam pa bya ba yin pas bla ma mnyes pa rab 'bring tha ma'i bye brag gis dngos grub myur bul dang che chung sogs tha dad du 'gyur bas sgo mang po nas yun ring por skyo dub med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis bla ma mnyes par bya ba la rag las pa kho na ste/ rang re sangs rgyas la sangs 2

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4rgyas kyi gzugs su mthong ba'i blo mig med pa rnams kyi mdun du dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo nyid tha mal ba'i gzugs su bstan nas dbang dang gdams ngag ston par rgyud sde rab 'byams las gsungs pa de thog mar mnyes nas rim gyis rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i gzugs can gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dngos las dngos grub len pa'i mthu thob par 'gyur ba la tshegs med cing /gzhan du lam gyi rten 'brel dang po de 'chuṭa na de nas tshes gcig nas 'chaṭa na bco lnga'i bar du nor 'gro ba ltar 'gyar te/rari bye risi pho'adi la dgongs nas/ slob dpon lha ni dam pa ste/ /'bad pa'i sgo nas mchod par 'os/ /'jig rten rjes bzung rgyu nyid kyis/ /de nyid de lta'i gzugs can no/ /zhes rgyud las gsungs so/ /dang po nas bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba'i mos gus ltem rkyang ma shor ba thob cing lus srog yal bar 'dor nus pa'i snying stobs kyis mnyes par byas na/ phyis bla ma des dbang bskur ba'i dus nyid du dgongs brgyud kyi rtogs pa slob ma'i rgyud la 'pho nus pa 'phags yul gyi paṇa grub du ma'i lo rgyus ltar yin kyang /de ltar ma byung tshe sngar dbang nod pa'i bla ma de rigs dang dkyil 'khor thams cad pa'i bdag nyid du blta ba'i bsam sbyor mtshams bsdam/ thun du bcad nas ched gtad kyis sgom pa'i bla 3

pod/ phung rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ 〉zungama'i rnal 'byor 'byong nges su sbyang dgos te/ 'di'i tshul gsar rnying bka' gter kun tu mtha' yas pa 'byung ngo / /de'ang khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' nyid gdul bya'i skal ba dang / dus ji lta ba bzhin du yul dang / rigs dang / mtshan dang / rnam pa gcig tu ma nges par 'byung bas/ bla ma so so tha dad la brten pa'i gzhung tshad bzung med par 'byung ba las/ 'dir kun ma.o bla ma 'jigs med gling pas/ rdzogs pa chen po brjod du med pa'i 'pho chen ye shes rdo rje'i khams/ /rang dbang gyur las bcu drug ye shes bla ma'i sar gshegs bi ma la/ /gangs ri'i khrod na rdo rje'i lam la rnal du 'byor pa'i sa mkhan du/ /thob las 'ja' lus grub mtha' snyogs pa'i grags pa nam mkhar shong ba min/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dpal kasmi ra'i yul du mtshan dpe'i pad+mo bzhad de/ rab tu byung zhing sde snod la sbyangs pa mdzad pas 'phags yul gyi bstan pa bzang sgang gi dus su paṇa chen lnga brgya'i khyu mchog tu gyur la/ sangs rgyas gsang ba dang /ñdzu na su tra sogs sangs rgyas kyi sa la bzhugs pa'i grub chen mang po'i gdams ngag rdzogs par brnyes nas dur khrod kyi gnas chen rnams sa bsgoms pas sku tshe de nyid kyis 'od gsal gzhon nu bam ri ring ri skohopa sku'i dbyings su mngon par byang chub ste/ gzhom bral chu'i zla ‘1

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4ba lta bu'i 'od skur bzhengs pa lha btsad po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi drin las bod khams 'gro ba yongs la gtsug nor gyi skal bar thob pa gsang ba bla med spyi dang / bye brag rdzogs pa chen po snying thig gi chos char phab ste skal ldan mang po gdod ma'i grol sar dbugs dbyung ba'i bka' drin gzhal du ma mchis pa/ nges pa'i don du che mchog bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo grub pa'i slob dpon gyi zol la brten par sgrub sde'i lung gis grub pa/ 'chi med bi ma la mi tra ste dri med bshes gnyen dang / bye ma la mu tra ste phyag rgya rgya chen du grags pa'i slob dpon chen po de nyid sku dngos shar phyogs rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga na bskal pa ji srid par bzhugs shing / lo brgya re'i mtshams su snying thig gi bstan pa gsal bar byed pa'i sprul pa re bod du 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes pa ltar/ gnas brtan ldang ma lhun rgyal dang / 'gro ba'i mgon po ku ma rā dza dang /lha btsun nam mkha' 'jigs med sogs snga phyir 'ga' re byon pa las/ lnga bdo'i dus mthar bod chen po'i ljongs 'dir lha rigs gnyos kyi gdung las bsod nams brgya ba'i sku'i nyin byed/ dri ma med pa'i rnam thar gyi snang ba dang ldan pa don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na/ 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba byung ste/mthong thos dran reg gi 'gro ba dpag tu med pa la kun tu bzang 5

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/po'i rgyal srid sbyin par mdzad pa des/ bzo gnas kyi rig pa la mkhas pa karma rnam rgyal zhes bya ba'i mos ldan gyi slob mas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ rang gi sgrub pa rang gis mdzad/ /zer ba'i tshul ltar dgyes bzhin bstsal ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor ye shes mchog stsol nyams su len par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ thog ma kho nar tshe 'di'i bya bzhag thams cad zin pa rjes med cha'i ri mo ༄ lta bu dang / der ma zad 'khor ba'i bya ba mtha' dag yid rton mi rung ba'i sdug bsngal gyi las thabs 'ba' zhig tu shes nas/ bya rgyu dam chos dang / re sa bla ma las med par kho thag bcad de/bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'dug ste/bdag gzhan mkha' khyab 'gro ba ma lus kun/ /sogs ltar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyud dang 'dres nges su bya/ de nas shu n+ya tā'i sngags don dran pas tha mal gyi snang zhen stong chen de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings su sbyangs te/ de'i ngang las rang snang rnam par dag pa'i 'og min gyi zhing khams rgyan dang bkod pa tshad med pas mngon par 'phags pa'i dbus su/ rang lhar sgom pa'i tshig zin med kyang tha mal pas dngos snang mi dmigs par byas nas yang tha mal pa'i nga rgyal skyed pa mi legs pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs gang yang rung ba'i lhar langs pa'i mdun mkhar rtsibs brgya'i 6

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can nyi ma brgya'i 'od 'bar bas steng nas bkab cing / g.yas g.yon du lha rdzas kyi dar gyi lda ldi dang / ba dan dang / me tog dang / nor bu'i chun 'phyang la sogs pas mdzes par bres pa dang / mtha' bskor kun tu gser sbyangs kyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang / bum pa gang ba/ spos kyi za ma tog sogs mchod pa'i yo byad sprin ltar spungs pas brgyan pa'i seng ge'i khri yangs shing mtho ba bsam par bya ste/ 'di 'dra phra mo rer yang rang la legs tshogs 'byang ba'i rten 'brel gyi gnad ༄shin tu che ba'i phyir ro/ /bla ma zhal bzhugs ring dar zab 'bol brtsegs kyi gdan la dang / gshegs rjes yin na pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs par byed pa'i lugs kyang yod mod/ 'on kyang sngon rang gis 'jal dus kyi rnam pa de ka slar rjes su dran nas gsal 'debs pa'i tshul gyis bsgom na mos gus kyi 'gyur ba skye sla ba'i blo rigs kyang yod la/ rang gis ji ltar mos pa de bzhin du sangs rgyas rnams mdun na bzhugs shing snang ba las ris chad can du med par lung rigs mang pos grub pas/ rdzogs chen snying thig gi dbang chog na/ sngon bzhugs dur khrod gnas nas 'dir gshegs shig /ces 'byung zhing / sa skya phyogs sogs kyi bla rnam mang por bla ma'i sku dbyibs bag tsam mdun du btud pa dang /7

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dbu skya ye re ba dang / zhal dbyibs skyong la rid pa sogs zhal bzhugs dus kho na ltar sgom par gsungs pa'ang de 'dra yin par snang/ des na gdan yang sngon dus bzhin 'bol brtsegs la byed pa mi rung ba med pas gzhung tshig ltar sor bzhag chog gam snyam/bla ma la tha mal pa'i 'du shes dgag sla ba'i ched du/ ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma de ka rnam pa rdo rje sems dpa' sogs kyi gzugs su bsgyur nas sgom pa'i skabs mang yang / 'dir ni rgyu mtshan bshad ma thag pa ltar dang / khyad par du sngon rang cag rnams la rdo rje 'chang chen pos zhal mngon sum du ston pa'i bka' drin mdzad skabs/ re zhig sku'i rnam pa gzhan lta ba'i mthu med par dgongs nas mi'i gzugs su bstan pa'i sgo nas zhal mthong gsung thos kyi bka' drin nod pa yin pas/ ngo bo rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang nyid dang tha mi dad pa la/ rnam par kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po zhes mtshan du gsol ba'i gnas skabs de nyid ltar bya ste/ sku'i rnam 'gyar de ni 'o skal rnams ༄dang las smon gyi 'brel pa che shos yin pas byin rlabs lhag cing myur ba'i phyir ro/ /de'ang byams pa'i rang bzhin gyi sku mthong na dga' ba skyed pa/ dkar la yid tsam dmar ba'i mdangs chag pa/pags pa pad+ma'i 'dab ltar 'jam zhing mnyen pa/ tshul khrims dri 8

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4ma med pa'i 'bras bur 'khrungs pas sku gtsang zhing dag la tsan+dan las kyang lhag pa'i dri bsung ldang ba/ thugs rgyud ting nge 'dzin gyi bde bas gang bas zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dwangs shing rnyog pa med pa/ sku brjid cing lhun chags la bag dro ba/ rtag tu zab mo'i de nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa'i shes rab kyi snang ba mi 'phrog pa mnga' bas sku'i gzi brjid zil gyis mi non pa/ mchog gi ye shes rnam par rgyas pas zhal ras pad+ma 'dab ma brgya pa ltar rgyas pa/dam pa'i chos kyi dga' bde mtshungs pa med pa la rol pas shin tu dgyes pa'i nyams can/ dus drug tu gdul bya'i 'jig rten la gzigs pa mi g.yel bas spyan yangs shing ma zum pa/ rtsol ba med pa'i thugs rje chen po shugs 'byung du mnga' bas glang po che'i gzigs stangs can/ sku tshe dpag tu med par mchod sbyin chen po mdzad pas phyag ring zhing rgyas la dpag bsam gyi lcug ma ltar mdzes pa/ phyag stabs dang phyag mtshan ni rang gang 'dod kyi dngos grub la ltos te gcig tu ma nges kyang / 'dir gang bsam gyi 'dod don thogs pa med par stsol bas g.yas mchod sbyin dang /ting 'dzin dgongs rgyud dag pas byin gyis rlob pa'i rten 'brel du g.yon mnyam bzhag /thun mong ba tshe dang shes rab kyi dngos grub stsol bas tshe bam dang pa snyi/ bla med phyag rgya chen po'i dngos ra༅ rabye9

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/grub sbyin pas rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa/ skal ldan slob ma'i tshogs rnams sdom pa gsum gyi tshul khrims la bkod de shes rgyud rnam par dag pa'i bka' drin mdzad pas chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba sogs dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i cha lugs can/thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sde snod rab 'byams la dbang sgyur ba'i chos kyi rgyal po'i cod pan 'dzin pa'i rtags su paṇa zhwa rna ring mnabs pa/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal srid las gzhan du mi g.yo bas zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung dang sku drang por bsrang ste bzhugs pa/ sku'i ba spu'i ba ga rer yang til gyi gang ba kha phye ba rig3 rabargyalta bu'i rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams rdzogs pa/ gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi rnga bo che las skad cig rer yang dam pa'i chos kyi char zad med du 'bebs pa/ thugs 'od gsal rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi dbyings su mkha' khyab kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ro mnyam rdo rjer gyur pa/ zhal mthong ba tsam gyis tha mal pa'i rnam rtog gcod pa/ spyan gzigs pa tsam gyis byin rlab kyi zil chen 'bebs pa/ thugs dgongs gtad pa tsam gyis ye shes btsan thabs su 'char ba/ rjes su dran ma thag tu thugs rje'i shugs g.yo ba/ gcig chog skyabs gnas yongs kyi rgyal por mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par bltas la yang yang gsal 10

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4gdab cing yid rtse gcig tu gtad par bya ste/ tshogs zhing mngon sum du bya ba dang bla ma rang sems dang sre ba'i bye brag cig kyang yin no/ /de nas de la yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba ni/ rang gi lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul nas mkha' mnyam gyi 'gro ba rnams dang lhan cig lag pa thal mo sbyor zhing lus kyi gnas lnga sa la btud ngag bstod tshig dbyangs su len/ yid dad gus kyi shugs byung ba'i phyag thog mar bya ste/ 'jig rten na yul mchog rnams mthong ba'i tshe dang por phyag stob pa lugs yin no/ /mchod pa'i tshe/ lus dang longs spyod kun bzang mchod sprin 'bul/ /zhes pa 'di la/ dngos 'byor lus dang longs spyod/ yid sprul kun bzang mchod sprin zhes so sor bshad tshul dang / rang gi lus dang longs spyod thams cad kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin du byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul zhes bshad tshul gnyis yod/ kun bzang mchod sprin zhes pa ni/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i zhing khams thams cad mchod rdzas kyis gtams pa dang / de dag gi rdul phran re la yang nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i mchod sprin gtibs pa dang / mchod pa de dag gi 'od zer kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad gang ba'i yo byad kyi char 'bebs pa sogs mdo sde las gsungs pa ltar ro/ /mchod pa'i nang nas lus dbul 11

pod/ shrī'i r+shar+sha rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba'i mchod pa ni/ dpal kha sbyor thig ler/ deng nas brtsams te rlo bdag bran du/ /khyod la bdag ni yongs su 'bul/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa bzhin te/ 'dis dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' bcag pa dang / thugs dkrugs pa sogs nyes pa lci ba mang po yang byang nus par bka' gdams gong ma rnams dang 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa sogs bzhed la/ kun mkhyen chen pos sems nyid ngal bsor yang bsngags pa cher mdzad pa ltar yin pas bsam pa thag pa nas byed pa lhag par gal che/ spyir lus 'bul tshul la yang /bran gyi tshul du 'bul ba dang bdud rtsir byas te 'bul ba'i tshul gnyis yod pa sogs shes par bya/ tshe rabs kyi sdig pa dang khyad par bla ma'i spyan sngar sdom pa gsum gyi tshul khrims la 'di khas ma blangs bya ba med cing / lag len la thug dus lug zhing gseb tu btang ba ltar kha ral sna zag las blo gdeng khel ba gcig kyang med pa de byin rlabs 'jug pa'i sgo 'gaṭa pa yin pas/ sdig ltung sngar byas gnong 'gyod drag pos bshags shing / phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi byed snyam pa'am/ ma mtha' ci nus su 'dzem snyam pa yan chad kyi sdom sems bsten/ bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis dam pa'i chos bstan pa/ chos kyi mdzod bzung ba/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing sbyangs ba/ sems can smin grol du mdzad 12

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4pa/ ye shes kyi sgo tshad med pa sgrub pa la sogs pa'i tshogs gnyis kyi spyod pa 'bras bu dang bcas pa thams cad la rin po che'i gter rnyed pa ltar dga' zhing snying nas rjes su yi rang ba dang /'jig rten na khyim dang zhing dang phyogs gzhan pa'i las kyi mtha 'a thams cad nyin mo'i snang ba la brten nas 'byung ba ltar/ mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi bde ba rgyu dang bcas pa mtha' dag ni bla ma'i gsung dam pa'i chos kyi snang ba gcig pa'i mthu la rag las pas gdul bya'i 'jig rten la thugs brtse bas chos kyi rnga bo che rgyun mi chad par brdung ste/ 'gro ba thams cad byang chub mchog gi go 'phang la bzhag tu gsol zhes bla ma la lha rdzas kyi gser sbyangs las grub pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong pa phul te gsol ba gdab pa dang / de lta bu'i gsung gi phrin las de yang pi waṃ gi rgyud dang de'i sgra dbyangs bzhin du sku la brten shā yin pas phyi ma'i mu mthar thug gi bar du sku'i snang ba mi sdud par bstan pa rgya mtsho'i dpal du bzhugs par rdo rje'i gdan khri phul te gsol ba dang / de dag gis mtshon pa'i dus gsum gyi dge tshogs thams cad rang gzhan yid can mtha' dag bla ma sangs rgyas rin po ches 'bral ba med par theg pa mchog gi lam du rjes su 'dzin pa dang /des ji ltar gdams pa'i bka' bzhin sgrub pa dang / bsgrub pa 13

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mthar son te thams cad gzigs pa'i go 'phang la reg pa'i rgyur snying nas smon zhing bsngo ba rnams re re bzhin gnad la thebs par bya ste/ bla ma bsten thabs la bsam sbyor gnyis las sbyor ba rnyed pa dang bkur snyi dang rim gro'i sgo nas bsten tshul sogs kyi don yang 'dir tshang ngo / /'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa'i sngon 'gror maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal gyi gzhi dang / tshom bur 'god rgyu'i 'bru sman rin chen gang 'byor/ ba byung gi chu sog/sa legs par 'du byas la/ gzhi byi dor bya zhing re khā 'bri ba/ ba byung byugs pa/ tshom bu rnams phyogs ma 'khrul zhing mdzes par 'god tshul phyag len ltar dang / so so'i thad du dmigs pa yid byed kyi khyad par sogs rnam bshad rnams las shes par bya 'di ni tshad yongs su chad pa med pa'i mchod pa zhes mchod pa thams cad kyi rgyal por bsngags pas gal po che'i gnad du bzung ste/sla las dang khral chos su ma song bar ci mang 'bul/ bla rnam ched gtad kyis sgom dus yin min gang ltar yang dbang thob nas nyin re dus gsum du bla ma la dngos sam yid kyis maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba chag na thun grangs kyi sbom po'i ltung ba skyed pas brjed du mi rung /ngag 'don gyi tshig ni sngags kyis 'bal tshal jo bo'i chos chang skor rabye rab ༄byin bzhugs pa dang / chos rgyal 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa 14

〉khur chos zug:re :do95 khur/sgrozing stonazugabazhi ceskucad stegorngasno (petha/ 21khyud/ pe'iyongs grags dang / klong chen chos spyod las 'byung ba lta bu gang byed 'dra'o/ /gsol gdab dngos la/ dper na phur bas gcig tu btsugs nas rdo tho lta bus drag tu brdung na gting ring du zug 'gro ba ltar/ bla ma'i rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la byin rlabs zhu ba'i dmigs 'dun rtse gcig tu btsugs nas mos gus gdung shugs drag pos 'phul brdeg byas na thugs rje smon lam gyi gting slong nus pa byang bas phur tshugs su gsol ba gdab pa zhes rir /༷༷/ /bye/shā //rngo| hāX/gsungs te dbang dang byin rlabs d+ngha da du da gas pa ༄ 'dun pa hur re ba'i ngang nas mos gus kyi shugs ci thon byed pa yin no/ /mos gus med par mig btsum thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs lo dang / byin gyis rlob lo'i tshig skam phreng bar bgrang zhing brgya stong sogs bsags kyang ras la 'byar rtsi ma thebs na tshon mi 'dzin pa ltar byin rlabs 'go ba'i yul med cing / mos gus kyis blo gtad ling bskyur nus na lus ngag gi rnam rig de 'dra rtsal du ma bton yang / chos rnams sngon du yid 'gro zhing / /yid gtso yid ni mgyogs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dgos don 'grub pas/ dpal sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ bla ma bsten thabs mos gus yin te zhe sa min/ /bla ma sgrub thabs mos gus yin te gsol 'debs min/ /mos gus yod na ji ltar byas kyang 15

stuXs/ spre'i lngardo grub 'jigs med bstan nyilnga/ gsung 'bum/byin rlabs 'jug /mos gus med na ji ltar byas kyang phan pa med//ces gsungs/ de'ang spyir bla ma de bzang po zhig yin nges snyam pa'am/ de bdag la bka' drin che snyam pa tsam yod kyang / de la rgyun ring du ma goms shing sems kha gting med par 'dres ma thub na/ bla ma'i byin rlabs kyang so nam gyi tshod ka'i lo tog cig las mi 'byung bas/ 'du 'dzi ci chod dang g.yeng ba ci khegs byas nas/bla ma'i rnam thar min pa'i bsam rgyu dang / mos gus sgom pa min pa'i byed rgyu med pa/ 'phral gyi bde thabs dang gtan gyi 'dun ma gang la yang thabs gzhan mi 'tshol bar/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pas/ 'chi ba'i dus la babs kyang sla/ /srid pa ru log gyur kyang sla/ /mos gus dkar po gcig thub 'di/ /thabs kyi nang nas thabs mchog yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'di kho na la blo gtad chig dril nus pa zhig dgos/ der ma zad bla ma de bzang po yin snyam pa dang / bka' drin che snyam pa'i yid byed zlum gong de tsam yun ring du bsgoms kyang dad gus kyi 'gyur ba shugs drag skyed mi thub pas bla ma'i yon tan sgo du ma nas sems pa dang / phyogs mang po nas bka' drin che ba'i tshul rnams bsam pa ni mos gus sbyang thabs kyi gtso bo yin pas tshal de sdong ༄po bkod pa'i 'phags pa dpal 'byung gi rnam thar dang / kun 16

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4mkhyen chos rje'i gzhung yid bzhin mdzod dang / sems nyid ngal gso rtsa 'grel sogs bltas la shes par bya'o/ /de dag gzhung rang gi tshig ris dang sbyar nas mdo tsam brjod na/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs/ zhes pa nas/ mkhas grub dbang po/ zhes pa'i bar gyis/ yon tan rjes su dran tshul bstan la/ de'i sgo nas bla ma nyid dran pa dngos ni/ dpal ldan bla ma la/ zhes pas bstan/de ltar bla ma la dmigs nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rkang pa tha mas bstan to/ /rkang pa dang po gnyis kyi don la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i 'chad tshul mang tsam byar yod kyang mi spro la/rags rim tsam du gnyis las/ phyogs dang po thun mong ltar bshad na/ 'jig rten pa'i tshong khe spogs/ khyim gyi las thabs/dgra 'dul gnyen skyong sogs dang / de dag las khyad par 'phags pa'i rig gnas sgra sman snyan rtsis sogs slob pa la mtshan nyid kun ldan gyi bla ma 'tshol mi dgos te/ de dag phyi rol pa tshun chad kyi nang na ches mkhas par shes pa mtha' yas pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /rang yang de 'dra la mkhas pa'i go 'phang lan grangs dpag med cig 'khor bar 'khor dus thob kyang tha mal pa'i sa nas 'phags ma nus/ gtan bde'i go 'phang sgrub lugs dang /lhag par rang gzhan mtha' dag bde ba'i mchog dang sprod pa'i 17

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lam ma nor ba zhig 'khor ba thog med nas da lta'i bar du rnyed ma myong zhing / da dung yang rnyed dka' bas de'i ched du 'bad pa chen pos bla ma bsten pa yin/ de la sngon 'gro blo ldog rnam bzhi nas bzung ste/ myur lam gsang ba bla med kyi bar gyi mngon mtho'i lam dang / nges legs kyi lam dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam thun mong ba dang khyad par ba dang mthar thug pa'i bar thams cad ma nor ba dang / lhag chad med pa dang / gong 'og ma 'chol ba dang nyams su len lugs kyi gnad thams cad gsal bar bstan nas/ rang gis bka' bzhin sgrub nus na sangs rgyas kyi sa la thaṭa thogs med par 'gro chog nges kyi phrin las rgya cher mdzad pa'i tshul la zhib tu bsam na/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i mkhyen rab phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas rang gi mdun 'dir gzugs grub tu byon yang de bas zab pa dang / de bas rlabs che ba dang / de las gya nom pa'i chos shig bshad du med la/ rang gi ngos nas go ma chod pa ma gtogs/ bla mas ji skad gsungs pa bzhin byas na 'khor ba dang ngan song nas zhi bde'i rgud pa phra mo'i bar gyi 'jigs pa mtha' dag las tshe 'di kho nas kyang 'da' thub pas/ rgyal ba'i zhing khams thams cad na mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa zhes snyan par grags pa 'phags mchog 18

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4'jig rten dbang phyug lta bus kyang thugs rje phrin las de bas lhag pa mdzad rgyu ma mchis shing / dmyal bar ri gzar gyi rbab ltar shugs drag tu rgyug pa'i sems can 'gro phyogs gtan bzlog ste sangs rgyas kyi sa la dpag chen mda' ltar 'phen pa'i nus mthu ni mthu stobs kyi che bar byed pa gzhan dang mi mnyam ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams kyang dgongs pa 'di kho na'i ched du 'jug pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsung gi phrin las kyi nus mthur ma zad gsang sngags bla med kyi ye shes grub pa'i slob dpon 'di lta ba mthong ba ༄dang / thos pa dang / yid la dran pa'i sems can rnams kyang rdo rje 'chang chen po dngos ltar phyag bya ba'i gnas su rgyud sde las gsungs pas sems can sgrol ba'i nus mthu'i tshad 'di tsam zhes bsam par dka'o/ /nus pa'i ye shes zhes pa ni mngon shes drug dang dbang bcu lta bu yin no/ /mdor na 'o skol rnams la rgyal ba sras bcas kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa dang mdzad pa mtshungs pas na de dag gcig tu bsdus pa zhes bya'o/ /phyogs gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa ltar bshad na/ dbang bskur ba'i dus su/ de ring phyin chad bu a kyi/ /rnam par snang mdzad nga yin pas/ /zhes sogs lha thams cad la 'dod pa spos nas 19

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gsungs pa ltar shes par bya ste/ dper na gar mkhan gyis cha byad dang rnam 'gyur gzhan dang gzhan du bsgyur nas skye bo mang po mgo rmongs par byed pa'i gar gyi rol pa ston yang gar mkhan gcig las ma 'das pa bzhin du sngags kyi lha'i rab dbye byed tshe/rigs brgya rigs lnga rigs gsum/ zhi dang khro chags phra men de bzhin gshegs pa dang byang sems khro bo yab yum sogs rigs dang dkyil 'khor mtshan dang rnam 'gyur tshad med par snang yang /gdul bya'i dbang gis gang 'dul gyi gzugs su shar bar zad kyi/'char gzhi ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi dgongs klong rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes gcig pur gnas te/ rgyud las/ gang du bde chen zhes bya gcig pu nyid/ /gcig pu'i nyams ni du ma'i gar mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis rigs dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ye shes ma lus pa rtsa ba'i bla ma'i ye shes kho na la 'dus pa yin no/ /gzhan yang / phyogs bcu dus gsum du so sor byon pa'i sangs rgyas grangs mtha' blos mi thag pa bzhugs shing / de snyed kyi ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa ༄ yod kyang yul chos kyi dbyings la tha dad med pas thams cad kyang dpal ldan bla ma'i ye shes kyi chos nyid mkha' ltar dag pa'i dbyings su chu klong thams cad rgya mtshor gcig tu 'dres pa ltar ro 20

ra〉 chos zug:re :de95 'o//gluzang stonazugabasu 6pecad /byetshod (peb/ 2sprorngad/ spre'igacig tu song ba la dgongs nas gter phyogs bla sgrub las/ rgyal ba thams cad ye shes klong du gcig /ces sogs gsungs te/dkon mchog brtsegs par/ bzang po rgyal ba gcig la mchod byed na/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la ni mchod 'gyur te/ /'di ltar de dag nga yi chos dbyings dang / /tha dad bya ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang phyogs gcig go/ /de ltar rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi ye shes thams cad dpal ldan bla ma'i 'od gsal rnam par mi rtog pa'i dgongs klong gcig tu bzhugs nas slob ma'i rgyud byin gyis rlob pa 'di'i gnad kyis bla ma gcig pu mchod na mkha' khyab kyi sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par 'gyur bar gsungs te/ gsang snying las/ dbang phyugs longs spyod lngas mchod na/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad mchod pa yin/ /nye ba'i dkyil 'khor smos ci dgos/ /zhes sogs mang ngo / /'di dag ni rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa yin lugs dngos so/ /de dag gang yang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dpal ldan bla ma spyi khyab tu 'gro ba'i phyogs nas bshad pa yin la/ bye brag tu rje bla ma 'di nyid kyi than mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba la sbyar nas 'chad tshal ni/riri pho rig bya'og tu zur tsam gsal ba las shes kyi/ rgyas par ma bris te yi 21

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ge'i ngal ba la skrag cing sgyid lug par gyur to/ /ji skad bshad pa de lta bu'i zhing gi mchog de skabs 'dir su la byed ce na/ dpal ldan bla ma zhes gsungs te/ mos gus can gyi re ba yid bzhin du skong ba'i dngos grub kyi 'byor pa zad mi shes pa mnga' bas na dpal dang ldan pa/ gu ru zhes pa'i sgra las drang na yon tan gyis lci bas sam/ zhing gi gong mar bkur ba'i yul gyi gtso bo yin pas na bla ma ste/ gong du mtshan bkra gsal ba ltar/ ngor chen byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin gyis gsol ba'i mtshan 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / rmog ston 'jigs bral chos dbyings rdo rje dang / 'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gus gsol ba'i mtshan 'jigs med mkhyen brtse'i zlos gar/ byang chab thags bskyed kyi mtshan blo ༄ ༄gros rgya mtsho dri ma med pa'i 'od/ paṇa chen bi ma la'i 'khrungs rabs dang sbyar ba 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje/ mnga' bdag tshangs pa lha'i me tog gi 'khrungs rabs kyi phyogs dang bstun pa 'jam dpal chos kyi bshes gnyen/ kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer dang rnam dbyer med pa'i mtshan rdo rje gzi brjid rtsal/ dus gsum mkhyen pa o rgyan chen pos gter ston grub thob rgya mtsho'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i chos kyi rgyal srid la dbang bskur ba'i mtshan/22

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa sogs sku gcig la mtshan mang por grags pa de'o/ /de'i rnam thar phyogs tsam mdor bsdus nas bstan pa ni/ mkhas grub dbang po/ zhes pa ste/ spyir rgya gar rdo rje gdan du song bar khas 'che yang lam rgyus bshad rgyu med pa'i mi zhig yod na/ de la lam mkhan bcol nas rdo rje gdan du 'gro thag mi chod/ de bzhin du sangs rgyas dang grub thob sogs su khas len byed kyang lam gang nas grub pa'i go 'phang la bgrod pa'i lam de'i thog mtha' bar gsum gyi rgyus mtha' dag la mkhas pa zhig mi 'dug na de la yid ches blo gtad bya bar mi btub/ rgya gar gyi lo rgyus mang po bshad rgyu yod kyang kho rang der 'gro ma myong na de la'ang rnam pa thams cad du lam la mi 'khrul ba'i blo gdeng khel dka'/ de bzhin du gzhung lugs mang po shes pa'i mkhyen rgya yod kyang sgom sgrub kyi srang la btegs nas nyams myong gi drod tshad gtan la phebs pa med na rtogs pa don brgyud kyi bde lam nas myar por bkri ba'i mthu med pas mkhas grub kyi yon tan gnyis nor cedrorto /re/ shā)( /rje) rmoje snyeXrde' ne+em pa ga rtsa ba bla mar —da dgos/ la btsun bla ma 'di nyid mkhas pa'i rnam thar gyi dbang du byas na/ dang po sku bltams pa'i dus nyid nas slob dpon chen po legs ldan 'byed dang / nags kyi rin chen sogs 'phags yul pa dang / mnga' 23

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bdag khri srong dang / rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen pad+ma dbang rgyal sogs bod yul gyi mkhas grub du mar 'khrungs pa'i sngon gnas gsal bar dran zhing / chos thams cad rdol shes su mkhyen pas bslab grar ma zhugs gong du'ang chos kyi lo rgyus dang /grub mtha'i rnam bzhag /zhal gdams nyams dbyangs sogs tshig sgros gtsang zhing don legs pa kho na thogs med du rtsom pa la sogs pa skyes thob kyi yon tan rmad du byung bas 'jig rten ngo mtshar bar byed pa byung yang / sngon gyi dam pa rnams kyi spyod tshul dang mthun par bya ba dang / ma 'ongs pa'i skyes bu rnams la gdams ngag rnam thar gyi sgo nas ston pa'i slad du/ thos pa tshol ba la ches gus par mdzad de/ dgung lo gnyis gsum dus nyi grags phyogs kyi bla ma zhig gis sngon 'gro dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'chad kyin 'dug pa'i sar ma yum gyis khur nas phyin pas dgong mo tshur slebs rjes su'ang / shin tu dgyes pa'i nyams kyis ngo bo dal ba bsam pa/ khyad par 'byor pa bsam pa zhes sogs yang yang bskyar nas gsung bar grags shing / gzhan ku se ba'i a mye sogs/ sa gzigs la/ khyod la chos bshad rgyu e yod ces dngos ༄ rdzas phran tshegs rigs yab yum gyis ma tshor bar gnang nas dri bar mdzad/ sku rtsed thams cad dam pa'i chos nyan bshad sogs 24

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4kyi rnam pa 'ba' zhig tu 'byung bas/ sde dge tshe dbang rdo rje rig 'dzin gyis/ chos dga' dmar lte zhes bla dwags su gsol/ yab drung chen rin chen dbang rgyal dang / sde dge'i bla sman pa chos grags rgya mtsho/ zhe chen 'gyur med mthu stobs rnam rgyal sogs thun mong rig gnas la mkhas pa'i dam pa mang po'i drung du/ yi ge 'a bri klog dang rtsis dkar nag /gso rig rgyud bzhi yan lag dang bcas pa sku gzugs mchod rten sogs kyi thig dang cha tshad/sgra ka swa gnyis dang tsan+d+ra pa/ snyan dngags/ sdeb sbyor/ mngon brjod sogs mkhas pa'i phul du phyin par sbyangs shing / na len+d+ra'i gzim 'og sprul sku byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags dang / brag sgom zhabs drung dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas/bkra shis lhun po'idaka' chen blo bzang dge legs/ li thang dge bshes byams pa phun tshogs sogs sa dge'i mkhas pa du ma las/phar phyin/ dbu ma/ mngon pa mdzod/ tshad ma rnam 'grel/ jo bo'i lam rim/ theg chen blo sbyong gi skor mang po sogs gsan cing / bka' pod gyi rtsa gzhung phal cher dang / sman gyi rgyud bzhi sogs blo 'dzin gnang / smin gling mkhan chen rig 'dzin bzang po sogs dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su tshig gsum rim nod kyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos por 25

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bsgrubs te 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba sogs la zhib tu sbyangs/ ngor mkhan chen kun dga' bstan 'dzin dang / 'jam dpal bzang po/zhwa lu mchog sprul rin po che rin chen blo gsal bstan skyong / kun mkhyen blo gros mtha' yas sogs las bya rgyud rigs gsum/ rnam snang mngon byang / yo ga dpal rtse dbyings gsum/ bla med bde dgyes gsang gsum/ dus 'khor/ gshin rje'i gshed sogs gsang sngags gsar rnying thun mong ba dang / gsar ma'i skor gyi dbang / rgyud bshad/ sgrub thabs/ zab khrid/ las tshogs kyi man ngag dang bcas pa mtha' yas pa/ 'gyur med mthu stobs rnam rgyal dang / sgrol ston 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal mtshan/'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gu/ khyab bdag pad+ma dam chos 'od zer/rdo rje 'chang karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho sogs las mdo sgyu sems gsum/ bka' dgongs phur gsum/ snying thig gong 'og sogs snga 'gyar bka' babs kyi cha bo bzhi dang 'brel ba'i bka' ra mi ༄༄ gter gyi gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu/ mdor na gsang sngags rnying ma pa dang / sa ngor tshar gsum/ bka' gdams gzhung pa/gdams ngag pa/ man ngag pa ste brgyud srol chen po gsum/bka' rgyud che bzhi chung brgyad/ shangs chos pa/ zhi byed dang /gcod yul ba/ zhwa lu pa/ jo nang pa/ bo dong pa/ ri bo dge ldan 26

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4d+kud+kupa rnams kyi bka' srol la gzhung bshad/ dbang lung / khrid/snyan brgyud cha lag dang bcas pa gang yod thams cad grub mtha'i phyogs ris dang / cher rlom gyi khengs dregs/ skyo ngal dang chog shes sogs yong ye med par gsan cing / phal cher re re'am lan grangs mang por gsan/ de dag kyang 'ol tshod mun pa lag nom gyis btsal ba'i lugs ma yin par/ chos brgyud de dang de'i dam pa gong ma gsan rgya che shos rnams kyi gsan yig la zhib tu gzigs nas so sor chos kyi rnam grangs ji lta bu yod pa dang /deng sang chos brgyud ma nub par du yod/ rgyun de phyogs gang du bla ma su la gtugs na rnyed par 'gyur sogs rtog dpyod mdzad pa'i gzhir bsnyel tho 'bral spang zhig mdzad nas mdo khams dang /dbus gtsang / mon bod kyi mtshams la thug par sku tshegs dang chos sgug brel phongs sogs la mi gzigs par lo mang po'i bar du bung ba sbrang rtsi 'dod pa'i tshul gyis gshegs te legs par btsal/de'ang thob yig gi kha grangs mang ba tsam don du gnyer ba ma yin par gang gsan de 'dris par bslab/ mtshan mo'i mar me'i snang ba tshun chad la dpe cha gzigs/ bla ma'i drung du yang yang gtugs nas zhun thar bcad/ dpe rgyun dkon po rnams 'bad pa chen pos dpe bshu mdzad/ zhal shes gsung spros sogs phyag 27

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mchan dang brjed byang du btab/ sgrub pa'i me tog dang phyag rdzas kyi phud kyis bla ma mnyes par byas nas lan cig ma yin par gsol ba btab ste zhus pa sha stag yin/ lan re gsan pa'am gzigs pas kyang gdams ngag gi gnad phigs pa'i shes rab kyi rtsal bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' bas nyid kyi yongs 'dzin rnams kyang thugs phrogs te/ gtsang paṇa chen dpal ldan bstan pa'i nyi ma dang / zhwa lu mchog sprul rdo rje 'chang blo gsal bstan skyong sogs kyis 'jam dbyangs bla ma zhes ched du bsngags pa'i cod pan dkar po dbu la gsol/ gtsang stod sa chen phug par smrar seng gi sgrub pa mdzad tshe nyams dang rmi lam lta bu ma yin par rje btsan 'jam pa'i dbyangs me tog atal sngon po kha phye ma thag pa rig mi zir rgyu/rdo /gur gum gzhon nu lta bu'i 'od zer gyi drwa bas mdzes pa'i rnam par dngos su byon nas thugs kar thim ste byin gyis brlabs shing /slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med dang / ye shes zhabs sogs sa mthor bzhugs pa'i paṇa grub sngon byon mang po dang dngos su mjal nas chos kyi bdud rtsi bzhes te 'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs dang / 'phags pa'i longs spyod mnyam pa nyid brnyes/mdor na chos tshul phyogs med pa sbyangs/ mkhas pa 'jug pa'i lam srol mang po gzigs/ grub thob kyi brgyud pa mang po'i byin 28

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4rlabs zhugs/ zab rgyas kyi gdams pa mang po'i mdzod du gyur/thugs dam gyi lha'i zhal gzigs shing zab mo'i blo gros kyi gter kha byin/ nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu dam pa'i chos nyan bshad 'bri klog gi bya bas dus 'da'/ de'i dbang gis bstan pa thams cad kyi dpal mgon dang / skal bzang chos don gnyer ba rnams kyi re gnas/ sa gsum na sgron me 'dzin pa gcig pur gyur pa yin no/ /thos don sgrub pa snying por mdzad de grub pa'i go 'phang brnyes tshul la rje nyid tha ma'i mdzad pa ston du nye ba'i tshe/ nye gnas 'jam dbyangs legs pa'i blo gros la bka' gdams chos 'byung chen mo dang / rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar klog tu bcug nas/ gsan cing / rang nyid kyis kyang gzigs nas bya btang dang /dben pa kho na la dgyes pa'i stangs chen po mdzad/ de mthar sa lam gyi rnam bzhag 'ga' re dang / dus 'khor dang rdzogs chen sogs kyi lam phan tshun dod thub sgrig lugs sogs bka' bstsal ba'i 'phros su/ nga yang tshogs lam 'bring po tsam la slebs pa yin pa 'dra zhes gsangs pas mtshon te/ le btsan snying thig gi chibasi༅ sna (5 ridami lung bstan du/ gsang ba sus kyang brtags par dka' ba/ ltar snang tha mal pa rnams dang shin tu mnyam par spyod pa/ zhes sa/su ngas pa ltar dus thams cad du sba sa pa'i brtul zhugs kho na la 29

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gnas pas mkhas pa dang rnal 'byor pa che bar snyems pa dag gis kyang gting dpog dka' na/ ku ba'i tshig gu lta bu'i blo gros can bdag 'dras lta ci smos/ 'on kyang gser sa 'og tu yod na 'od nam mkha' la 'char zer ba'i tshul du phyogs tsam mthong thos su gyur pa las re re gnyis gnyis shig brjod na/ byis pa'i dus su rnal 'byor dbang phyug rdo rje dril bu pa dang / paṇa chen bi ma la mi tra/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan/ rgyal sras mchog grub rgyal po/gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug /'chi med thang stong rgyal po sogs su gyur pa'i tshul de ring gi skabs ltar dran par gsungs te/ don gyis byang chub brnyes zin du zhal bzhes gnang ba yin/ dgung lo bzhi par/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi rnam pa can gyis snying thig sgron ma bdun pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi pham phab bstsal/ lo brgyad bzhes dus snyun gyi tshor ba mi bzod pa bzhes tshul bstan pa'i rkyen las o rgyan rdo rje 'chang yab yum dngos su mjal te rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhing mtsho rgyal gyis yang phur sbrags ma'i zab sgrub gnang / bco lnga pa shing rta'i lor/ dngos dang nyams snang gang yin 'byed dka' ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi gsal snang brtan pa'i ngor/ dbus 'gyar rdo rje gdan gyi gtsug lag khang du slob dpon sto30

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4chen po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / theg rgyal rdzogs pa chen po'i chos kyi glegs bam gtad nas bstan pa thams cad kyi bdag por dbang bskur zhing nyid dang rnam dbyer med par byin gyis brlabs/ gtsug lag khang de'i sgo drung na me phung chen po zhig 'bar ba gzigs nas/ der dbang med lta bur zhugs pas rags lus lhag med du sbyangs/ bi ma la mi tra dngos yin snyam pa'i 'od skur lam me song ba gzigs/'di la rje rang gi bka' las/ nga lo bco lnga'i dus su 'phags yul rdo rje gdan gyi ke'u tshang rim dgu'i sgo drung du sbyin sreg byas tshe lus ngag yid gsum thams cad tshig /shul na 'od gsal gyi rig pa rkyang pa zhig lus 'dug /de nas bzung ste rig pa nyag gcig de ma gtogs gzhan gang yang mi 'dug /rtogs 'bul byed mkhan mang po byung ste/ nga dang mthun pa su ma byung zhes gsungs te/ 'di ni mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po ches/ lha lung gi brag la bya ltar lding / /ba gam can brag la byi ltar 'dzul/ /skyes pho mo 'gas grub thob grub thob zer/ /de grub thob kyi go ba da mi len/ /chos nyams blangs kyi nyams snang thob tsam yin/ /don 'pho 'gyur bral ba ma rtogs na/ /lus sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul bya byis ston/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ gsang sngags bla med spyi 31

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ dang / khyad par rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i man ngag gi gnad shes pas bltas na mchog gi dngos grub kyi rtse mor phyin pa yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan zhib par bshad du yod kyang / shin tu gsang ba'i gnas yin pas bzhag go/ /lo de'i phyi mar rnga yab gling du slob dpon chen po pad+mas ngo mtshar bka' babs kyi gsang mdzod bdun la dbang sgyur bar rdo rje'i lung gis bsngags shing /gter ston grub thob yongs kyi khyu mchog tu mnga' gsol/ de ltar na sngon nas lam bsgoms pas tshe 'dir rtsol med rang grub tu byung ba 'di lta bu la dam pa gong ma rnams rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor pa dang / rang byang gi grub thob ces gsangs te sku tshe 'dir dngos zir mi rig megrub sgrub pa'i ngal ba la mi ltos kyang gong du ji skad smos pa'i dgos dbang gzigs nas/ sku na gzhon dus klong chen snying thig gi sngon 'gro'i khrid sbyang rgyas par btang / slad nas gter phyogs sngon 'gro'i khrid dang / bka' gdams lam rim dang blo sbyong gi skor gung bsgrigs nas nyams bzhes kyi mthil du bzung / bya rgyud rig gsum spyi dang / rnam 'joms gdugs dkar sogs bye brag dang / rnam snang mngon byang / rdor dbyings/ kun rig /bde dgyes gnyis dang dus 'khor/ gu ru zhi drag skor mang po/ bka' brgyad dang phur ba lugs srol bcu dgu tsam/ mdo sgyu gnyis 3 2

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4sogs dkyil 'khor gyi lha mang po'i bsnyen pa sbyin sreg dang bcas pa rang rang so so'i brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes 'khrul med ltar mdzad/ de dag gi tshe yang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod brgyud pa'i bla ma dang bcas pas zhal bstan cing / rnal 'byor ma'i zhabs mtheb las byung ba'i bdud rtsis rdo rje gsum gyi lang tsho rgyas pa dang / 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo yi ge bcu pa'i sgra dbyangs can mngon sum du byon te/ thugs rgyud 'od gsal gyi dbyings su 'dres pas dgongs pa'i gter kha rdol ba dang / rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rjes sde gsum rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan pa gtad pa dang / rang byung pad+ma rgyal pos lan cig ma yin par dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa sogs rtsa gsum lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung ba'i rnam grangs mtha' yas kyang thugs sgam pas cher mi gsung / myur mdzad nag po chen po dang zhing skyong stobs 'phrog dbang po sku lus dang grib ma'i tshul du bzhugs nas phrin las thams cad bzhed pa bzhin sgrub/ sngags srung e ka tsa tis mkha' 'gro'i chos mdzod kyi glegs bam mang po dngos sa phal ba sogs rdo ༄༄rje'i chos srung thams cad bran bzhin byed/ byis pa ltar ma khengs shing 'grogs na bde ba'i ngang tshul can yin yang rang snang dbang du 'dus pa'i rten 'brel gyis lugs gnyis nas gzi brjid che 33

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bar snyams pa sus kyang gzi brjid mi bzod par zhum bzhin du 'dud/ rnyed bkur gyi phyir du bla ma 'tshong ba dang / mdun du chos zhu zhing phag tu skur zhu gtong ba dang / phrag dog gis gsol ngan 'dren pa sogs log sgrub mkhan ji snyed cig byung yang bag tsam thugs g.yos pa'i mtshan ma yang med par phyi phyir phan 'dogs pa kho na la dgyes/ che gnyan rnams kyis 'bul chen btegs pa na nga la sdig ro 'gel ba red ces mi dgyes shing /sprang po sogs kyis rdzas ngan ngon cig phul yang / 'di phyug po tshos brgya 'bul gyi dod yin/ a re sha tsha zhes phyag tu bzhes nas bsngo smon gnang ba sogs dman pa dang phongs pa la lhag par brtse bar mdzad/ res shig kong sprul rdo rje 'chang rdzong gsar du yun mi ring tsam bzhugs nas lo mjug dus gtor skabs rang gnas su phebs grabs mdzad pa gsan nas kong sprul rin po che re zhig bzhugs na chos 'chad nyan byed rgyu mang po yod de/ sku rim mang po dgos gsungs nas phebs rgyu yin skad/ khong lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa la srung rim gto chog rigs kyis ci bya/ nga rang tshos ni lus ngag yid gsum 'di sems can thams cad kyi glud du bsngos nas smon lam 'debs pa ma gtogs/ mi tshe 'di la rang don du glud mdzu gu tsam dang / gtor ma mtheb tshe gang yang bsngo ma myong 34

〈me chos zug:re dza/95 khur(5kān stonazug/ga :skucad /byetshod (petha/ 1sprorngad/ 〈benazhes gsungs shing / rgyal khams nang 'khrugs chen po zhig 'byung la nye ba'i tshe sde 'khrugs kyi sna 'dren byed pa'i 'byung po ma rungs pa rnams la nyid kyi sku tshe'i lhag ma lo brgyad zas skal du byin nas zhi bar mdzad pa sogs bdag bas gzhan gces kyi spyod pa 'ba' zhig lhur len/ gang du bzhugs kyang tshul khrims kyi dri bzang mtshungs pa med pa khor yug tu ldang zhing / gtum mo'i bde drod lhag par 'bar bas mgo rgyal gyi zla ba'i grang sgang la yang gzims spyil nang du tshad pa gzhung rgyas kyi dus ltar gos stan chig rkyang la brten dgos pa dang / thog khar kha ba babs tshad de ma thag zhu nas mi 'chag pa bsnyon med du mthong yang sngon dus khang dmar mdor gter chen mchog gling dang lhan cig ras 'bud btang zhing / 'khyaṭa pa zhu ba'i nus pa bstan pas der 'khod thams cad ngo mtshar du gleng ba na/ mi gson po'i lus la drod los yod/de la ya mtshan gang yang med ces gsungs par grags/ nyag dmag gis rdzong gsar dgon mes bsreg dus/ rje nyid bzhugs pa'i sku 'khris kyi skar khung nang nas mi lce dmar zing zing byung bar snyems med kho nar bzhugs pas de nyid du me zhi ste/ de phan chad kyi khang pa gzhan rnams kyang ma tshig pa dang / sde dge'i spar khang chen po'i gyang la rig 'dzin rdo rje drag rtsal gyi sku rten dang /35

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/phyag mtshan rdo rje sbas nas dgongs gtad mdzad pas mes ma tshig pa dang / dpal spung yang khrod du nyang gter khros nag gi dbang gnang dus bdud rtsi'i thod pa reg tu mi nus pa tsam du drod 'bar ba dang / dpal dge'i rdo ring mar grags pa'i rdo 'bum la rab gnas kyi dgongs pa mdzad tshe nyin lam lnga drug gis chod pa yin yang der lhag par gnas pa'i me tog char babs pa bzhin byung ba dang / rong me dkar mo stag tshang nas khros gter bzhes skabs ye shes kyi dgongs nyams 'ur te brtul zhugs cho rol gyi spyod pa mang po mdzad pa'i drung du/ sde dge sa dbang dpal ldan 'chi med rtag pa'i rdo rje bzhugs pa'i thong rtsa nas bsnams te brdeg grabs lta bu mdzad pa'i 'jigs zil gyi rkyen las bsam yas su gu ru rin po che dang rje 'bangs 'dus pa zhal 'dzoms nas gter sbed kyi phrin las mdzad pa'i sngon gnas yad yud cig dran zhes chos rgyal nyid kyis phyis su gsungs shing / de dus snyad 'dogs ma rnyed pa lta bus rten 'brel ma 'grigs pa ma gtogs brdung yag byed rgyu byung na rgyal srid la sked nyag mi 'ong ba yin zhes bka' gnang ba dang / mkhan po rin chen dar rgyas la phyag 'bebs gnang bas bar chad kyi 'phrang bsal te tshe tshad lung bstan pa 'dzol med du byung ba sogs dang / zhal ji srid 36

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4bzhugs ring bod yul du kla klo'i 'jigs pa med par lung bstan pa'i bden pa mngon du gyar pa sogs byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan ༄yang ci rigs bstan/ bla ma pad+ma bzang pos rtogs 'bul zhus par/ rdzogs pa chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye she sa tshig dang dpes mtshon dgos na dbang dus su me long 'ja' shel gyi brda la brten nas ngo sprod byas pa de las lhag pa bshad mi shes/ 'on kyang gsol ba thob cig dang nga la byin rlabs yod kyis zhes gsungs shing / yang lan cig/ khyed tshos gsol ba 'debs nus rgyu ma red ma gtogs/ nga shi yang byin rlabs chung du mi 'gro byin rlabs je cher 'ong gis zhes bka' mi 'gyur bas zhal gyis bzhes te/ mdor na 'ja' lus 'pho ba chen pos ye shes kyi skus bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa ma nub kyi bar du 'dzam gling 'di las gzhan du mi gshegs par 'tsho zhing gzhes la/ skal bzang mos gus can la dgongs brgyud kyi ye shes 'pho ba'i thugs dam skad cig kyang mi bsnyel ba'i tshul la yang yang bsam nges shes skyed/ blo snying gtad/ mos gus kyi nyams ci thon byas la yid gzhan du ma yengs par rtse gcig 'dun pa'i gzhur la drangs te gsol ba gdab cing / skabs ci rigs par rang sems bla ma la bsre ba'i tshul gyis shes pa khong glod de rang babs kyi ngang la 37

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bzhag cing ngal bso/ gsol 'debs kyi sngags la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ni bla ma'i sku gsung thags rdo rje gsum skul ba'i sngags yin la/ oṃ ༄byin rlabs 'byung ba/ āḥdangos grub stsol ba/ hūm̐ phrin las myur ba'i sngags su bshad tshul sogs gzhan mang yang / 'bru gsum 'di ka rig 'dzin bla ma spyi'i bsnyen sngags su gsungs pa'ang yod la/ mtshan sngags gzhan dang sbrags tshe/ thog mar sbyar ba dang /mtshan de 'bru gsum gyi sgrom nas bzla ba'i phyogs tha dad yod pa las 'dir phyi ma'o/ /gu ru ni bla ma ste sngar brjod zin/ mañdzu ghoṣa ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs te sbrel bas 'jam dbyangs bla ma'am bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes par 'gyur/ de'ang rje 'di mnga' bdag nyang dang / rad gling sogs kyi gter lung mang por 'jam dbyangs zhes pa'i mtshan sgras bstan te/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang gsang gsum dbyer med du gyur pa'i cha nas sam/ gtso bor gter lung mang po dang rnam thar sogs las rgyas par gsungs pa ltar 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa'i sku btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi skye mtha' yin pa'i phyogs nas bstan pa'o/ /da lta kho nar bi ma mi tra'i sprul pa'i skur bshad pa brjed dam/ khri srong dang bi ma la dus mnyam yon mchod yin pas gnyis kar ji ltar rung zhe na/ rgya mtsho chen po'i gting mtha' 38

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4zhed+ku'adzub mos tshol ba bya ba de 'dra la zer/ sangs rgyas mang po'i chos sku sprul pa'i sku gcig tu mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas gcig gi chos sku sprul pa 'i sku mang po la brten pa'i rnam gzhag rgyas par yod de spros pas chog go/ /der ma zad rgyal sras sa dang po thob pas kyang skad cig re rer sku'i bkod pa brgya/ 'khor brgya phrag bcas te ston pa sogs bshad pas bsam mi khyab bsam pa'i ngal ba mi bya ste/ mgo rmongs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /rnam grangs gzhan du 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes pa ni 'phags pa'i gang zag gcig cig kho nar mi bzung ste/ rgyal ba'i gnyis med ye shes kyi sku de la 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' zhes brjod pa yin pas/sangs rgyas pa dang / rgya 'gyur thams cad 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi ngo bor mngon par byang chub pa sha stag yin te/ de ltar na zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku brnyes pa nyid kyis 'jam dpal rdo rje'i ngo bor bzhag chog pas/ mtha' gcig tu sngon gyi 'khrungs rabs 'tshol ba'i 'bad pa la ltos dgos pa'ang min no/ /gang ltar yang bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi ngo bo nyid du bzhugs pas 'jam dbyangs bla ma zhes mtshan gsol ba yin gyi/ bram ze'i khye'u seng ge min yang / ming seng ge zhes btags pa lta bu ni gtan min no/ /de ltar gdung dbyangs kyis 39

lo/drarngan/ 〈co lngardo sdo/ba 'o/:drob/sa byasgorngasno bshāstan nyi6( gasdo/nga 'o/dra/phyo//mtshan nas bos te zhu rgyu ci yod snyam na/ sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ zhes pa dngos grub thams cad stsol cig pa ste/ dngos grub la mchog thun mong gnyis/ thun mong la las phra mo'i dngos grub dang / grub pa chen po brgyad sogs mang du yod/ tshig btsan pa/ 'khor mang ba/longs spyod che ba/ g.yul las rgyal ba sogs kyang dngos grub kyi grangs su yod mod de/ rang cag 'dra ba la de rnams thob kyang phung 'tsheng gang gi gzhir 'gro cha med pas/ thag mkhan rkang lag brgyad pa'i gtam rgyud ltar ma song bar gtan tu 'tsheng nges kyi dngos grub gcig zhu dgos/ de la sna kha mang ba mi gtso/ gcig chog snying po gcig la mthil gtad dgos pas/ bla ma'i byin rlabs rang rgyud la zhugs/ rang gi sgo gsum bla ma dang 'dres nas/bla ma'i 'od gsal thugs kyi thig ler mngon par byang chub par mdzad pa zhig dpal ldan bla ma khyed rang mkhyen no zhes sngar ltar phur tshugs su gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /rjes la dbang blang ba ni/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas bla ma nyid shin tu dgyes shing thugs rje'i shugs lhag par g.yos te dbang dang dngos grub stsol ba la phyogs par gyur pa'i spyi bor sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin oṃ yig dkar po/ mgrin par gsang rdo rje'i rang ༄bzhin āḥdamar po/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin hūṃ sngon 40

ra〉 chos zug:re :de95 khuradresazeng stonazugathag 6pezud /gerngasno (petha/ 21tshad/ khungapo rnams gsal btab/ oṃ las 'od zer zla ba shar ba lta bu dang bdud rtsi 'o ma'i rgyun ltar dkar ba byung / rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs shing spyi gtsag lus kyi thig le la thim/ lus kyi sgo nas ༄bsags pa'i sdig ltung nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag /khyad par du lus la ma dag par snang zhing zhen pa'i cha rnams sbyangs/shin tu rnam par dag pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku rdo rje sprul sku 'grub pa'i nus pa rgyud la bzhag pa'i tshul gyis bum dbang thob/ de bzhin du mgrin par gsung rdo rje dang / ā dmar po dang / 'od zer nyi ma 'char kha'i mdog can dang / bdud rtsi dmar po/ rang gi mgrin pa'i ngag gi thig ler dang / ngag sgrib dang / ngag gi snang zhen dang / gsung rdo rje longs sku zhes dang / gsang dbang zhes 'don pa bsgyur ba dang / thugs kar thugs rdo rje'i hūṃ sngon po/ 'od zer dang bdud rtsi mthing zhun gyi kha dog can/ snying ga'i yid kyi thig ler/ yid kyi sdig ltung nyams chag /yid kyi snang zhen thugs rdo rje chos sku/ sher dbang zhes bsgyur ba dang /gnas gsum gyi ye ge thams cad las 'od zer dang bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing gsum mnyam du byung / rang gi gnas gsum du dus gcig la zhugs shing thim/ sgo gsum cha mnyam gyi dri ma bag chags thams cad dang bcas pa gtor zhing sbyangs/ sangs 4 1

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rgyas kyi rdo rje gsam dbyer med pa'i zang 'jug ye shes rdo rje ngo bo rig mi ༄༄༄menyid sku 'grub pa'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag pa'i sgo nas dbang bzhi ba thob par bsam/ 'di ni sngar bla ma las dbang bskur thob nas sdom pa'i rgyun ma btang bar yod pa de nyid nus pa gong 'phel du byed pas lam gyi dbang zhes bya la/ mang du blang na nyams chag skong ba dang / byin rlabs 'jug pa'i thabs kyi rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /ting 'dzin dbang len 'di dag ci tsam du dmigs pa gsal zhing brtan pa de tsam du nus pa che bas/ dal pos gsal btab cing mos pa yid byed the tshom dang bral bar bya ba gal che'o/ /dbang gi ye shes dngos sam rjes mthun gyi nus pa ci riṭa skyes pa rnams lhag par rtsal rdzogs shing brtan par bya ba'i ched dang / gtso bor dbang bzhi ba'i rjes 'brel du thugs yid sre ba ni/ bla ma nyid 'od kyi thig le dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can/ snum la 'dril ba/ dwangs shing gsal la 'od zer kha dog lnga 'bar ba/ phra ba'i dbang du byas na yungs 'bru'am sran ma lta bu/ yangs pa'i dbang du btang na chos kyi dbyings kyis khyab tshad shong ba tshad 'di tsam zhes bsam par dka' ba'i gzugs su gyur nas rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ snying dbus mi shigs pa'i thig ler thim pas mthar thug don gyi bla ma brjod bral gnyug ma sems 42

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4kyi rdo rje/ don dam 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i rang zhal/tshig dang yid dpyod kyi shun pas ma bsgribs par rjen ne mthong byung snyam du mos pa brtan po bzhag ste/ lam 'bras/ phyag chen/rdzogs chen sogs sngar rang nyid gang la 'dris cha che ba'i grub thob kyi man ngag bzhin gnas lugs zab mo'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag /de las ldang ba na/ bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i lam khyer gsum gyi man ngag dang / le'u bdun ma'i bla ma sku gsum ma'i zab khrid sogs las 'byung ba bzhin rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo gshis brjod med/ mdangs 'gag med/ rtsal mos gus su dung nge ba'i ngang ma shor bar byas la/ snang grag rig gsum de ka'i rang snang / dpal ldan bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rnam rol 'ba' zhig tu blta ba bslab cing / dga' brod rlom sems sogs dang ma 'dres pa'i mos gus rnam par dag pa'i rgyas gdab/ stan thog gcig tu bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pas mtshon dus gsum gyi dge ba mtha' dag rang gzhan sems can thams cad chos rje bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che yang yang mthong ba dang / sangs rgyas su ngo shes pa dang / de'i gdams ngag gi snod du 'gyur ba dang /zab dang rgya che'i lam gyi gnad thams cad tshang bar ston pa dang /ji skad bstan pa bzhin du 'bad pa thams cad kyis nyams su 43

la/sdojid/ shrī'i lngardo sdo/ba khu/:drogs cesarngasno brtagan nyilnga/ ba/ṭa/nga 'o/dra/skya//blangs te/ ring por mi thogs par kun bzang chos rje bla ma'i thugs klong du rnam par grol ba dang / tshe 'dir btsan sa ma zin na 'chi khar rang dbang 'phrog pa'i gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal dang / chags sdang gi yul rkyen ngan pa sogs mi 'byung bar rang sems bla ma la sre ba'i ting 'dzin lhag par las su rung ste 'chi ba 'od gsal la brtan pa thob pa dang / de ma thob par srid pa bar dor 'khyams na bla ma rjes su dran zhing sku'i snang ba dang mjal nas mkha' spyod sogs rig pa 'dzin pa'i zhing khyad par can du khrid de lam gyi 'phro rdzogs par byed cing ston 'khor dgongs pa dbyer med du 'tshang rgya ba'i rgyur bsngo bas mtshams sbyar/ thun mtshams thams cad du'ang / bla ma'i bka' drin dang yon tan ston pa'i mdo bstan bcos blta zhing don la bsam zas za ba na phud kyis bla ma mchod cing khrid gzhung gzhan ltar bla ma nyid mgrin pa'am snying khar spyan drangs la bza' btud tshogs mchod du shes pas longs spyod/ gang du 'dug kyang dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs drung na gnas pa'i 'du shes kyis bag med kyi spyod pa spangs la sgo gsum tshul khrims la ci tshad bya/ nyal ba na snying ga'i dab raring rig mima'i nang du bla ma'i sku shin tu phra ba mar me ltar 'od gsal ba bzhugs pa la sems gtad de gnyid kyi rnal 'byor bsgom/ dus 44

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4d+kunam yang bla ma la dad pa med cing sdang ba dang dam sel yod pa'i mi dang mi 'grogs/ bla ma'i mtshan brjod pa na yang / bla ma lnga bcu par/ de yi mtshan smos brjod na ni/ /ming mthar zhal snga ldan par bya/ /gzhan dag gus par bya ba'i phyir/ /khyad par can gyi tshig dag brjod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ gus pa ma bskyed pa dang / rje bla ma'am/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang zhes pa lta bu'i tshig ma sbyar bar mi brjod pa sogs/ mdor na thun dang thun mtshams kyi dge sbyor phra mo nas phan tshun grogs su 'gro ba la bslab par bya'o//'khor ba'i 'brog dgon las dang nyon mongs dang / /sdug bsngal gcan gzan khro bos gang ba 'dir/ /yid 'byung skyes na thar nga/'i grong mchog tu/ /bgrod pa'i lam ston bla ma nyag gcig las/ /blo gtad re ltos gzhan du yod min pas/ /gnyen grogs srid sde gyod dang tshong khe sogs/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba ngan pa rgyang bsrings te//mos gus bla ma'i lam la mi tshe skyol/ /phyug kyang thams cad bzhag nas lag stong 'gro/ /dar yang stong sde'i nang nas gcig pur 'khyar/ /btsan yang las kyis khrid nas dbang med 'phyan/ /tshe 'di'i phun tshogs dngos kun de 'drar zad/ /skyid kyang mi 'tsheng skyid ske 'chi bas gcod/ /sdug kyang mi phung tshe mjug dgun nyi 'dra/ 'chi bdag rgyal po nam 'ong mi she sa kyis/ /rang mgo ma 45

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'khor gtan gyi 'dun ma soms/ /gang na'ang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i nyi 'od 'grib/ /sdig spyod las kyi mun pa je gnag 'ong / /lam ston dam pa phal cher zhi bar gzims/ bsams shing bsams na skyo ba'i yul du mthong / /skyo bar dgongs na don med bya ba bor//don ldan las la snying stobs cher bskyed dang / /'brel bas bsdus tshad thugs rjes rjes 'dzin cing / /dad pas 'jus tshad bde nas bder 'khrid la/ /skal ba dman pas zhal mthong rnyed dka' ba/ /'jig rten gsum gyi yid bzhin nor gcig pu/ /'di 'drar mjal ba bgo skal ma pham gyis/ /mos gus sgom la rtse gcig gsol ba thobs/ /bla ma gdos bcas lus su mi bzhugs kyang / /ye shes sku la bgres rgud 'das grongs med/ /mtshan dang rnam 'gyur gcig cig bsdus zin yang / /thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul gzhar yang zad mi shes/ /cha bar mig sngar mthong ngam mi mthong ༄༄yang / /mkhyen brtse'i spyan ras sgrib g.yogs ma mchis kyis/ /the tshom spongs la mos gus bskyed mdzod dang / /mi bslu nges par bden pa'i thugs dam lags/ /dad pas khams gso bla ma'i rnam thar la/ /rab dga' rgyas pas nyin mtshan bde bar 'da'/ /srid zhi'i phan bde mtha' dag bla ma las/ /'thob par shes nas blo bde'i gdeng tshad rnyed/ /'chi tshe'ang skyabs mchog bla ma'i byin 46

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4 rlabs la/ /yid ches brtan pos 'jigs skrag zil gyis mnan/ /shi nas bla ma gar bzhugs dag pa'i zhing / /theg mchog chos kyi 'byor pas brgyan par 'gro/ /de ltar tshe 'di bde la phyi mar skyid//dus rnams kun tu 'tsheng ba'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /rnyed pa mang ste rnyed nas za ba nyung / /bsod nams ldan khyod tshim par bzhes su gsol/ /bdag kyang dam pa'i zhabs pad la bsten cing / /de yi zhal gdams bdud rtsis yid dbang sim/ /bla ma'i dbang gyur bka' bzhin sgrub pa yis/ /thugs zin g.yog po skyo ngal spang bar shog /bla ma'i rnal 'byor ye shes mchog stsol nyams su len tshul khrid yig du byas pa 'di ni/ chos 'di la nyams len mthil por 'dzin pa'i yid lhung lha ri bla ma karma nges don chos kyi rgya mtshos/ gser dang / sman tse yug /spos bam sogs gnang rten dang bcas snga phyir nan tan chen pos gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor/rje btsan bla ma dmigs pa med pa'i thags rje chen po dang ldan pa nigi ༅ riri byade'i zhabs kyi rdul spyi bos blangs shing / gsung gi bdud rtsi snying gi za ma tog du 'khyil ba'i rdo rong gi sprang po mkhos ngan yang skal ba bzang bar rlom pa/ 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas blo thog nas gang dran lhug par bris pa 'dis kyang 'gro kun dpal ldan bla mas rjes su 'dzin par gyur cig /sarba dā maṅgalam̐// //47
ma la nye ‘da du ban+d+ras bzhutha

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄/ /na mo gu ru bh+ya/ 'khor ba'i chu mtshor snying rje'i 'dab stong rgyas/ /de dbus ye shes lang tshor rab rdzogs pa/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas rdo rje gzi brjid rtsal/ /snying dbus zangs mdog dpal rir 'bral med bzhugs/ /ji skad du dgongs 'dus lung bstan bka' rgya mar rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling ba lung ston pa na/ 'brel tshad rig 'dzin zhing du 'phen pa 'byungaḥ zhes gsangs te/ gtso bor bla ma'i phyi sgrub yid bzhin nor ba la ri rib ri ribabarten nas 'brel tshad rig 'dzin gyi zhing du 'gro ba'i lung don mngon du gyur par gter 'byung dang / rnam thar chen mo las gsungs pas/ 'dir bla rnam 'di la dpal ri'i zhing du bgrod pa'i man ngag gi gnad ji ltar mthong ba rnams zin bris su bya ste/spyir gdul bya rab dang sbyar na bla sgrub 'di dngos gzhi'i nyams rtogs kyi sgo 'byed du 'gyur tshul kho na bshad dgos pa yin kyang /'dir gdul bya tha ma skye ba phyi ma la grol du re ba'i bsam ngo dang bstun nas brjod do/ /de la bcu gnyis las/dang po ni/ snang bas gar khyab pad+ma 'od kyi zhing dngos su sgom par gsungs pa de yin te/ de'ang rgya mtsho'i nang na sau ma pū ri dang ma la ya ste dag pa mkha' spyod dang mtshungs pa'i zhing gi mchog gnyis sogs ya mtshan dang 'jigs zil gnyis ka che ba'i 50
