bla rnam la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge/ pod/ 4srin po'i yul gling chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus na gnam sngon sa la 'khyil ba lta bu'i mtsho chen po yod/ de'i lte bar zangs mdog dpal ri che zhing mtho la lhun chags pa/ ngos rnams la lar srin po'i grong khyer dang / kha cig tu gzhal med khang nyams dga' ba/ gzhan du dur khrod kyi bkod pa/ dpa' bo ḍāk+ki tshogs kyi dga' ston la rtse ba sogs ngo mtshar du mas mdzes shing brjid pa'i steng gi mthil yangs shing rgya che ba la/ dpag bsam gyi nags tshal dang / bdud rtsi'i chu mig /zla ba nor bu'i brag ne'u sing me tog rgyas pa/ mkha' 'gro brda'i glu gar la mkhas pa'i bya dang bung ba khyus lding ba/ spu sdug ri dwags rtsed 'jos dregs pa la sogs pas brgyan pa/ gos rgyan khri stan bza' btung sogs yo byad ci 'dod 'bad med du 'byung ba/ bar snang thams cad 'ja' tshon gyi dra ba bres pa'i lam nas rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro nyi zer gyi rdul bzhin 'khrigs pa/ gsang sngags kyi dzab dbyangs dang / rdo rje'i glu gar rol mo'i sgra du mas skad cig la snang ba bde chen du sgyur ba/ de'i dbus na pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal med khang nor ba sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin khra phang nge ba/ gzi brjid mig rini mi rab migis bltar mi bzod pa lta bu/ shar zhi ba chos kyi tshogs khang dang /lho rgyas pa longs spyod kyi tshogs khang sogs bkod pa'i khyad par 51

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mang po dang bcas shing / gser gyi rgya phib dang dril g.yer gyi phreng ba chos sgra sgrogs pa sogs rgyan dang 'byor pa tshad med pas gang ba ste/ der skye ba'i skal ldan rnams ni zhi khro'i gzhung du/rig 'dus rnga yab dpal ri'i pho brang cher: skad cig nyid la brdzus te skyes nas kyang: zhes pa ltar mngal gyi dri mas ma gos par 'byung ba'o/ /rgyas par gzhan las shes par byas la yang yang yid la bya'o/ /rnga yab gling du skyes na pad+ma 'od du skye ba yin snyam pa yang mang bar snang bas de ltar ma song bar 'dun pa gtod yul ngos zin pa gces so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gsang sngags bla med kyi rig 'dzin grub pa'i zhing phul du byung ba 'di dag gnas tshod bzhin du mthong ba dang /mthong nas dngos su longs spyod pa ni 'gro ba phal bas mi nus par yon tan mdzod kyi le'u tha ma las gsungs pas lha'i rnal 'byor la brten nas sgrub dgos shing / de'ang gu ru rin po che'i thags don dam lhan skyes kyi ye shes sgyu ma'i gzi byin ci tsam snying ༄la phebs pa de tsam du zhing der 'jug pa'i nus pa rgyas par 'gyur la/ ye shes de skul zhing dbang du byed pa'i mchog ni gdul bya la snang ba bstan tshul dang sbyar na marnya ra dang mtsho rgyal gnyis te/ de las kyang rang cag bod 'bangs la lhag par nye ba 52

bla rnam la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge/ pod/ 4phyi ma nyid yin pa dang de nyid dpal ri'i zhing gi gtso mor bshad pas rang nyid der byin gyis rlobs na gu ru'i thugs rgyud 'khul ba dang / pad+ma 'od kyi zhing la dbang sgyur ba'i rten 'brel gyi gnad che bas mtsho rgyal rnal 'byor ma'i gzugs su nga rgyal 'jog pa yin no / /gsum pa ni/ gu ru rin po che'i 'chi med rdo rje'i sku mtshan nyid pa'i rnam pa la yang yang dmigs nas yid ngor shin tu 'dris pa'i rjes dran gyi rnal 'byor sbyong ba ni sku des mngon sum du rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyu che shos yin pas de nyid tshogs zhing gi gtso bor 'dzin pa yin la/ sku'i rnam pa ni spyir gcig tu ma nges par gsungs kyang dus mtha' 'jigs su rung ba 'dir rig 'dzin gyi zhing du bgrod pa la bar chad rags la mang bas/ de'i gnyen por mchog tu bsngags pa snang srid zil gnon gyis rnam par byed pa de nyid khyad par du 'phags so/ /bla ma khrom tshogs su sgom pa'i phyogs 'dir rgyal sras nor bzang gi rnam thar ltar sa mthor bzhugs pa'i bla ma mang po dang myur du mjal nas gsung gi bdud rtsi nod pa'i rten 'brel gyi babs che bas tshal de'ang dmigs 'og ༄tu legs par chug pa gces te/ 'di nyid rgyas par phye ba'i bla mchod dngos grub rgya mtshor/ /sa ra ha dang klu sgrub yab sras/53

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/thoṭa med dang zhi ba lha/ chos kyi grags pa sogs nas/ dpal ldan a ti sha sogs bstan pa spyi dang khyad par sngags phyogs la phyag rjes che ba'i paṇa grub phal cher tshig zin la thon cing /de'ang bla sgrub rtsa ba'i gzhung la mkha' 'gro'i brda sgyur ji ltar gnas pa nyid yin par sbyar byang du 'byung ngo / /bzhi pa ni/ slob dpon rin po che gdul bya 'dren pa'i thugs rje la g.yel ba med kyang / rang cag la phrin las myur du 'jug pa lam 'di ston pa'i bla ma'i mtshams sbyor la ltos te rdzing chu zhing la 'dren pa yur ba'i mtshams sbyor la ltos pa bzhin no/ /de'ang dang por brgyud ldan gyi bla mas rigs 'dus gu ru'i ting nge 'dzin gyis o rgyan rin po che'i sku dang zhing khams mtha' dag rang nyid kyi ngo bor bsgrubs nas 'o skol la dbang bskur ba ni pad+ma 'od kyi rgyal srid gtad pa yin la/ de'ang bla mas de ltar mos pa rkyang pa tsam min par o rgyan pad+ma dngos nyid de'i tshe slob dpon gyi lus la zhugs nas byin gyis rlob par rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i lung gis grub pas rang cag zhing 'dir 'jug pa la dbang ba'i rtsa ba'i gnad ni de yin no/ /de ltar rtsa ba'i bla mas dbang bskur ba'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun de nyid slar yang rang gis kha gsos te tshad la 'bebs pa'i ched du bla ma dang o rgyan pad+ma tha mi dad du bltas 54

bla rnam la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge/ pod/ 4 nas bzlas sgom la brtson par byed pa yin pas/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma dngaḥ dbyer med mtsho skyes rdo rje sprul pa'i skuḥ zhes gsungs te 'o skol skyabs yul thams cad kyi nang nas 'brel ba che shos rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pas de'i drung du skye ba sgrub sla la/ 'dir rtsa ba'i bla ma'i spyan sngar skye sla ba de ka zangs mdog dpal rir skye sla ba'i don du yang sgrub lugs kyi dbang gis song yod pas gnad kyi dam pa gcig go//lnga pa ni/ 'dir slob dpon chen po'i zhal mjal ba tsam zhig sgrub pa'ang min gyi/ gu ru nyid sku dngos kyis 'khor skyong zhing rtag tu bzhugs pa'i phyogs su/ skye gnas kyi che ba'am skye ba'i rigs kyi che bas dwangs gsal phra yang sogs gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig 'dzin gyi lus khyad par can thob nas gu ru'i zham ring du gnas shing / chos kyi mdzod bzung ste/ mkha' khyab kyi 'gro ba 'dren pa'i phrin las par sgrub pa yin pas gsol 'debs rkyang ba la rtsal du bton pa lta bas mi chog gi rdo rje theg ༄pa'i bsags sbyang spel gsum gyi sgo mang po nas rten 'brel bsgrig dgos pas gnad bsdus yan lag bdun pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /so sor sbyar na rgyal ba'i mchod rten la phyag byas pas sa rdul grangs snyed kyi 'khor sgyur 'thob par gsungs shing / 'dir 55

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sngags kyi bla rnam dang 'brel ba'i gnad kyis phyag gi yan lag kyang rdo rje'i rig 'dzin gyi 'khor los sgyur ba sgrub pa'i sgor 'gro ba dang / mchod pa'i skabs gzhal med khang dang kun ra sogs 'bul bar khrid yig tu gsungs pa rig 'dzin gyi gnas bzang bo la spyod pa'i rten 'brel du che ba sogs sgo du ma dang / bshags pas sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar skye ba 'dzin pa la sgrib pa'i las sgrib spyi dang lhag par dam tshig nyams chags thams cad sbyong ba dang /rgyal sras rnams kyi rdzogs smin sbyang ba'i spyod pa la yi rang bsgom pa'i zhing sbyong gi tshogs mang po sdud cing / sngags kyi theg pas 'gro ba rnams kyi dge sbyor la yi rang sbyar bas rdo rje'i gnas kyi rig 'dzin rnams dang dge rtsa gcig cing / skal pa gcig par 'gyur ba dang / theg gsum spyi dang bye brag gsang chen rgyud sde'i chos 'khor 'byams klas pa bskor bar bskul bas gu ru'i drung du mang thos rgya mjo'i mdzod gsog pa'i dge rtsa mchog tu 'gro ba dang /bzhugs gsol kyis byang chub snying po'i bar du bla ma o rgyan rin po che'i sku'i snang ba dang mi 'bral ba'i gnad dang bsngo ba'i tshe byang chub chen po'i lam cha tshang re dmigs 'og tu bcug na phyi ma theg chen gyi rtogs pa phyogs med du rgyas pa'i gnad che ba sogs zhib tu nges par bya'o/ /56

bla rnam la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge/ pod/ 4drug pa ni/ rdze btsun gu ru rin po cheḥ sogs kyi thad du 'byung ba ltar bla ma o rgyan pad+ma'i yon tan dang bka' drin yang bsams te/ blo bla mas phrogs pa/ bsam rgyu bla ma las med pa/lus sems tshugs mi thub pa/ phar thim phod pa dang / tshur 'bral mi nus pa lta bu'i gdung shugs yun ring du bskyed de yid khyed shes kyi dad pas lus ngag yid gsum ltos med du phul nas phar tshags su gsol ba 'debs pa ni rang gi sgo gsum gu ru'i ༄ ༄ dgongs klong du mos gus kyis 'pho ba'i spar chog shin tu zab pa ste/de med par bla ma dang dag pa'i zhing la 'dun pa gtad dus chu'i kha la shing phye btab pa ltar yam me ba zhig tu zad cing / dgra 'dul gnyen skyong tshong so nam sogs la thug dus sbrang bu gar phyin la 'byar ba ltar shes pa gting nas zug 'gro ba de bla ma'i thugs kar 'phangs kyang phyir lhung yong ba las 'os med do/ /da lta dus ngan snyigs pa'i 'groḥ mi bzad sdug bsngal 'dam du byingaḥzhes pa'i ngang tshul bsam nas blo thag chod pa'ang med du mi rung bar de gas shes so/ /bdun pa ni/ rdzu 'phrul gzhan brten ma gtogs par/ /de dag gong ma mthong ba med/ /ces pa'i dpe ltar gtso bor gzhan stobs kyis pad+ma 'od du skye ba sgrub pa'i skabs yin pas de la gu 57

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ru'i byin rlabs sgo du ma nas yang yang 'bebs pa'i dmigs gnad shin tu gces te/ ci tsam byin gyis brlabs pa de'i tshod du zhing der 'gro ba la tshegs med par 'gyur ba'i phyir te/lcags kyus gting ring du phug nas bzung ba gzhan du 'chor ba'i go skabs med pa bzhin no/ /de la rdo rje gsum gyi byin rlabs so so nas 'bebs pa dang / dbyer med ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs dbab pa bcas rgyas par phye ba ni dbang bzhi blang ba'i dmigs rim ste/ sku rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs sogs kyi tshig la bltas pa rang gis shes so/ /khyad par du bde ba chen po'i lam la drod thob na mthong chos su'ang rig 'dzin gyi gnas mchog rnams bgrod nus shing / de'i byin rlabs kyi sna rtse tsam rnyed kyang phyi ma mkha' spyod dang sa spyod sogs bgrod pa la khyad che ba/ dbang len 'di'i 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum sogs kyang bde ba'i bdud rtsi 'od kyi rnam par shar ba 'ba' zhig tu mos dgos pa/rig 'dzin yum ka'i/ bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyunaḥ sogs dngos grub kyi ye shes bsdu dmigs dang ches cher mthun pas mdor na bde chen ye shes 'bebs pa'i dmigs rim kho na yin te/gong gi sa bcad gnyis pa dang yang bsgrigs nas shes par bya'o/ /gzhan yang rang gi lus 'di la ngan song gsum dang bde 'gro rang 58

bla rnam la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge/ pod/ 4dga' ba'i sgo gsum skyed byed kyi rtsa rlung thig le'i cha mang po yod par rgyud klong gsal dang sgyu 'phrul gsang thig sogs las gsungs te/ de rnams kyi dpal gcog pa ni rig drug bsreg sbyong zhes gnas lung gi zab gnad de/ bde chen dag pa'i gnas su 'gro ba'i lam shul po che bzhin du dbye ba la grogs byed kyi thabs mkhas phul du byung ba yin la/ de yang 'dir/ oṃ gyi 'od kyis lus kyi las dang rtsa'i sgrib pa dag /āḥ'i 'od kyis ngag gi las dang rlung gi sgrib pa dag sogs kyi khongs su spu ris zin na ji lta ba bzhin tshang ba dang / rnam smin rig 'dzin gyi sa bon thebs/zhes sogs de 'dra rig 'dzin bzhi ka'i gsungs las kyang rig 'dzin gyi gral du 'jug pa'i nus pa skyed tshul gsal bar thon pa sogs dar zhud mi 'then par zhib tu brtags na shes par 'gyur ro/ /dbang len skabs 'dir 'khor gyi bla ma dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyang gtso bo dang dgongs pa gcig tu bzhugs nas dbang skur ba'i mdzad pa la thugs gtad par bsam na byin rlabs kyi tshan che bar rtogs so/ /brgyad pa ni/ gter gzhung 'dir pad+ma 'od du bgrod pa la dmigs phug pa'i gsol 'debs/ nam zhig tshe yi/ sogs gsol 'debs dkyus ma las 'bur don du yod pa rdo rje'i gsung 59

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/byin rlabs che yang yid legs par gtad nas rgyud dang 'dres nges ma byas na gsol ba mi theb pas/ gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debasaḥ kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin noḥ zhes gsungs pa yin kyang don ci yin la blo kha tsam yang mi phyogs par g.yas lta g.yon nyan phu 'khyar mdo bsam gyi ngang la/ kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin noḥ zhes tshogs zhing la rdzun lab pa ni spyi brtol ha cang ches te/ rang gzhan su la brtags kyang de 'dra mang ngo / /zhing sgrub kyi dus su gsol 'debs 'di bdun nam nyer gcig sog sa bskyar yang legs par sems so /dgu pa ni/ zhing mchog bgrod pa'i dmigs rim gyi dngos gzhi yin te/ de'ang gu ru nyid bdag la lhag par dgongs te zhal 'dzum pa mdzad cing spyan dgyes chags kyi rnam par g.yo ba'i ngang la thugs ka nas bde chen snying rje'i 'od dmar byin rlabs kyi tsha drod can nyi ma shar ba bzhin du 'byung ba ni rang pad+ma 'od du 'dren pa'i dpyang thag dang bsu ba'i sa mkhan yin te/ de snying kar reg pa'i rkyen gyis rang gi sgo gsam gyi snyigs ma sbyangs te ༄mos gus kyi rang mdangs bde bar shar ba'i dwangs ma'i thig le dmar po skar mda' lta bu'i shugs can du 'dril ba la sems rtse gcig tu gtad/ de nyid rta mchog bang kha gar gtad du 'gro ba 60

gling〉 /blo/ ::rdocarngo/ 〈sna/ ༷༷ste thabashā se can//(1 thab/bye( (1) 1re// ྅rngosarngapa// 〈mi'iltar rang gi gus dung 'dun pa'i rlung shugs kyis yar 'phar/thugs rje'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyu smos ma thag pas khab len gyis lcags phye drangs pa bzhin steng du 'then te gu ru'i thugs kar sib kyis bstims nas thugs yid bsres pa'i ngang la sems bzung /gong du gu ru'i yon tan dran pas yid 'khul ba'i rgyun yin na 'di dus ngang ba pad mtsho la zhugs pa 'dra ba'i dga' nyams 'byung ste de 'dra stobs che la/ dga' spro med bzhin byas pa'i phur tshugs rkyang ba la stobs chen med do/ /gsol 'debs las/gsal 'tsher 'od kyi gong bu ruḥ zhes gsungs te/ nam zhig 'chi dus rlung sems 'od kyi gong ba gnad gcod kyi tshor ba la ༄sogs pa'i rnyogs pas ma bslad par bde ba'i gzi mdangs gsal zhing bkrag par gyur nas dpal ri'i zhing du 'gro ba la mthu dang ldan pa'i rten 'brel yin nam snyam mo/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rje dang phrin las ni gdul byas ji ltar dmigs shing mos pa de kho na bzhin thogs med du 'byung ba nor bu chu shel tshon gang dang nye ba de'i kha dog tu mod la snang ba lta bur mdo rgyud thams cad nas gsungs pas/ rang gi gsol 'debs dang mos pa byed tshul tsam du zad kyi don la da ltar cang 'gyur ram snyam du the tshom mi bya ste/bsam pa lhun 'grub mar/ yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 61

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/d+ku'adebasaḥ zhes lan bcu gsum bar du gsungs pa ltar shin tu gal che'o/ /'di kho na gtso bor byed tshe/ slar yang rang dang zhing gi rnam pa rgya mtsho la gza' skar cig char du shar ba ltar sngar bzhin bkra lam gyis sad par bltas nas nam zhig ma'i gsol 'debs ci rigs kyi mthar bshad ma thag pa'i tshul kyis thugs yid bsre/ de 'dra ba dkyus rer gsum mam bdun sogs bskyar/'di ni rnam shes gong du 'jug pa'i dmigs gnad yin/ kyang /lus sems phral nas 'pho ba'i phyogs ma yin pas 'pho rab tshe thung ba'i nyen yang med par gsal lo/ /bcu pa ni/ rjes la dpal ri'i smon lam 'don pa yang gnad dam pa'o/ /zhes khrid yig gter gzhung gnyis kar gsungs pa ste/ smon lam gyi gzhung 'di la zhing bkod dang smon lam tsam du ma zad/ bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen dang bcas pa'i lam rim gyi brjod bya 'gangs chen po yod pas tshig rjes don dran gyi sgo nas bag chags thebs nges bya'o/ /bcu gcig pa ni/ gter gzhung yig chung lasatshwag par gang du 'dug pa'i gnas zangs mdog dpal ri dngos yin snyam pa las tha mal du mi blta/ zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ thun nang du 62

yangami /bla/ :thucan/ 9// ༷ṣ+ṭha) /spro/ring/ can//(1 /spro//blo/ (1) 1)// :sdo/shāḥ// 〈mi'i'abad nas bsgoms pa'i 'phro de ma thag gi thun mtshams nas rlung la bskur na bsam brlag mdo shog zer ba de 'dra las zur na med pas thun mtshams su yang gang snang thams cad pad+ma 'od kyi gnas grogs longs spyod dngos rang yin snyam du dran 'dzin chen po bsten nas sbyong zhing / bde sdug gi yul rkyen gang byung dang bsres te chig rkya pher bar bya tshul gter gzhung ltar lag tu blang /'di bzhin thun dang thun mtshams gnyis rta shig phrug pa ltar gcig grogs gcig 'gro'i tshul du bar ma chad par bslabs pas lus ma brjes bzhin du yid ngor zangs mdog dpal ri ra skyes zin pa 'dra ba'i snang zhen 'byongs na goms shugs shog dril dang 'dra bas gdos bcas kyi lus rgya bor ma thag zhing snang gi steng du khrug gis 'dres nas 'gro ba'i gnad mchog tu gyur pa ste/ bskyed rim 'pho bar 'gro lugs kyang 'di lta bu yin no/ /bcu gnyis pa ni/ de ltar nyin mo'i dus su snang phyogs kyi zhing khams la shas cher dmigs shing thags yid bsre ba'i rdzogs ༄rim la'ang bslab pa'i mthar mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor gyis stong phyogs zhing gi de nyid la gtso bor sbyang ba ni/ sngar ltar zhing bkod legs par gsal btab la/ spyi bo'i bla ma snying dbus kyi ze'u 'brur spyan drangs te/ de'i 'od zer gyis dag pa'i snod 63

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bcud rang lus dang bcas pa me long la ha btab pa'i rlangs pa dbus su yal ba bzhin bsdus nas 'od gsal thig le chen po'i dbyings su sems bsres te gnyid log pas/ legs par 'byongs pa na 'phen pa'i rkyen cung zad tsam gyis zhing khams kyi rten brten pa/ gang 'dod rmi lam du blta bar yang nus so/ /gnyid dang 'chi ba chos mthun pas 'di la goms 'dris legs par brtan na 'chi dus dang bar dor yang sleb pa'i gnad che'o/ /rnam shes dag pa'i zhing du 'pho ba la tshang bug gi lam sbyang ba gces par bshad pa dang / 'dir nyal ldang gi dus su bla ma lam de nas gshegs bzhud mdzad pa'i dmigs rim gsungs pa gnyis bsgrig tshul zhig kyang yod dam brtag par bya'o/ /nyin mtshan gyi rnal 'byor gcig gis gcig la rgyas 'debs tshul dang / zhing sku pho brang gsum so so'i de nyid rang babs gnyug ma'i shes pa skad cig ma gcig la ldog cha tha dad kyi tshul du tshang lugs snying thig rang skad bzhin 'chad tshul gyi gnad phra mo yang yod mod/ /snga ma cung zad shes sla la/ phyi ma dngos gzhi'i zab don yin pas 'dir ma brjod do/ /de dag gi skabs su spyir rang cag bod kyi 'gro ba dang sgos zab gter gyi chos la spyod pa rnams gu ru rin po che dang las smon gyi 'brel pa che ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis zhing der skye sla ba'i tshal la ༄64

bla rnam la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge/ pod/ 4bsam nas spro ba skyed cing / skyes na don che ba'i tshul yang bsam par bya ste/ phal cher sngar bshad pa'i khongs su tshang mod/ 'on kyang tshig sna bsring nas phyogs gcig tu bsdeb na/ gnas der lus srog longs spyod dang dge ba'i phyogs 'grib pa'i snyigs ma'i rgud pa thams cad dag pa rab 'byams ye shes sgyu ma'i rang mdangs stobs su gyur pa'i rig 'dzin gyi zhing gi che ba dang rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro mthu chen rnams kyi sngags dang ting nge 'dzin dang brtul zhugs grub pa'i nus pas zil gyis mnan nas lam sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i rkyen byed pa dang / rig 'dzin grub pa'i gnas kyi 'byor ba mthong na ngo mtshar bar byed pa mthong ba'i mod la snang ba bde chen du 'char ba/ ci tsam 'dris kyang dag snang cher 'gro ba/ gang ltar bltas kyang byin rlabs kyi gting mi mngon pa/ ci 'dod du 'byung ba/ gang mos su snang ba/ yid kyi rjes su byed pa/ gzhan gyis mi 'phrog pa/ dbang 'byor gyi mthu gzugs can du gyar pa lta bu rnams dang phrad pa na/ gnas kyis ༷༷༷/ /༷༷/riring /༷༷/ /jirngordogang zag d+nghan d+nghas rlobs pa zhes bya ba tshul la sa pa rang dbang med par skyes pa dang / de na lha klu dang mkha' 'gro ma'i phyag na bzhugs pa'i chos kyi gsang mdzod thams cad dbyar gyi me tog ltar shugs rdol la 'byung zhing sngags rang bzhin gyis 'grub 65

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa'i gnas kyi yon tan dang / rang nyid kyang grub pa'i zhing gi rig 'dzin yon tan gyi phung po rnams dang skal ba mthun par skyes pa'i stobs shugs dang / rtag tu de na bzhugs pa dang /mkha' spyod sogs zhing gzhan dang gzhan nas rdzu 'phrul gyis gshegs bzhud mdzad pa'i dpa' bo ḍāk+ki rnams kyi rang bzhin gyis byin rlabs dang / de dag gis ched du dgongs shing lam gyi grogs mdzad pa'i mthu dang / grub pa'i mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyun du mthong bas sngags dang dngos grub kyi gnas la dad gus brtan pa sogs kyi dbang gi las dang ye shes kyi dngos grub thams cad bde blag nyid du 'byung ba dang / khyad par du yang zhing gi gtso bo 'chi med bde ba chen po pad+ma 'byang gnas zhes bya ba/༄dam pa'i chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ rgyud lung man ngag mtha' dag gi 'phro gzhi rigs dang dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa thams cad pa/ dngos grub kyi ye shes thams cad bsdus pa'i gzug/sa can/ mkhyen brtse gzi brjid nyi ma bye ba phrag brgya bas bag dro ba/mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo chen po rnams kyang gang gi zhal la mig chags shing mchog tu ngo mtshar bar 'dzin pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi mtha' klas pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams bka' nod cing bran bzhin du 'jug pa/ phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa'i zhing du gdul bya 66

bla rnam la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge/ pod/ 4'dul ba'i mdzad pa dus las mi yol ba rgya mtsho'i dus rlabs lta bu'i chos nyid thob pa de rigs kyi cod pan dang / rang skal gyi bla mar dus gsum 'bral ba med par bsnyen nas zab chos kyi bdud rtsir longs spyod de/ khrid yig du/ dag pa'i zhing khams der rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi'i lam nyi zla'i bgrod pa las kyang myur bar kun tu bzang po'i sa la phyin par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i thog tu 'chugs med par 'gro ba dang / de'i gnad kas da lta kha chu skam skam chos bshad/ lham mthil rdol rdol rgyal khams bskor yang sems can gcig gi kha lo tsam gyen du sgyur dka' ba de/zhing der kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i 'khor los ris med kyi gdul bya'i khams la mnga' sgyur ba 'jam dbyangs dang spyan ras gzigs lta bur 'gyar ba la tshegs chung yun thang las mi dgos riring ra/༷rdo //bye(//rdordopas/ don gnyis gang la bltas kyang 'dun ma gas pa ༄ sne mor son pa yin no/ /rang cag thog med nas ngan 'gro'i gting rum du bzod dka'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir bzhin bying ba las da res lan gcig bde 'gror mgo nyu ga tsam byung ba 'di dus brgya za ma gcig tu gzigs nas btang snyoms su ma bor bar thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung ste chos kyi lam srol du btsud/ smin grol gyi gdams pas bskyangs/ blo ldog bzhi nas 'od gsal rdo rje'i rtse 67

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mo'i bar gyi rgyal ba'i lam bzang mtha' dag la slob pa'i rten 'brel gyi rtsa ba btsugs te ma byams mas bu la slob pa'i tshul du/khyod kyi sgrub pa 'di mthar 'khyol ba zhig dgos/ sangs rgyas dus mthar 'khyol ba yin/ 'phro chad na 'khyol dus mi 'ong / khyod shes rab dang brtson 'grus sogs lam gyi rten 'brel dman pas tshe 'dir mthar mi 'khyol/ phyi mar yang zangs rbab ri sked nas 'gril ba bzhin thar du shor te 'phro chad pa'i nyen che bas klung rdo ༄gyen bzhag thur la mi ldog pa'i ched du/ ngas khyod la sgrub sla ba/'khyer bde ba/ legs par sgrub nas bzung na rig 'dzin gyi gral du de ma thag 'gro ba dngos grub kyi ral gri lta bu'i gdams ngag cig ster zhes sgrub thabs 'di gnang ste/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar chos la brdzang ba 'di gcig pu'i ngang tshul bsam na'ang dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin la gzhal thabs ma mchis pas bka' drin ngo shes nas dran par bya la/ chos kyi yab des brdzangs sar yang 'gro dgos so/ /chos 'di nyams su len pa la sngon du rtsa dbang rgyal thab spyi blugs bskur nas snod rung du byas pa zhig dgos par kun mkhyen nyid kyis gsungs pa go dgos shing / dbang thob kyang dam tshig nyams na rig 'dzin gyi lus rten phar zhog /mi'i skye ba tsam yang rnyed dka' bas khrid yig las/ mos gus dang dam tshig 68

phabang /blo/ chenazug 95 ༷) /bshā se zug/(1 rngabahāre (pe thego/ :sdo/rngad/ 〈sdo'irnam par dag pa gang zhig /ces gsungs pa ltar nyams na phyir bcos sogs dam tshig dag pa'i thabs la 'bad pa med mi rung yin la/ gdams ngag yod kyang / da lta khams dwangs/ blo gsal/rang dbang yod dus legs par sbyangs nas gdeng thob par ma byas na/ nam zhig thog babs su 'chi ba'am/ 'chi nad kyis gcur bas 'du shes 'khrugs shing bya spu rlung bskyod bzhin rang dbang dang bral ba'i tshe rtsol ba byed snying mi 'dod cing / byas kyang bsam du mi btub pas ci yang byar med de/ de'i phyir sngon du sbyang ba nges par gal che zhing / 'chi kha dang bar dor 'di bzhin bya dgos snyam du 'phen pa mang du gtong ba yang zab pa'i gnad do/ /de ltar byin rlabs bla ma'i sgrub pa 'di la rtsal thon na tshe phyi mar dngos grub ston dus kyi 'bras bu smin pa ltar 'byung ba lta ci smos/ tshe 'dir yang me tog gi tshul du bsam pa thams cad des 'grub/ bar chad thams cad des sel bas gcig chog yid bzhin nor ba'i 'du shes bskyed de yi dam gyi mthil du bzang bar rig bye rigazizubya'o/ /sa chu snyigs pas nyam thag phyugs kyi khyu/ /khu byug snyan sgrog glu yis dbugs 'byin na/ /pad 'byung zab gter gdams pa'i rgyud mang glus/ /lnga bdo'i gdung ba 'phrog la ngo mtshar ci/ /legs bshad dpyid kyi dus bzang gzhon nu khyod/ /'gro sems 69

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dge ba'i myu gu rgyas byed cing / /mtsho skyes phrin las dbyar gyi rtse dga' ma/ /'bod la ngal bar ma rtsi rings par song / /bdag kyang deng nas skye ba'i phreng ba kun/ /gzhan phan 'khor los sgyur ba'i srid thob ste/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i phrin las rin chen char/ /mkha' khyab zhing kun 'gengs par 'bebs byed shog /ces pa'ang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas rang 'dra'i blo dman 'ga' la phan du re nas brjed thor btab pa dge bar gyur cig /chu byi nag pa zla ba la'o// //70
ma nga du sheb lu‘

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/ gang zhig bla ma dang dpal o rgyan chen po tha mi dad du shes pas gsol 'debs kyi sgrub lugs nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ gnas gtsang mar gu ru'i sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar mchod pa gang 'byor bshams/ ma grub na yid kyi cho ga bya/ sngon du blo legs par bcos te/ dge sems khyad par can gyi ngang nas/bdag gzhan 'jigs pa kun las thar bya'i phyir/ /dkon mchog rnam gsum snying nas skyabs su bzung / /rnal 'byor zab mos byang chub mchog bsgrubs te/ /mkha' khyab 'gro ba sgrol bar sems bskyed do/ /lanagasum/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā sogs/ gdod nas rnam dag 'od gsal stong pa nyid/ /kun khyab kun tu snang ba'i rol pa las/ /phyi snod pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal med khang / /nang bcud rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i 'khor lo che/ /de dbas rang nyid mtsho rgyal ༄rnal 'byor ma/ /byu ru'i mdog can zhi 'dzum rjes chags nyams / /gcer mo rus pa'i rgyan ldan gri thod 'dzin/ /bzhengs stabs mos gus spyan gsum nam mkhar gzigs/ /rang mdun bar snang ye shes 'od lnga'i klong / /rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun pad+ma 'byung / /dkar dmar gzhon tshul mtshan dpe'i dpal rab 'bar paṇa zhwa chos gos gsol zhing rdor thod bsnams/ /mchan khung g.yon na sbas yum kha ṭ+wāṃ 'chang / /zhabs zung rdo rje skyil krung pad zlar bzhugs/ /'dzum zhal dgyes pa'i nyams bcas bdag la gzigs//72 ne

bla ma dang o rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gsal/ /zhes dmigs te/hūṃ/ o rgyan yul gyi sogs lan gsum mam bdun gyis ye shes pa dang bsre/ ma bcos spros bral sogs/ rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'og min chos kyi sogs/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed su dag sogs kyis yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ mkhyen pas zhi ba'i dbyings kyi de nyid gzigs/ /snying rjes srid pa'i 'gro ba rjes sa 'dzin/ mkhyen brtses srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis ring spangs pa//༄dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dgongs pa sangs rgyas kun dang rnam dbyer med/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dam chos sgrom gcig pu/ /dus gsum 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams skyed pa'i yab/ /dkon mchog gsum dngos khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /bzhugs pa'i gnas mchog dpal ri pad+ma 'od/ /thugs rje'i gdul zhing ris med 'jig rten khams/ /mdzad pa'i cho 'phrul phyogs dus kun tu khyab/ /spyod yul tshad med khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag 'dra shugs drag nyon mongs chu bos khyer/ /las kyi dbang gis snyigs ma'i 'dam du byings/ /phyi nang 'gal rkyen rlung mar bzhin du 'tshubs/ /thar bar 'dod kyang phyi phyir 'og tu ltung / /'jig rten bla ma'i nyin byed chos dbyings mnal/ /bstan 'dzin phal cher de yi phyi bzhin nub/ /skyabs med mgon 73

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/med lnga bdo'i gcong rong du/ /'o dod 'bod pa bdag la thugs rjes gzigs/ /khyod ni sangs rgyas gdul bya'i lhag ma rnams/ /lhag par sgrol la sras bcas rgyal ba yis/ /dbang bskur nor bu'i cod pan dbu la gsol/ /nyam thag skyob nus seng ge'i sgra yang sgrog /de phyir bdag ni khyod la mgo gtad cing / /khyod min re sa gzhan du mi tshol gyis/ /ye shes pad+ma'i spyan gyis legs gzigs nas/ /thugs rje'i phyag yangs rgyas pas rjes su zungs/ /khyod zhal rjes dran khyod kyi rnam thar sems/ /khyod mtshan gsang sngags rgyal po zlo byed pa/ /bdag la mthu rtsal ci mchis 'dir zad pas/ /rje khyed dgongs pa'i dus ni 'di lags so/ /'di nas byang chub bar gyi tshe rabs kun/ /mgon khyod bdag gi bla mar 'gyur ba dang / /bsam sbyor dag pas khyod thugs mnyes byas nas/ /bka' drin bdud rtsis 'tsho bar byin gyis rlobs/ /srid pa'i bde 'byor dpal la mi chags par/ /gtan 'dun chos kyi bde bas yid drangs te/ /'jig rten 'dren pa'i bstan la rab 'byung zhing / /tshul khrims srog ltar bsrung bar byin gyis rlobs/ /khyad par theg mchog bstan pa'i gnad kyi mthil/ /rlabs chen snying rjes drangs pa'i sems bskyed dang / /spyod pa rgya mtsho'i dpung dang ldan pa yi/ /nges don lam bzang rnyed par 74

bla ma dang o rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4 4byin gyis rlobs/ dbang gis rgyud smin dam tshig srog tu btsa'/ /bskyed pa'i rim pas lam bzang gzhi tshugs shing / /rdzogs rim zab mos skye 'chi bar do yi/ /snang zhen lam du longs par byin gyis rlobs/ 'khrul pa'i na bun chos dbyings mkha' la dwangs/ /'od gsal nyi ma mtha' dbus med par shar/ /snang spyod ma lus dag pa rab 'byams kyi/ /dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mthar thug dag pa gnyis ldan dbyings kyi rgyan/ /ye shes thig le gcig pu'i rang 'od kyis/ /'gro ba'i yid mun ma lus 'phrog byed pa/ /khyod dang rnam thar dbyer med byin gyis rlobs/ spro na bla ma sku gsum ma'i gsol 'debs sogs kyang bya/ oṃ.āḥhūṃ zhes 'bru gsum dang / gu ru sid+dhi bzla/ mthar/ gu ru'i gnas gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje gsum mchog yi ge'i gzugs snang ba/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum dkar dmar mthing ka'i mdog /rang rang rigs kyi 'od zer 'bar bas mtshan/ /de dag 'od kyis bdag gi gnas gsum khengs/ /sgo gsum sgrib sbyang rdo rje gsum gyi lam/ /skye brtan 'phel ba'i rten 'brel legs bsgrigs shing / /sku gsum go 'phang 'grub pa'i nus ldan byas/ /slar yang 'od zer gsum gyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /gcig tu 'dres nas rang gi gnas gsum zhugs/ /cha mnyam sgrib sbyangs bzhi ba'i dbang don rtogs/ /ngo 75

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bo nyid sku'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag /ces dbang blang / de mthar bla ma rang sems 'od gsal dbyings/ /ro gcig rnam 'dres dgongs pa'i rtsal chen rdzogs/ /gdod nas rnam dag dang po'i mgon po'i zhal/ /smra bsam brjod bral ngang du lhag par mthong / /zhes thugs yid bsre/ slar yang lha'i snang zhen gsal btab la/ dong sprugs smon lam sogs kyi bsngo ba bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang sdom brtson shri'i ming can gyi ngor/ /bstan nyis bris pa dge/bkra shis/༄༅/ /na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ gang gis bla ma sgrub 'dod pas/ /slob dpon rigs rnams kun 'dus nyid/ /dad pa'i yul du rab byas te/ /rnal 'byor 'di la snying por bya/ /gang zhig dran pas ye shes mchog ster ba/ /slob dpon sangs rgyas kun dngos rigs kun bdag /de la mi phyed gus pas skyabs mchi zhing / /gzhan phan rlabs chen bsgrub phyir khyod bsgom bya/ /lan gsum/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs/ srid dang zhi ba'i chos rnams ma lus pa/ /rang bzhin gdod nas mi dmigs mnyam pa che'i/ /rtsal snang rten 'byung rol mo 'phrul pa'i gar/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar seng chen nor ba'i khrir/ /dpal ldan bla ma 'khor lo'i ༄dbang phyug ni/ /mtshan dpe'i zhal bzang lta bas mi ngoms shing / /phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad phyag rgya mdzad/ /zhabs zung rdo rje'i skyil krung gdan la bzhugs/ /sku la ngur smrig rngul gzan mthang gos mnab/ /pan zhwa dmar ser mdangs ldan dbu la 76

bla ma dang o rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4gsol/ /dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i ngo bo nyid/ /phul byang /rdoXge ri pa ye shes mchog gi sku ru gsal/ zhesabarjod/ ༄ snyed su dag sogs/yan lag bdun pa bya zhing phyag 'tshal/ de mthar phur tshugs su gsol ba gdab pa ni/'jigs med theg mchog chos kyi seng ge'i sgras/ /tshul gnyis bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sgreng mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag rgyud 'phags pa'i lam du bsgyur byin rlobs/ /zhes mang du brjod cing bsam/ spro na rgyang 'bod rkang pa bcu drug pa bya ste/ mkhyen no mkhyen no drin can gyi bla ma/ /gzigs shig gzigs shig thugs rje yi mnga' bdag /dag pa gnyis ldan chos nyid kyi klong nas/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i rnam rol gyis bzhengs shog /bde gshegs kun dngos dpal ldan gyi bla ma/ /thar lam ston mdzad byang chub kyi sa mkhan/ /thugs rjes skyongs shog khams gsum gyi 'dren pa/ /byin rlabs stsol shog drin chen gyi chos rje/bka' drin 'khor med rje btsun gyi bla ma/ /skyob pa mtshungs med srid zhi yi gdung sel/ /thugs rjes dgongs shig dran chog gi skyabs gcig /byin rlabs mchog stsol rigs kun gyi spyi gzugs/ /yang yang dran no drin chen gyi bla ma/ /snying nas dran no byin rlabs kyi gter chen/ /tshe rabs kun tu thugs rje yis bzung nas/ / dngos grub mchog gi char chen zhig phob shog /ces brjod/ 'di skabs 77

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'bru gsum gyi bzlas pa byas mthar/ bla ma'i sku las sna tshogs 'od kyi sprin//dpag med bdag gi snying dbus zhugs pa'i mod/ /ji snyed sgrib pa'i tshogs rnams yongs sbyangs te/ /zag med ye shes snang ba rgyas par gyur/ /de mthar bla ma mchog gi ye shes sku/ /'od zhu bdag dang ro gcig 'dres gyur nas/ /spros med mnyam pa chen po'i gzhi dbyings su/ /gnyis med ye shes zhi bar mnyam par bzhag /ces rtogs pa bskyed/ rgyal ba kun gyi sogs kyis bsngo smon bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang dge ba'i bshes gnyen pad+ma bde chen gyi ngor sprang smyon 'jigs med pas bris pa dge/༄/ /dpal ldan gru 'dzin dbang po'i thugs ka nas/ /zla mdog 'od kyi 'khri shing ring po'i rtser/ /rje btsan bla ma dmigs ༄med brtse ba'i gter/ /rgyal ba'i cod pan 'chang ba gshegs su gsol/ /rang mdun nam mkha' seng khri pad+ma dang / /cha rdzogs zla ba gsar pa'i dkyil 'khor steng / /bdag gi bsod nams myu gu spel ba'i phyir/ /'chi med sprin gyi ba gam brtsegs ltar bzhugs/ /rgyal ba kun dngos dpal ldan bla ma la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod sprin du mas mchod/ /sdig ltung ma lus gnong 'gyod drag pos bshags/ /rang gzhan dge tshogs kun la rjes yi rang / /zab cing rgya che'i chos tshul bsam yas pa/ /gdul bya'i skal pa ji 78

bla ma dang o rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4t+yābazhin snang mdzad cing / /bstan 'gro'i nyer 'tshor bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /bsod nams byang chub chen po'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /lan gsum/ /theg mchog chos tshul la mkhas 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /'gro la phan bde'i dpal ster spyan ras gzigs/ /bsod nams zhing du sras bcas rgyal rnams dang / /dbyer med rje btsun bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /cinus/ dpal ldan bla ma khyed kyi bka' drin ni/ /spel legs nor bu'i them skas la 'dzegs nas/ /rgyal ba'i lung rtogs 'chi med dga' tshal du/ /bdag sogs 'gro rnams rtag tu rol par shog /bsngo ba gzhan yang bya'o/ /chos grags kyi gsung ma bcag tsam du/ spro ba med bzhin smyo gtam cal col bris/ maṅga lam/༄༅/ /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig gis bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brtson par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ oṃ swa bha wa shudz+nyo sarba dharma sogs/mi dmigs stong pa'i rang gdangs 'gags med pa/ /kun snang dag chen rol mor 'char ba'i gzugs/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar rin chen seng ge'i khrir/ /rje btsun bla ma dgyes pa'i 'dzum mdangs can/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag phyag rgya mdzad//zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing / /sku la ngur smrig bgo bas mdzes par klubs/ /dbu la paṇa zhu dmar po legs par mnabs/ /rtsa gsum rgyal ba kun dang dbyer med 79

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bzhugs/ /zhes gsal btab/ rgyal kun spyi gzugs rje btsun bla ma la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /sdig ltung kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang / /chos 'khor bskor bskul mya ngan mi 'dar gsol/ /dge tshogs bla med byang chub snying por bsngo/ /zhes tshogs bsags/ dpal ldan bla ma sangs rgyas kun dngos la/ /rtse gcig mi phyed gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag blo dam pa'i chos su 'dren nas kyang / /ye shes snang ba rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes phur tshugs su gsol ba gdab/ oṃ āḥm hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūṃ/ zhes bzla/ thun mthar/ bla ma'i gnas gsum yi ge 'bru gsum las/ /'od 'phros rang gi spyi mgrin snying gar thim/ /sgrib pa bzhi sbyangs dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob/ /sku bzhi'i go 'phang rgyud la bzhag par gyur/ /de mthar bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim/ /thugs yid gcig 'dres kun bzang chos sku'i zhal/ /mngon gyur khyad chos drug gis gdod ma'i dbyings/ /dag pa gnyis ldan chen por ro gcig gyur/ /ces mnyam par bzhag /thun mjug dge bsngo sogs bya'o/ /ces pa'ang dad ldan mgon po rdo rje'i ngor 'jigs med pas so/ /༄༅/ /gang zhig gis bla ma sgrub par 'dod pas skyabs sems dang swa bha wa sngon du song rjes/ spros bral zab mo'i gnas lugs de bzhin nyid/ /'gags med sgyu 'phrul rol mor snang ba'i gar/ /rgyal kun spyi 80

bla ma dang o rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4gzugs dpal ldan bla ma mchog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis chos 'chad phyag rgya mdzad/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gdan khar brjid/ /sku la ngur smrig bgo bas rab mdzes shing / /mthong na mi mthun zhi ba'i ye shes sku/ /snang stong sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i ngo bor bzhugs/ /zhes gsal btab/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus rje btsun bla ma la/ /rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal zhing / /mi zad mchod sprin rgya mtshos rtag tu mchod/ /sdig ltung gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol zhing 'chags/ /dus gsum dge tshogs kun la rjes yi rang / /tshul gnyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /'gro ba'i don du bskal brgyar bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dge tshogs byang chub snying po'i sa la bsngo/ /zhes tshogs bsags/ 'jigs med ye shes dam pa'i ral gri yis/ /log rtog drwa ba stug po gcod mdzad pa/ /bla ma chos kyi dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag rgyud dam pa'i chos su 'dres byin rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba yang yang gdab/ oṃ aḥm hā gur+bha bh+ya dhamen+d+ra sid+dhi hūṃ/ ci nus bzlas/ than mthar/ bla ma'i 1)/na riri rgyasku las 'od zer dpag med 'phros/ /bdag gi gnas gsum thim pa'i mod nyid la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun thob ste/ / bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med gyur/ /ces brjod cing bla ma rang la bstim zhing mnyam par bzhag /dge ba 'di yis mkha' khyab yid 81

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/can kun/ /rmad byung zab mo'i lam dang mi 'bral zhing / /rnam 'dren dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes bzung ste/ /theg chen lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin shog /ces pa'ang btsun pa gsang sngags kyi ngor 'jigs med pas so//༄༅/ /bla ma la na mo/ /o rgyan rin po che la gsol ba 'debs pa/ tshig rkang bdun pa'i bklag thabs mdor bsdus pa ni/ skyabs sems sngon du btang la/mdun gyi nam mkhar rin chen seng ge'i khrir/ /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan steng du/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma mtsho skyes thod 'phreng rtsal/ /sku mdog dkar dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /rdo rje thod bum 'dzin cing skyil krung bzhugs/ /sku la za 'og ber smug brjid ldan gsol/ /mthong grol 'dab ldan rigs lnga'i zhwa thod can/ /zung 'jug bde stong phyag rgya'i 'khor lor bzhugs/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus rdo rje 'chang dbang dang / /dbyer med dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi rje'i/ /yon tan yid la dran pa'i mos gus kyis/ /bsngags brjod rgyud mangs 'khrol ba'i mchod sprin spro/zhes pa'i mthar/ hūṃḥ o rgyan yul gyi sogs/ ci mang bzla/ mthar/ bla ma'i gnas gsum yi ge'i 'od zer gyis/ /bdag rgyud sgo gsum 'khrul pa'i khams sbyangs te/ /mthar ni bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim//thugs yid ro gcig 'dres pa'i ngang la blta/ zhes mnyam par bzhag /82

bla ma dang o rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4bsngo smon bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang sras lha dbang ngor sprang rgan 'jigs med pas so//༄tsho/ /e ma ho/ ka dag skye med rdo rje'i pho brang nas/ /lhun grub bde ba'i sku can pad+ma 'byang / /rtsa gsum chos skyong rgya mtsho'i //de/ /khro/bye risi me— dpal / /gangs can bstan 'gro'i mgon po da bzhengs shig /mtha' dmag dam sri'i ru mtshon gzings pa'i tshe/ /rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i gtso mchog pad+ma 'byung / /thugs rje'i thugs dam ma g.yel dus la babs/ /bdud 'dul gar dgu'i mthu byin da bskyed cig /bstan zhabs kla klos sdud la rings pa'i tshe/ /bde mchog grub pa'i dpa' bo pad+ma 'byung / /mngon spyod las la dgyes pa'i dus yin gyi/ /dpa' gtum rdo rje'i gzugs skur da bzhengs shig /bod khams mtha' 'khob skye bos 'jig pa'i tshe/ /'jigs med brtul zhugs mchog grub pad+ma 'byung / /phas rgol lhag mar mdzad pa'i dus la babs/ /drag shul ral gri'i rno dbal da phyungs shig /dus 'khrugs mtshon cha'i ru 'dzing rngoms pa'i tshe/ /'jigs mdzad he ru ka dpal pad+ma 'byung / /khams gsum stobs kyis gnon pa'i dus la babs/ /bde chen rdo rje'i mthu nus da spor cig /dbyings nas dag chen mnyam pa'i ye shes che/ /gtum rngam a la ha la'i gad rgyangs dang / /lhan cig khro la khros pa'i skur ston zhing / /bdud srin dam sri'i snying khrag da 83

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rol cig /mnyam nyid zhi ba chen po chos sku'i thugs/ /khrag 'thung khros pa'i gzugs skur mngon bzhengs la/ /mtha' dmag dus kyi 'khrug rtsod zhi ba dang / /bod khams bde la 'god pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /ces pa'ang mtha' dmag du ru ka'i bya ma rta'i khrag tshos nam mkha'i bzhin ras su byug pa'i tshe/ sprang smyon 'jigs med pas bris pa kla klo'i 'dun gros 'jig pa'i tho lum du gyur cig /༄7/ /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /o rgyan rin po che'i gsol 'debs tshig bdun ma kha ton byed dus kyi dmigs rim shin tu nyung la go sla bar brjod na/ grub na gu ru rin po che'i snang brnyan sogs rten gsum gyi drung du mchod pa ci 'byor bshams/ kha lho nub tu bltas te/ le'u bdun mar/ khye'us pha mar 'bod 'dra'i gdung dbyangs laḥ pi waṃ gling bu'i gdangs ltar snyan pa yisaḥnyin mtshan dus drug rnams su gsol ba thobaḥ ces gsungs pa ltar sems rtse gcig tu gtad de gdung ba'i dbyangs su 'don par bya'o/ /de'ang tshig bdun nyid kyi 'bru non raṭa rim zhig byas na skabs don 'grub pas de la hūṃ zhes pas gsol 'debs kyi byang drangs te snyan gsan phab la/ o rgyan gyi yul gyi nub byang mtshams na dha na ko sha'i mtsho chen po yod pa'i gling du me tog pad+ma chen po'i ge sar te ze'u 'bru shin tu rgyas pa'i sdong po la brdzus te 84

bla ma dang o rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4'khrungs shing 'khrungs dus nyid nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbang bskur zhing mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis mchod bstod phul ba la sogs pa'i ya mtshan pa ste ngo mtshar dang ldan pa/ sngar nas sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi ngo bor mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'am thob zin nas 'dzam ba'i gling mtha' dbas kyi ni༄1 nor gdul bya gdul ba'i ched du bstan pa'i sprul pa'i sku pad+ma'i rigs yin pa dang pad+ma las 'khrungs pa'i cha nas pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i zhing khams thams cad na yongs su grags pa de/ dang po rgya gar gyi yul du rgyal po in+t+ra bho dhi sogs rgyal chen mang po dang rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas sogs dzo ki lha lcam mad+dha ra ba sogs rigs ldan gyi bud med la sogs pa gdul bya dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad/ bar du bod kyi yul du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rtsa ba thog mar btsugs shing mi dang mi min gyi gdul bya mtha' yas pa smin grol la bkod/snyigs dus kyi rgud pa zhi ba'i ched du gter kha bye ba phrag brgya bsam gyis mi khyab pa sbas/ tha ma 'gro lding gi yul du rdzu 'phrul dang gdams ngag gi sgo nas phra men rnams dam la btags shing mi'i 'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad de mthar rnga yab srin po'i gling gi lte ba mthing zhun gyi rgya mtsho'i dbus zangs mdog dpal gyi ri 85

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bo'i rtse dag pa'i zhing gi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i nang /pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal med khang khra phung nge ba na 'khor du ye shes dang 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro ste dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma mang pos bskor nas rdo rje lta bu'i sku da lta yang skye 'chi bgres rgud dang bral bar bzhugs yod tshul zhib tu bsam nas che ba'i yon tan gyis yid rang dbang med par 'phrogs pa'i dad pa 'dren nges bya/ de nas gu ru rin po che khyed kyi rjes su bdag zhugs nas bskyed rdzogs kyi lam mthon po tsho re zhig nyams sa ma longs yang gsol ༄'debs dang mos gus kyi gdung ba drag pos rtse gcig tu sgrub par byed kyi/ gu ru'i sku srin yul na bzhugs kyang thugs rje nye ring med cing mkhyen pa chags thogs mi mnga' bar 'jug pas na/bdag cag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib sogs mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi phun tshogs la bar du gcod pa thams cad skad cig nyid la zhi ba dang / tshe bsod dpal 'byor lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan mthun pa'i rkyen dang bcas pa thams cad 'bad med du 'grub par byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir du yid mgyogs kyi rdzu 'phrul chen po'i stabs su gshegs su gsol lo zhes 'dod don la thugs rje bskul zhing spyan 'dren pa'i gsol 'debs phur tshugs su bya zhing gsol 'debs kyi don bsdus pa bla 86

bla ma dang o rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4na med pa'i yon tan gyi khur gyis lci bas gu ru ste bla mar bya ba'i khyad chos can/ pad+ma'i rigs gtso bo pad+ma las 'khrungs pa'i mtshan yang pad+ma zhes bos te bdag la mchog dang thun mong gi sid+dhi ste dngos grub ma lus pa hūṃ zhes stsol cig par bskul ba'i sngags kyang sbrel la thun rer stong phrag la sogs par dag cing gsal ba'i ngag gis mi tshig dang ma 'dres par 'don/ o rgyan rin po che zangs mdog dpal ri na bzhugs pa'i da lta'i gnas tshod de nyid tshogs zhing du byas nas gsol ba 'debs pa yin pas rjes la bsdu rim sogs mi dgos/ thun mthar bsam pa myur 'grub dang dge bsngo bya/ de ltar nyams su blang ba'i phan yon yang gter gzhung nyid las/ 'di ltar gsol ba btab pa'i buḥ nga yis skyob pa smos ci dgosaḥ dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras su 'gyaraḥ zhes su ༄gsungs te gu rus nam yang rdzun mi gsungs pa la nges shes skyed de the tshom med pa'i yid kyis nyams su len pa gces so/ /zhes pa'ang rigs dbon bsod nams dpal ldan gyi brjed thor bstan pa'i nyi mas smras rim bzhin ma ti bha tras bris pa dge/87

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄khya/ /mtshams sgrub kyi zhal gdams sogs/na mo gu ru/ mtshams sgrub la yag po byas nas bsdad na rgyal ba sras bcas mnyes/ o rgyan rin po che'i dgong sa pa skong /rang gi 'di phyi'i legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba tshugs/ khyad par chos brgyud 'a dir sgrub tshugs 'dzin pa'i rjes 'jug rnams la kun mkhyen gong 'og gnyis sogs sangs rgyas kyi sa la bzhugs pa'i sngon gyi rig 'dzin mang pos bden tshig smon lam gyi dgongs pa gtad pa'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun ma nyams par yod pas/ bkra shis/byin che/ mtha' bzang ba yin gsungs/ yag po byas nas ma bsdad na/ ri stong du kha ta'i khyim mtshes la bsdad pa dgos pa ci yod/ des na rang gros rang la btab/ rang gis rang bcos te dam bca' mtha' skyel gyi zhe bcad brtan po byed/ dus nam yang 'di bya 'di byed kyi bsam blo dang / skyid sdug 'byor rgud kyi sems khur sogs mi bya bar sems bag phab/ khong klod/ gu yangs bar byas/ mtshams sgrub la 'di ltar brtson nas rgyal ba gong ma'i gshegs shul e snyogs lta rgyu byung ba bzang snyam nas khur du mi 'gro bar rgyan du 'gro ba'i 'du shes bsgom na/ 'dug je 88

tshar ṇ+ḍagu zug rngasnorngab skyetho sbyo1zug rngasnodre)zab cesajusno sdos /spyongs (sprub/theg skrasab/ba / 21yin/ shrī'imos/ snang ba je skyid/ dga' spro je cher song nas sgrub pa mtha' thon yong ba lags/༄7/ /ji skad du/ dpal ldan ma khol gyis/ /yul la nye bar spyod pa na/ /lha mi'i sbyor pa tha dad kyang / /chos kyi longs spyod thun mong bas/ /khyod la dbye ba mi mnga'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa bdud rtsi lha dang mi skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyi thun mong gi longs spyod du rgya cher 'phel ba'i rten 'byung bzang po'i ming swā dha ra ṇa ste than mong zhes pa lcags ༄pho khyi'i lo nas rdo stod gtsang chen du snying thig 'og ma'i rtsa gsum gyi sgrub grwa la bzhugs pa rnams kyis blang dor bya ba'i rim pa rags bsdus shig bsnyel tho'i tshul du spel ba la/ thog mar sgrub grwa pa phan tshun nang mthun pa dang / klong snying gi chos dang brgyud 'dzin la dad gus brtan pa dang / chos ldan gyi nang khrims la gces nor ltar rtsi 'jog byed mkhan kho na 'jug rgyu las/ 'thab bgrol can dang / mi dad pa dang / spyi brtol can/ ngan dred la song ba'i rigs mi 'jug /sgrub khang du bcad rgya bsdams nas grol gyi bar du/ dang po nas dmigs 'og tu bcug pa rnams ma gtogs su dang yang mi phrad cing ngag mi bsre/ dmigs 'og tu 'jug rgyu yang chu len pa dang / sgrub khang yang thog gi kha ba sprugs 89

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mkhan/ gang dgos cha med kyi lha rje/ gso sbyong sogs kyi dus 'dun dag len mkhan sogs chos ldan gyi bya ba'i yan lag tu med ka med 'ga' zhig tsam ma gtogs rang gi nye drung sogs su dga' gang 'thad dang bstun nas mi 'dzud/ shing gshog mkhan sgrub grwa pa rang rang nas chu len pa la phrin bskur te mngags pa'am/yang na chu len pa rang gis sgrub khang gi 'og tu bses na des 'thus/ gzhan mngags na sgrub khang gi phyi rol du bses te nang du chu len pa sogs dmigs 'og tu chud pa'i mis 'jog rgyu byed/sman pa dang / 'dun dag len mkhan sogs dmigs 'og tu chud pa yin yang / dgos pa de dang de'i dus kho na ma gtogs gzhan du mi 'dzud/ yo byad gtong len dgos na'ang chu len lta bu dmigs khongs su yod pa kho nas snga thun grol ba'i nyin gung gi thun mtshams la sprad len byed/ sgrub g.yog gis chu skyel ba dang /thal ba dbo ba sogs kyang gung dus kyi thun mtshams de kho na la byed cing / thun dang thun mtshams gzhan du sgrub khang du mi 'jugasgrub khang pa nang phan tshun dang / sgrub g.yog lta bur dgos pa'i dbang gis ngag bsre dgos pa byung na nyin gung gi thun mtshams de kho na la smra ba las/ thun dang thun mtshams gzhan du smra bcad kyi dam rgya lhod med byed/ nyin gung yang don ldan gyi ngag nyung la 90

bla ma dang o rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4trazheran pa tsam smra ba ma gtogs/ gtam nyob nag 'byams mi bya zhing / kha brgyags lab pa/ gcig gis gcig la 'bod rgyang byed pa/ byung rgyal gyi 'don dbyangs dang / don med par rnga dang ḍā dril dkrol ba sogs dus nam yang mi bya/ sngon 'gro/ skyabs sems/ rdor sems/ maṇ+ḍal/ ku su lu'i tshogs bsags/ bla rnam dang drug po zhag ci tsam byed kyi ring la/ thun dpon pas rnga zil 'bebs/ bzhag rol gcig brdung dus thams cad kyis thun bsdams shing / grol dus kyang der mtshungs/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi thams cad kyi skabs/ nyin zhag re la thun bzhi bzhir bgos te thun bsdams pa dang grol ba/ dngos gzhi'i dus dgong thun mtshams tshogs dang gsol kha gtong ba/ yar mar gyi tshe bcu gnyis la tshogs bskang cung rgyas byed dus sogs dus thams cad sgrigs la phab nas 'grigs pa/ ḍā dril dang rnga sogs brdung dus dang brdung sa brdung tshigs rnams gcig pa/ gtor bzo yang klong snying gtor dpe dang / gtor ma'i re mig gsal ba kho na ltar las/ gzhan gyi shan ma zhugs pa sogs phyag len gtsang sha gang thon la sgrims/ khyad par du ngag 'don gyi rim pa/ klong snying rang gi sngon 'gro/ rtsa gsum chos srung rnams dang / tsi'u dmar sogs rdo grub gong ma'i ring nas rgyun 'don byed rgyu'i bstan srung 91

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gsol kha kha shas dang / ltung bshags/ sgrol ma/ zab mdo lta bu ma gtogs/ lha srung dang chos rgyun mi gcig pa'i gsol kha sogs kha ton sra sre gtan nas mi byed/ thun dang thun mtshams kyi ring thung sogs nyi skar la tshad bzhag ste/ dpyid dang dbyar dus srod than dang / thor than cung zad thung bar bya zhing / ston dgun ra me /rngordo ༷༷༷ shāXste /re)zuraraganyis su las rang ba sogs tsho na mtshan 4 rang thung dang /rang gi khams kyis lcogs min sogs la zhib tu brtags nas thun dpon pas tshod 'dzin ji ltar bgyis pa bzhin sgrigs la phebs rgyu dgos kyi/ so so'i snang bar gang dran la mi 'jug /thun bar rnams su bsnyen yig sogs/ sgrub mtshams de nyid kyi nyer mkho tsam ma gtogs/ dpe bltas dang yig bris rigs mi byed/sngags chu dang srung mdud ster ba/ gsol kha 'phar ma dang /bdun bcos sogs chos 'don yon len/ sman sbyin pa/ mo rtsis dang skar ma blta ba/ bzo btsem drub dang / rwa bzhog shing bzhog byed pa/ g.yas nyal g.yon snyes byed pa/ gzhan gyis bcol gtam len pa/ phyi rol gyi skye bo la phag ltas rna nyan byed pa/gcig gis gcig mgron du 'bod pa/ sgrub g.yog la lce bcol nas nyo tshong byed pa sogs sgrub pa g.yel zhud dang / dngos grub phrogs pa'i rgyu chen por 'gyur ba'i nyes dmigs dran nas 'go 92

〈colo3 ṇ+ḍagu zug rngasnorngab 65 sbyo1zud tshodadrergeshāt+na byaspurngasno /snye /spyongs (sprub/bsu theṭab/bsu/ 21rngad/ shrī'iba'i nad bzhin du spang / sngon 'gro skyabs sems nas bla rnam bar la zhag grangs zhe dgu gtong rtsis byas nas lnga bcu pa'i snga dro/gtor bzo/ bshams bkod/ de nyid kyi dgong mo bsnyen sgrub dbu 'dzugs 'ong bar bya zhing / sgrub pa snga ma rdzogs nas/ tho rangs dngos grub blangs pa'i dgong mo sgrub pa phyi ma la 'jug pa sogs rigs 'gre sbyar/ snga phyi'i bar thag de las cung zad ring dgos na'ang / nyin gcig las lhag par ngal bso mi bya zhing /de'i ring la'ang stan nyi ma la bzhag nas sa dug bsang zhing /sgrub pa phyi ma'i bsnyen yig lta ba sogs las/ 'du 'dzi'i long gtam gleng ba dang / gnyid rtse dgod sogs bag med kyi kun spyod mi byed/ lo mjug zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i mar ngo'i zhag lnga tsam gyi ring kha skong sbyin sreg gi tshab tu yig brgya gang mang bzla/de dang dus mtshungs su sgrub grwa'i tshogs khang nang / mchod bzo pa rnams kyis gtor ma dang shom sogs tshags su tshud par byas nas gtor bzlog btang / de nas lo gsar tshes mgor/ sgrub grwa pa gsar rnying gnyis kas sam/ yang na gsar bzhugs rnams kyis rnam grol lam bzang gi cho ga nyin gsum mdzad nas/ gang ltar yang sgrub khang pa snga phyi brje dus/ snga ma rnams kyis smon lam dang / khyad par shis brjod gang rgyas/ phyi ma rnams kyis bsang 93

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gser skyems/ cha gsum sogs bsngos nas brje spo byed/ ldebs yig chung ngu 'di yang yang gzigs nas rang zhe rang la mi khrel ba'i spang blang zhib mo nan tan du mdzad pa dang / sgrub grwa pa snga phyi brje dus rtsis sprod len mi lhod pa gal che/ zhes smin zla'i dkar phyogs kyi gang ba la rdo sprul ming pas bris pa dge bar gyur cig/ // 94

bla ma dang o rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4༄/ /rdo rje gzhon nu la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/dpal rdo rje gzhon nu la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor mdor bsdus su 'god pa la/ grub na dam tshig gi rten du phung bo'i sku gzugs bris 'bur ci rigs kyi mdun du mchod pa ci 'byor bsham/ ma grub kyang chad skyon med/ stan bde ba la 'dug nas nges 'byung gi bsam pas rgyud bskul te/ skyabs sems ni/ bla ma mchog gsum yi dam lha/ /gus pas skyabs mchi mkha' mnyam 'gro/ /bla med byang chub mchog thob phyir/ /zab lam snying po bsgom bar bgyi/ / lan gsum/ de nas tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa ni/ dpal rdo rje he ru ka'i ye shes kyi sku mngon sum du mi mthong ba'i sems can rnams la de nyid tha mal pa'i lus can gyi bla ma'i rnam par bstan nas rjes su 'dzin pa dang / 'dzin tshul yang de 'dra'i bla ma des dam ye gnyis su med pa'i he ru ka dngos kyi rnam pas dbang bskur ba legs pa'i phrin las dam pa yin phyir/ bla ma dang yi dam tha mi dad pa'i nges shes kyis drangs pa'i yid ches brtan pos/ ā rang byung nam khar mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus/ /seng khri pad+ma nyi zla dregs pa'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma dpal ldan he ru ka /rdo rje gzhon nu dbang sngon nor bu'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis ri rab phur bu 'dril/ /dur khrod chas rdzogs ye shes me 'bar klong / zhabs zung g.yon brkyang gyad gyi 'dor stabs 'gying / /'khor lo rgyas 'debs gri thod 'dzin pa 'khyud/ /gar dgu'i nyams kyis brtan g.yo zil 95

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ gnon pa/ /dam ye dbyer med rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun/ /spro bsdu'i byed po sgrib med ye shes spyan/ /gsol 'debs ba la ༄brtse bas dgongs bzhin bzhugs/ ces gsal btab la/ de'i spyan sngar bsags sbyang spel gsum bya ba ni/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal / /sogs/ snga 'gyur bka' ma ltar ram yang na/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gshegs/ /nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /nyams chags sdig sgrib mthol zhing bshags/ /gsang sngags bsgrub la rjes yi rang / /smin grol gsang sngags chos 'khor skor/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlabs du gsol/ ces dmigs 'dun rtse gcig pas lan gsum sogs ci nus bya/ de nas phur tshugs su gsol ba gdab pa las thog mar brgyud 'debs ni/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dgongs pa yis/ /sogs/'phrin las brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlabs du gsol/ /lan gsum/ sogs/ de nas brgyud pa kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma he ru ka nyid la rang gi lus ngag yid gsum srid pa thams cad rdo rje gzhon nur byin gyis rlabs pa dang / de nyid kyang 'bras bu mthar phyin pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje gzhon nu dang gnyis su med par sgrub pa'i slad du/ rdorje gzhon nu rig 'dzin rnams/ /srid pa rdo rje grub mdzod cig/ /96

bla ma dang o rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4srid pa rdo rje phur bu'i lha/ /ye shes khro bo grub par mdzod/ /ces dang / rgyal rnam 'phrin las ye shes phyag rgya'i gzugs/ /rnam mang gdul bya'i rgyud kyi sgrib pa'i phyir/ /thal 'byin rdo rje'i stobs mnga' bla ma dang / /yi dam dbyer med khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdud dang grogs ngan chags sdang rnam rtog sogs/ /phyi nang bar chad yul kyis mi brdzi zhing / /byang chub lam bzang sgrub pa'i brtson 'grus stobs/ /shugs drag rdo rje lta bur byin gyis rlobs/ /zang thal rig pa'i phur bu stong chen dbyings/ /btab pas 'khrul snang brag ri thal phyung ste/ mkha' khyab 'gro kun bdud bzhi'i dgra sde las/ /skyobs nus mthu chen dbang por bdag byin rlobs/ /ces lan grangs ci rigs dang gtso sngags 'bru dgu sogs dang 'bru bcu bzhi ba ci 'grub gsol 'debs kyi bsnyen pa'i tshul du bzla/ de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i bla ma te ru ka nyid mchog tu dgyes pa'i nyams gyis sku'i gnas bzhi nas 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun dang bcas pa spros te rang gi gnas bzhir zhugs shing thim pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang bar byas shing / dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub thob par mos la/ dpal ldan bla ma'i sku yi gnas bzhi nas/ /'od zer byung ba rang gi gnas bzhir thim/ /sku gsung thugs dang ye shes rdo rje yis/ /byin gyis rlabs nas dbang bzhi thob par gyar/ /༄zhes brjod thugs yid bsre zhing dgongs pa mnyam par bzhag pa ni/ bla ma dpal 97

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/chen he ru la /dgyes pas 'od zhu rang la thim/ /rang yang kun gzhi ma bcos pa'i/ /ngang la yid ni 'dzin pa bral/ /rnam dag spros bral chos kyi sku/ /chos kyi sku la gnyis sa med/ /bsngo smon ni/༄dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /dpal ldan bla ma 'grub gyur nas/ /sogs dang / spro na dong spruṭa smon lam kyang gdab bar bya'o/ zhes pa'ang sprul sku 'jigs med tshul khrims rgyal mtshan kyis ngor rdo rgan bstan nyis lha bskyed gsol 'debs kyi tshigs bcad ma gtogs rdo rje'i tshig byin rlabs can rnams bsgrigs te smras pa ltar blo gsal bzang pos yi ger bkod pa'o/༄khya/ /'phags mchog phyag na pad mo'i rnal 'byorasnying rje mchog gi sa bon bzhugs so/ /na mo lo ki shwa ra ya/ 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs bsgrub par 'dod pas thog mar skyabs sems ni/ na mo/ mchog gsum ngo bo thugs rje'i lhar//byang chub bar du skyabs mchi zhing / /'gro don byang chub sgrub pa'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor zab mor 'jug par bgyid/ /lan gsum/dngos gzhi lha'i rnal 'byor ni/ hrīḥ spros kun mtshan ma zhi ba'i dbyings//dag chen brtan g.yo'i snang cha ru/ /rnam rol gru 'dzin zhing gi dbus/ /pad ma zla ba'i gdan steng du/ /rgyal kun snying rje chen po'i gar/ /trīḥyig zla ltar dkar ba'i mdog /yongs gyur 98

bla ma dang o rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /dkar gsal mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar ba/ /zhal gcig zhi 'dzum bzhad pa'i nyams/ /phyag gnyis nor bu pad dkar 'dzin/ /dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /kriṇ+ḍa'i pags pas nu g.yon bkab/ /zhabs zung bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis gnas/ /thugs kar pad zla'i lte ba ru/ /trīḥmathar yi ge drug pas bskor/ /'od 'phros sangs rgyas mdzad pa bsgrubs/ /tshur 'dus rang la thim pa'i mod/ /sgo gsum 'phags pa'i gsang gsum dang / /dbyer med mchog gi sa thob gyur/ /yig drug ci nus bzla/ de nas mdun bskyed ni/ oṃ swā bha wa sogs/mi dmigs chos dbyings mchog gi rtsal/ /lhun grub snying rje chen po'i sku/ /mdun mkhar pad+ma zla ba'i steng / /hrīḥdakar dwangs ma'i gzugs can las/ /'od 'phros rgyal mchod 'gro sgrib sbyangs// tshur 'dus yongs su gyur ba las/ /'phags tshogs sdug bsngal rang grol lha/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang bo gnyis/ /snyim pa'i thal mo thugs kar sbyar/ /g.yas 'og shel dkar phreng ba 'dren/ /g.yon pas pad ma dkar po 'dzin/ /zhabs gnyis bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis sgeg /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /'khril ldem gzhon nu'i ngang tshul can/ /gas/la 'tsher 'od kyi sprin phung 'phro/ /spyi gtsug rigs bdag snang mtha' yas/ /99

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sangs rgyas bsod nams phung bor bzhugs/ /mtha' skor 'phags ma sgrol ma sogs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /dpa' mo mkha' 'gro'i sprin phung 'khrigs/ /kun gyi gnas gsum yig 'bras mtshan/ /de las 'od zer rab 'phros rterngazeram rig rimi mi tsho cingapas/ /ja snyad rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /phyag na pad+ma' rnam rol gyis/ /skad cig nyid la spyan drangs gyur/ /ces brjod cing bsam/ hrīḥ chos sku skye ba med pa las/ /lhun grub rang byung snying rje'i gzugs/ /ma 'gaṭa pad+ma rigs kyi lha/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'phags pa'i tshul/ /rigs kyi sprul ba 'bum dang bcas //sngon gyi thugs dam chen po yis/ /sems can don du dgongs mdzad la/ /byin gyis brlabs phyir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ lo ki shwa ri sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ mchod pa ni/ trīḥ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med pa'i /zhing khams ma lus ji snyed pa/ /lha rdzas mchod sprin rgya mtsho yis/ /til gong 'phyur ba bzhin du gtams/ /zag med dgyes pa bskyed pa'i rdzas/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i mchod yon dang / /me tog bdug spos mar me dri/ /zhal rdzas rol mo'i sprin phung gis/bla ma mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /rgyal dang de sras bcas kun mchod/ /thugs kyi dgyes pa bskangs nas kyang / /ma lus 100

bla ma dang o rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4d+kudangos grub ba475 du gsol/ /oṃ a r+ghaṃ sogs/ bstod pa ni/ hrīḥchos nyid mnyam pa nyid kyi sku/ /nyes pa'i mtshan ma kun zad cing / /rtog pa kun las rnam grol ba'i/ /rang bzhin bsam mi khyab la bstod/ /mi dmigs zab mo'i ye shes dang / /kun snang thugs rje zung 'jug pa'i/ /ye shes skye dgu'i bla na 'phags/ /'jig rten nyi ma khyod la bstod/ /khyod mtshan lan gcig thos pas kyang //rgud pa'i nyes pa kun sel ba/ /smon lam thabs mkhas rgya mcho1re gter/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid khyod la bstod/ /ting 'dzin sgyu ma gcig gi 'phrul/ /rnam pa du ma'i gzugs sku ru/ /ston mdzad dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lhar/ /mi phyed dang bas rtag tu 'dud/ /dzab dgongs ni/ mdun bskyed 'phags pa'i thugs ka ru//nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor dbus/ /ting 'dzin sems dpa'i hrīḥyig mthar/ /sngags phreng yi ge drug pas bskor/ /bdag bskyed thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ /thugs rgyud dal zhing dgyes pa bskyed/ /byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i 'od snang gis/ /bdag gzhan sgrib pa'i mun bsal nas/ /ye shes snang ba rgyas par gyur/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ trīḥ zhes rnam rtog rgya 'byams su song ba ma yin par rtse gcig 'dun pa'i gzhur la drangs pa'i ting nge 'dzin khab mig tu skud pa 'jug pa lta bu'i gnad dang ma bral bas ci tsam nus par bzla/ thun mthar mchod cing bstod/ ma 'byor pa dang 101

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sogs yi ge brgya pa brjod/ oṃ khre9) kyi sogs/ badz+ra mus ye shes pa gshegs/dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam la/ bsngo smon shis brjod kyis mtha' rgyas par bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang rdo rje yi ge drug pa'i rnal 'byor la mos pa snying bor byed pa'i dge slong gnas brtan dam pa a mo gha'i bzhed skong du sprang smyon 'jigs med pas gang dran thol byung du brjod pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ // 102

phar chosazug rngasnokhung skyetho sbyo1zug rngasnodrergezang byaspurngasno /rgya /spyorngab (sprupe/ba theṭab/thab/ rngosarngad/ 〈co༄/ /klong snying gi lo rgyus lkor/༄༅/ /rje bla ma bka' drin 'khor med gter chen chos kyi rgyal po mdo sngags gling pa'i zhabs rten rin po che'i pad+ma la spyi bos gtugs te phyag 'tshal lo/ /klong snying gi lo rgyus skor la/ gsang gtam chen mor o rgyan rin po che dang / 'jam dpal gshes gnyen gyis dbang gnang bar bshad pa ni rtogs brjod chu zla'i/yul seng ga la yi a tsar+ya/ /sogs kyi skor yin/ gnad byang las/rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yiḥ bskul ma thengs gsum/zhes pa/ rig 'dzin gyi bskul ma ni/ kun mkhyen chos rjes brda 'grol mdzad pa dang / dpa' bo'i ni kong smyon pra ti sngags 'chang gi bskul ma dang / mkha' 'gro'i ni mchims phur sman btsun mched lngas bla ma sku khams ma dang / chos rnga chen po'i sogs kyis gsol 'debs phal ba de yin 'dra/ lo rgyus 'di rje ༄bla mar snyan sgron phul/ zhes pa'i bla ma ni dpal ri sprul sku yin zhes dge sprul gyis bshad kyang rje dri med gling par mngon/ nam snying nyang ban mchog dbyangs dngaḥ lha sras sprul pas/ zhes pa'ang pra ti sngags 'chang / 'jigs med kun grol/ theg gling 1 03

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhabs/ rdo grub rnams su snang / rnam thar na klong snying gis chos bka' 'byung ba'i ltas su blo ldan bh+ra ma ra'i gtam shar bar gsungs pa'ang 'di'i lo rgyus su sdud dgos/ snying thig ces pa ni rdzogs chen man ngag sde'i snying thig skor gyi gnad 'dril bas yin par gsal te/ de'i mtshan gzhi'ang ye shes klong gi rgyud sogs rgyud phyi ma/ rgyud gnyis/ lung dgongs nyams/ man gnad gsum dag /gnas lugs rdo rje'i tshig rkang sogs so/ /chos sde'i gtso bo de rnams yin zhing / rig 'dzin zhi drag gi skor sogs de'i 'khor du gtogs pas na gtso bo'i sgo nas mtshan btags pa'o/ /de ltar yang snying po don gsal las/ 'di ni sems phyogs kyi grub mtha'i snying po gtso bor 'don pas zhes pa nas/ye shes klong gi rgyud la sogs pas man ngag gi thus ka tshang la ma nor bar ston la/ zhes so/ /rdzogs chen snying thig la/ pad+ma'i bka' srol dang / bi ma la'i ste phyogs 'dir gnyis su grags che ba las 'di gang zhe na/ rnam thar du/ 'di snying thig gong ma'i don po yin par gsungs pa ltar gnyis ka'i ste pad+ma'i bka' srol yin pa ni/ rig 'dzin pad+ma'i klong chen brdaḥ mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod chen mo yinaḥ zhes shog dril lnga ka pad+ma'i zab gter du bshad pas shes shing / gnad byang las/ zab don snying gi 104

bla ma dang o rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4thig le'i skoraḥ sogs kyis kyang gsal/ bi ma'i bka' srol yin pa ni/ klong rgyud kyi bsgyur byang na shin tu gsal zhing / kun mkhyen chos rjes brda bkrol bar yang yin par gsungs shing khyad par rgyud phyi ma las bshad pa'ang / lar mkha' 'gro snying tig gi bdag po gcig pu'ang rgyal ba klong chen pa yin mod de/ 'dir bī ma'i bka' babs kyi phyogs nas byin gyis brlabs pa gtso che ba 'dra ste/ paṇa chen bī ma la'i sgyu 'phrul zhes snying po don gsal du snang ba'ang dgos dbang che zhing / thig le'i rgya can du'ang bī ma la'i bla sgrub tu sbyar ba bzhin no/ /'on kyang chu zla'i gar mkhan du lhun grub kyi sbubs gzigs tshul thun mong ma yin pa rnams o rgyan rin po che'i byin rlabs kyi lag rjes kho nar sbyar te/ dbyings gzhon nu bum sku'i zhing khams de/ sogs gong 'og kun tu 'byung bas pad+ma'i bka' srol gtso che'am snyam/ de de'i rgyu mtshan du 'gro lugs ni/ skabs 'dir gdod ma'i gzhi klong du btsan sa zin tshul dang gzhi snang la dbang bsgyur tshul bshad pa rnams ni chos 'di'i don brgyud kyi bka' babs brnyes tshul bstan par snang ba'i phyir te/ gsang gtam chen mor dus de'i tshe gnyid 'od gsal gyi 'khor lor sogs dang rtogs brjod chu zla bsgrigs na shes/ de'ang dang por mnal lam du gu ru'i zhabs rjes las 105

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dbang bzhi blangs pa'i rkyen gyis nang dbyings khyad chos drug ldan gyi grol sa mthong ba dang / de rjes 'jam dpal gshes gnyen gyis byin gyis rlobs pa'i rkyen las/ dus 'di nas dgongs pa'i gsang mdzod rdol/ /sogs gsungs shing / de'i tshe mnga' ris paṇa chen gyi bag chags gsal bar sad tshul dang / de rjes rnga yab gling du gu ru bde ba chen po dang thags yid 'dres nas 'od ༄gsal gzhon nu bum sku'i zhing gzigs par gsungs pa rnams ni/chos 'di'i don brgyud kyi dgongs pa ji ltar babs pa dang / de la brten nas rnam thar do ha'i rgyan du/ rtsa khams kyi yi ge ye shes kyi rlung gis bskul bas dam pa'i chos kyi rol mor 'khrol bar bshad pa ltar chos gter 'di byung tshul bshad pa ste/ gsang gtam dang chu zla sbyar na gsal po yod/ 'dir zhal gzigs dang lung bstan byung rabs sogs rtsal du bton nas ma bshad par/'od gsal bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dgongs pa la dbang thob tshul dang / de'i rang rtsal las mkha' 'gro'i brda'i gsang mdzod rang shar du rnyed tshul rgya cher bstan pa 'di ni nang zab mo dgongs pa'i gter gyi lo rgyus khyad par ba yin zhes bshad na blo'i mig can rnams ngo mtshar bar byed do/ /des na 'dir ni zhal gzigs sogs kyang dgongs pa de'i sad rkyen du sbyar nas bshad 106

bla ma dang o rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4 pa shas che'o/ /de'ang dpe rgyud sngon la rnyed de slar zhal gzigs kyi steng nas snyan rgyud blang ba'i phyogs dang mi 'dra bar/ dpe rgyud rnyed dus don brgyud kyang rdzogs par brnyed zin pa'i lugs su byung ba ste/ de dag gnyis ka'ang sku tshe 'dir chos 'di'i byin brgyud gsal bar thob tshul gyi steng nas khyad bshad kyi/ gter brgyud dngos sngon gyi bag chags sad pa'i steng nas 'jog par ni 'dra'o/ /de dag ni gter ston rang nyid kyis chos 'di rnyed tshul yin cing / de nas sprel lo sprel zlar bsam lhun tshes bcu'i cho ga'i dus o rgyan rin po che mjal bas bar chad bsal zhing byin gyis brlabs par bshad pa dang / g.yu sgron mas rnam dkar gyi 'bul ba bcas gsol 'debs kyi gdung dbyangs byas pa dang /gong smos bskul ma thengs gsum/ sngags srung ma sha za mo gzhon nu'i rnam pas snyoms 'jug gi bde chen bstabs nas sku tshe dang phrin las kyi rten 'brel gsos btab pa sogs ni gzhan don du chos gter chen po 'di 'chad spel gyi phrin las khyab gdal du skyong ba'i sgo phye tshal yin te/ 'di ltar dmigs phyed pa yang zhib tu ༄bltas na sla'o/ /chos 'di'i sgo 'byed kyi dbang la/ dang por zhi khro dang dpal chen gang rung gi dbang skur dgos par snying po don gsal 107

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/las te/ sngar dbang ma thob pa la phyi nang gi 'jug pa dang / sdom bzung gnyis sogs med pa'i nus dbang tsam gyis bskur mi rung bas/ dang po nas rgyal thabs spyi blugs sogs bskur ba mi 'thad mod/ rgyal thabs spyi blugs lta bur yang 'jug pa gnyis dang slob ma'i dbang lnga sogs rgyas par man ngag gis bskangs te bskur na ni dang po'i dbang chog tu bya rung bar rdo grub sogs bzhed pa 'dra ste legs par mthong / phyi sgrub bla ma'i rnal 'byor la bzlas pa 'bum phrag brgya gtong mi nus na yang / gsang gtam chen mor/'bru 'bum gtong ba nyi shu rtsa grangs byung / zhes dang / rnam thar du/ 'bum ther nas/ 'bum phrag brgya'i bar gsog pa'i lam srol tshugs/ zhes pa ltar 'bum yan chad cis kyang gsog dgos/gal te bla ma phyi sgrub 'di ka'i steng nas tshogs bsags rgyas pa dang / bskang bshags sogs dang / bsnyen pa 'khyol rjes bdag 'jug kyang byed par spro na bla mchod dngos grub rgya mtsho ltar bya ste /de nyid 'di'i rgyas bshad yin pa'i phyir te/ shin tu gsal/ tshe sgrub dbang bshad zhal gsung mar/ dgongs 'dus gter lung drangs nas/ zhes snying thig gi rdzogs rim dang / rig 'dzin gyi bskyed rim la brten nas rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhir sbyor ba'i lam ston du bsngags pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa ltar 'di'i bskyed 108

bla ma dang o rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4rim chos skor kyi rtsa ba ni rig 'dzin bla ma'i sgrub pa yin cing /de la dpal 'dus kyang rig 'dzin zhi drag zer dus kyi gur drag yin pas gur drag bka' brgyad yin pa shin tu sla/ 'on kyang /phyi ltar byang sems nang rig 'dzinaḥ zhes sogs skabs dpal 'dus rang gsang ba sgrub sde brgyad ltar sgrub pa dang / nang rig 'dzin ltar sgrub pa la rig 'dus bzhag dgos pas rig 'dzin rtsa sgrub ni nang sgrub rig 'dus te/ mdor na 'dir rtsa gsum kun gyi gtso bo rigs 'dus yin no/ /de la dgongs nas kun mkhyen bla ma nyid sgrub sde'i nang tshan rig 'dzin bla ma'i bka' babs su zhal gyis bzhes pa yin no/ /des na rtsa rgyud thod dum las/ 'di ni rig 'dzin rdo rje chosaḥ zhes pa nas/ mnga' bdag rgyal po'i chos skal yinaḥ zhes so/ /gsang sngags snga 'gyur la rgyud sde dang sgrub sde gnyis las/sgrub sde 'i ring lugs 'dzin na gdams phran gyis sa chod chung bas khog che shos bka' brgyad kyi lugs srol zhig 'dzin dgos la/ de la bka' srol mi 'dra ba mang ba las/ 'di ni bla ma bka' brgyad ces rig 'dzin yongs 'dus dang / grol thig lam rgyas pa'i snying po'i yang zhun lta bur mngon te/ rtsa rgyud thod dum las/ rig 'dzin ltar du 'di lta steḥ zhe sa sogs don 'di shīn tu gsal la 109

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rgyas par bshad do/ /chos 'di 'byung ba'i ltas su mnga' ris paṇa chen gyi bag chags sad de skye ba 'phos pa lta bur song tshul bshad pa'ang / bla ma bka' brgyad sa gter gyi babs so che shos mnga' ris paṇa chen yin pas/ de'i zab gter gyi yang snying slar yang dgongs gter du dbang sgyur ba'i rten 'brel gyi khyad yin nam snyam/ gu ru zhi ba'i thugs srog hrīḥyig la mdzad pa shas che mod/ 'dir hūṃ du byed pa'ang bka' brgyad kyi gco bo'i thugs srog dang gcig du mdzad pa'o/ /'dir bskyed chog la ting 'dzin rnam gsum rim 'jug med par bsnyen yig tu gsungs shing /der gzhung gi tshig don che long du bkral ba'i 'gangs la brtags na/ gtso bo sa bon gyi yi ge las bskyed mi ba skyed tsam ma gtogs yum ka'i/ aḥ snang ba thams cad yum lnga'i klong ཿ sogs dang 'gros mthun par gsal lo/ /'di'i lugs kyis/ gtso bo'i sngags kyi bzlas pa dang / gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sems 'dzin sogs kyis bsnyen pa dang gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi bzlas pa dang / gtso bo'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje chos bskyed pa bsnan nas do li'i dmigs pas bde chen gyi ye shes spor ba'i bsam gtan gyi lde kha 'dogs pa ni sgrub pa yin/ las sbyor ni tshe sgrub tsam las zur pa ma bstan snang / bsnyen sgrub kyi go 110

bla ma dang o rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4don ni 'di'i bsnyen pa'i thad du/ rig 'dzin rgya mtshos byin gyis rlobasaḥ sogs tsam las ma gsungs te/ sgrub pa'i thad du/'bum phrag bcu yis dngos grub thobaḥ ces pa dang / bsgrigs pas 'di ltar mngon te/ sgrub pas rig 'dzin bzhir sbyor nus kyi rtogs pa khyad par can gyi dngos grub dngos su 'thob la/ de la sngon du sgrub pa po'i rgyud lha sngags ye shes kyis byin gyis brlabs nas de 'dra'i dngos grub kyi snod khyad par can du gyur pa dgos pas de ltar sgrub byed du bsnyen pa'i rnal 'byor bzhag pa ste/'di ni sgom phyogs dris lan du/ dper na so nam byed pa la/ /sogs dang yang shin tu 'grigs so/ /smin slob kyi dbang du byas kyi las rung la ni de dang de'i rten 'brel tsam bsgrigs par zad do//blo'i mun sel du bshad pa rnams dang yang khog gcig par snang ngo //de ltar na dngos grub dngos su sgrub pa'i nus pa skyed byed du bstan pa'i sngags ni sgrub sngags yin la/ dngos grub kyi mthu ma thob par rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa tsam gyis dngos grub kyi las la dngos su sbyor mi btub pas/ las sbyor gyi khyad par tshe sgrub ni sgrub pa'i rjes 'brel du gtogs kyi/ bsnyen pa tsam gyi rjes 'brel min pas tshe sngags kyang bsnyen sngags sham ldan la ma mdzad par/sgrub sngags sham ldan la mdzad pa yin no/ /des na rdo grub kyis 111

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags gnyis kyi rigs re bzlas nas gdod tshe sngags kyi bzlas sgom la 'jug par tshe chog ljags bsgrigs las gsungs pa'ang shin tu legs so/ /yang na tshe sngags rig 'dzin spyi dzab sham ldan la mdzad pa ni 'di'i lugs kyis/ rigs lnga'i rig 'dzin la brten nas 'byung lnga'i sogs dang / dhā na saṃ skyi la brten nas sogs ltar gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs la brten nas/tshe sgrub pa'i gnad kyis yin zer dgos te/ bskyang bde ba la 'di bzang ngam snyam/ phyi ma 'di ltar na'ang / 'di'i tshe sgrub tshad ldan byed na gtso sngags kyi bzlas pa tsam 'khyol bas mi chog gi/spyi dzab kyi bzlas grangs yang them dgos te/ spyi dzab kyi mtha' sgyur yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bka' brgyad gzhan las bla ma bka' brgyad byin rlabs myur ba ni/ sgrub sde chen po brgyad kyi gtso bo rnams rig 'dzin brgyad du bzhengs pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin las shes te/ gsang rdzogs su blta'o/ /'di'i kha skong sbyin sreg ni ye shes me lce ltar dang / 'di'i sgos kyi rdzogs rim ni snyan rgyud shog dril dang / thabs lam ma bsgom sangs rgyas te/ de'i phyi lus kyi stong rar lha bskyed pa'ang sku mdog dang bzhugs stabs bsgyur ba tsam ma gtogs 'di'i ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje chos rang yin no//112

bla ma dang o rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4yang bsnyen pa o rgyan rin po che nyid la byas na nye ba'am myur te/ bod kyi bla ma'i skal ba zhes so/ /sgrub pa rig 'dzin spyi dzab la byas na tshan che ste rdo rje 'chang gi gral brnyes so cog gi rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang thams cad dngos grub stsol ba la dgongs pa gcig par dril nas bsgrub pas te/ blo ngo la ltos so/ /bka' brgyad bde gsang gnyis su yang rig 'dzin slob dpon yongs rdzogs kyi snying po 'bra gsam dang ma hā gu ru'i sngags 'di nyid du ༄ ༄bshad cing / rig 'dzin yongs 'dus dang / grol thig lam rgyas par yang sngags 'di 'byung ngo / /sku gsum lam khyer skabs/ gzhi la 'chi bar gnyis rim gyis kho nar 'byung yang / 'dir 'chi srid dag pa'i 'od gsal gyi rang mdangs bar do dang skye srid rnam par dag pa'i snang char shar bar bslab pas sbyong bar bzhed 'dra ste/ 'chi srid du 'ong rgyu'i 'od gsal sgrib bral du dag pa'i chos sku dang / 'chi srid las bar srid du ldang rgyu'i rlung sems dag pa'i longs sku hūṃ yig gnyis dus mnyam cig car du skyed pa ni 'bras bu dang bstun pa ste/'bras dus su ni bar srid dag pa'i longs sku de 'chi srid dag pa'i 'od gsal las ma g.yos bzhin du 'od gsal de'i rang snang mdangs la bzhag par zad pas so/ /hūṃ dang gtso bo gnyis snga phyi 113

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rim can du sgom pa ni 'bras dus su gdul bya la snang ba ston tshul dang gzhi la bar skye'i go rim gnyis kar bstun chog /'chi srid dag pa'i 'od gsal dang / bar do dag pa'i longs skur mos pa'i mi rtog pa dang hūṃ yig mnyam bskyed byas pa'i mi rtog pa des bskyed rim pa'i 'chi ba chos sku'i lam khyer gyi go mi chod de/skabs 'dir bcos ma'i tshul gyis 'od gsal gyis stong nyid sgom pa'i tshul la rtse gcig tu dmigs nas sgom pa zhig med na/ de 'dra'i 'al 'ol tsam gyis da gzod rdzogs rim dus 'od gsal stong pa dang bsres nas tha mal pa'i 'chi srid sbyong ba'i smin byed du mi 'gyur bas so zhe na/ gsar ma'i lugs bzhin byas na shin tu bden mod/ 'di pa'i lugs kyis/ sgrub thabs kyi sngon 'gro'i chos bdun rdzogs nas/ dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor la/ sku gsum gyi'am/ rdo rje gsum gyi rnal 'byor gsum las/ dang por sku phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor dang / gnyis par gsung bzlas pa'i dang /gsum par thugs nyer bsdu'i rnal 'byor te/ rags rim nas phra rim la 'jug pa yin la/ de las skabs 'dir dang po sku phyag rgya'i ting 'dzin skabs yin pas 'chi srid lam khyer yang dmigs 'og tu bcug nas sgom pa tsam las gtso bor 'don pa mtha' gcig tu mi dgos pas rdzogs rim pa'i 'chi srid lam khyer gyi dge 114

bla ma dang o rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4rtsa smin byed tsam du song na des chog gi/ dge rtsa de rdzogs par smin byed tsam du rtsal 'don mi dgos/ slar sa bcad gsum pa rtag mtha' 'am srid mtha' sbyong byed thugs nyer bsdu 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor dus rtsal 'don byed do/ /rjes thob sgyu ma'i lha skur ldangaḥ man chad mjug thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor te rjes thob ces pa 'dis mtshams bzung bas so/ /des na 'dir skye ba sbyong byed kyi dge rtsa rdzogs par smin pa la 'bad dgos shing / gnyis pa'i thad du bar dor 'ong rgyu'i rlung sems sngags su 'char ba dang sngags dang lha dbyer med dang zung 'jug tu blta ba la sbyangs nas bar do'i sbyong byed la rtsal thon pa gal che ste/ nyang gi khros nag gi sku gsum lam khyer dang shin tu 'grigs so/ /de gzhi la 'chi srid las bar dor dang de las skye srid du 'gro ba dang / 'bras dus su 'char gzhi chos sku las longs skur snang zhing des sprul sku 'dzin pa'i go rim dang mi mthan zhe na/ 'di la brtags pa zhib dgos/༄'di rnams yum kar yang mkho ste/ bsnyel thor stong pa sngon du bsgom nas gdod dkyil 'khor bsgom byas pa ltar na/ 'og min bgrod par/ drod gsher sbyong thad/ rim gyis 'jug pa gang zhe na/dbyings dang ye shes rim gyis zhugs nas ni/ /zhes drangs pa der 'gyur pas/ 'og min bgrod pa'i rdzus skyes sbyong thad na shin 115

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tu gsal ba ltar snang stong gi phyogs gnyis dus gcig du rdzogs pa'i tshul du mos dgos te/ rang bzhin yongs grub kyi bskyed rim zer/ phyi khyams dpal mgon bdun cu dngaḥ zhes pa'i khyams ni gzhal yas khang gi phyi'i bka' sdod kyi snam bu yin gyi/ rtsig pa'i nang gi khyams yin na bar khyams zhes bshad rigs par 'gyur ro/ /snying po don gsal gyi thig yig de'ang rig 'dus kyi yin par grags pas de la ni/ zlum skor phyi ma rtsig pa la gtugs snang ste/grwa phyogs mdog ces pas shes so/ /des na bar khyams med do/ /bla rnam skabs klu sgrub dang 'jam dpal bshes gnyen bi ma sogs rig 'dzin brgyad dang / dga' rab rdo rje/ klong chen/ rgyal ba mchog dbyangs sogs 'khor gyi rig 'dzin rnams kyi gsol 'debs sngags kyang bzla bar mos na/ bla ma mchod pa'i/ ma hā gu ru dz+nyā na sid+dhi sogs can de bzla ste rgyu mtshan sngar bzhin yin pas so/ /rig 'dzin brgyad spyan gnyis pa dang / yum can bris 'dug /116

bla ma dang o rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4spro//rten gsum rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga snying por dril ba bzhugs so//skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal he ru ka'i skur gyur/ lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga la bar du gcod pa'i log 'dren bgegs kyi rigs thams cad 'dir ma 'khod par gzhan du dengs shig /hūm̐ bzhi'isngags brjod/ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba dang gur khang gis mtshams bcad par gyur/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā sogs/ stong pa nyid kyi ngang las sgyu ma lta bu'i ye shes kyi rtsal snang dag pa rab 'byams brtan g.yo'i 'khor lor cir yang 'char ba'i dam tshig gi rten rnams bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin cing longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chos kyis brgyan pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros 'og min gyi zhing nas ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam ye dbyer med du gyar pa'i thags ka nas 'od zer 'phros dbang gi lha rigs ༄ ༄117
