pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ye shri ye hūm̐ḥ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs lnga'i cod pan gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/oṃ tsak+ṣa tsak+ṣa sa mān+ta tsak+ṣa bi shwa dha ni swā hā/ oṃ aḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ring rang dang (rwa/bsgoms pa'i lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las rten so so'i rnam par gyur/brtan bzhugs ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/khyad par du yang sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/ dbyangs gsal rten snying ci rigs/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'khor ba srid du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /mchog rnams legs par bstsal du gsol/ /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ mthar shis brjod bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang rigs kyi gcung po 'dzam gling dbang rgyal gyi gsung ngor 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas skad 118
bla ma dang o rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4—cig gis shar mar bris// // 119
po yi ces bsdengan bzhung

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄༅/ /'phags pa dang sgrol ma spre'u dang brag srin du sprul/slar yang sprul gzhi nyid kyis de gnyis bza' mir gnang zhing byin gyis brlabs/ 'gro ba riṭa drug nas 'phos pa'i sems can drug de gnyis kyi bu phrug tu byin gyis brlabs nas riṭa drug gi 'gro ba rnams 'phags pa'i sras su skyed pa'i rten 'brel mdzad/ de nas bzung ste sprel sgom gyi tsha rgyud du skyes tshad thams cad 'phags pa yab yum nyid kyis rang gi gdung rigs su 'byung bar byin gyis brlabs pa kho na yin te/ de ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'i rgyu mtshan dang dgos pa'ang ma ṇi'i rnal 'byor grub pa'i sngags brgyud du mdzad nas de'i dngos grub 'bad med du 'grub par bya ba'i ched do/ /de'ang sems can de dag thams cad ni sngon 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis dngos sam brgyud nas bsdus te/ ma ṇi'i rig sngags 'chang gi rigs su smon lam gyis bdag gir bzung zhing / dgongs pa ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs pa dang / 'phags pa'i bka' drin gyi cha shas dang rig sngags kyi pham phab la spyod pa'i dge rtsa rgyud ldan gyi skal ba can sha stag ste/ tshon nam rdo yi nang na gser//bag la zha ba lta bur gzigs/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /'di dag ni snying rje pad dkar chung bar/ sngon thub pa la las 'brel med na 122

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4da lta de'i bstan pa'i chos gtan nas mi go bar gsungs pa sogs mang pos shes so/ /bshes spring las/ ma yi thug mtha' rgya shug tshig gu tsam/ /sogs thad bka' gdams gsar ma kha cig de ltar deng nas bsam tshe rang re'i lus 'di sems can brgya stong grangs med kyi mi gtsang ba'i rdzas kyi rgyun 'dus pa las grub par shes nas lus sred dang rgyags pa sogs 'dul gsung skad/ de bzhin du bod 'bangs tsho'i lus kyi byung khungs yar ded byas nas bsam na/ 'phags pa dang jo mo'i nyi zla la thug 'gro bas rang re'i lus 'di spu sen mo skra sha rus rgyus pa khrag sogs re re nas ma ṇi pad+me'i rig sngags kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun las ma byung ba cung zad kyang med do/ /'on kyang lo tog 'dod pas sa bon du 'os pa'i nas sam gro sogs 'bru bzang la spus gtsang ba rnyed rung des mi chog /zhing bzang po la btab nas so nam rem dgos/ de bzhin du rang re'i sgo gsum la ma ṇi'i phabs gta' yod lugs de ltar ngo 'phrod thog nas sgom bzlas kyi las kas 'phags pa'i rdo rje gsum gyi dngos grub kyi chang la ngos shes pa byed rgyu gal che/ de ni thun mong ltar bshad pa'o/ /rang rgyud kyi sngags kyi phabs gta' mthar thug ni gnyug ma mi shigs pa'i sgo gsum gdod nas thugs rje chen po'i ngo bor 123

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bzhugs pa 'di kho na yin te/ 'di ni rgyal po bka' 'bam gyi ༄zhal gdams skor na shin tu rgyas shing yang 'dus sogs mang por yang yod/ snang ba lhar sgrub ltar dpyod dang shes/ 'di ni yongs dag gnyug ma'i sgrub gzhi ste sems can thams cad la khyad med du yod/ snga ma ni glo bur tha mal gyi rags phung steng nas bshad pa ste/bod kyi sgos chos so/ /snga mas dngos grub kyi bya ba sgrub pa la sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa ngo ti dgos/ phyi ma'i steng nas gsol 'debs gdung dbyangs kyi tshul du bton pas rjes 'dzin gyi bya ba byed pa ni mi nag dang yang thun mong ngo / /gong 'og tu bris ltar 'phags pa la sngon dge rtsa che phra ci rigs kyis 'brel ba'i las mthun kho na bod kyi yul mir skye/ de bsnyen 'brel thogs pa dang dpe don du sbyar ba ni 'brel ba thogs pa'i dpe tsam yin/de'ang sngon 'phags pa la bskyed rgyu'i dge rtsa ni bsam sbyor gyi ngos nas ches chung la zhan yang zhing gi mthus tshad med par 'phel 'gro ba 'dul ba lung du n+ya gro dha'i ljon pa dang de'i sa bon gyi dpe dang / nga las nu'i gtam rgyud sogs lta bu'o/ /deng sang ma ṇi dung yon brgyab pa sog sa las tshe 'dir phan yon 'thob mi 'thob dang / tshe sngon 'phags pa'i rten la mjal phyag zhu ba'i gseb tu phyin pa sogs kyi phan yon yang rigs 'gre mi sbyor te/ snga ma ni 124

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4dus de rang la 'phags pa la 'brel ba thebs pa red kyang /'phen byed kyis 'phangs kyang 'grub byed kyis ma bsgrub pas smin dka'/ de ma smin yang sngon dge gzhan gyi 'bras bu sad pa'i rkyen tsam byed pa 'thad de 'gab na yod/ phyi ma ni las de rim gyis bcu pa srid pa'i rten 'brel du song nas/ da lta'i lus rten 'phen rdzogs ci rigs byas zin red pas snga ma dpyid las dang / phyi ma las kyi ston thog la spyod skabs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i sngon 'brel gyis rgyu byas/ 'phags pa yid bzhin nor bu'i sngon gyi thugs bskyed smon lam gyis rkyen byas nas da lta 'phags pa sprel sgom gyi gdung rgyud du byung / 'phags pa la bskyed pa'i dge rtsa'i dbang 'bras smin pa'i yul du skyes/ zang zing gi longs spyod 'phags pas lto skal du gnang ba'i rtsam pa dang / chos kyi longs spyod yig drug la spyod par skyes pa red pas/ bod du skyes nas ma ṇi 'don pa ni rang gi rigs chos kyi kun spyod du bsod nams kyi las kyis bskos pa kho na'o/ /dbu phar sogs dang lam rim sogs chos kyi longs spyod lar mang yang / chu thun mong gi btung ba/ nyi 'od thun mong gi gos yin pa ltar/ mchog dman/ mkhas blun/ skya ser/ pho mo/ rgan gzhon kun gyi thun mong du khyab che/dar che ba'i mod shos dang / mod kyang sus spyod srol med pa ma 125

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ yin par nam dang nam yang kun gyi kha la rang babs lta bur 'ong ba ni ma ṇi kho na ste/ des na rang gi lha skal dang / chos skal gar yod phar btsal ma dgos par tshur nga yin zhes gsal bar bstan pa red pas 'di la mi 'ju na ci la 'ju/ blo thag rbad bcad/ blo rtse gcig hril dril nas 'di la sgril bar bya'o/ /des na sgab tu/bod mis ma ṇi rang shes pa rgyu'i stobs dang rkyen gyi stobs yin dpyod smras pa de rtsing bas/ gnyis ka'i stobs yin lugs 'di bzhin dgos la/ 'phags pa'i sngon smon gyis ma ṇi rang shes dper na 'od mdor/ bde ba can pa rnams sangs rgyas grangs med kyi chos kyi longs spyod la rol bar gsungs nas/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'od dpag med kyis sngon sems can rnams la chos mnyan pa byin pa dang / sngon smon lam btab pa grub bo/ /zhes pa lta bu 'di rigs rnal 'byor pa'i che bas 'chad tshul dang cung zad tshul mi gcig gam dpyod/ 'phags pa la sngon 'brel yod pas da lta ma ṇi'i zhing 'dir skyes zhes pa'i sngon 'brel de lag tshad dgos zhe na/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du sems can mig zur gyis bltas pa'ang / rjes su bzang ba nyid du 'gyar/ sogs dang / gzhon /re) sirnyi/) /|) ra mi 111 /resanu ma bdun d+ngha sngon 4 rgyu sogs —sa dpags na —ra dgos pa 'dra ste/ zhing gi che bas so/ /thugs rje chen po'i 'dul skal min 126

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4pa bod yul gyi mir mi skye/ bod yul gyi mir skyes pa tsam nas 'phags pa thugs rje chen po bsgrub na 'grub thag nye ba kho nar nges/sngon gyi 'brel ba'i dbang gis da lta rdol shes sam rang shes su 'ong ba ni dper na lo chen rin bzang sngon mkhas par gyur dbang gis tshe 'dir a li kā li rang shes pa'am/ dud 'gro tshun chad ma bu phan tshun ngo rang 'phrod pa dang / lung phran tshegs su rkun chen gyi bas pa me tog phreng gis ngos bzang ba lta ba ste/ tshe rabs ra mi skurami ra megazhan la rmi lam bzhin du spyod/ /ces skyes rabs las so de ltar sngon nas ma ṇi la 'brel ba song dbang gis 'dir ting 'dzin med par kha rkyang bas bton pa la'ang byin rlabs cher 'byung ba ni/dper na drag sngags lta bu la bsnyen pa sngon du btang ba'i mis sngags de ngag tu brjod pa kho na'i nus pa yang / sngar bsnyen pa ma myong ba'i mis dmigs rim dang sbrags nas bzlas pa la'ang med pa dang 'dra'o/ /'on kyang bod mis ma ṇi rang shes pa 'di rgyu'i stobs kyis yin nam/ rkyen gyi mthus yin dpyod la zhib cha gyis/gal te rkyen stobs yin na 'phags pa'i byin rlabs kyis yin te/lus can kun gyis bya dang ni/ /shing dang 'od zer thams cad dang / /sogs ltar/ de'i dbang du btang yang / de ltar 'phags pa nyid kyis ngag dang yid byin rlabs stobs kyis ma ṇi 127

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lhan skyes lta bur shes pa ni 'phags pa nyid las rig sngags 'don pa la gnang ba thob pa'i phyogs gtogs yin pas yul gzhan gyi mis bzlas pa dang nus pa mi mnyam ste/ dper na lhas gnang ba'i mtshan ma thob na sems brtan pa'i mtshan ma ma rnyed kyang dbang skur ba'i nus pa rnyed par 'jog pa bzhin no/ /lhar skye ba'i las can rnams lha yul ba'i sde tshan/ mir skye ba rnams de'i sde tshan du 'ong la/ mtha' 'khob tu skye ba'i las can rnams sde tshan du byas nas der skye/ yul dbus su skye ba'i las can rnams kyang las kyis 'phang lugs ltar yul dbus rang du skye/lha yul de sems can bsod nams can rnams kyi bsod nams kyi dbang 'bras/ mi yul bsod nams bar ma ba rnams kyi sogs/yul dbas snying po lta ba'i sems can rnams kyi las dbang shas che rabye dbyeb las/ mtha' 'khob spun pa lta bu'i sems can gyi las shas che ba las grub/ de'i 'gres kyis 'phags pa la brten pa'i dge las kyis mir skyes pa sogs 'phags pa la bskyed pa'i las mthun rnams sde tshan du 'ong ste bod kyi mi'o/ /lhar skye ba'i las kyi dbang 'bras su lha yul grub pa ltar/ bod kyi yul ri brag nags tshal chu mtsho dang bcas pa yang 'phags pa ma ṇi dang las 'brel che ba'i sems can rnams kyi las kyi dbang 'bras so/ /de ltar na bod 128

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4'bangs spyi mthan gyi las 'brel che shos sa yod pa 'phags pa 'di riringami rig miyin pas de'i phrin las 'jug myur/ de rnams kyi las kyi dbang 'bras su grub pa'i yul gru 'di yang yig drug sgrub pa'i gnas su bkra shis shing byin che'o/ /dge ba'i dbang 'bras rgud kyang bsod nams kyis gso nus pa shi bi'i rgyal khams kyi gtam rgyud lta bu/sdig pa'i dbang 'bras kyi nyes pa dge ba'i gzi brjid kyis kyang sel dka' ba mong gal bus mnar med du char phab pa lta bu/de'i rigs pas bod kyi sa cha 'di'i rgud pa sel ba dang legs tshogs gso ba la dge las gzhan pas yig drug tshogs 'don stobs shin tu che 'dra/ nang rnam smin gyi lus la nad med dang tshe dang lang tsho sogs kyi dngos grub sgrub pa'i sgo sngon 'brel che ba'i lhag lha'i bzlas sgom rno ba ltar/ phyi rol las kyi dbang 'bras kyi yul la rtsi sman rlung chu sogs kyi nyes rgud sel zhing yon tan skyed pa la'ang de ka rang rno bar gsal/ grub rjes sog yul du rgya mi mang pos 'dzin 'ching byed pa'i mnal ltas gzigs tshe/ yig drug dung phyur 'ur 'don rgyab chog byas par gsungs te/ gshin rje chos rgyal gyi chad pa yig drug gis zhi nus par dgongs par snang / lan cig tā ra nā tha bsnyung ste/ nyin mtshan kun tu sku khams nyog cing dub/ mgo lus tshiṭa gsum thams cade mi na sa 129

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gcig kyang med/ zungs shor/ dang kha 'gags/rtag tu mgo 'khor ba'i rnam pa yod pa/ mig sogs dbang po 'grib pa sogs nad tshabs che la dos drag pa byung bar zhag mang rab song / de nas snga dro zhig spyod 'jug gi me tog char ba spos chu dang 'dres 'bab pa yis/ /sogs yang yang dran pas rkyen byas nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs 'ba' zhig yid la dran zhing / mos gus gdung shugs drag pos mchi ma rang dbang med par 'chor ba kho na zhag gnyis gsum la shugs 'byung du byung / de ka'i ngang la nyin gcig gnyid du 'phri tsam song bar/ 'phags pa sems nyid ngal gso 'dra ba zhig bkra lam gyis gsal por byung / gnyid sad pa na de 'phral rang du khams cung zad bder song 'dug /de nas zhag po gnyis gsum na nad rags pa de dwangs gsungs/ ri gangs dkar gyis g.yogs pa/ chu dwangs bsil du 'byang ba/ chu 4 gzi ///smoriri shil shal zam 'chags pa/ char kha bar 'bab pa/ gas rgya gar na med pa'i bod yul gyi khyad chos yin la/ gzhan yang jo bos rgya gar na med par gsungs pa'i me tog shang dril sogs 'bru sman me tog gi rigs bzang mang skye ba/ brag ri'i phug dang shing gi drung sogs bsam gtan spyod pa'i gnas mang ba/ sa gtsang la dben zhing nyam dga' ba/ ma ṇi'i dar dang rdo mkhar gyis gnas dang 130

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4gnas rnams mtshan pa/ rma rgyal na kha sar pa ṇi'i gangs ri dang /bso thog gnas na ri gtso spyan ras gzigs kyi gnas ri/ 'brong ri smug po sogs 'jig rten phal ba'i kha dang gsal yang thags rje ༄chen po'i pho brang du grags shing de ltar 'du shes pa mang ba rgya nag pad+me/ yid lhung ma ṇi/ khro skyab 'ur 'ur/ brag dkar sprel rdzong na 'phags pa'i sku dang yig drug rang byon/ mtshams kyi yi ge drug ma sogs 'phags pa'i rten gsum khyad par can gyis stod smad kun tu brgyan pa/ rgyal rabs gsal me sogs ltar na bod 'dir nyung rdog dang de'i lo ma za ba rnams kyang lha cig kong jo'i phyag rjes su gsal ba sogs 'phags pa'i sgrub gnas kyi mtshan nyid mang pos khyad par du byas shing / smyung gnas pa sogs 'phags pa'i sgrub pa po mtha' yas pas snod bcud thams cad gru 'dzin ri dang bde ba can gyi rten brten par yang yang dang brgyud mar brlabs/lho rgyud na mtshams kyi yi ge drug ma zer ba'i gnas ri yod/lha srin bka' 'og tu sdud pa'i dbang sdud skabs/ nga ni 'jig rten kun gyi rnal 'byor dbang mdzod nas/ /zhes pa ltar sa'i lha'i gtso bo sogs mi rgyu ba'i 'jig rten gyi dang / tshangs dbang sogs rgyu ba'i 'jig rten gyi dbang 'di ltar dpal mchog dang po dang za ma 131

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tog gnyis kar gsungs la ha lam dam chos pad dkar sogs las kyang 'byung /phyug dang kun gyi dbang phyug dpal rta mchog rol pa sogs ma hā kā la myur mdzad/ kyi ngo bo nyid nga'o nga kho na'o zhes nga rgyal gzung ba la bslab dgos shing / de'ang yin te/ 'dir lha 'di phyag rdor yang yin/ ya mān+ta kri ta nas bisnan ta kri ta bar yang yin pa'i phyir te/ sems dpa' sems ma bcu drug dang / rig pa'i khro bo yab yum brgyad 'dus pa yin pa'i phyir te/ 'di rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yin pa gang zhig /rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad gtso bo gcig pu la 'du ba'i phyir ro/ /des na 'khor gyi phrin las la gtso bo'i phrin las su mi 'du ba cung zad kyang med do/ /de lta bu'i go ba yod na gtso bo'i phrin las la rtsal thon pa nyid kyis 'khor gyi phrin las rab 'byams la rtsal thon 'ong ngo / /byang sems kyi stobs bcu dkon mchog sprin du gsungs pa'i nang gi bka' mi gcog pa'i stobs la snang zhen bslab pa dang / bka' 'bum las tshogs kyi dbang las dang dzab dbyangs nyer gcig sogs lto sbyar/ dbang las de kha skong bya na/sngags las 'od dmar 'phros/ sde brgyad gang yin de'i gnas lus thams cad btum nas dmar khyil khyil/ yom yom/ des kho 'od dmar gyi srog yig tu bzhu ba khab len gyis lcags phye'am rlung 132

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4gis ras bal khyer ba ltar tshur drangs/ thugs srog gi gdan la bstim nas mnyam bzhag /da dung thugs sgrub las bzhi'i thad dang bsgrigs/stong nyid snying rje'i lam ston pa'i gsung rab gzhan las kyang /lam de rig sngags kyi sgo nas bstan pa 'di khyad du 'phags te/don la sgrub pa snying por byas na go 'phang je mthor 'gro ba la khyad med kyang / snga ma'i don las sbyangs kyang rtogs pa yang tshad la ma sleb bar du rnam 'grel las/ skye 'dod nyes pa bcom pa'i phyir/nas/ ji ltar byas pa nyams par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar yin la/rig sngags ni sngags tshig kho rang gi rang ldog nas/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi bsam gtan gyi yul dang / sman dang nor bu dang rig sngags kyi mthu bsam gyis mi khyab ces bsam mi khyab kyi rigs tha dad du bzhag pa ltar yin te/ sngags kyi nus pas me bsil bar 'gyur/ chu khol bar/ dug bdud rtsir byed/ rgas pa gzhon nur 'gyur/ na ba gso/ shi ba slong / shang skam la me tog 'byung /las kyi rnam smin gyi 'bras bu'i mi lus kyang dud 'gror sgyur zhing /mi'i rten nyid rig 'dzin gyi lus su sgyur ba sogs mtha' yas so/ /de dag gi de gtso bo'i mtha/ zhes so/ /de'ang rig sngags yin pa/༄byed po 'jig rten las 'das pa/ rgyal bstan dang theg chen kho 133

casajid/ 〈co lngardo sdispyings 'o/codrob/thag byasarngasno ngasartagazug rta):re ba/sdisajib 'o/dra/zug/ 0〈mna'i dbang du byas nas bshad pa/ don zab cing rgya che ba yongs su rdzogs pa sogs re res kyang phan bde mtha' yas ster na kun rdzogs na smos ci dgos/don dam rtogs pa'i shes rab las byung dmigs med snying rje shin tu sbyangs pas snying rje de kas chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'am sangs rgyas pa/longs spyod chen po sgrub byed la ma ṇi 'phags te/ 'phags pa'i sbyin pa'i phar phyin sngags kyi yi ger brlabs pa yin pas so/ /gzugs bzang po sgrub byed la'ang ma ṇi mchog ste/ 'phags pa'i bzod pa'i phar phyin der mdzad pas so/ /sogs/ rang bzhin gang kho na phu thag chod par ram dpyis phyin par ma rnyed pas lus can rnams las dang nyon mongs dang sdug bsngal gyi 'khrul 'khor rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / byis pa'i rgud pa rnams las mi 'da' ba dang / phyogs bcur chu zla lta bu'i las kyis 'gro don byed pa'i :) 15mthu dbang 'a ba pa dang / gang rtogs ched byang sems rnams dka' ba mtha' yas pa spyod pa'i rang bzhin de sems can thams cad la shin tu bstan par bya'o zhes pa skyob 'dod kyi snying rje'i srog red/ dri za'i pi waṃ rgyud stong ldan pa yod kyang / ma bskul bar sgra mi 'byung / de'ang rgyud gang dang gang bskul ba de kho na'i 134

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4sgra de las gzhan mi 'byung / de bzhin du 'phags pa la thugs rje chen po yod rung / dngos grub kyi don du gsol ba ma btab na don de mi 'grub/ de'ang dngos grub gang gsol ba de kho na bzhin du thugs rje smon lam gyi byin rlabs kyi cha so so'i lag rjes 'byung bar gsal/bla ma zhal dngos su yun ring ma mjal bar bsgug dgos byung na/ yun ring por da nga'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen de nam mthong bar 'gyur snyam du de mthong ba la sgom pa'i yid byed dang don gnyer ji snyed dang ci tsam mang du byung ba de'i tshod tsam gyi chos kyi sgrib pa 'dag cing chos dang chos smra bas byin rlabs 'jug pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po mtha' yas pa 'dzin pas/ ston pa yang dag 'jog la bzhugs pa'i dgos ched kyi nang na/ sangs rgyas mthong pa la sgom par bya ba'i phyir dang / zhes yod la/ rtag tu ngus chos 'phags lo bdun du ma mjal ba lta bu yod/ dpe de bzhin bsgrub pa po dad gus shin tu brtan cing blo mi 'gyur ba rnams kyis mthong ba na dga' ba ches cher lhag par skye ba'i ched kyang yin te/ snyan ngag me long mar re ba med pa'i dga' ba dang re ba dang bcas pa'i dga' ba'i rgyan bshad pa lta bu/ dga' ba ji ltar lhag pa ltar de la yid 'grus shing gtod pa'i gus pa skyed/135

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sangs rgyas mthong ba rnyed dkar shes na de la gus pa chen po skye ba'ang 'di 'dra zhig red/ yi dam yun ring bsgrubs nas grub rtags ma thon na yang / des sgyid mi lug par phyi phyir lha mchog des mngon sum rjes 'dzin la don gnyer gyi skom tshad drag po bcos min du 'phel nas sgrub la brtson par byed la de ltar byas pas ma 'ongs pa na rmi lam dang nyams snang lta bu min par mngon sum du rjes su 'dzin pa dang / dngos grub rlabs che zhing gya nom pa mang po dang sna tshogs pa dang ches brtan po 'thob pa dang /gdon mi za bar 'thob pa'i dge rtsa yun ring dang / stobs ldan/rgyun chags sa song nas don chen po la sbyor bas/ sgrub po 'dod ༄ thag nye la sgyid lug skye ba 'ga'i bsam ngo dang bstun nas grub pa'i rtags mtshan than thun 'ga' re myur du bstan pa las de ches lhag par sems te/ dper na/ khyod kyis sang gnangs skor las sgugs mi nus na ras sbom po dang snam phrug ngan ngon kha shas ster/sang phod rgya mtsho'i tshong ba thon thon bsgug nus na gser srang bye ba brgya stong ri ba'i rin po che mang po ster zer na phyi ma ches don du gnyer bya yin pa lta bu'o/ /dka' spyad kyis sna drang na dngos grub tshan che la mtha' brtan pa yong bar bla ma dmar khrid du gsungs pa'ang de ltar red snyam/ phyag stong spyan stong gi mdor/136

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4the tshom za ba dang / 'phags pa nyid la rtse gcig yid ma gtad cing ma dmigs par bzlas kyang mi 'grub gsungs shing sems rtse gcig tu ma bgyis pa ni ma gtogs so/ /zhes gzhan du'ang gsungs pas sngags kyi lha las gzhan du gtan ma yengs par bzla dgos/ dmar po'i rgyud du/ gzhan du g.yengs pa'i sems kyis ni/ /bskal bar bzlas kyang 'bras mi 'byin/ /zhes dang / ḍo bhi pas/ skad cig tsam yang gzhan gzugs kyis/ /dngos grub 'dod pas gnas mi bya/ /zhes sogs mang ngo / /las tshogs sgrub dus sogs la the tshom mi za ba'i rogs su/ mkha' 'gro'i rol rtsed las bshad pa'i smyon pa dang bu chung gi snang shas la gnas pa'ang 'gro'am snyam/ma ṇi'i yig 'bru rnams mkha' 'gro sde lngar sbyor ba 'og tu bshad ltar/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga 'di ni 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro rigs bsdus pa ste/ bde mchog las ri rab so bdun rdul snyed kyi ḍa ki ni thams cad snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi la 'du bar gsungs pa'i bzhi po'ang rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs bzhi po 'di ka yin no/ /smin gling gsang ye'i dbang chog tu/ gsang ye'i dbang thob pa kho nas zhing sngags lhan skyes kyi pho nya mo thams cad dang rten 'brel 'grigs tshul gsungs yod/ mdor na yo ga 137

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ dang gsang 'dus sogs thun mong du gsungs pa'i yum bzhi dang /rnam 'byor gsang mtha'i thun min snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi po ril gyi sngags yin/ de'ang sngags 'di'i cha shas kyi yi ge rnams mkha' 'gro sde bzhi dang / cha can sngags nyid gsang ye red/de'ang gsang ye nyid mkha' 'gro ma stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis gcig tu dril bar nges shes skyed cing / snying gar bkod pa'i yig drug kyang / sngags kyi gzugs can rnal 'byor ma/ /zhes pa ltar/ gsang ye dngos rang yin pa'i nga rgyal bzhag nas bzlas pas bskul bas/ bzlas brjod las su rung ba na gsang ye nyid 'phags pa dang lhan cig rgyud la zhugs nas sam snying ga'i mi shigs pa la zhugs nas/ de las 'phros te chags pa'i rtsa thig rlung gsum gyi cha thams cad byin gyis brlabs par mdzad nas 'bar ba gsum 'byung ste/ de man phag mo'i zin tho ltos/mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis ma ṇi dung phyur lhag bzlas/ 'phags pa yi ge drug pa zhag mang por gzigs/ las dag pas spyan ras gzigs dngos su mthong ba'ang byung / rdo ring ba chen pos kyang skyer sgang ba'i yig drug nyams len mdzad/'phags pa lan gsum mjal/ ched du thugs gtad na mdun gyi bar snang la yig drug gi sgra mi bcus bzlas pa'i sgra tsam rgyun du 138

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4gsan/ gnas gsar ba mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis byang gter 'gro ba kun sgrol gyis ma ṇi ril sgrub mdzad pas ril bu la gzhi bdag gter srang gis skor ba byed pa/ ril bu dril bu bdun 'phel ba/rigang ///rdo rwa/de/ //shes ༷༷༷/'ja' gur dang me ga char ba/ nga thams cad bzang gis khyab pa/ ril bu'i dbang gi skabs gzhi bdag 'brog pa brjid bag can gyi rnam pas dngos su dbang zhu ba sogs byung /sems can 'bum phrag gsum 'khor ba las sgrol ba'i lung bstan gyis bsngags/ yar 'brog mtsho dang / gnam mtsho sogs thams cad du ril bu 'khyol gang che mdzad/ da dung ma ṇi ril sgrub gang mang mdzad par thugs 'dun chen po 'khrungs/ rgya yul du ha shang ṭi'u ṣan bya ba'i dge slong bzang po zhig rgyal po'i bka' nan ltar khri rin thang can spyad pas pus mo'i lha ngar phol mig smin ma dang mig dang kha sogs dod pa/ khar zas bcug na za/ na zug bzod blags med pa zhig byung ste shin tu gdungs/ de'i tshe 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa'i ha shang zhig gis/ gong ma yung gi dus ha shang ṭi'u ṣan 'di nang blon gid dhi dang / phol mig khyod blon po bzho'u tshir gyur/ gid dhis dbyen byas te gong mas bzho'u tshi bsad/ de tshun skye ba bcur lan chags snyogs phyir khyod 'di'i rjes su 'brangs kyang / gid dhi 'gyod nas rab tu 139

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/byung / de tshun skye ba kun tu tshul khrims dag pa sha stag tu brgyud pas glags ma rnyed ces de rnams e yin zhes rim par dris pas phol mig gis kyang so sor ang zhes lan btab/ da res bcas 'gal gyi ltung ba byung bas 'di ltar glaṭa rnyed 'dug kyang khyod la'ang las 'di'i 'bras bu ngan pa 'ong bas ngas bsdum pa yin gyis song zhig ces chus bkrus/ rnga yab kyis byab pas 'bag dor ba ltar lhung bar bshad/ 'gu sngags 'chang rtar bas ma ṇi bum sgrub mdzad par yang / dur khrod ma gsum gyis mdong gsol phul ba sogs 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rtse dang mtshungs pa'i grub rtags thon/ mkhan chen sding ma ba dang / rje dbang rab kyis kyang ma ṇi'i ril bu bsgrub pas snga ma dang phyogs 'dra byung / grub thob 'dar phyar gyis nyi phag pa las thags rje chen po'i skor gsan/no༅ ra ti se dar nags rgyal gyi gnas su 'phags pa'i zhal gzigs/'das dus dbu thod la yi ge drug pa phyed skyil du bzhugs par shar/si tu chos 'byung rnam thar na/ gzhi bdag gi gdug rtsub sogs las thog ser nam byung du/ snang grag thams cad thugs rje chen po'i yo lang du bltas nas ma ṇi bton pa kho nas zhi bar bshad la/chu'i 'jigs pas nyen tshe chu la yig drug bsgoms pas thar rabs las 'bras brgyud pa'i lo rgyus zhig na yod/ de'i rigs pas/140

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4dgra byung tshe cir snang 'phags par lta zhing / mtshon char pulda ri ka'i phyag mtshan du bltas la yig drug bton pas dgra'i sdang sems zhi/ mtshon kha snyol/ dme 'dre med pa sogs dang / yams nad la/ ci snang 'phags pa'i dkyil 'khor du lta ba thams cad la 'dra/ nad ma ṇi'i bdud rtsir bsam pas zhi ba dang / dug zhi bar yang de bzhin/ dbang sdud la/ rta mgrin gyi/ snang ba lha la grag pa sngags/ /sogs dbang sdud du 'gyur lugs zur tho shig dril ltar las/ rta mgrin zhes pa 'phags pa zhi bar 'don pa spos pas chog ste/ mdor na snang srid snod bcud 'khor 'das thams cad bdag thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten pa nyag gcig gi rang bzhin du bsdu zhing rgyas 'debs pa'o/ /gdon 'dul/ rgyal po'i chad pa zhi ba/ 'byung ba'i dug gzhil ba/ ltas ngan dang byad byur chag sgo zhi ba/ gza' skar gyi gnod pa zhi ba/ nang 'thab/ sde 'khrugs/ nyams grib/ mi kha bra mchu/ lha 'khrugs/ nad sna tshogs zhi bar bya ba sogs mtha' yas par 'phrul ba ni/ gzhung gi/ gang 'dul phrin las lhun grub bsamaḥ zhes par shin tu 'byor/ a ba ta rar/ dpa' bo'i rang bzhin gyi nga rgyal bya ba sogs drang / dngul chu rgyal sras rin 141

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/po ches/ chos nyid thugs chud thugs kar thal mo sbyar/ /thugs rje rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phreng ba 'dzin/ /'khor ba'i 'dam gyis ma gos pad+ma bsnam/ /zhes bkod 'dug /'phags ma'i snying tig las/ rang 'phags ma'am 'phags par bsgom/ thugs kar tshe dpag med dam rta mchog /de'i thugs kar yig bcu'am/ yig bdun bkod/ de ngag tu bzla/ zhar la a ma ra ṇi'am/ rta sngags bzla zhes dang / rigs pa des khro bor yang 'grub pas khro bo'i nang du ma ṇi 'dren chog pa/ kun mkhyen phyi ma'i rgyun khyer gcig pu min yang khungs snyed snang / gsang ye ni zhing rdo rje'i gnas mchog o rgyan gyi mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dpon du smin gling gsang ye dang / bka' gdams glegs bam sogs na yongs grags/de yi ge drug mar bstan pas ni lha mo yi ge drug ma nyid 'dzam gling 'di nyid kyi o ṭi ya na gsang sngags kyi 'byung gnas na sku dngos kyis da lta'ang bzhugs nas sgrub pa po byin gyis rlobs par ston pas/ byin che zhing myar bar ston te gal che'o/ /yab kyi thal ༄sbyar sangs rgyas thams cad byang chub sems gnyis kyi dngos grub don du skul/ yum gyi cang te'us las dang ye shes pho nya mo rnams bde chen skyed dang phrin las don du skul snyam/ skyes rabs kyi kun tu rgyu byang chub kyi thad na'ang sprel lpags sprul zhes ma gsungs 142

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4par pags pa'i ched du spre'u sprul gsungs pa ltar spre'u 'di'ang 'phags pa'i phyag g.yon pa'i 'od zer las sprul par gur bkra'i chos 'byung gi brgya nyer lnga na yod/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/byang gi phyogs su ni byang chub sems dpa' lag na pad+ma 'grub bo/zhes dang sogs bod 'bangs sprel tsha/ bod rje li tsa bi'i rigs so//bu'i rigs kyi thun min gyi rgyu pha red pas spre'u las mi skye zhe na/bden yang / mi'i 'gro ba sngags kyis spre'ur byas pa yod kyang /de 'dra'i spre'u de byol song gi 'gro bar bzhag dka' ste/ 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pas grong 'jug gi lus gzhan blang ba skye 'chi mtshan nyid pa min par bshad pa ltar te/ de ltar 'di'ang spre'u'i gzugs 'dzin pa'i mi'i rten can du khas len nam dpyod/ dge bsnyen du bshad pa'ang de ltar ro/ /de'ang yin te/ spre'u lta bu'i mi yod pa'i phyir te/ drang srong chen po rnga bong bzhin no/ /'phags pa 'di la 'jig rten dbang phyug ces 'jig rten gsum gyi rgyal srid kyi dbang por bsngags la/ rgyal po ni 'khor sdud pas rab tu phye la ste steng nas 'jog dgos la/ 'khor bsdu ba'i sgo yongs su rdzogs pa ni bsdu dngos bzhi yin pas bsdu bzhi'i lha'o/ /rdo ring pa'i rnam thar tshar chen gyis mdzad pa las rgya bod thams cad du yongs su grags shing yi ge drug pa'i phrin las kyi 143

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rgyun gyis 'khor ba mtha' can du mdzad pa grub thob thang stong rgyal por grags pa zhes dang / grub thob thang stong rgyal po dang nged dpon slob kyi rnam thar sa yin gyi blo la shong ba med gsang / zhes ri mi riri ༅so/ /'khrul zhig seng ge rgya ba dang / rig 'dzin bla ma ku ma ra dza/gu ru 'od gsal rang grol sogs kyi rnam thar na'ang 'phags pas rjes su bzung rabs yod/ rwa lo rdo rje grags pas kyang yig drug gi phrin las rgya cher spel zhing / 'phags pa dbu gang la mchod pa mdzad skabs/ phyag mchod kyi chu dri ro bzang por gyur cing 'phags pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po ma ṇi'i rang sgra sgrogs pa byung ste/ rwa chen gyi thugs kar thim pa kun gyis mthong ba dang / lha sar 'phags pa rang byon lnga ldan mjal tshe de'i thugs ka nas chos rgyal srong btsan byon nas gdams pa mang du bstsal ba dang / rgyal mar chos rgyal srong btsan gyi 'khrungs sa gzigs pa la gsol 'debs mdzad pas lung pa 'ja' 'od kyis gang ba'i gseb nas dngul gyi yig drug char du 'bab pa kun gyis mthong ba dang / che gnyan gyi yul mchog mang por drag las mang du mdzad pa'ang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs las mngon spyod kyis 'gro don byed par gnang ba nod nas byas pa yin par bshad pa sogs mang / dam pa dmar po byis pa'i dus bra ma'i nang du khyi 144

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4smyon ro bsregs pas klu nad byung / phyis rdo rje gdan pa la sgom lung zhus/ zla ba gcig tu ma ṇi bzlas pas rmi lam du sdig sbrul mang po lus las thon pa rmis/ mal chu ser gyis gang / yid dwangs sing ba byung / sha ro dang bal ldog sogs kyang mi 'dug/grub rtags nus pa cher thon/ byang sems zla rgyal gyi slob ma skyi tsha 'od 'byung gi slob ma zhang dbu dkar bas thugs chen dmar khrid kyi sngon 'gro'i ma ṇi la nus pa rnyed nas lha 'dre la phrin btang bas chog pa dang bden tshig grub pa byung / 'di'i slob brgyud la 'phags pa'i zhal mthong mang du byung / gtsang pa rgya ras gshegs tshe sgal tshigs la spyan ras gzigs kyi sku nyer gcig phebs/ bya yul ba'i thugs sras gtsang pa rin chen ro stod cher bsnyung tshe/mi dkar po ral pa'i thor cog can zhig gis ril pa spyi blugs nas bdud rtsi blugs pas nang thams cad gang ba'i snang ba byung nas dwangs/ bka' gdams pa zhig mdzes bsnyung bas cis kyang ma phan nas/ da nga rang mi khyu nas bud ngo shes par byas te kyi mo rdza 'phrang gi 'og der lam zan la brten nas bsdad de ma ṇi bgrang la tshe bskyal lo snyam du thag bcad pas de nub rang khong chus khyer ba las mi dkar po zhig gis bton nas brag thog cig tu bzhag pas lus las chu mang po zag pa rmis nas sad pa dang 145

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lam thams cad chu ser gyis gang nas 'dug ste mdze nad yul thon zhes rgyal sras rin po ches gsungs/ chos rje don grub rin chen gyis grwa sar slob gnyer mdzad dus/ chos kyi grags pa'i riṭa gzhung gi gnad phra ba 'char dka' bar byung bas/ zhwa lu'i thugs rje chen po'i rdo sku rang byon de la skor ba mang po mdzad de gsol ba btab pas/ de'i mod la blo gros kyi mthu chen po skyes te/ kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che'i spyan sngar yang mkhas grags kyi rgyal mtshan thob/ da lta'i a bzang rdor grags kyi a phyi de lo nyi shu'i nang mig long / ma ṇi 'bad nas bzlas pas/ lo bzhi bcu skor na mig phye ste sngon bzhin gyar/ rdzong mda'i mi zhig gi mig long /༄ma ṇi rtse gcig bton pas nam zhig 'chir nye dus/ khye'u dkar po zhig gis lag nas khrid de lam dkar po zhig ri rtser zug pa nas yar phyin/ ri rtser sa phyogs skyid nyams can zhig tu slebs pa rmis/ phyir nyin tshe 'phos/ mgar skor gyi khang srung mi skya rdzun med zhig gis ma ṇi kho na bton pas/ khang pa der mi gzhan med dus phal che bar khye'u dkar po zhig 'ong nas mi rgan kho rang la dga' nyams ston/ kho khang pa'i sgo'i thang na gcig por bsdad de skad rgyangs mthon pos ma ṇi 'don dus tshor khang pa'i skar khung nas khye'u des bzhin bstan nas dgod cing ma ṇi'i 'ur rgyangs 146

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4 byed pa byung zer te/ 'phags pa yin 'dra yang kho rang gis ni 'di tshang gi khyim lha i mi yin zhes zer/ khro skyab tshe gzung gi mes pos ma ṇi 'bad pas bton pas yang yang rmi lam du khye'u dkar pos gces nyams ston pa mthong / 'di rigs mi nag pho mos bton pa'i mthu red/ 'bri khog ga shed mi rgan dad can zhig gis ma ṇi kho na brtson pa chen pos bzlas pas kho shi nas yun ring bar du sngon mal bcas shul de'i nye 'khor nas ma ṇi'i rang sgra khor yug tu grags pa byung / 'di'i skye ba de ma thag pa rje dpon kun grol rnam rgyal yin par bshad/ thugs rje chen po'i sgrub pas ni/ de ba thams cad kyi thugs rje phyag na rdo rje grub zer ba lta bu/'grub yong ba ste/ de ba thams cad kyi bdag nyid spyan ras kyis btsa' ba'i dngos grub sgrub pa zhes snang /'dzam bu gling pa 'od gsal gyi lha'i rgyud las mched kyang spyir btang yin/ dmigs bsal du bod mi la rje 'bangs gnyis las 'bangs rnams ni thugs rje chen po'i mi rgyud yin te/ spyan ras gzigs dang sgrol ma spre'u dang brag srin du sprul pa 'dus pa'i sa bon las gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i rgyun la byung / ma ṇi 'don mkhan gyi dbugs kyis phog tshad rnam par grol ba'i skal ba can du 'gyur zhing / ma ṇi pa de'i bdun brgyud tshun chad rnyed pa 147

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/legs par rnyed pa dang yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dzin par mdo sde za ma tog las bka' bstsal bas ma ṇi pa gcig kho na'i byin rlabs yon tan yang de'i mi rabs mi brgyud thams cad la spang la me shor ltar mched 'gro na sprel sgom lta bu 'phags pa dngos kyi rnam 'phrul lta ci smos/ des na rang cag la 'phags pa'i rab gnas chags sla ste/ chu las byung ba'i lan tsha chu nyid du zhu ba'i tshul du sgo gsum 'phags pa'i gsang ba gsum du 'grub pa la tshegs med/ bod 'bangs 'tsho ba'i lo tog gi khyad par rnams kyang 'phags pas 'bru sna bdun bod du gtor nas smon lam btab pa las byung bas spyan ras gzigs kyi smon lam las byung ba'i kha zas can sha stag go/ /des na 'phags pa la sngon las 'brel thogs nges min pa bod yul gyi mir mi skye/ las 'brel che rtags su byis pa lo gsum pa rnams kyang ma ṇi 'don shes/ skye bo yi ge mi shes pa yang ma ṇi rko shes/ sprang phrag lto slong ba yang ma ṇi ༄la ngo chen sgron/ mi nag chos dran yang ma ṇi sna la 'ong ba sogs lta sa na yod pas kyang chog /de ltar sngon gyi las 'phro yod pas 'di lha sngags gzhan dang mi 'dra bas ting 'dzin med par kha tsam tshig tsam gyis ma ṇi bton bsdad kyang byin rlabs 'jug /sngags gzhan mang du bzlas pa bas ma ṇi lan re bzlas pa byin rlabs che 148

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tshwa sogs/ pod/ 4zhes dpal sprul rin po che gsung / de ltar bod 'bangs la spyan ras gzigs la brten pa'i spyi mthan gyi bsod nams chen po yod ༄pa'i dbang gis/ 'phags pa nyid srid skyong rgyal po'i rnam par dngos su byon te thugs dam gyi lha gsol 'debs mdzad dus tshun chad la/ nga'i bod 'bangs rnams la thugs rjes gzigs shig /ces gsungs te/ mi bdag byams pa'i stobs kyi skyes rabs bzhin/de ltar bdag tu bzung tshad 'phags pa'i mir song ba yin pas shin tu nye ba shes sla/ sprul pa'i rgyal po des ma 'ongs pa'i bod 'bangs rnams la'ang rang nyid dngos su bzhugs pa dang rnam dbyer med pa'i byin rlabs mdzad phrin 'jug ched nyid kyi sku 'bag tu rang byon bcu gcig zhal bzhengs nas yab yum gsum ka der thim zhing / slar thugs ka dang nu ma las dbu nyug mdzad de zhal chems yang bstsal bas chos rgyal yab yum dngos kyi 'du shes brtan par mdzad/ gzhan yang dmar po ri'i rang byon lo ki shwa ra dang / de gar bzhugs su zhal gzigs nas bod 'bangs kyi ched du ngo chen zhu ba'i tshul can srong btsan nga 'dra mar grags pa deng sang jo khang steng na bzhugs pa dang / yar 'phrang gi yi ge drug ma dang / tshe chu 'bum par chu shel gyi 'phags pa rang byon yod par bshad pa/ rgya nag pad+me/ yid lhung du ma ṇi gad mgor 149

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/grags pa/ khro skyabs 'phags pa rang byon sogs kyang bod 'bangs spyan ras kyis 'tsho ba'i rjes dran gyi mtshan ma dang / tha tshig mi 'gyur ba'i don rtags yin/ de 'dra'i rten 'brel gyis gangs can mtha' dbus kyi mi thams cad da dung lha sa la mjal phyag skor ba dang mchod pa dang smon lam gyi 'brel ba 'jog tu 'gro zhing / phyogs zhen mos dung khyab gdal du che ba dang /mtha' dbus kun tu chos dang zang zing gi dpal 'byor 'byung ba'i rtsa ba'i khungs kyang lha ldan yin pa sogs srong btsan dngos bzhugs dus dang 'gro don phrin las phyogs mtshungs pa mthong chos la yod/ mdor na rang cag bod 'bangs rnams spyan ras gzigs kyi mi rgyud yin cing / gong rjer bcu gcig zhal dngos rang bzhugs pas dus kyi mthar yang ma ṇi'i nus pa dang yon tan rig sngags gzhan dang mi mnyam par thogs med du 'byung ba yin no/ /bod 'dir dam pa'i chos kyi dbu yang mdo sde za ma tog nas brnyes pa dang / sprul pa'i rgyal pos phyogs 'dir rgyal bstan rin po che'i g.yang 'khor ched shākya mu ne mched gnyis spyan 'dren pa dang / nag phyogs kyi 'byung po mang po 'dul ba dang / gtsug lag khang thog mar rtsigs pa'i sa 'tshol ba dang rmang 'ding ba la sogs pa'i mdzad chen thams cad 'phags pa kho na la gzhi rten 150

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4dang srog shing bcol/ de'i sgo nas khog phab ste mdzad pa'ang 'di ༄bod kyi lha skal dang / bod 'di'i gdul zhing yin pa'i gnad la gzigs nas yin cing / phyis rgya gar gyi paṇa grub gnam gyi skar ma ltar mang ba'i nang nas bod du bstan pa'i srol 'byed mkhan la rig 'dzin yongs 'dus las/ spyan ras gzigs dbang srong btsan sgam po nyid/ /dha na ko shar sku ru sprul mdzad de/ /zhes dang / longs sku thugs rje chen po sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes mang po las gsungs pa dang / bka' rtsis dang rgyal po bka' 'bum sogs mtha' yas pa nas gsungs pa ltar spyan ras gzigs nyid rig 'dzin slob dpon gyi gzugs su byon pa gu ru pad+ma dang / de dang thugs rgyud gcig par bka' gdams glegs bam nas gsungs pa'i dpal ldan zhi 'tsho gnyis po rang byung ba dang / bsam yas bzhengs dus kyang thog mar spyan ras gzigs dang sgrol ma'i lha khang ma bzhengs bar du brtsig mi btub ces gsungs nas ar+ya pa lo'i gling brtsigs pa dang / khri srong dang ral pa can sogs kyis lha khang nam bzhengs su bar chad med cing byin chags bkra shis 'byung ched srong btsan gyi phyag rjes ras la bzo phud phul nas bzhengs pa dang / gu ru rin po ches gsang sngags ston dus spyi khyab la/ bod kyi bla ma'i skal ba gu ru nyid/ /151

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lha skal jo bo thugs rje chen po yin/ /zhes dang / mtshan mo byung res pad+ma nga nyid sgomasaḥ rang gi don du badz+ra gu ru sgrongasaḥnyin mo 'phags pa thugs rje chen po sgoms/ sems can don du ma ṇi yig drug sgrongs/ /zhes gsungs shing srin yul bzhud ka'ang spyi khyab la yig drug gi phan yon gsungs/ gter chos rgya che ba sgrub sde brgyad dang / yan lag las tshogs rab 'byams sogs kyi gnad bsdus snying po bla rdzogs thags gsum zhes 'byang //bye/ 11dres /rdo nge //byerdo sagling nga / gsum ma tshang na gter —na na zhes gter chos kyi skabs su'ang srog gi dbang po lta bur bsngags pa dang / chos dbang rin po che dang rje thang stong pa rad gling sogs kyis yig drug rgya cher spel zhing ma ṇi'i ril sgrub gyi rgyun btsugs pa dang /jo bo rje lha cig gi gsang chos bka' gdams snying po'i man ngagabastan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas pa'i bla rdo lta bur bsngags pa thig le bcu drug kyang thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs rang yin pa dang / mnga' bdag nyang dang chos dbang rin po ches lha sar mar me'i mchod rgyun btsugs pa dang / rje btsun tsong kha bas mgon po 'jam dbyangs kyi bka' bzhin mdzad chen bzhi'i che shos smon lam chen mo'ang srong btsan gyi dngul dam rta mgo ma gter bzhes sogs dang 'brel bar lha sa'i zhabs tog tu mdzad pa sogs 152

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4mtha' yas pa zhig rgyu mtshan de'i steng nas bshad par bya'o/ /de ltar rang dang sngon bsod nams kyi las 'brel che ba'i lha dang chos shig bsgrubs nas rlan shas che sar chu pho ba dang 'dra bar sngon dang da lta'i las gnyis gcig dpung gcig gis byas nas 'grub thag nye/ 'on kyang ko skam la snyung bus phug pa ltar mig hu re ba'i sgrub 'bras dgos na ni de gnyis nang 'dzom tsam gyis kyang mi chog gi/ lha sngags gcig po der rtse gcig tu phur tshugs su gtad btsugs nas bya dgos/ gang zag sgos btsan la 'phags pa dang sngon 'brel yod pas ma ṇi bton na stobs che ba dang / 'phags pa la bskyed pa'i spyi mthun gyi bsod nams kyi dbang gis yul dus 'dir 'grub thag nye ba don mi gcig pas phyi ma 'di yang gnad dam pa gcig tu bzung ngo / /chos yang dag par sdud pa sogs mdo sde du mar rje btsun 'di sogs byang sems kyi tshogs la chos kyi mdzod gtad de lnga brgya pa tha ma la 'dzam bu'i gling du rgyas par byos sogs dang / de'i rgyu mtshan byams pa seṅge'i sgra'i mdor 'chir nye ba dang mi tshe ring la nor bcol ba'i dpes bstan nas gdul bya'i lhag ma skyong bar bka' bsgos/ ri bo ta la'i lam yig sogs ltar da dung gling 'dir bzhugs pa/ston pa lam grogs kyi 'phros zur bris sogs bsgrigs na spyi dpon 153

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tshangs rgyal ba pa mi mjed bdag po 'dra ba de las kyang sgos dpon mi'i chos rgyal rgyalasras 'dra ba 'di mjal bde 'dris sla zhu lam btsal sla ba 'dra/ sngar bshad des na rang la thugs rje chen po'i bu rgyud dang / thugs rje chen po la pha mes kyi 'du shes bskyed de/snying nye lhan ne/ yid dung dun ne ba bya ste/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs la nye ring med/ mtha' gcig tu nye ba rkyang yin yang / rang gi 'du shes 'jog lugs kyis nye ring ltar 'gyur bas 'grub thag nye'o/ /gzhan yang / las lnga dag gi rgyal sras rnams/ /sems can pha dang 'dra ba zhes pa'ang dran par bya'o/ /lnga po'i nang der/sangs rgyas la ni gsol ba dang / /zhes yod pa thal mo sbyar ba'i phyag gi go don dang mthun/ 'di dang bgrang nor gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mgo la phyag gis dbang bskur bar gsungs pa za ma tog gi mdor yig drug zlo ba'i phyogs der sangs rgyas mang po 'du bar gsungs pa bzhin te/ dam chos pad dkar gyi gaṅga re gnyis kyi bye snyed kyi rgyal ba mchod pa sogs las 'phags pa 'di'i mtshan brjod pa lhag par bsngags pa dang / rtog ge 'bar bar phan gyur pa'i phyir dang sogs kyang 'dir mkho/ rta mgrin rta skad kyis mkha' 'gro dam can sdud pa'i dod du/ 'di'i shel phreng sogs la dmigs nas ma ṇi bzlas pas de'i mod kho nar gaṅga'i bye 154

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje 'khul te/ de rnams kyis lhag par dgongs shing byin gyis rlobs pa nyid yin te/ de ltar dgongs shing brlabs pas rmi lam du yang rgyal ba sras bcas mthong zhing bdud dang phyir rgol ba thams cad kyis mi brdzi ba dang /phyin ci log gi blo sna tshogs dang 'jigs pa dang sdug bsngal dang yid mi bde ba'i phyogs thams cad ngang gis 'grib cing / dkar po'i chos dang bde skyid legs tshogs thams cad stobs 'phel nas gong 'phel du 'gro/ sgrub pa pos ji ltar don du gnyer ba de ltar gzangs spobs/ ting 'dzin mngon shes snying rje/ tshig ༄btsan pa'i ngag gi dbang phyug /tshe stobs nad med bde ba lang tsho dbang phyug gzi brjid gnas lus 'khor dang longs spyod rtsom pa phun tshogs sogs nas mkha' spyod dang mi snang ba sogs sgrub pa po'i nus pa ji lta ba bzhin stsol bar mdzad/ des na mtha' yas pa'i rgyal ba rnams ni dpag bsam gyi nags tshal/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs dngos grub ni yongs 'du'i me tog /yig drug bzlas sgom ni lha'i rlung / des de rnams bskul bas gang 'dod bzhin 'thob pa ni shing las me tog phrul ba lta bur go/ des na 'khrul 'khor gyi gnad gcig nas bskul bas 'khrul 'khor brgya stong mang po g.yo 'gul byas yod pa'i 'phrul thabs/ sangs rgyas 155

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/thams cad kyi snying rje'i gnad che shos kyi gzer bu gcig bskul bas rgyal ba thams cad bskul yong pa ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying rje'i gnad gzer ni 'phags pa'i lha sngags/ de'i nang nas kyang yi ge drug pa/ des bskul tsa na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thags rje 'khal/ de 'khal ba nyid de rnams kyi stobs dang mi ra༄mi rang rangami 'jigs ma 'dres dbang bcu so rig bzhi sogs 'bras chos thams cad 'khul ba ste/ 'bras chos de thams cad kyi gnad srog skye la thugs rje chen po yin pas sam/ 'bras chos de thams cad snying rje chen pos gzhan don kho nar bsgrub pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas bskul nas zhu rgyu'i dngos grub kyi gtso bo ni byang chub sems gnyis kyi dngos grub ste/ mi gos pa dang / 'jig rten la dbang bsgyur ba gnyis tshogs kyi 'gro ba 'dul ba'i ye shes zhes pa de'o/ /dngos su bsgrub bya gzhan la byed na ni/ 'di la dgra'am mi min nam 'byung ba'i gnod pa 'di lta bus gtses sam gtser dogs pas mi 'jigs pa stsol cig ce'am/ rgyal srid stsol cig ces pa lta bu ste/ 'di ma ṇi la nus pa cung zad rnyed pa yan chad kyis bya'o/ /ma ṇi rtag tu 'dzin cing rjes su dran par byed pa rnams 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' yas pa las thar bar 'gyur/gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang der tshe rabs dran par 'gyur/156

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4lus ba lang gi spos kyi tsan dan snom par 'gyur/ kha nas ud pa la'i dri 'byung / lus yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ stobs po che'i stobs kyi shugs dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / ma ṇi'i yig 'bru gcig 'brir bcug kyang rigs ngan du mi skye/ dbang po nyams par mi 'gyur/ theng po dang sgur po dang mdze can sogs su mi 'gyar/ lus la nad kyis 'debs par mi 'gyar te/ nad pha rig dmi me la rig rwarngo(1 niring 4155mad pa dang / mthu cha ba dang / dbang gsal bar 'gyur zhas gsungs shing / yig drug 'brir 'jug pa de chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong 'brir bcug par 'gyur zhing / gling bzhi la dbang ba'i 'khor sgyur du 'gyur bar gsungs te rdo 'bum bzhengs pa sogs la sbyor/ phyi rol rdo dang gro shog sogs la 'bri ba dang / nang bsgom pas 'bri ba gnyis kyi phyi ma la'ang sbyor rung ngam ste/ yid gtso bo yin pa'i phyir te 'phags pa nyid kyis sangs rgyas pad+ma'i mchog la rig sngags phul thad/ dkyil 'khor tshon gyis 'bri ba ma 'byor na yid kyis 'bri ba de'i dod du gsung ba bzhin no/ /yang / yig drug rtag tu 'dzin cing zlos pa la brtson pa rnams ni bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa ste/ de dag gis zlos par byed pa'i tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gā'i klung dgu bcu rtsa 157

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dgu'i bye ma snyed 'du bar 'gyur/ byang sems rdul phra rab snyed 'du bar 'gyur/ phar phyin drug sgo na gnas par 'gyur/ gzhan yang lha'i sde sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi lha'i bu dag 'du bar 'gyur/rgyal po chen po bzhi yang phyogs bzhi srung bar 'gyur/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho dang / ma dros pa dang / 'jog po sogs klu bye ba khrag 'bum du mas yongs su srung bar byed/ sa bla'i gnod sbyin dag ni bla gab med par srung bar byed/ rigs kyi bu de'i ba spu'i khung bu re rer yang sangs rgyas bye ba dag bzhugs nas rus kyi rigs bdun brgyud dang / lto na gnas pa'i srog chags rnams kyang dbugs 'byin par mdzad/ 'di 'chang ba de'i lus ni rdo rje'i lus dang / ring bsrel gyi mchod rten dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes bye bar rig par bya'o/ /'di zlos pa de ni spobs pa mi zad par 'gyur/ ye shes kyi phung po rnam par dag par 'gyur/byams pa chen po dang snying rje chen po dang ldan par 'gyur/ de nyi ma re re zhing phar phyin drug yongs su rdzogs par 'gyar༈/ de ris / ༄'dzin gyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i dbang thob par 'gyur/ la la zhig la de'i dbugs kyis reg gam lag pas reg gam la la zhig gis de mthong bar gyur na skyes pa bud med khye'u bu mo bya dang ri dwags ba lang dang bong bu sogs gang su yang rung ste thams cad bla med 158

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur/ skye rga na 'chi dang mdza' ba dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal med par 'gyur/ rnal 'byor bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par 'gyur/ bsam gtan dpag tu ma mchis pa zil gyis gnon par bgyid/ chos kyi mdzod yongs su gang bar bgyid do/ /zhes gsungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rdul phra rab snyed kyi sku gzugs lha'i gser rin po che las byed cing byas nas nyin gcig bzhin du ring bsrel 'jug pa de'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa ni yi ge drug pa'i yig 'bra gcig gi 'bras ba'i ra༄me rig rnam par smin pa tsam mo/ /zhes so/ /yul 'khor mor 'jig gi chos smra maṇi ba ba'i lo rgyus kyi thad na/ lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po dang mi dang mi ma yin pa dag khyod las chos nyan te/ khyod la chos nyan pa'i tshe thams cad 'du bar bgyid do/ /khyod ni rdo rje chen po dang mnyam pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'chad par mdzad do/ /sems can 'khor ba'i bcing bas bcing ba mang po thar bar mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs te rdo rje dang mnyam lugs ni 'og tu 'ching ba gcod par gsungs pa 'di yin pa 'dra ste/ rdo rje ni lcags sgrog gcog pa yin no/ /yang / dper na mes nags kyi 'dab ma myur du 'tshig par bgyid pa de bzhin du khyod mthong ma 159

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/thag tu sdig pa thams cad 'phrog par mdzad do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyang mkhyen to/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma dang / tshangs pa dang /'jug sred dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / rlung gi lha dang / chu'i lha dang / me'i lha dang / chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dag khyod la mchod pa'i las bya ba'i phyir mchi'o/ /zhes so/ /yang / nges par 'byung ba tshol ba kha cig dbang phyug chen po dang / 'jug sred sogs la rab tu 'byung ste/ de dag la yang thar ba med/ mgon yang ma yin/ brtul zhugs can yang ma yin no/ /lha mang po dang /tshangs pa dang / 'jug sred dang / dbang phyug chen po dang /brgya byin lha'i dbang po dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / rlung gi lha dang / chu'i lha dang / me'i lha dang / chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje dang gshin rje chos rgyal gyis phyag byas tshul za ma tog dang 'grel chen dri med 'od las so/ /dbang phyug dang gi ri lung bstan pa/ lha mo dpal gyis gling bzhi'i sems can rnams kyi longs spyod kyi phyir bre bo lo tog gis gang ba phul ba/ tshogs bdag glang po gdong gi lo rgyus sogs/ rgyal po chen po bzhi dag rtag tu yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo slong ngo / /zhes dang / 'di la cung zad bzlas pas kyang theg pa chen po'i rnam pa mang po mdo 160

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4dang / dbyangs kyi sa bsnyad pa nas gtan la pha ba par bstan pa'i bar bcu gnyis dang / zhi ba dang / thar pa yang thob par 'gyur ro/ /mang du bshad ci dgos te/ sa'i nang du gtogs pa la snying por 'dzin pa ci yin zhe na/ 'bras ni snying por 'dzin te khyer nas bdag gi khyim du snod rnams yongs su bkang ste 'jog go/ /bzhag nas nyi ma'i tshul bzhin du nyi ma tsha ba la skems so/ /bskams nas gtun la brdungs shing phub ma rnams sel to/ /de'i snying po ni 'bras me'u yin te/ de bzhin du rnal 'byor gzhan dag phub ma dang 'dra'o/ /rnal 'byor thams cad kyi nang na yig drug gi rig sngags 'di ni 'bras rme'ur gyur pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi phyir tshegs 'byin te bzlas pa gcig byas pas phyin drug yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /la la zhig gis lag pas reg na de dag kyang phyir mi ldog pa'i sa 'thob bo/ /'di'i ming lan gcig bzung na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la na bza' dang bshes dang mal stan dang snyun gyi gsos sman dang yo byad thams cad kyis bkur stir byas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /'di 'dra'i rtags ldan de yig drug phyin drug dang sbyor ba'i khungs su 'gro'am dpyod/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las 'jig rten dbang po'i sku'i ting nge 'dzin las sgrol ma dang gos dkar mo 161

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sogs byung gsungs shing / rnam snang mngon byang 'grel par khro gnyer gyi rgyud las khro gnyer can byung gsungs la/ za ma tog las ba spu re rer yang ting nge 'dzin mang po yod par gsungs te /ba spu re re sgrub byed kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi steng gi 'gro 'dul gyi phrin las kyang mthar thug pa med do/ /de'ang ka na ka dang / nyi ma'i 'od dang / bdud rtsi dang / rdo rje'i sgo dang / kriṇ+ḍa dang /sman chen po sogs ba spu'i khung bu rnams na/ iṇ+ḍa nī la la sogs pa rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi ri bo shin tu rgya che zhing lhun mtho ba rtse mo sna tshogs can/ ngos rnams lha'i nor bu rin po che'i skyed mo'i tshal gyis brgyan pa/ sil snyan gyi sgras khyab pa dang / lha'i gzhal med khang shin tu bzang zhing lta na sdug pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ lha'i rin po che'i 'od kyis snang bar byas pa/ nor bu dang /mu tig gi chun 'phyang dang se mo do dang / dar gyi lda ldi dang /gser gyi dril bu'i drwa bas brgyan pa/ gser gyi them skas can mchog tu dga' bar byed pa mang po dang / 'chag sa dang skyed mo'i tshal rnams na dpag bsam gyi shing khang pa brtsegs pa lta bu la lha'i gos dang rgyan dang dril bu 'phyang ba'i nags tshal dang /spos kyi shing grangs med pas dkrigs shing / la la chu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pas gang / la la chu dang me tog gis gang ba'i 162

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4rdzing bu 'bum phrag mang pos mdzes pa/ de dag gi me tog kyang ut+pal dang pad+ma dang ku mu ta dang / puṇ+ḍa ri ka dang / mad+dha ra ba dang / mad+dha ra ba chen po sogs sna tshogs pa/ rin po che sha ri da ka zhes bya ba dang me tog pad+ma ltar snang ba zhes bya ba sogs bsam dgu 'byung ba'i nor bu rin po che'i khyad par yod pa/ drang srong mngon shes thob pa dang / lha dang dri za dang mi'am ci dang dri za'i bu mo dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ba'i zas can grangs med pa dang /rje btsun gyi rjes su slob pa'i byang sems phyir mi ldog pa bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag mang po la la ni bsam gtan byed/ la la ni theg pa chen po'i chos kyi gtam byed cing gnas pa/ bya dang ri dwags rnams kyang mdo sde za ma tog rjes su dran par byed pa/ rje btsun gyi mtshan dran pa tsam gyis lha'i zas ro mchog dang ldan pa dang lha'i gos sogs lha rdzas kyi longs spyod 'byung ba ste/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs yi ge/ drug pa'i rig sngags kyi ming gis rjes su dran na ba spu'i khung bu de dag tu skye'o/ /slar 'khor bar mi 'khor ro/ /ba spu'i khung bu nas ba spu'i khung bur 'gro ste/ mya ngan las 'das pa thob kyi bar du de dag na gnas par 'gyur bar gsungs so/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi spyod yul 'di'i spyod yul zhes pa ni mngon sum gyi spyod yul lta bu la mi zer gyi/ spyod yul gyi grong zhes pa ltar shas cher mang du gnas 163

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa'i spyod yul lo/ /'dra ba sangs rgyas rnams la'ang med gsung pa'i dgongs pa brtags na/ rmi lam yid bzhin nor bu'i gtam ltar sangs rgyas kyi lam 'bras mtha' dag sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal phra rags thams cad bsal ched kho nar byung bas snying rje'i rtsa ba las 'phros pa sha stag yin la/ sems can gyi nang nas kyang sems kyi rgyud tshig cing nyes spyod rgyu 'bras kyi stobs bdo ba rnams phyag mtshan gtso bor bzhes nas sgrol ba'i khur bsnam pa ni sangs rgyas kyi nang na'ang lhang nger 'phags pa yin te/ bya dka' ba lhag par mdzad pa'i phyir te/ shākya'i rgyal po pad dkar lta bur bsngags pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis shes so/ /'phags pa 'di sa dang po thugs bskyed dus nas rang don yid byed kyi dri mas ma sbags pa'i snying rje chen po dang / de'i nang nas kyang dmigs med kyi brtse chen rab mtha'i bsam gtan la brten pa'i rnal 'byor nyid rtsal 'don gyis lhur mdzad tshul dang / de'i steng nas ma dag pa'i zhing gi 'gro ba las kyang nas bkrab snyigs kyi bra yug phyag dar du bor ba ltar cir mi rung gi sems can las ngan 'jigs pa dang sdug bsngal gang che che thu thu rnams gtso bor dang lhag par rjes su 'dzin pa'i thags bskyed smon lam gyi shugs sbyang tshul dang de ༷༷ ri 47 char charathugs dam gya gca ra bzhas pa 'dra ba bya nga sams gzhan la 164

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4dka' bar ma zad/ de bzhin gshegs pa las kyang lhag tshul shākya'i dbang po bsngags pa'i tshul des shes pas/ gang dang yang mi mnyam par bsngags pa ste/ 'di 'dra mi 'khrugs pa'i spyod pa 'dra bas sangs rgyas stong dang rin chen tog sogs la med par gsungs pa lta bu gzhan yang snang ngo / /da dung bshad na/ mnar med sogs sdug bsngal gang che gdul gang dka'/ skal ba gang ngan gyi 'gro ba rnams la lhag par brtse bas rang nyid snying rje chen po'i rig sngags kyi lhar zhal gyis bzhes te nyid kyis sems can thams cad skyob pa'i snying rje dang snying rje'i spyod pa mtha' dag sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ma thu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rigs sngags kyi yi ger byin gyis brlabs te/ de'i sgo nas smos ma thag pa'i sems can las ngan rnams kyi 'jigs pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad mig 'phrul bshigs pa tsam du myar la tshegs chung ngus zhi bar mdzad cing ////she dmi ༅ ///ro ༷༷/drob ba can dang gru 'a na la sogs par btsan thabs su 'a na/de'i ched du byis pa gzhon nu ni rtag tu spyod pa'i gnas rtsed mo byed pa'i nang kho na yin pa ltar shas cher mang du bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan song sogs gang dang gang na sems can phongs shing sdug bsngal ba gnas pa rnams la mdzad pa dang / tshul des skad 165

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/cig rer yang phyogs bcu mtha' yas mu med pa'i 'jig rten khams rnams su chu'i zla ba pad dkar du/ thabs dang ye shes yangs pa bslab pas na/ /phyogs bcu'i 'gro ba mang po thams cad dang / /ma lus zhing kun tu yang rab tu snang / /zhes sogs ltar bzhugs pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo ltar dang / 'jig rten gyi khams re re'i rdul phra rab re rer yang mtha' dang dbus med pa'i 'jig rten dang de re rer yang sprul pa'i sprin tshad med pa sogs de dag byang sems gzhan las kyang shas cher mang du gnas pas 'phags la mchog zung lta bu/sngon gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i dbang gis de bzhin gshegs pa las kyang lhag tshul snga ma bzhin no/ /de'i steng nas dpyad na/ ma ṇi 'di 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi snying po dam pa yin pas sus kyang mi shes/ de bzhin gshegs pas kyang mi mkhyen zhes bka' bstsal ba'i dgongs pa'ang / theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i rtogs rigs kyi dbang du btang na shes rab las kyang snying rje chen po gtso ste/ bla med byang chub las phyir mi ldog gi rtags thob mtshams yang rang don yid byed kyi go skabs bcom pa'i gzhan phan gyi sems rang gi thog nas bzhag 'dug pa/ bla med byang chub bya ba de/ slob dpon seng bzang zhabs kyis/ sdud pa'i/bdag gi bde ba btang nas re ba med sems kyis/ /zhes pa la 166

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4sbyar ba ltar yin pas so/ /des na snying rje chen po ji lta ji ltar phul byung dang khyad par can du skyes pa de lta de ltar de'i rten can gyi spyod pa mtha' dag phul byung dang khyad par can du skye ba chos nyid yin pas gong ltar rje btsun gyis snying rje la sgrub pa nyams len nam sgom pa'i sbyor ba bsten pa 'dra ba rgyal sras gzhan la med byas dus/ de'i byang chub kyi spyod pa ci tsam rlabs che ba de tsam du rlabs che ba'i spyod pa rgyal sras gzhan la med ces par yang 'gyur ro/ /ma ṇi phyin drug gi ngo bo nyid yin zhes pa'i phyin drug ni phar phyin drug yin tshad la mi byed kyi/ thugs rje chen po'i thugs rgyud kyi de dag la byed pas phyin drug la ring du spyad pa'i rgyal sras rnams kyis kyang ma ṇi'i sngags don gyi gting slebs par dka' ba mi 'gal lo/ /'di bzhin byas na/ 'di ni rnal 'byor dpag tu med pa'i phyir sgrub dka' ba'o/ /zhes pa'ang bshad bde/tshul 'di gdul bya la bstan ched sgrib sel lta bus kyang ma ṇi la sgom tshul dang de'i ched du 'o brgyal mdzad snang / 'di ni nor bzang gi bla ma rnams kyis/ de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am yon tan brjod par nus re skan/ zhes gsungs pa dang tshul mthan/༄de'i 'gres kyis ma ṇi'i de nyid la de bzhin gshegs pa mang po'i rnam thar las kyang lhag pa'i sgos chos bshad zin ltar yod pas/167

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'phags pa kho rang gis ma gnang bar du yig drug rang dbang du sbyin par sangs rgyas nyid kyis kyang mi spyod pas sangs rgyas pad+ma dam pa de bzhin gshegs par gyur bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang por yig drug 'tshol du gshegs par bstan te/ sgrib sel khyod kyis kyang 'phags pa mnyes phyir ma ṇi'i chos smra ba ngan ngon ltar snang ba la yang nga rgyal dang brnyas sems rnam pa thams cad du bcom pa'i gus pa chen po bskyed de nyon zhes pa ste/ 'dis ni 'di'i chos dang bla ma la mi gus pa la ma ṇi ma sbyin cig /ces pa dang / gus pa med pas rig sngags kyi rgyal mo mi 'grub ces dang /'di ster ba'i bla ma'i phyogs su dka' spyod ci tsam byas pa de tsam du 'di'i snod du 'gyar zhes bstan par 'gyar te/ rje btsun nyid (155 4155 rig mi rig me zu rigakyas pad+ma' bla ma la phul skabs na/ ma dad pa rnams la sbyan par mi bya/ zhes gsungs pa dang / sgrib sel khor mo 'jig gi chos smra'i drung du byon thad na/ byang chubabyusems dpa' 'dis dka' ba mang po spyad kyis rig sngags kyi rgyal mo byin cig /ces gsungs so//de dag gis ni/ kye ma'o bla na med pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di ni sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar zhus kyang thob dka' ba'o snyam du phyi ma'i skye bo rnams gus pa cher bskyed par mdzad do/ /jo bo rjes nga la yon tan ci yang med gsungs/ 'di 168

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4dang 'di 'dug pa zhus dus de bla ma'i drin yin gsungs pa ltar 'di ngas shes pa min gyi/ bla ma'i drin las shes pas khyod kyang bla ma'i phyir dka' spyad kyis zhes bshad kyang lom tsam ste/ snga ma bzang snyam/ gong smos gyi phyin drug rlabs po che rnams dmigs med kyi brtse ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi steng du 'dril ba'am/ phyin drug de rnams bsdus pa'i rang bzhin gyi brtse chen ni yi ge drug po sngags gcig tu tshogs pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i de nyid yin la/ de 'dra'i brtse chen de la ni sher phyin mas kyang phyag mdzad de/ sher phyin sangs rgyas dang byang sems thams cad kyi yum du 'gyar ba ni de mgon du thob pa'i mthu dang drin yin pa'i shārig ri sna ༄༄ lajug (1)—rig zurang tshorangaphyar ra/ /das na ga drug ma la rgyal ba' yum gyas kyang phyag 'tshal bar gsungs/ 'phags pa'i ba spu gcig gi bsod nams kyi tshad bshad nas de 'dra sangs rgyas la'ang med gsungs pa'ang /de'i ba spu gcig 'grub byed kyi bsod nams la dgongs pa min nam snyam ste/ bsod nams de bas ches che ba rtse sbyor thob pa'i byang sems phal cher la'ang yod par bshad pas so/ /des na tshe mdo la bskyed pa'i bsod nams zhes gsungs pa yod la/ 'dir yang de'i 'gros ltar rje btsun gyi ba spu gcig la bskyed pa'i bsod nams kyis sangs rgyas mang po dus mtha' yas su mchod pa'i 169

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bsod nams zil gyis gnon zhes pa ste/ gong du bshad pa'i tshul gyis sems can la phan 'dogs pa che ba'i ngos nas sangs rgyas las kyang lhag tshul yod pa'i phyir te/ des na phan 'dogs kyi zhing la ltos nas bzhag pa'o/ /ma ṇi 'don pa'i mdun du de bzhin gshegs pa mang po 'du bar gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/sdud pa'i/ ma zhig na bar gyur pa'i sogs dang / pad+ma'i mchog gis thag ring du btsal zhing chos kyi dga' ba bstsal ba/ sgrib sel gyis bdud rtsi thob na ro myang bas chog ma 'tshal zhes chos kyi mchod pa chen po mdzad du phebs pa/ ston pas kun dga' bo la byang chub yan lag gsan pa/ dam chos pad dkar gsan ched rin chen mang byon pa sogs mang pos dpyod/ gtso bor dang po byin gyis brlabs tshal gyis yin te/ de dag gi de gtso bo'i mtha rimi bya nod mizhes so/ /yig drug 'byung bar sbyar ba la/ phyi'i sa chu me rlung dang /nang lus 'byung dang / gsang ba sems kyi cha la sbyar ba so sor yod/ gdon srung ba la yi ge drug po go rim bzhin du/ lha'i gdon dang / mo gdon/ rgyal 'gong / sa bdag gi gdon/bdud dang gshin rje/ gnod sbyin dang gza' rnams thub pa'i srung ba yin/ nad 'don la 'dus pa/ tshad pa/ rlung / bad kan/170

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4grang ba/ mkhris pa'i nad rnams yul 'don te go rim bzhin no/ /de'ang thugs rje chen po nyid kyis de ltar nad 'don du byin gyis brlabs tshul shes nas the tshom spang la/ de rtsal du bton pa'i steng nas las rung rnyed rnyed du sgom bzlas brtson na nad zhi ba la rtsal 'thon te/ sna tshogs nor bu bzhin no/ /byang gter las phrin las bzhi'i sbyar ba sogs kun la de ltar shes par bya'o/ /nad gdon la sbyar ba 'di dang bka' 'bum las tshogs kyi nad gdon drug lto sbyar na yid tshim thub yod/ yum ka la sbyar na/ oṃ yum yi ge drug ma/ lhag ma lnga spyan sogs yum lnga ste/ gsang 'dus su yum bzhi'i phreng sngags bstan pa sogs dran par bya/yang oṃ de bzhin te thams cad mkha' 'gro/ ma sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro sogs mkha' 'gro rigs lnga ste/ mkha' 'gro ma'i brda skad byin rlabs 'bebs pa'i sngags yin gsungs/ de'ang yum yi ge drug ma sngags kyi 'od zer gyis gnas nyer bzhi dang / dur khrod brgyad kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams gnad nas bskul te/ rang dbang med par shing lo skam po rlung gis khyer ba ltar bkug /bya nag mo'i khyu 'drogs pa ltar mdun du gar dang stangs stabs sgyur zhing spungs se byon nas byin rlabs dngos grub thogs med du stsol bar bsam pa bka' 'bum snga dum sum brgya so gcig na yod cing /171

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/da dung yod/ nad 'don du bsngags pa ni/ nad ni rnam 'tshe'i las 'bras yin la snying rje ni rnam par mi 'tshe ba'i las can no zhes mngon pa las 'byung bas snying rje'i lha mchog yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis te/ jo bo'i lo rgyu sa na rnam 'tshe spangs pas snyun dang bral ba'i che ba zhes pa dang gnad gcig /des na nad 'don gtso bor byed na snying rje'i dag dran gtso bor bya dgos/ phyag rdor drang srong gi tshul bzung logh+ri pa la lta bu yod kyang / rtsa ba'i sprul sku gnod sbyin stobs po che'i gzags/ rje btsan thags rje'i ༄༄mi rig ra migater ni gtso bor rig sngag sa 'chang grub pa'i lha'i drang srong phan 'dogs nus pa'i gzugs can te ri dwags pags pa ral ba'i cod pan dang / bgrang phreng zhes pa nas/ drang srong gzugs kyis phyogs rnams kun tu rgyu/ /zhes bla ma gsungs/ phreng ba'am bgrang nor bsnams pa'ang de ltar ro/ /cha byad 'ga' drang srong dang bstun yang thams cad mthun mi dgos/rig sngags ni 'dir shes rab snying rje ste/ man tra ya zhes yid skyob/ ma ṇi'i srung gur dang gnas khang byin dbab byed na/ngos bzhi dang steng 'og rnams 'bru drug gi rnam par lta ba bka' gdams pha chos ltar/ yig drug 'byung bzhir sbyar lugs bka' 'bum na bzhus/sa pa/ dpal mchog tu 'phags pa nyid sa'i lha 172

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4d+ku dang chu'i lhar bzhengs pa sogs bshad pa dang bsgrigs nas de dag gi sngags su yang 'gyur lugs yod par shes chog /de'i steng nas yig drug las rung rnyed na/ sa bcud dang chu bcud gso ba/sa la dbang sgyur ba/ char dbab pa/ chu dang rtsi thog la phan pa'i rlung dgug cing / dug ldan gyi rlung zhi bar bya ba sogs 'byung bzhi'i gnod pa zhi zhing dngos grub byed tshul mang po yong bar gsal/ rig 'dzin zhi bar/ rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan gyi gtso bo rnam snang / spyi bor rigs bdag tshe dpag med red/ de'i rigs pas yi dam zhi bar yang rnam snang sogs kyis rgyas btab kyang /rigs bdag 'od dpag med sgom rung ngam ste/ dpal 'dus su'ang mi bskyod pa sogs kyis dbu brgyan yang rigs bdag snang mthas mdzad pa lta bu/ srong btsan sgam pos nga'i dbon sras rnams kyis lha khang bzhengs na'ang nga'i ra sa la sa rdo shing gsum gyi phud bskyal nas bzhengs na bar chad med gsungs pa ltar bsam yas bzhengs pa'i thog mar bzo phud phul/ de nas dang por ar+ya pa lo'i gling rtsigs ces sgrol mas lung bstan nas de bzhengs/ gu ru rin po che srin yul bzhud ka'ang thugs rje chen po'i lha sngags yi dam mthil du zungs shig pa'i zhal gdams gnang / rje 'bangs 'dus pa yongs la thugs rje chen po'i chos 173

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/kyi gtad rgya mdzad de slar bod yul du de'i sgo nas phrin las byed par lung bstan cing byin gyis brlabs/ gangs brag mtsho gsum sogs 'phags pa'i chos gter gyis gtams/ de kho na ltar phyis gter 'don dus kyang bla rdzogs thugs gsum cha tshang ma thon na gter chen min zhes 'byung ba bzhin thugs rje chen po'i gdams skor re med pa'i gter kha chen po mi snang / gter ston rnams kyi rtsa ba'i thugs dam yang phal cher 'di la mdzad pa gong 'og gnyis dang sangs gling sogs kyi rnam thar gyis mtshon nus/ ma ṇi'i bzlas rgyun spel ba dang skye bdun bum sgrub sogs ma ṇi'i phrin las tshad bzung med par bskyang tshul yang chos dbang rin po che dang /thang stong rgyal po/ 'gro 'dul las gling / rad gling / rdor brag rig 'dzin sogs kyi lo rgyus las shes/ sa gter la mang shos bla rdzogs thugs gsum yin pa'i rgyu mtshan des gter srung rnams kyang thugs rje chen po zhi drag gi dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing dam tshig nod pa sha stag yin par shes nus/ gter srung de dag ni bod kyi sa bdag chu bdag che shos rnams so/ /de dag thams cad kyang bod spyi mthun la sngags kyi lha'i nang nas las smon gyi 'brel ba che la mang shos thugs rje chen po yin pa'i gnad la gtugs dgos/174

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4rje 'bangs thams cad la 'phags pa'i gdams skor gyi bka' babs su lung bstan ma thob pa med pa dang / sa gzhi thams cad 'phags pa'i chos gter gyis gtams par cis 'grub ce na/ 'di la lung khungs mang po yod mchi ste da res dpe ma 'byor/'on kyang bla rdzogs thags gsam mi tshang ba'i gter chen med pa de rabye dbyikas gsal bar 'grub/ bin+dha'i rtags can 'dir/ bod 'dir ston pa'i dam chos dar ba dang de la brten nas phan bde rgya cher 'byung ba thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i gleng gzhi lta bu ni spyir bcom ldan 'das kyis mi mjed kyi zhing 'di sngon yongs su sbyang ba'i lag rjes kyi khongs su tshang ba smos mi dgos kyang / bye brag tu yul 'di'i skye bo rnams 'phags pa dang las 'brel che la mang ba dang /'phags pas de rnam sa la shākya'i rgyal po'i phrin las kyi chu bo'i 'ol kha sgyur ba'i smon lam dang thabs mkhas pa'i khyad par nyid do/ /shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa rdzing chu/ bod yul zhing sa/ thugs rje chen po'i lha sngags yur ba red pas zhing du chu dkon por song na yur ba rtsa shing rdo gsum ma gus pa dang snyom las sogs/ lta bu'i 'gaṭa rtags red pas de sbyang ba la 'bod/ des na bod 'dir dam chos mi nub ched srung rim gzhan byed pa las ma ṇi'i sgrub dang las sbyor rno ba 'dra ste/ chos kyi dbu brnyes/ srol btod/ rgyas 175

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/par byed pa sogs mgo 'jog lugs kyi rten 'brel las so/ /rnam pa gcig tu na/ rgyal bstan bya ba lung rtogs yin gyi 'ar re 'ur re la mi zer/ bod 'dir rgyal bstan spyi khyab de'i lam srol 'dzugs mkhan dang 'byed byed sogs ma ṇi'i lha sngags yin pa'i rten 'brel des sgos kyi bstan pa rang rgyud la dar rgyas 'byung ba'i thabs su'ang ma ṇi'i rnal 'byor kho na zab/ des na gsang 'dus kyi gos dkar mo'i phreng sngags thad gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i chos kyi dngos grub bshad pa dang 'dra ba ma ṇi la chos kyi dngos grub sgrub par yid gtod par bya'o/ /bka' gdams thig le bcu drug tu bstan pa rgyas pa'i cho gar bsngags pa'ang de ltar ro/ /ba spu'i khung bu kriṇ+ḍa'i bya ri dwags dang / rin chen rna cha'i dri za'i bu mo'i dang / rdo rje sgo'i mi'am ci'i thad kun na ma ṇi dran pa'i mod la bde ba'i yo byad thams cad rang 'byung bar gsungs pa la brten nas/ sgrib sel gyis/ theg pa chen po'i mdo dkon mchog gi rgyal po za ma tog gi ming dran pa tsam la yang de 'dra'i mthu yod na/ mdo de nyan klog 'dzin pa sogs la lta ci smos zhes ched du brjod/ za ma tog ces pa rnams ni ma ṇi nyid do/ /yang yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo'i ming lan gcig bzung na de bzhin gshegs pabyuthams cad la na bza' dang /176

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4bshos dang / gzim cha dang / snyun gyi gsos sman dang / yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur byas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs/yang yig drug zlos pa po de la nor bu rin po che 'dzin pa dang /dmyal ba dang byol song skem pa dang / rdo rje'i go cha dang / rkang pa shin tu gnas pa dang / thabs mkhas pa thams cad dang /bsam gtan gyi rgyan dang / chos kyi shing rta la 'jug pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mthong ba la sogs pa ting nge 'a dzin brgya rtsa brgyad thob par 'gyar ro/ /zhes gsungs/ theg chen than mong ma yin //bye ra pa 13 nge //re/ rab mipa ༄ lam gnad — shos mtha' 'gog byed rnams yin pas byang sems kyis de la gtso bor 'dzin dgos shing / lung las/ 'chag pas thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni ring du gnas so zhes pa ltar/de'i nang nas kyang gtso cher ram shas cher sems can gdul gang dka'/ bskyab gang dka'/ las sgrib gang 'thug /sdig stobs gang che rnams kho na la kyog pa'i shing la srong ba'i tshul bzhin dmigs phug ste thabs shes kyi lam thams cad ched gtad kyis dus mtha' yas par rtsal sbyang ba ni mgon med kyi 'gro ba rjes 'dzin gyi rtsal thon phyogs dang / rno nus skye phul gzhan dang khyad zhugs pa yin/ byang sems yin mnyam la'ang de 'dra'i khyad 'ong 177

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba mi 'gal te/ nyan thos dgra bcom yin mnyam la'ang mchog zung 'gran med du gsungs pa bzhin no/ /phal cher don yod dang / rnam kun don yod sogs kyang chos dbyings mngon sum rtogs par 'dra yang thabs shes kyi rtogs pa rtsal byang ma byang dang /mthu che chung yin la/ de bzhin du spyir sems can sgrol ba la rtogs pa'i rtsal byang mnyam yin yang ches cher snyigs shing rgyud tshig pa'i gdul dka'i 'gro ba lhag par skyob pa la rtogs pa'i rtsal byang tshabs che chung / bur shing 'o ma bu ram gyi/ /mngar ba nyid ni khyad par che/ /zhes pa lta bu yod pa'o/ /rje btsun gyis stong nyid snying rje'i lam 'di sangs rgyas grangs med mchod nas btsal/ rnyed nas smon lam grangs med 'bum bcu sogs dang / sbyin sogs spyod pa dpag med tshad med kyis brgyan te/ rtag 'grus rgyun mi 'chad dang / sgo thams cad kyi phun sum tshogs shing rnam par dag la ches phul byung dang mi 'phrogs pa'i sgrub pa mdzad de/ shin tu mthar phyin cing yongs su rdzogs pa na de nyid yig drug tu brlabs pa red pas de thams cad kyi nus pa yig drug kho na la yod do/ /des na mnar med du byon tshe yang ma ṇi tshar re gsungs pa rkyang pas sa chen po'i rdul ltar mtha' yas pa'i dmyal ba tshang sprugs su sprugs nus pa red do//178

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4yang / so skyes chos smra sogs stong gsum gyi rdul snyed kyis skal ba mtha' yas par chos rgya cher bshad pas/ rje btsun gyis ma ṇi rdog gcig gsungs pa gzhan phan grangs med 'gyur du che ba ni/stobs bcu mnga' ba'i gnad kyis yin te/ stobs rnams ma rig sgrib la rdo rje bzhin/ /zhes pa'ang gzhan rgyud kyi ma rig sgrib la zhes pa'o/ /'doms par byed pa po nyam che chung gis 'khor gdul ba la khyad zhugs pa thams cad 'di dang 'gro phyogs 'dra'o/ /sngar klad bris skor 'khrul pa la yang bri byas pa/ mngon spyod mkhan tsa na kyas mi brgya stong mang po la gdung ba bskyed pa ni sems can de dag gi las ngan gyi nus pa drag sngags kyi lhan cig byed rkyen gyis bslang ba yin cing / mngon spyod de'i rnam smin ni phyi mar yi dwags kyi rje bor skye ba de red la/ der ma zad/ tsa na kya'i brlang spyod de las shin tu stobs ldan yin pas mthong chos myong 'gyur red pas/ tshe der lus tshal bar gas pa'i nad kyis shi ba red/ de go bzlog ste tshe sgrub sogs la'ang 'don pa sgyur chog 'dug /de'i 'gros kyis ma ṇi'i rgyab chog /go 'tshogs sogs kyis sngon las ngan pa'i 'bras bu nad gdon byur chag sogs la lo tog ser bas bcom pa ltar 'gal rkyen byas nas phyir bzlog pa dang / rgyal po la tsan dan phul bas yul thob pa ltar/179

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tshe ring nad med sogs kyi rgyu'i sngon la tshe 'dir 'dren pa'i rkyen byed pa tsam red la/ ma ṇi'i chos 'don la yon phul ba'i las 'bras ni da gzod tshe rabs phyi ma la smin rgyu yin la/ zhing dang bsam pa phul byung 'ga' zhig mthong chos myong 'gyur yang yod/sngon 'brel che chung sogs kyi dbang gis rgyab chog sku rim la'ang sngon gyi dge ba'i las gzhan gyi 'bras bu 'phral la sad rkyen byed nus mi nus mang po yod kyang / gsol ba btab na sngon gyi dge 'bras nam 'dod der 'drong thub pa la ma ṇi stobs che/ rnam smin stobs che ba ni sla'o/ /des na las gzhan gyi sad rkyen byed lugs la'ang / gzhan rgyud la dang / rang rgyud la byed tshul gnyis yod par snang / 'di zhwa dmar lam rim ltar na ma ṇi bton pa'i skyes bu byed 'bras su bya'am snyam/ rtsi shing gi bcud dbyar ka rtse na yod rtags su de'i ro nus khyad par 'phags byas pa rkyang dam ye'i rdo rje gsum dbyer med/ gis mi chog bcud rtse mor yod rtags su 'bras bu'am thog 'bru gsum/ gu chags dgos/ gnas gsum go cha ni rang rgyud kyi sgo gsum dang sangs rgyas rnams kyi rdo rje gsum gcig tu sbyar nas mdud pa brgyab pa yin pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi rdo rje gsam gyi dbyings sa rang gi sgo gsam sba ba ste/rig mi raring rigang chu thigs rgya mtsho la bzhag nas nyi ma'i gdung ba las srung ba 180

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4bzhin no/ /pad+ma'i rigs la dam pa'i chos kyi 'od zer dang / mdo sde bshad pa'i mthu rnyed phyir sogs yo gar bshad pa ni/ gti mug gi gnyen po sher phyin gyi ngo bo nyid pad+ma 'gro 'dul gyi rigs su dpal mchog 'grel chen du bshad pas/ sher phyin gyi mtshon byed glegs bam du byed pa dang / chos dbyings rtogs pa'i rgyu mthun pa'i gsung rab ces pa dang 'dra bas mi gos pa'i de nyid kyi steng nas shes par bya snyam/ 'di ltar yin nges te/ kun snying gi hrīḥbashad du/ chos kyi rigs zhes pa'i chos ni rang bzhin dag pa'i chos la gzigs pa'i sher phyin du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de'ang nyan rang gis ni dag bya nyon sgrib la ltos te rang bzhin dag pa'i cha tsam mngon sum rtogs te/ de'i dbang gis dag pa phyogs gcig pa de la brten pa'am de'i yon tan du gyur pa'i 'phags pa'i chos kyang nyi tshe ba tsam brnyes la/ theg chen nas sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa dag byar bzhag pa'i rang bzhin dag pa mtha' dag mngon du byed de de'i dbang gis dag pa ma lus pa de'i yon tan dag pa de la brten pa'ang mtha' dag pa 'thob ste/'di ni rang bzhin dag pa de sgom byed lam gyi dbang gis chos kyi dbyings sam 'phags chos kyi 'byang khungs su 'gyar tshul rgya che ra ra༅181

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/chung ngo / /rtogs pa'i chos kyi 'byung khungs yin par ma zad lung gi chos thams cad kyi 'byung khungs mthar thug kyang yin te/ rgyu mthun de dag thub pa bzhed/ /ces chos dbyings rtogs pa'i rgyu mthun pa'i gsung rab ces grags pa ltar ro/ /so so yang dag rig bzhi zhes pa'i sgra bshad kyis kyang shes/ des na lung gi chos thams cad kyang 'gog bden chos dbyings rnam dag gi yon tan kho na'o/ /lam rim gyi lhag mthong gi stong nyid btsal dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan thad ltar de kho na nyid 'tshol ba ni glo bur gyi dri ma sbyangs nas dag par bya ba'i ched do/ /dri ma'i gtso bo ni rmongs pa bag chags dang bcas pa ste/ de rang bzhin gyis dag tshul 'di rang bzhin dag pa zhes pa'i gtso bor bzung ngo / /rgyun 'khyer du bzla na/ skyabs sems dang shun+ya tā'i don dran sngon btang sogs ma byung rung sngar gyi goms shugs ltar lha gsal btab ste rdo rje phred bzung lugs su bzlas pas 'grub pa dang / de'ang lha'i rnam pa gsal bar ma gyur kyang ye nas rang gi sgo gsum lha'i rang bzhin du sangs rgyas pa'i nga rgyal gyis bzlas pas kyang chog pa man ngag gi gnad dang 'brel ba yin zhes rig 'dzin thugs thig gi bsnyen yig tu gter chen gyis bshad/ lhun gyis grub pa'i chos nyid thob rnams gzhan las bya dka' zhes bya 'ga' yod min/ /182

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4phyag drug pa'i yum gyi sngags la yang / bh+yo nag mo bai ta li zhes rgyud las gsungs so/ /'o rkyal sgomabazlas/ bsrub bsgrilayus che bas mi chog /zo mar drodatshad gyi gong bu thon pa dgos/ rdo rje'i de nyid ni mi chod mi shigs mi phyed pa ste/ de dran nas li pi sha ta bzlas pas shin tu brtan par byed/ 'phags mchog gang du dmigs pa der sa bcu par lag na rdo rje stong phrag brgya rtag tu phyi bzhin 'brang bar gsung pa ltar gyi lag na rdo rje'i srung ma dang / rta mchog rig pa bye ba'i 'khor dang bcas pa sogs 'khor dag pa gzhal med rnams mi'i lus shig med na med du zad/ yod phan chad grib ma zhig nges par yod pa dang / ga bur zhig yod na dri bsung nges par yod pa ltar 'bral med du yod nges pa dmigs 'og tu chug dgos/ khong rigs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba red pa/'khor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal po dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi dang mi ldan pa zhig shes bya la mi srid pa des na rdo rje khro bo'i dmag dpung bye ba khrag khrig rang shugs kyis rjes su 'brang ba yin par shes par bya'o/ /pad+ma'i mi gos pa'i de nyid dang / chu 'damanas skyes shing chu 'dam na gnas pa'i de nyid gnyis rim bzhin don dam sems bskyed dang kun rdzob sems bskyed/ shes pa rnam dag dang / shes bya rnam dag /srid mtha' 'gog byed dang / zhi mtha' 'gog byed/183
