pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mngon mtho mthar thug dang nges legs mthar thug /rang don dam pa phunatshogs dang gzhan don dam pa/ thugs dbe+en pa'i bde mthong chos bde gnas sogs kyang bas gang zhing / sku 'du 'dzi'i khrod na yang spyod pa/ phyag stong spyan stong gi mdor/ gal te chos bzhin du bzlas brjod byas te sems can rnams la snying brtse ba'i sems bskyed par gyur na bdag kyang de'i tshe dge ba'i lha dang / klu'i rgyal po thams cad dang / lag na rdo rje gsang ba rnams la rtag par de'i rjes sa 'brang zhing yongs sa srang ba gyis shig /de'i nye dmi rig ༄༄ 'khor na gnas nas mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du yongs su srungs shig /rang gi srog gi dbang po bzhin du yongs su skyobs shig ces bsgo bar 'gyur ro/ /bdag gis gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang / /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sme brtsegs lcags kyu can/ stobs ldan shaṃ ka ra dang sde brgyad dag /btang nas rtag tu gzungs 'dzin srung bar byed/ /ces sogs mang du gsungs te/ ma ṇi zlos tshe lha klu mang pos srung tshul ka raṇ+ḍar gsungs pa dang 'dra'o / /de ltar srung ma rang 'khor ba'i dbang gis 'brog dgon sogs su gcig pur nyal yang gdon bgegs kyis gtse mi nus pa dang /mya ngam sogs su lam gol bar 'khyam yang / lha klu'i sprul pas lam ston pa dang / nags tshal stong pa sogs su me'am chus 184

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4 phongs na de dag sbyin par gsungs te/ dgra jag chom rkun 'ching ba dang / mthun pa'i yo byad gzhan 'du ba sogs mang por sbyor chog thugs ka'i ye sems rta mgrin du byas nas sngags 'khor bkod de/ rta skad kyis bde gshegs gsung gi dngos grub sdud pa la dmigs pa gtad nas bzlas na sngags kyi nus pa skye ba'i khyad che 'dra/ mdor na chos ni mi 'tshe ba'o/ /zhes rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyid rjes phye/ lha chen dmod pa grub pa sogs nas/ mgon khyod thugs rje grub pa las sogs lha dang drang srong dmod pa'i mtshon cha can rnams kyi dmod pa sa mi khyim 'bum phrag du mas gang ba'i grong chen ring por mi thogs par 'brog dgon stong par byas skad de rbab thur la btang ba lta bu 'jigs rung gi dper byed/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs bskyed pa re res sam 'od zer re res stong gsum brjod med brjod med tshad med gzhal med kyi rdul snyed kyi 'gro ba mngon mtho nges legs kyi bde ba bzang mang la 'jog pa red/ rbab gyen la 'then pa lta bu ste thur du rbab stong sgril ba bas/ gyen du pha bong gcig 'dren pa ches dka' bas ya mtshan dpe med/ mthu phyi ma 'di sa dang po'i yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis nas rim gyis nam son tshul sogs/ dang po rtsa ba tha ma 'bras mchog ldan/ /sogs dang / rnam snang mngon byang las/ snying rje'i rtsa ba can yin zhes/ /sgrub byed thugs rje goms 185

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/las de/ /zhes/ theg chen phyir mi ldog gi rtags kyang rang don yid byed bsdams pa'i steng nas bzhag yod/ mdzod 'grel dang rnam 'grel rang 'grel las sogs 'thad sgrub skor/ tshad chen 'grel par/ de 'dod pa'i phyir ro zhes sogs kyis gzhan don rang gi 'dod don yin lugs/ bdag gces 'dzin gyis phongs shing rang don phun tshogs mi 'byang ba bzlog na don gnyis 'byang lugs gnyis kyis snying rje r+sāsngag rabye charag ri sna zug ra༅ 1(1 zurag 15 chagaskyad nus dang / skyad dgas gnyas bstan/ dang na/ brtsa mad goms na der 'gyur ba ro sreg mkhan brtse bral dang / bram ze gtsang zhen sogs kyis bsgrub yod/ dgra gsod phrog la rang don du zhen pa la 'dod pa'i phyir ro zhes pa las sgrub byed gzhan med de'i rigs pas snying rje shin tu goms na zhes sogs kha bsgyur/gzhan phan dga' ba sogs slob spring dang / sems can rnams ni grol ba na sogs/ 'gro drug skyed tshul dus ston ltar/ /rang gi yon tan sems can phan 'dogs dga'/ thub pa'i skyes rabs thams cad bdag bas gzhan gces mdzad tshul kho nar gsungs/mthong ba'am grong khyer rgyu ba na/ long bas mig thob sogs/mtshan bzung ba tsam yang brgyad brgya pa sogs ltar/ ston pa dang shā ri'i bu'i snam sbyar steng phug ron babs pa/ ston pa dang kun dga' bos seṅge la reg pa/ rnam kun don yod ni/ sangs rgyas 186

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4rnams kyi g.yo ba ni sogs/ dge rtsa dang mtshungs ldan gyi nyon mongs brgyad/ brgya lnga bcu pa'i thugs rje la bstod pa/ gang phyir brtse nyid rgyal ba'i sogs/ snying rjes spyod pa rgyas/ spyod pas snying rje rgyas/ bsod nams dag gi rgyu mthun pa zhes snying rje'i spyod pa mtha' dag snying rje'i rgyur bsngos/ de pa thams cad chos kyi dbyings nas rdzu 'phrul dang chos ston sogs 'gro 'dul gyi mdzad pa la skul ba'i byed po gcig pu ni skye la thugs rje chen po yin pas/thal mo sbyar ba'i phyag la nges pa ster/ der ma zad bgrang nor gyi las phyag stong spyan stong mdor 'byung ba dang bgrang nor snying rje sbyar ba gnyis bsgrigs pa'ang 'di dang bstun na legs 'dra/ ci tsam btsal yang chos dbyings gting mtha' la/ /thug pa yod min de tshul ma lus par/ /mngon mdzad sor rtog ye shes mkhyen pa'ang de bzhin te/ /de yi dbang gis dbang dang mngon shes sogs/ /de yi byin rlabs mthu yang thug pa med/ /sor rtog ye shes sngags su byin brlab pa'i/ /sngags kyi byin rlabs mthu yang de nyid de/ /ci tsam sngags kyi dngos grub gter phyang yang / /de ༄la tshad dang mtha' ma dmigs mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin rgya che'i lam gyi rtogs pa yang / /so sor tshad med re re'i rno nus kyang / /thug pa yod med de kun gcig bsdom nas/ /sngags su shar ba'i nus 187

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mthu de ye shes/ /sgra gcan 'dzin chen po/ chung ba blo brtan/ ha ya li la/ ha ya gho ṣa/ nyi ma sbas pa/ thams cad mkhyen bshes/ka na ka shri/ kan+dha pa/ tā ra shri/ ṭhak+ki nag na pa/ man+dir pa la/shākya rak+ṣi ta/ lo ka pra dā pa/ ngag dbang grags pa/ dge bsnyen btsun pa/ dkon mchog gsum gyi 'bangs/ dze ta ri/ tsan+d+ra go mi/jo bo rje/ tu ruṣ+ka mang pos bkur ba/ seṅge lnga pa/ 'phags yul du kha sar+sha ṇi'i gtsug lag khang du sa the btsugs nas gang gsol 'grub par grags/ bod du de'i dod lnga ldan rang byon la jo bo rjes lha dngos red gsungs/ mnga' bdag nyang gis 'di'i zhabs 'og nas gter bzhes shing 'das dus gdung khang nas 'ja' zug//sangs gling la ma ṇi'i gsung byon/ spyan snga grags byang bas bskor ba mdzad pas dar lam brkyangs/ rje rin po ches smyung gnas mdzad pas sku che'i lung bstan brnyes/ zhang ston dar ma rgyal mtshan gyis/ chos yang dag par sdud par dpe gsum dang sbyar ba'i snying rje'i che ba gsangs/ de las bar bar byang sems kyi ༄dge chos kyi spyod pa phyin drug bsdu bzhi sogs dpung gi tshogs/snying rje'i 'khor lo de thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba dngos zin/'khor lo byung na dpung tshogs thams cad ma brtsal bar 'byung /'khor lo ma byung bar la gzhan mi mchi bas gcig yod na thams 188

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4cad shugs 'byung du 'ong ba ni 'khor lo kho na red pa de ltar snying rje chen po yod na spyod pa thams cad lhun grub tu 'byung / byang sems ni chos ngan pa la dmigs pa'i snying rje las go 'phang mchog grub/ nyan rang de las zlog /skye ba dpag tu med par lha mi yi/ /'jig rten kun gyi rnal 'byor dbang mdzad nas/ /zhes par bsam gtan gzugs med kyi mthar son pa'i snying rjes 'jig rten la dbang sgyur sogs/ snying rje chen po kho rang zhi mtha' 'gog byed/ snying rje'i rgyu yid 'ong dang sdug bsngal sems pa phyi ma la sdug bsngal brgya rtsa bcu sogs ji tsam bsam nas yid 'byung rgyas pa de tsam du snying rje 'phel ba/ srid mtha' 'gog byed/ skyon mthong phyir ni srid par min/ /zhes srid pa'i nyes dmigs rig pa ste/ mi rtag sdug bsngal sogs kyi rnam can/ rgya ma'i blo sbyong gi 'gro don rab thad na/ 'dod 'du la yid ma log pa la snying rje rnal ma gtan med gsungs te/ 'dod bde can bdud dang / sems bde can tshang sa pa lta bu man chad thams cad snying rje ba'i gnas su 'char ba la/ srid bde de thams cad sdug bsngal du mthong ba dgos/ des na snying rje'i rtsa ba'i rgyus srid mtha' khegs pas snying rje chen po goms pas srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis ka sel byas kyang rung bar go/ sems can rang ngos nas 189

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/grub na/ /ther zug chos ni mya ngan 'da' mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar red la/ rten cing 'brel 'byung sprul ba'i grong khyer lta bur mthong phul che na/ mya ngan zlo ba la mi 'jigs te/ re zhig sgyu ma mkhan po'ang skye bo'i mig khral khrul du sbrid par byed pa'i sgyu ma'i grong khyer mang la rgya che ba yang / rig sngags phyir brtul ba tsam gyis bsdu nus par shes nas phyir bsdu ba la mi zhum na/ 'gro ba dang skye gnas dang sdug bsngal gyi grong khyer tshad med pa thams cad ma rig pa'i 'khrul 'khor rgyas pa tsam du mthong zhing / rang nyid dag pa'i chos kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gtsang ma dam pa brnyes pas mtshan brgya nas bshad ltar gzhan rgyud kyang rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid du sbyong nus par gzigs nas mi 'jigs pa brnyes shing dgyes pa 'phel ba'i snying rje'i rtsal rdzogs pa'o/ /las nyon gyi rig sngags kyis sprul pa'i bden stong rten 'brel tsam du mthong bas/ sher phyin gyi rig sngags kyis las nyon gyi sgyu ma'i rig sngags de bcad cing brtul ba tsam gyis sdud par rig ste spro ba 'phel/ kun nyon rkyen byung gi chos thams cad rkyen dbang gis 'byung zhing / rkyen bshigs na nub pa kho na/ de'i rkyen de'ang glo bur ba kho nar rig nas mi 'jigs pa'o / /dmigs med snying rje ni yid bzhin nor ba ltar sems/ can gyi ༄190

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4re ba skong bar bsngags te/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyi yon tan nam byin gyi rlabs so/ /byang 'phags kyi dmigwas med snying rje ni gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i bslad pa can dang / sangs rgyas kyi ni bslad pa de med pas khyad par gnam sa tsam mo skye bo che chung gi khyad par ni/ sems rgya che chung ngam/ bsam pa rgya che chung gis 'byed de/ dbu ma snying por/ wa ni glang chen dregs khyu yi/ /sogs ltar/ rtog ge 'bar bar/ me khyer dang nyi ma'i dpe bstan pa sogs kyang de bzhin no/ /des na/ chos kyi dbyings na skyes bu gcig pu ba/ /zhes sogs 'byung ngo / /pad+ma'i kha dog dkar bas rang bzhin dag pa'i chos la gzigs pa'i sor rtog ye shes mtshon/ dmar bas srid par chags pa'i snying rje mtshon mod kyi phyi mas shin sbyang gi dga' bde 'dren pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dmar ba'ang ston lugs yod dam dpyad/ pad dkar can ni sku mdog dang hrīḥyang dkar/ sku mdog dmar po can ni phyag mtshan dang srog yig kyang dmar te de thams cad de nyid gcig pas so/ /byang sems kyi snying rje la brtse ba tsam gyis mi chog sems can grangs mang ba/ byed pa ngan pa/ sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho tshad med pa sogs gang gis kyang mi zlog cing mi 'jigs pa dang / sgyid lug pa med par shin tu dpa' ba'i snying rje stobs ldan rlabs che 191

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ ba blo gros rgya mtshos zhu sa par/ grong dpon pha ma gnyis kyi dpe gsungs pa lta bu/dgos la/ de la sdug bsngal 'bral 'dod kyis bskyab dgos su mthong ba tsam gyis mi chog /bskyab nus su mthong ba stobs ldan dgos/ de la dbang rnon gyis sems can skyob par khur 'khyer ba'i snying rje skye ba'i sngon 'gro/ yang dag shes tshol sngon btang ste sogs ltar dgos/ dbang rnon la 'bral 'dod kyi snying rje chen po skye ba la stong rtogs sngon 'gro mi dgos kyang / skyob 'dod kyi brtse chen mtshan nyid rdzogs pa la dgos zhes pa/ lung 'di'i/ 'gro don byed par dpa' gyar pa/ /zhes pa go rgyu che ste/ snying rje yod ༄kyang sngar bag dang bcas pa mang bas de las khyad skyob 'dod 'don no/ /des na sems can thams cad gshob gcig gi bden 'dzin 'khrul 'khor kho na la brten nas ma rig pa'i 'khrul 'khor rgyas pa tsam du shes nas/ sdug bsngal ba'i gnad shes nas gshob de'i mtshang brtol ba tsam zhig sems can dgrol ba'i gnad du mthong na zhum pa sogs mi skye bas sems can thams cad dgrol ba'i snying rje la dmigs med kyi snying rje bsngags/ de'ang snying rje dang bdag med rtogs pa rgyud na so sor yod tsam nyan rang la'ang yod pas/de gnyis sbyar nas phan tshun gcig gis gcig zin par/ bogs 'don res kyis dmigs phug ste rgya cher sbyang dgos/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi bdud rtsi gya nom pa de nyan rang gis nges 'byung 192

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4gi bsam pas zos na rang gi sdug bsngal gtan zhi ba tsam du 'gyur la/ rgyal sras kyis snying rje chen po'i blos zos nas 'khor bar bsngos na ni gzhan don gyi bya ba sgrub pa la yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu kho nar 'gyur te/ ke ta ka'i me tog glang po che gzhan gyis zos na lci ba dang / spos glang gis zos na gla rtsi lta bur 'gyur ba dang mtshungs/ stong rtogs kyis ma brgyan pa'i snying rje ni nor bu phal pa dang 'dra/ snying rje'i sbrul chen zab mo'i shes rab kyi nam mkha' lding gi lto ba'i mes legs par sbyang na gzhan skyob pa la nor bu tog gi blo gros lta bur 'gyar/ snying rje 'dzam bu'i 1111 //sde rami mi /bye/dzashing sag dang 'dra/ zab mo ༄ shes rab ma dros ma dang 'dra/de des bzung zhing ring du bzung na sgyu ma lta bu'i dbang 'byor gyi mthu phul byung 'dzam bu'i chu gser du 'ong ste snying rje de la chos kyi dbyings bsam mi khyab kyi byin rlabs zhugs pas so/ /'di ltar snying rje de chos dbyings rtogs pa'i 'byung khungs mchog nas byung ba'i yon tan yin pa'i phyir te/ don la chos dbyings rtogs pas shin tu zin pa'o/ /sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje sogs ni rdo'i nor bu ltar bzang yang 'od zer cang med/ dmigs med kyi brtse ba ni shes rab kyi snang ba 'bar bas 'jig rten snang nus/stong rtogs kyis zin na skyob nus su mthong ba lhag par ma zad/193

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/skyob dgos su mthong ba'ang khyad 'don te/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du lhag bsam dag pa'i sa zhes pa lta bu mthong nas so/ /bdag chags lhag pa'i skyon lnga de dag la/ /yod pa de dag de spong don du gsungs/ /zhes so/ /rtag pa dam pa'i lag rjes 'jog byed/ mya ngan 'das la mngon dga'i phyir zhes 'di skor mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po phyogs kyi gzhi shes kyi thad dang sgrigs dang legs po go 'ong / zhi bde dang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal kha thag ring bas nyan rang gi thugs la 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa 'char ba'ang dka'/ gong ma'i lugs la'ang / srid pa'i chos nyid stong nyid yin yang / stong nyid dang kun rdzob gnyis blo ngor rang bzhin ches bskal bas snying rje bral bas stong rtogs la chig dril byas na/ mthar stong dbyings su gnyid la g.yur ba lta bu dang / 'dus byas 'khor ba la blo gtan mi 'jug pa 'dra mo yong / stong pa nam bsgom la snying rje'i rtsi drag pos zin nges dang / stong nyid rtogs rim bzhin de snying rje'i grogs sa 'gro tshabs je che dang / snying rje yang stong pa'i grogs sa ri ring ri ringaje 'gror bslab pas/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus par/ shing sdong gcod pa'i dpe dang zhing la chu bkye ba'i dpe ltar/ stong nyid la zhugs tshabs che rung / snying rje'i shugs na re ba dang / snying rje'i dran pa nyams par yod pas/ stong nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa'i 194

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4dus nyid na 'khor ba blos ma dor bar yod phyir/ nam ldang ba na de ma rtogs pa la brtse ba'i snying rje'i steng du hril gyis 'ong / ring du song bar blo lhag pa'ang stong nyid snying rje sbrel ba'i lag rjes sogs/ nyan rang gi stong nyid rtogs pa'i lhag mthong ni sa skam ltar trag hrog yin/ byang sems kyi lhag mthong ni snying rje'i zil ba hril le ba red/ lar stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can dang /snying rje stong pa'i snying po can zer te/ de dag tsam min gyi/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi sbyin sogs spyod pa rgya chen po thams cad bya'o/ /sbyin pa'ang de gnyis kyi snying po can yin dus gzhan ci smos/ shin tu phra ba'i stong nyid la dmigs pa'i shes rab dang /ches rags pa'i srid pa'i sdug bsngal la dmigs pa'i snying rje gnyis zab pa dang gsal ba ste/ phan tshun gcig gis gcig rtsal 'byin cing rgyas par byed pa 'di ni rang sems la 'dod dgur dbang sgyur ba'i gnad chen po ste/ thod rgal gyi ting nge 'dzin yang gnad 'di las sla bar go/ sa thob nas smon lam chen po grangs med 'bum phrag bcu byang sems kyi bslab pa mtha' dag pa'i tshul khrims kyi gzhi blangs pa la rtsal shin tu 'byor bar gyur te/de 'dra ba'i kun tu bzang po'i smon lam thams cad pa'i rtsi'am/'du byed dam shugs drag pos/ rang bzhin dag pa'i de kho na 195

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nyid rtogs pa'i sher phyin gyi mnyam bzhag sems can thams cad dang thun mong du bsngos pa'am/ snying rjes sher phyin lus can ma lus pa'i thun mong gi spyad par bsngos tshul lam brlab tshul ni/ ma mtha' theg chen tshogs lam dus nas stong nyid la dmigs pa'i bsam byung nam sgom du de gzhan don kho na la dmigs nas sam gzhan don ched du bya bar bzhag nas sgom la/ de gong nas gong du nar son nas sa thob bar du mthu je cher 'gyur ba'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi nyer 'tshor byin gyis brlabs pa yin la/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis mnyam bzhag de la 'khor ba 'dzin byed dam mngon mtho sgrub byed thabs bsod nams kyi tshogs thams cad kyang nus pa mthu can du tshang ste/ de phar phyin drug ldan dang / sgrib gnyis spong ba'i nus ldan dang / longs sku'i 'khor du skye ba len pa'i rnam smin gyi rgyu sogs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na mnyam bzhag de ka 'khor ba las 'da' byed du ma zad/ 'khor bar gnas byed kyi rgyur yang 'gyur/ de bzhin du sher phyin nges bzung ba'i'am/ de snying por yod pa'i snying rje'ang 'khor bar gnas byed du ma zad/ 'khor ba'i nyes pa las 'da' byed du'ang 'gyur/byams snying rje 'jig rten gyi gtso bo'i go 'phang sgrub byed yin lugs thad/ rgyu byams pa'i dmigs rnam rgya che chung ltar/ 'bras bu rgyal srid rgya che chung du 'gyar tshul/ stong gsum byams pa'i ༄196

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4dmigs 'og tu chug na tshangs chen dang mi mjed bdag por skye ba sogs be bum sngon po ltar/ rgyud bla'i/ ji bzhin yang dag /skye sogs rnams las zhes pa ni khyad gzhi dkar ba dang / khyad chos mi gos pa/ snying rje'i bdag nyid/ 'chi dang rga dang / zhes pa 'dam las skyes dang 'dam na gnas pa'i de nyid/ de ni snying rjes 'jig rten sdug /de nyid kyis ni yun ring gnas/ /zhes so//lus mi gos pa nas/ ngag /yid/ spyod pa mi gos tshul mang /skye 'chi bar do'i nyes pa dang / snyigs ma lngas mi gos tshul sogs/rang bzhin dag par rtogs pa'i bar chad med lam/ des lag rjes bzhag pa'i rnam grol lam/ thag bsring gi gnyen po khyad par lam/ de'ang sa bcu'i rim pas gong nas gong du khyad zhugs pas khams gsum las shin tu 'das pa yin/ de ltar 'das pa dang khyad du 'phags pa don 'dra/ gong mas 'og ma zil gyis gnon pa dang / dbang bsgyur nus pa ni tshangs pas 'dod lha bzhin no/ /de ltar khams gsum las shin tu thag bsring ba'i dben pa mthar thug brnyes pa na/ dbang med du khams gsum na spyod pa'i cha thams cad lhag ma med par gtan log tu song ba yin cing / de nyid kyang bskal pa mtha' yas par goms nas ngang du gyur pa'i dmigs med kyi snying rje chen pos/ 'khor bar bsngos pas/ rang 197

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ dbang chen po thob pas dbang phyug ces bya/ spyan ras gzigs zhes pa la zab rgya che'i phyogs kyi bshad tshul gnyis yod pa bzhin du/ dbang phyug ces pa la'ang zab rgyas kyi phyogs nas bshad tshul gnyis yod la/ de'i nang nas rgya che'i phyogs ltar sbyor dus chos kyi dbyings dri ma med pa'i rgyal srid brnyes kyang / zhi bde des cung zad kyang mi 'phrog par mtha' dang dbus med pa'i 'khor ba'i gzugs bzung ste khams dbang mos pa tshad med pa'i sems can sna tshogs pa'i thabs kyis so so'i dus las skad cig kyang mi 'da' bar 'dul ba de yin 'dra/ de'i tshe smon lam dang dmigs med kyi snying rje yongs dag kho nas chu'i zla ba dang sgyu ma'i rgyal thabs lta bu'i gzags bzang ste/ sngon bskal pa grangs med mchog skur rir zurangagasum du sams can thams cad bdag gar bzung / bdag tu bzung ba'i gzhan gces 'dzin gyi nus pa rdzogs shing klong du gyur pa'i dbang gis mtha' yas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su gdul bya'i dkyil 'khor la dbang bsgyur ba'i 'jig rten dbang phyug ming don mthun par 'gyur ba yin no/ /'di ltar byas na khams gsum gyi dbang po'i lag rjes 'jog byed kyang shes rab/ ting nge 'dzin snying rje chen po gsum ka yin lugs dpyad sla/ sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya 'gyur gsar legs pa las/ dpal ldan yid 'ong po ṭa la/ /sna tshogs khams kyis rnam par spras/ /sna tshogs ljon pa 'khri zhing bkram/ /'dab chags du ma sgra 'byin pa/ /'bab chu sna tshogs lhung lhung sgrogs/ /ri dwags mang pos kun tu dkrig /me 198

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4tog sna tshogs rigs rnams kyis/ /kun tu dri yis bkang ba ste/ /sna tshogs yid 'ong 'bras bur ldan/ /rkang drug pa rnams glu sgra 'byin/ /mi'am ci rnams dbyangs snyan len/ /glang po myos pas rab tu gtams/ /grub pa rig 'dzin tshogs dang ni/ /dri za rnams kyis glu blangs pa/ /thub pa 'dod chags bral rnams kyis/ /rtag tu legs par bsten pa na/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs gzhan dang / /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams kyang ste/ /'phags ma sgrol sogs lha mo rnams/ /rig pa'i rgyal mo stong rnams dang / khro bo'i rgyal po'i tshogs gzhan dang / /rta mgrin la sogs kyis bskor ba'i/ /sems can kun la phan brtson pa/ /bcom ldan 'das ni spyan ras gzigs/ /bzhugs te de nas dpal dang ldan/ /pad+ma'i snying po'i gdan bzhugs pa'i/ /dka' thub chen po dang ldan pa/ /byams dang snying rje ldan pa yis/ /lha yi 'khor ni chen po la/ /de yi chos ni ston par bzhed/ /ces gsangs/ yang de ༄las/ skyob pa 'od dpag med pa yi/ /smon lam dbang gis byung ba ste/ /bdag gi ar+yapalo bka' yis 'jig rten ma/ /snying rje che dang ldan pa yis/ /'gro ba 'don par brtson pa mo/ /nyi ma shar ba dang 'dra ba/ /zla ba nya 'dra byad kyi 'od/ /lha dang lha min mir bcas pa/ /'di rnams sgrol zhing snang bar byed/ /'jig rten 199

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gsum po g.yo bar byed/ /gnod sbyin srin po 'jigs par byed/ /lha mo ut+pal sngon po'i phyag /ma 'jigs ma 'jigs zhes brjod ma/ /'gro ba yang dag bsrung don du/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis bdag bskyed pas/ /'brog dgon mtshon cha ltung ba dang / /sna tshogs 'jigs pa 'khrugs pa'i tshe/ /ming rnams dran pa nyid kyis ni/ /bdag gis rtag tu sems can srung / /sna tshogs 'jigs pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis bsgral/ /des na bdag la 'jig rten du/ /thub pa'i tshogs kyis sgrol mar sgrogs/ /zhes so/ /bzlas pa'i nges tshig ni dge ba la brtson pas rgyal bar 'gyur zhing yon tan rmad du byung bas bzlas pa ste/ rtse mo las/rmad byung chen po'i bzlas pa bya/ /ci yi phyir na bzlas par brjod//dge ba la brtson rgyal 'gyur zhing / /rmad byung rnams kyang mthong bar 'gyar/ /byang chub spyod pa rgyal 'gyar zhing / /sangs rgyas ste pa ra mi rtse(sngo /re/ ra mi/re/ zurag /de/ /re la pa ma ༄na par 'gyur/ / sa so/ / sa pa kun rag ka rnan las so/ /rnam snang mngon byang gi rgyud phyi mar spyan ras gzigs kyi rnal 'byor la gnas pas gtor ma sbyin par gsungs zhes kun rig ṭika chen las cha gsum 'grel thad du'o/ /'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug /nyag gcig dpa' ba/ 'jig rten ma lus pa la srung ba gcig pu mdzad pa/ zhes so/ /ji ltar snying rje 200

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4goms pa de ltar snying rje'i bye brag tu 'gyur/ snying rje'i srog tshul khrims kyis 'dzin te/ byang sdom gyi srog kyang so thar gyi sdom pa'i tshul khrims yin cing / de'i srog kyang gzhan la mi 'tshe ba'i brtul zhugs red pas tshul khrims ldan (na)ngang gis snying rje dang mthun pa'i rgyud bzang por 'gyur/ sdug bsngal brgya rtsa bcu sogs dmigs pa mang zhing rgya che ba/ sbyong tshul rgyu 'bras bdun ma dang mnyam brje sogs mang ngo / /snying rje'i rnal 'byor rgyun mi 'chad pa'i 'phen smon dang rgyu mthun gyis skye ba dpag med dang bskal pa tshad med par sbyang ba/ 'grus par ram bsgrims te'am sems thams cad kyis bslab pa bar ma chad par sbyang ba/ bzod pa'i sgo nas log sgrub sogs kyis mi 'phrog pa'i rtsal thon pa ste byang ba/ bsam gtan gyi sems rten la snying rje sbyang ba/ shes rab kyi stobs kyis dmigs med kyi snying rjer byas pa/ snying rje dang sbyin sogs la gang bslab snying rje chen po brgyud pa'i ched du bsngo ba/ snying rje 'phel brtan sogs phyir sangs rgyas grangs med mchod pa sogs sgo tshad med nas snying rje'i shugs rgyas pa red/ci tsam du snying rje lhag pa de ltar gzhan phan gyi dga' ba lhag par 'gyur ba ni/ dmigs yul gyi sems can ci tsam phongs shing rgud pas nyen pa de ltar de la dmigs pa'i snying rje lhag par 'gyur la/201

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/de ci tsam lhag pa'i tshod tsam du de dag bskyab pa las byung ba'i dga' ba lhag ste/ bu la tsher ma zug pa dang / bu rgyal po gdug pa'i khrims mun du chud pa gnyis ma la sems khral skye tshul mi 'dra/de'i dbang gis snga ma thon pa dang / phyi ma las thar ba'ang dga' ba che chung phyogs mi 'dra ba lta bu'o/ /'phags mchog dmyal bar mang du 'byon pa'ang der 'byon pa la dgyes nas yin gyi/ mi dgyes bzhin min la/ de'ang dmyal ba na chen po'i 'byor ba bla med yod pa'i dbang gis te/ chen po'i 'byor pa ni/ chen po ni 'khri shing las/ zla ba'i kun dga' nyi ma'i rab gsal dang / /sogs dang / slob spring du/ rang don 'gal med chen po rnams kyi rang bzhin de 'dra ste/ /zhes dang / dbu ma snying po'i le'u dang por/ rigs ngan dang rgyal po chen po'i dpes bshad pa ltar yin cing / de'i 'byor ba ni sems can yongs su smin pa'i gzhan phan gyi dga' ba'o/ /de'i phyir 'khor sgyur lha'i skyed tshal du 'jug pa lta bur za ma tog las gsungs/ gzhan phan gyi dga' ba ci tsam yod pa gsal bar phongs pa la rang srog dang rgyal srid chen po byin tshe rten gyi dga' ba phal byang gi tshod tsam yal la med rigami rabye rirabapar mdo rgyan las dang / 'jug par/ ji ltar byin cig ces sgra sogs kyi 'gres sbyar na sla/ de 'dra'i gzhan phan gyi bde ba ni 202

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4 gzhan 'phrul 'dod bde dang tshangs pa'i bsam gtan bde ba dang nyan rang gi zhi ba'i bde ba gang gis kyang mi mtshon par/slob spring gi/ gzhan phan dga' ba rnams kyi sogs dang / spyod 'jug gi/ sems can rnams ni grol ba na/ /sogs ltar ro/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i mtshan don thad/ rang bzhin dag pa'i chos la gzigs pa la dbang thob pa'am dbang sgyur brnyes pa'i don ni/ snying rje shin tu shugs drag stobs ldan gyi rtsi'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi ting 'a dzin phul byung gi mthus bsam gtan rnams bzlog nas 'dod khams su 'gro ba lnga'i gzugs sna tshogs su skye ba ston pa dang / rang bzhin dag pa'i chos la dmigs pa'i ting 'dzin goms pas 'gog pa thob pa zhes bskal ba la sogs par rang bzhin dag pa'i dbyings las mi ldang ba'i mthu yun ring mo nas thob kyang / sa bdun par blo lhag stobs kyis zhi mtha' 'gog pa'i nus pa thob cing / sa dgu par zhi mtha'i 'jigs pa dang bral nas yun ring lon pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas zag med kyi dbyings su mi lhung bar 'khor bar gzugs sna tshogs 'dzin pa ste/mdor na rang bzhin dag pa'i dbyings la gzigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin rtsal rdzogs kyang rnal 'byor pa ting nge 'dzin gyi gzhan 203

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dbang du phar mi 'chor bar/ ting nge 'dzin de rnal 'byor pa'i rang dbang du tshur 'dus nas gang 'dod byar yod pa ste/ 'di ko sa la'i rgyan la brten nas bshad do/ /pad gling gter byon g.yu sgron ma'i sgrub thabs dang pra sgrub na/ bdag bskyed thugs rje chen po'i byed par bshad de/ pra sgrub la bdag bskyed de ltar bsngags pa ni/ pra sngags la chu bur mig gi sgo sol/ zhes med par sngags 'bru drug dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi mo ston zhes 'byung ba ltar spyan ras gzigs mig 'byed dam spyan 'byed kyi lhar bsngags pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin par mngon/ yo ga las mngon shes kyi lhar bsngags pa ting nge 'dzin gyi lhar sems dpa' bcu drug 'byang ba'i thad nas gsungs pa lta bu'i gnad kyis yin ༄te/ de'i steng nas kyang rno mthong mngon shes rigs spyi la bsngags par rtogs nus pa 'dra ste/ gsang ba thams cad kyi spyi'i cho ga dkyil chog rdor phreng dang sngags rim las kyang spyan ras gzigs la brten nas rmi lam brtags pa gsungs so/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgra'i zur phyi ma 'dir 'di nges na bris pa 'di'i rigs pa sbyar na/ srib ngo 'dir 'a khod 'di ni stong rtogs sor rtog ye shes la sbyar ba ste/ des dpags nas snying rje la sbyar na/'khor ba pa rnams la snying rje'i 'dzum mig rtag tu chags pas 204

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4'khor bar skye ba 'dzin kyang mi dmigs pa'i shes rab kyis shin tu zin pa'am dmigs med kyi snying rje yin phyir rang dbang brnyes pas ci 'dod du 'khor ba na gzugs 'dzin par zad kyi/ 'on te snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgom pas kyang / /sogs ltar dbang med du skye ba sogs min gyi/ snying rjes 'khor ba 'dzin bzhin du dag pa'i chos dbyings su 'dod dgur spyod nus pa'o/ /sor rtog dang sbyor tshe kun snying dang shākya mi tra cung mi 'dra'am dpyod/ grub chen mi tra ltar na/ yo ga dang bstun tshe ma ṇi rang bzhin dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang / pad+me gzugs sna tshogs la sbyar nas zab rgyas kyi mdo sde bsdus par bshad lo/ bka' 'bum na pad+me shes rab dang / mi tras pad+me thabs la sbyar mod/ gnyis ka phyag mtshan bzhin du bya rgyu yin te/ ma ṇi pad+me zhes pa'ang nor bu pad+ma can zhes par bshad pas nor pad 'dzin pa zhes pa'am phyag na nor pad zhes par 'gyur bas so/ /gur 'grel dang bstun tshe phyag mtshan la mi byed pa 'dra/ des na gur 'grel na ma ṇi pad+me gnyis ka sor rtog la sbyar yang / bka' 'bum na ma ṇi ste bgrang nor snying rjer sbyar ba 'gros tha dad red dam brtags/ yang na mi tra'i bshad tshul yang phyag mtshan la sbyor mi dgos sam ste/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtshos ye zhes pa can la ma bshad par 'bod pa la 205

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bshad pa lta bu/ gal te mi tra dang bka' 'bum bstun rgyu byed na/kri yog gi pad+ma'i bshad lugs mi 'dra ste/ bya spyod du pad+ma dkar po mdzad nas pad+ma snying rje dang / de'i kha dog dkar po rang bzhin dag pa mkhyen pa'i sor rtog ye shes la sbyar/ yo gar pad+ma dmar po mdzad nas pad+ma chos kyi ting 'dzin nam rang bzhin dag pa'i ting 'dzin dang / dmar ba snying rje la sbyar/ de bzhin du pad dkar kho na'ang khyad gzhi'am rten gzhi'i steng nas bshad tshe mi tra ltar dang / khyad chos sam rten chos kyi ngos nas bshad na bka' 'bum ltar 'gyur/ ma ṇi bgrang nor du byed tshe'ang /yid skyob kyi cha nas rang rgyud ldan skyob tshe mi tra ltar/ gzhan rgyud skyob pare sbyar tshe bka' 'bum ltar/ 'di thams cad dpyad gzhir bkod/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin thobabyupa rnams kyi lus ni theg pa chen po'i dam pa'i chos kyi rang bzhin gyi lus yin phyir/ gom pa 'degs 'jog /lag pa brkyang bskum/dbugs 'byung rngub/ sems sems byung / sems bskyed pa'i skad cig thams cad pha rol phyin drug dang ldan pa kho nar 'byung ste/spos kyi rigs 'bum phrag sbyar ba'i phyi ma'am lde gu la spos sna gzhan dang ma 'dres ma bsgos pa'i spos rdul cig len rgyu med pa lta bur mdo las gsungs/ yig drug phyin drug gi ngo bo nyid yin 206

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4cing / lha sngags ye shes dbyer med pas spyan ras gzigs kyi gsang gsum gyi cha phra mo la'ang yig drug 'dus pa'i rang bzhin ma yin pa med la/ yig drug gi yig 'bru re re'i thog mtha' dbus kyi cha phra mo re yang rje btsun gyi thugs rgyud kyi phyin drug kun 'dus kyi rang bzhin min pa yong ye med par shes par bya'o/ /g.yas pa'i phreng ba snying rje/ g.yon pa'i pad+ma shes rab lta bu mi zer bar/phreng bas stong nyid snying rjes grangs med pa'i sems can yang yang skyob pa'i yon tan dang / pad+mas stong nyid snying rje'i mi gos pa'i yon tan mtshon te/ mdor na stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor gyis gzhan yid skyob pa dang / rang rgyud mi gos pa'i yon tan so sor ston nam bya'am dpyad/ 'og bris 'di'i dag ther/ gleng gzhi ni/ spyir bod dang bod chen gyi yul yang mi mjed kyi zhing gi khongs su thab pas bzang ba smos mi dgos kyang //rdo pe riri mirwarngoXsna ri'i mi /༷bye(nang gses su rgyal sras —na sa so so bzhugs gnas rkyang ba khyad par du ma yod pa las/ bod 'dre srin gdug pa'i yul 'di snga nas rje 'dis rang gi bzhugs gnas dang gdul zhing du thugs rje dang smon lam gyis bzung zhing byin gyis brlabs nas/ kho bo la sogs 'og bris ltar ro/ /des na bde ba can du skyes tshad 'od dpag med la 'brel ba che ba kho na yin par dpogs nus pa ltar 207

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bstan pa 'di la mi mjed du skyes tshad shākya'i rgyal pos sngon bsdu bzhi'i spyod pa'i cha shas kyis zin pa re yin dgos te/ de'i zhing yin pa'i phyir/ de las kyang bod du skyes tshad spyan ras gzigs la lhag par las 'brel che ba kho na yin par bstan pa 'dir bod du skyes pa'i rtags kyis dpogs nus/ des na 'di thams cad kyi rtsa bar ston pas bod 'di 'phags pa 'di la gtad cing lung bstan pa de grub na des 'thus la/ de ni chos rgyal bka' 'bum dang / bka' chems ka khol ma sogs kyis 'grub cing / phyag rdor dbang bskur gyi/ byang phyogs su ni byang chub sems dpa' lag na pad+ma 'grub bo/ /zhes pa'ang de ltar ro/ /bod 'di shākya'i rgyal po'i zhing gi cha shas su 'dod dgos la/ zhing gcig na ston pa gcig tu zad pas spyan ras gzigs kyi zhing du ji ltar rung zhe na/ gling bzhi yongs rdzogs 'khor sgyur gcig gi mnga' 'og yin yang / nang gses su khams kyi rgyal po brgyad khri sogs la so sor dbang ba'i yul 'khor ris su bcad pa re yod pa mi 'gal ba lta ba ste/ rje btsan 'di 'og min du sangs rgyas zin dang / bde ba ra༄mi rigamican na rgyal tshab gcig pu yin yang zhing 'dir mdzad pa bstan tshul la bsam dgos/ ma ṇi ni nor bu ste/ rtog pa med pa dang /dgos 'dod sbyin pa gnyis kyi gzhi mthun ltar/ spros pa'i rtog 208

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4pa med pa dang / gzhan don gyi phrin las rtag khyab tu 'byung ba'i gzhi mthun te/ de 'dra stong rtogs kyi shes rab rkyang pa goms pa la med kyi/ stong rtogs de snying rje'i snying po can du byas nas mthar phyin pa kho na las so/ /des na ma ṇi zhes pas stong rtogs kyi shes rab ba stan pa tsam min te/ de la dgos 'doda'abyung ba'i don ma tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /des na shes rab de snying rje'i snying po can dang / shes rab de nyid kyis srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis sel tshal lam/ don gnyis phun tshogs ster tshal ston pa'i tshig nus niri rgya riri byachen po dang / ston tshul khyad par can yin pas 'jam zhud ma byed/ de'i 'gros kyis/ pad+ma yang chu las skyes shing chu'i dpal du gyur pa dang snying rje de phul du byung ba'i yon tan gyi lang tsho 'jig rten sdud pas 'khor ba'i gnas la mdzes pa skyed cing nyam dga' dga' ltar byed pas/ yon tan ni gzhan la phan 'dogs pa'i yon tan no/ /chu'i nyes pa nya lcibs dang 'dam gyi skya dri sogs kyis ma gos shing dkar mdangs dri med nyis tshogs kyi steng nas snying rje stong nyid kyi snying po can zhes dmigs med kyi snying rje 'chad tshul shes sla/ 'phags pas pad+ma dam pa la ma ṇi byin pa'i tshe gling bzhi lha gnas dang bcas pa shing chu skyes kyi 'dab ma bzhin du 'gul/ rgya mtsho bzhi yang 'khrugs/ bgegs dang bar chad byad pa thams cad kyang skrag cing bros par gsungs 209

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/te/ phyag stong spyan stong gi mdor/ rig sngags 'dis ni ri rnams 'joms shing rgya mtsho chen po skem par byed do/ /lha ma yin gyi dmag rnams rnam par bcom nas pham par byed do/ /yul 'khor rnams dang / grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal rnams yongs su srung bar byed do/ /'dre gdon dang / nad dang / sman gyi dug dang / srin bu'i dug dang / log pa dang / ma rungs pa'i mi rnams pham zhing rab tu zhi bar byed do/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams btul nas rab tu dul bar byed do/ /zhes gsungs pa dang 'dra'o/ /za ma tog gi gong 'og gnyis tsam na/ phyag brgya stong pa/ spyan bye ba brgya stong pa/ dbu bcu gcig pa zhes 'byung zhing / don yod pa'i zhags pa ston pa/ zhes 'byung ba 'phags pa yi ge drug pa la bsngags pa'i skabs yin pas/ yig drug nyid bcu gcig zhal dang don zhags kyi sngags su yang 'gyur bar shes nus sam dpyod/yang gshin rje'i rgyal pos bstod par/ nad las yongs su thar bar mdzad pa/ zhes pas nad zhi'i sngags su 'grub bam snyam pa'ang de bzhin no/ /yang phyag stong spyan stong las/ zas skom dug can gyis ni gsod pa'i tshe/ /rtse gcig thags rje chen po'i ༄gzungs bzlas na/ /dug nyid zil mngar zas skom nyid du 'gyur/ /210

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4zhes so/ /kun snying gi 'gro 'dul 'grel par/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa bdag yin no zhes bsgom la nang gi bdag nyid can gyi khrus byas te/ snying po byang chub la thug gi bar du dngos por 'dzin pa'i mngon par zhen pa mi bya'o/ /zhes so/ /'di dang a ba ta ra'i/ dpa' bo'i rang bzhin gyi nga rgyal bya sogs bsgrig tshe pad+ma dkar po'i kha dog gi de nyid kyis bgegs dang nyams grib sogs sel tshul shes/ rdo rje chos ni glur blang bas//zhes bya ba ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo'i sems dang sems las byung ba dang pad+ma'i rigs ni rdo rje chos so/ /de glur blang ba ni chos thams can ni rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'o/ /zhes so sor rtog pa ste/ de'ang gsal ba'i dbye bas rnam pa sna tshogs so sor rtog pa yin te/ de bas na glur blangs pa zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes de nyid snang ba las so/ /lo rgyus thad/ bod 'dir phan bde'i snang ba rgya cher 'char ba'i gleng gzhi gtso che shos ni/ phyogs 'di'i 'gro ba rnams 'phags pa la las kyi 'brel ba lhag par che zhing / 'phags pa nyid kyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang dang / ston pas kyang yul 'di rje btsan 'di'i gdul zhing du byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthas so/ /ri rib riri casmon lam ni/ gangs ri'i ljongs de snying rje'i bsil 'od dang rjes 211

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sa mthan pas bdag gi zhing du dang / der kho bo la las smon gyi no༅ ༄'brel ba can rnams shas cher 'byung bar dang / bdag gi mthus de na thams cad kyang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo smra bar gyur cig sogs yin te/ bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi smon lam gyi rigs pa sbyar ba'o/ /'phags pa'i rnam thar ni mdo sde bzhi dang mdo sde du ma'i gleng gzhi sogs nas rgyas par 'byung la/ sngags dang dkyil 'khor dang bsam gtan dang phrin las la sogs pa'i sgo nas rgyud sde bzhi ka las yang yang gsungs/ 'phags ma sgrol ma dkar sngo dang / gos dkar mo/ lo gyon ma/ rma bya chen mo sogs mgon po 'di'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sku'i cha shas las byung bar gsungs la/dpal na ga dzu nas kyang de dag gi nang tshan rma bya chen mo'i rig sngags la brten nas klu'i 'jig rten du 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing /rgyal ba'i yum rgyas pa sogs mi yul du spyan drangs par grags te/'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ rig pa rma bya chen mo ni/ /bdag nyid chen po des kyang 'grub/ /ces gsungs pa dang mthun te/ klu sgrub kyis lha 'di grub la tshad bzung med kyang / 'jig rten yongs grags la smos ma thag pa'i mdzad pa 'di kho na grags che bar ma zad klu sgrub ces pa'i mtshan yang de'i sgo nas gsol ba yin cing / mdzad pa de rma bya chen po'i rig sngags kyi sgo nas 212

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4mdzad ces byas na thugs dam lha'i nang nas de kho na smos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang bshad bde ba 'dra/ der ma zad bshad bya sher phyin gyi mdo sde spyan drangs/ 'chad byed dbu ma rtsa ba mdzad nas de'i mtshan la'ang sher mdo las shes rab ces btags te/ 'di gnyis shing rta'i srol 'byed kyi dang por 'jog byed dang / theg chen gyi bstan pa la bka' drin che bar byed pa'i sgo che shos so/ /gzhan yang ye shes snying po/ tsan+d+ra go mi/ tsar+sha ti pa/ sgra mkhan pa ṇi/ bram ze mo rab gsal ngang tshul/ bram ze mchog sred/ bram ze ba su ne tra/ dge slong ma dpal mo/ tshong dpon gyi bu su kha de ba khyo shug khaṅga pa/ ka ma la go mi/ dge bsnyen zhi ba'i go cha/badz+ra de ba/ dpal ldan mar me mdzad ye shes/ grub chen dpe med 'tsho/ mi tra dzo ki/ rnam rgyal grags pa'i lha/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ sangs rgyas zhi ba sogs 'phags pa'i rig sngags grub pa'i gtam rgyud mang / lho phyogs dpal gyi rir klu sgrub kyi sku gdung gi rdzu 'phrul gyis rdo la byon pa'i 'phags pa gtso 'khor lnga pa/o ṭi bi shar rdo rje dril ba pas rdzu 'phral gyis spyan drangs pa'i rdo sku/dbyi ra༅shar phyogs kha sar pa ṇi'i lha khang sogs/ mi dbang gau sā la ni kha sar pa ṇi'i gtsug lag khang du phyin nas gsol ba btab pas rgyal srid thob ba'o/ /gter ston chen po phal cher gyi thugs dam gyi 213

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mthil yang 'di la mdzad de/ nyang / chos dbang / sangs gling /gter bdag gling pa sogs kyi lo rgyus kyis shes/ phyi ma 'di'ang bde gshegs kun 'dus su/ pad+ma dbang gi snying khrag gter sgo 'byed/ /ces dang / 'gyur med rdo rje pad+ma'i rigasaḥ zhes so/ /klong snying gi dang por yang thags rje chen po'i skor byang tshal ḍa rig mi skur racing ki'i gsang gtam ltar/ der/ thugs rje chen po'i zhal mthong zhing / /zhes pa ltar/ bod gangs can gyi lha gcig snying rje'i gter/ /sogs dang / gsol 'debs zhal gzigs mar/'phags pas rjes su bzung ba'i rtagasaḥ sogs/ yi ge phyed bzhi pa dang / kha sar pa ṇi'i yig bzhi dang / bya rgyud du dzi dzi dzi rna sogs dang / don zhags dang bcu gcig zhal gyi gzungs ring sogs/ 'phags pa'i rig sngags mtha' yas kyang / byis pa brda mi 'phrod pa la yang / bslab mi dgos par rang shes su 'ong ba'i sgo nas skyob pa 'jig rten dbang phyug mi mchog dman med pa'i snying dang kha'i sgor rig sngags kyi gzugs kyis bzhugs nas byin gyis rlobs pa'i rtags mi 'khrul ba ma ṇi 'di la mngon sum du grub pa 'dra ba gang yang mi snang ste/ de ltar sngags 'di ni bod la rang bzhin gyis grub par shin tu gsal ba yin zhing / bod spyi'i chos skal gcig pu zla med cing / gcig chog yid bzhin nor 214

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4ba'i gter yin par shes/ zla med pa zhes pa 'di la myang rgyu zhim ༄po yod/ bka' gdams brgyud pa na yang / thugs rje chen po'i grub thob/ yol chos dbang / jog sgom yon tan rgyal po/ chag khri mchog sogs jo bo'i dngos slob dang / slad nas rgyal sras rin po che thogs med bzang po dpal sogs smyung gnas brgyud pa nyi phug pa man chad thams cad dang thig le bcu drug gi brgyud pa'i bla ma sogs bzang mang byon/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan gyis kyang ma ṇi dung phyur gnyis gsungs/ lha 'di'i rigs kyi zhi drag gi lha gzhan rnams kyang mkhyen brtse nus gsum las shas cher brtse ba'i rigs kyi lha yin stabs gzhan las byin rlabs myur ba sha stag ste/ sgrol ma dkar mo/ ljang mo/ rta mgrin/dzam dkar/ mgon po myur mdzad sogs so zhes kong sprul rin po ches gsung / rigs gsum byed dus/ brtse ba'i rigs la nus pa'i rigs kyi dngos grub tshang ba chos dmigs kyi snying rje la sems can la dmigs pa tshang yang gsum du phye ba'i sems can la dmigs pa min pa lta bu/ bla med du'ang las rigs pad+ma'i rigs su 'du gsungs/ bod 'dir phrin las che ba'i 'phags pa'i gdams pa ni/ dpal mo lugs kyi smyung gnas/ jo bo'i yi ge drug pa/ srong btsan bka' 'bum rnams yin snang / phyi ma 215

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'di grub thob dngos grub nas rog bde gshegs chen po shes rab 'od dang / mnga' bdag nyang gnyis la bka' babs shing / grub mtha' thams cad la dar/ chos dbang yang snying 'dus pa'ang phrin las tshad med/ gzhan yang dam pa dmar po ba ri lco/gnyan tshem bu pa mtshan dar ma 'od zer te/ 'di la 'phags pa nyid kyis yi ge drug pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi dmar khrid gnang ba zab par grags shing dam pa du mas thugs dam mdzad/ sogs nas brgyud pa mang / de 'dra rnams rab byung dang sngags pa rnams la dar che ba red/mi nag tsho la'ang ris med du khyab pa ni/ 'bru drug chig rkyang de'o/ /lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs su/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po rtog pa'i sngags kyi rgyal po yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'di mtshan ma med pa'i sbyor bas blta zhing bzlas pa bya'o/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes sogs rgya gzhung rnams las yig drug kho na 'byung yang / gter phyogs su yig bdun mang la/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang byang gter las/ phyi ni srog sbas zhi ba'i tshulaḥ yi ge drug pa rdo rje'i sgraḥ zhes pa nas/ gsang ba srog gi mtha' rten canaḥsnyigs ma'i dus sa srog mthar rten0 zhes gsangs te/ spyir yig ridami dzorwa ridami drug rang yang thugs srog skul ba'i sngags las ma 'das mod /'on kyang gnyis ka skul byed yig drug dang / bskul bya srog yig /dngos su 216

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4sbrel nas bzlas na thugs rje gnad nas skul ba la lhag par rno bas/sngags 'grub par dka' ba'i dus su 'di gtso bor gzung zhes pa yin nam dpyad/ rdo rje snying po rgyan las sogs/ 'phags yul paṇa chen tshos kyang byang sems chen po'i nang nas spyod pa rmad byung 'bur cha thon par bsngags te/ bshes spring dang spyod 'jug gsang ba grub par sngags kyi lha'i nang nas kyang 'bur dod du gsungs shing bsngags/ lha gzhan gyi bstod par yang bsngags te'am gzhan la bstod pa'i sgo nas kyang 'di la ste/ thams cad mkhyen bshes kyis/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug zhabs mthil bkra shis kyi/ sogs dang / bram ze phur bus/ spyan ras gzigs dbang sogs dang / nyi ma sbas pa'i phyag 'tshal dang po'i 'grel pa/ de nas rgya gar du grub brnyes byung rabs/ bshes spring gi don/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bdag nyid che bas khams gsum gyi dbang po brnyes nas 'gro ba nyam thag rnams kyi mgon mdzad pa'i sgo nas byang sems gzhan las 'bur dod du bsngags par snang / spyod 'jug tu/ thugs rje'i spyod pa ma 'khrul pa/ /zhes phal byang ma ltar/ thabs mkhas pa'i snying rje chen po'i ༄ ༄sgo nas byang sems kyi spyod pa 'khrul pa ste/ dri ma'i nag nog cung zad kyang med pa/ de'i tshul cung rgyas pa ni/ de bas ji ltar/217

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yang na thugs rje'i spyod pa ni/ rin chen phreng bar/ rang gi don la mi lta bar/ /sogs ltar gzhan phan gyi spyod pa red la/ de ma 'khrul pa ni rang don yid byed sogs kyi dri ma med pa chang nga na/༄ ༄sogs byis pa rnams ci byed rang bde 'dod pa phugs bcug las mi 'da' zhing / rang 'dod la bar gseng mi 'chor ba ltar/ de go bzlog pa'i steng nas bsngags te/ 'khor gyi 'jigs pa'ang bsal ba'i phyir/ /zhes sdong po bkod pa'i lung dang sbyar bar mdzad/ 'di'ang bshes spring gi/ 'gro ba nyam thag mang po rjes bzung ste/ /zhes pa'i rgyas bshad lta bur 'gyur/ de ltar bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i sgo nas bsngags pa 'dis/ de ltar rgyud ni goms gyur pas/ /sogs ltar lhar bcas 'jig rten nyan rang man chad dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gzhan phan gyi bde ba'i 'byor pa rgya che la gya nom pa mi 'phrog pa'i sgo nas bsngags par yang 'gro ste/ lha dbang dang 'khor sgyur la 'dod yon gyi dpal 'byor dang /tshangs pa la bsam gtan gyi dga' bas bsngags pa sogs ni/'di dang gshib na nyi ma'i drung na me khyer dang / 'dzam gser dang ra gan bzhin no/ /mdo rgyan du/ rgyan dang ston mo sa mchog rtse dga' ba/ sogs dang gcig red/ bod 'bangs spre'u dang brag srin las chad zer te/ der sgrol ma'i sprul pa'i brag srin mo 218

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4zhes grags pa ltar na/ rang re tsho'i rigs rgyud kyi dang po nas 'phags mas byin gyis brlabs par mngon/ de nas dam pa'i chos kyi srol 'dzugs pa'i thog mar lha cig kong jor mdzad de jo bo rin po che bod yul gyi lte bar spyan drangs nas sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs/ btsan po khri srong gis bsam yas bzhengs dus kyang slob dpon chen pos tā re'i lha khang ma bzhengs bar du gtsug lag khang bzhengs su mi btub gsungs te ar+ya pa lo'i gling sngon la brtsigs/ slob dpon chen po'i bka' brgyud gtso bor gyur pa'i bod 'bangs la bka' drin 'gran zla bral ba jo mo mtsho rgyal yang sgrol ma'i sku'i rnam 'gyur kho nar rad gling dang rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling ba dang lnga ba chen po'i gdams ngag skor nas gsungs/ phyis su glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs te lo chen rin bzang sogs kyis kyang sor chud par gso ma nus pa'i skabs su dpal ldan mar me mdzad ye shes sgrol ma'i lung gis bskul nas byon te rgyal bstan nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad/ 'di'i dngos slob la nag tsho lo tsā ba dang / rngog gsang phu ba/ ka ba shākya dbang phyug /glo bo'i yul gyi ston pa yang rab/ gung thang gi sgom chen gzhon nu tshul khrims/ zhang btsun dri med/ btsun pa dge ba skyong /rnal 'byor pa khri mchog sogs sgrol ma'i zhal mthong gi grub thob 219

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mang du byung / rnal 'byor pa khri mchog chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa dang / kha rag sgom chung gis srog chags grangs med pa ri me shor bas 'tshig tu nye ba gzigs nas sgrol ma la bos shing me nang du mchong bas chus btab ltar zhi ba dang / sa skya bdag chen bzang po dpal la gdung rgyud kyi mchog bstsal ba dang /rong pa sga lo'i sras dang nye gnas khri mon nas bton pa dang /gnyan lo rgya gar du dug sbrul las bskyabs pa dang / 'bri gung spyan snga'i nye gnas hor mi chen gyi chad pa las bskyabs pa dang /steng ba lo tsā/ chag dgra bcom/ zhwa dmar rtogs ldan grags pa seng ge sogs tshad nad las dang / bla ma rin ye ba chu'i 'jigs pa las dang / rta pa bdun chus khyer ba rgyal sras chos rdzongs pas sgrol ma la gsol 'debs mdzad pas bde bar bskyabs pa sogs sngon dang da ltar byung ba grangs med/ spyan snga ba'i slob ma dge bshes sgre pas sne'u zar ba la bdag gis mi g.yo ba'i yig bcu ༄bzlas pas mi g.yo ba'i zhal mthong ste/ de'i tshe sngon la sgrol ma mthong ba zhig byung ba ci yin zhus pas/ yi dam gyi lha gang gi zhal mthong yang sngon la las kyi lha mo yin pas sgrol ma mthong ba chos nyid yin gsung / zhang ston dgra 'jigs kyis kyang sman bla dang 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal mjal tshe thog mar sgrol ma zhal 220

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4gzigs gsung / chos rgyal 'phags pa rin po cher gzhan gyis sngags kyi lha'i nang na 'grub thag nye shos gang yin dris pa'i lan du/gsang sngags phyi nang thun mong gi lha'i nang na 'phags ma sgrol ma dang / thun min la bde mchog nye zhing myur bar 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gsungs par bshad/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du/ 'di ni 'bad med grub pa ste/ /zhes so/ /thub bstan rgyas pa'i ched du gnas brtan bcu drug mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa bsngags mod kyi/ theg chen gyi bstan pa rgyas pa dang bstan 'dzin la bar chad med cing phrin las gong 'phel du byed pa la de bas kyang sgrol ma la gsol ba btab na tshan che ste/ bod kyi paṇ+ḍi ta gcig la sku tshe brgyud mar phrin las che ba/ rje dge 'dun grub kyis gtsang du chos gzhi btsugs pa na sku rim rgyab chog sna kha mang po mi mdzad par sgrol bstod kho na 'bum ther mang po bsags pa'i lo rgyus dang /dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i bstod ṭika las kyang rje btsan sgrol ma phrin ༄las kyi lha yin pas rgyal ba'i phrin las rgyas pa'i ched du gsol ba gdab par bya'o zhes gsungs/ yab rje kun mkhyen bla ma 'jigs med gling bas kyang gru 'dzin gyi bkod pa'i steng mkhar sgrol ma bzhugs pa zhal gzigs shing / srong btsan bang sor sgrol bstod 'bum ther bsags pas 'jig rten du dge legs kyi mtshan ma 221

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/byung ba dang / tshe ljongs su gtsug lag khang bzhengs tshe'ang nang rten gyi thog mar sgrol ma'i sku gzugs bzhengs dgos pa'i lung bstan byang tshul dkar chag tu rgyas par bzhugs/ /thugs rje chen 1(tho 1)sgorir //bye//)(1 //de/ /rje) tsar+shar yi drug pa rgyus / bla ma ra hu la gubha badz+ra —sa ra nag po'i khong gseng du sgrub pa mdzad pas dgyes rdor sogs yi dam mang po'i zhal gzigs/ khyad par 'phags pa thugs rje chen po rgyun chad med par gzigs/ des dpal ldan a ti sha la gnang nas so ma pu ri'i nags su zla ba gsum sgrub pa mdzad pas zhal dngos su bstan nas byang chub sems sbyong gi gdams pa bstsal/jo bo la nag tsho lo tsā bas lo bcu dgu bsten nas rgyud dang sgrub thabs mang po gsan cing / khyad par jo bo'i zhal nas/ thugs rje chen po sgrubs shig gsungs te sgrub pas zhal mthong zhing lung bstan mang po'ang gnang / rnal 'byor pa shes rab rdo rjes kyang jo bo las gdams pa blangs te sgrub pas zhal gzigs/ lan cig gi tshe ma ṇi bzlas pas zhal nas 'od zer shwa shwa 'ong ba la/ rnal 'byor pa chen po'i zhal nas/ sgom chen 'di kho na re skyid byang chub kyi thugs mnga' ba gsung / 'dis gsang phu dang rwa sgreng gi bar du 'byon bzhud mdzad pa la dro zan 'khyer mi dgos gsungs te/ rkang mgyogs gyi rdzu 'phrul thob par grags/ nag tshos rong ba 222

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4lag sor ba zhes skye ba gsum dran zhing bsgoms stobs kyis rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa/ dge bshes ston pa/ rnal 'byor pa/dgon pa ba/ jo bo legs/ zhang btsan yer ba pa sogs jo bo'i ༄dngos slob bdun dang / nying slob gnyis la thug pa de la gnang zhing lung bstan mdzad/ khong gis lag sor dgon du lo gsum bsgrubs pas 'phags pa dngos dang mjal nas khyod kyis tshe 'di nyid du grub pa thob ste/ slob ma yang sum cu tsam gyis nga mthong bar 'gyur zhes lung bstan/ lag sor bas ba yu ba shes rab tshul khrims la gdams/ des lo lnga bsgrubs pas zhal mthong ste sbyor lam chen po brnyes/ de la 'phags pa lce sgom dang / mnga' ris pa shes rab rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis zhus te/ 'di gnyis kyang tshogs lam chen po pa yin gsungs/ lce sgom gyis brag lha blo phug tu bsgrubs pas lo ngo brgyad na zhal mthong / mnga' ris pas ru mtshams kyi brag phug tu bsgrubs pas lo bzhi na zhal mthong /'di la rgyun du mi ma yin rnams kyis 'tsho ba drangs gsung / de gnyis ka la grub thob chen po skyer sgang bas zhus te/ lo phyed dang bzhir sgrub pa mdzad pas zhal bstan nas/ snyigs ma'i dus su zhal mthong ba 'ba' zhig gi brgyud pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan te/ slob ma yang lnga bcu tsam gyis zhal mthong / sgrub 223

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa lo gsum byed pa sogs kyi sgo nas chos 'di la 'brel ba bzhag pa'i slob ma ni mtha' yas/ des sangs rgyas gnyan ston la gnang /khong gis lo gsum bsgrubs pas yi ge drug pa dang / kha sar+ṣa ṇi dang / bcu gcig zhal phyag stong spyan stong rnams zhal gzigs shing / slob ma'ang bcu gcig gis zhal mthong bar 'gyur ba'i lung bstan mdzad/ phyis de kho na bzhin byung gsung ngo / /bla ma des sangs rgyas ston pa la gnang nas dag pa'i zhing du 'gro nges kyi slob ma brgya rtsa brgyad 'byung bar lung bstan pa bzhin 'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad/ de la mkhas grub shangs ston chen pos zhus te/ thags dam lha'i gtso bor mdzad/ sku la srin 'ab med cing /dmi ༅ riri byedri ma rang sangs te shel ltar dwangs par gyur pas gtsang ma shangs ston du grags/ ljags chab dang dri chu 'thung byug bgyis pa tsam gyis nad gdon las grol ba dang / mthong ba dang thos pa tsam gyis dge sems khyad par can skye ba sogs rnam thar ngo mtshar ba mnga'/ yang sangs rgyas ston pa la bla ma a seng dang mkhas btsun gzhon nu grub kyis zhus nas nyams bzhes mdzad/ de dag nas brag po che ba rdo rje dpal/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/rgod phrug ras par grags pa chos rje grags pa 'byung gnas sogs la brgyud de so sos thugs nyams su bzhes shing 'gro don mdzad/224

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4don bdun ma'i bla brgyud nang gi mkhan chen bde ba dpal dang /dka' bzhi pa grags gzhon/ mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa sogs kyis kyang chos 'di'i phrin las bskyangs te/ mtshon byed tsam bkod pa'o/ /phyis su grub chen thang stong rgyal pos skyer sgang ba'i gdams pa thams cad tshang bar gsan nas mi lo bcu bzhi'i bar mi dang mi phrad pa'i smra bcad kho nas ma ṇi dung phyur gnyis bzlas/ kha cher dge slong pad+ma ka ra sogs sku che'i phreng ba mang por thugs rje chen po'i sgrub pa por gyar ba dran/ mgon po phyag /rdo rdo norang //jordo //de/drug sogs chos skyong —na po rnams kyi spyi bor dam ga rdo rje bzhag cing / lha 'dre dregs pa can mang po dam la bzhag /rgyal bstan la gnod pa'i bon gyi 'bum pa sogs nus med du mdzad/bden tshig brjod pa tsam gyis stag byams pa la gnas pa dang / dred dmag gis khal bskyal ba sogs nus pa dpag tu med/ 'phags pa'i lung bzhin lcags zam byang chub rgyun lam bgrang dka' ba btsugs/ klo yul dkar por bsgyur/ dbus gtsang gi sa mdud sgrub khang gis mnan cing / sa gnad me btsa' mang po btab nas mtha' dmag 'byung ba'i go skabs bcom/ nad mug 'khrugs rtsod kyi sdug bsngal rgyun bcad/ lha sa'i jo shaka la brtan bzhugs mdzad cing rten bzhengs grangs med pas 'jig rten du 225

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dge legs spel/ yi ge drug pa'i phrin las kyis bod khams bkang /dad pas gsol ba btab pa rnams mi dang mi min 'byung ba'i 'jigs pa las bskyab tshul sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi lo rgyus la 'gran pa yod/ gzhan yang don zhags pa sangs rgyas rin chen gyi zhal nas/ nga'i bla ma 'phags pa don zhags pa chen po shes rab brtson 'grus kyi bka' las/ jo bo yi ge drug pa 'di snying po'i don yin pas 'di la dril cig gsungs pas 'u cag gis kyang bsnyen pa'i mthil 'di la byas gsungs/༄༅/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃḥ mkha' ltar rgya che'i sku dang mchog stsol gsungs/ /zab brling ye shes phung po ro mnyam pa/ /dran dang brjod pas bsod nams len pa'i sngags/ /oṃ gyi de nyid brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ ni a u ma gsum 'dus pa yin la 'du rgyu'i yi ge gsum po des shin tu rnam par dag pa'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje rnams mtshon la/ de dag 'dus pa'i oṃ yig gis ni rdo rje gsum dbyer med pa'i zung 'jug gi go 'phangs ston te/sngags don de ltar shes nas oṃ zhes brjod pas bsod nams rlabs po che 'byang bar byed pas na nor ba 'dzin pa'i sngags zhes riring rig mirdo rje rtse mo las bshad do/ /srid zhi'i phun tshogs yongs kyi za ma tog /rab 'byams rgyal kun oṃ gyi rig sngags kyis/ /thar 'dod 226

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4blo gros rtag tu dge byed cing / /'gro kun oṃ gyi gnas su 'khod par shog /mtha' bral de nyid gzigs pa'i ye shes kyis/ /'gro sems tha mal rtog pa'i 'jigs pa las/ /skyob pa'i bya ba rtag tu 'jug mtshon phyir/ /zla shel ma ṇi 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo ma ṇi ni nor ba'i skad dod de/ 'dir bgrang ba'i nor ba zhes grags rig 3 rig 3pa bgrang phreng la byed do/ /bgrang phreng gi de nyid ni sngags yin la/sngags kyi skad dod/ man+t+ra zhes pa yid skyob pa la 'jug pas yid sdug bsngal dang / de'i rgyu las nyon dang / kun gyi rtsa ba bdag tu rtog pa bag chags dang bcas pa las skyob par byed pa'i shes rab/bden pa gnyis kyi gnad la mkhas pas rtag pa dang chad pa'i mtha' gnyis las brgal ba ste/ grub chen mi tri'i gsung la brten pa'o/ /shes rab kyi phar phyin de nyid gdul bya gzhan gyi rgyud 'khor ba las skyob pa'i bya ba la ltos nas yang dang yang du 'dren pas bgrang phreng gi mtshon don du 'jog par rgyal dbang pad+mas bshad snang ngo / /'gro 'di rgyal rnams sher phyin ma ṇi yis/ /mi shes dug rnon 'phrogs pa'i snod gyur te/ /dri bcas blo gros tha mal rdo yi khams/ /kun mkhyen ye shes ma ṇir 'gyur bar shog /srid pa'i chu las bltams kyang de yi skyon/ /mi chags srid gsum spyi bor legs gyes pa'i/ /thugs rjes 'jig rten kun dgar 227

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mdzad pa'i dper/ /yid 'dzin pad+me bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo /pad+me zhes pa pad+ma 'dzin par mdzad pa ste/ ji ltar me tog pad+ma ni chu las skyes/ 'on kyang chu'i skyon gyis ma gos/ ma gos par ma zad mdzes sdug dang dri bsung gis chu'i rgyan byed pa ltar/ rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje chen po yang sems can srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba la dmigs nas skyes pas/ srid pa yongs su mi gtong ba'i rnam pa can yin kyang / thabs la mkhas pa'i shes rab kyis bzung ba yin pas 'jig rten gyi nyes pas mi gos shing /slar la zang zing dang mi 'jigs pa dang chos kyi 'byor ba la sogs sogs sgras/ tshul bzod brtson bsam sdud/ pas 'khor ba'i rgyan byed cing mkhas pa rnams kyi yid 'phrogs pa ste/ dpal mos mdzad pa'i bstod pa dang / grub chen mi tri'i gzhung la brten nas bshad do/ /rgyal dang byang sems rnams kyi rjes brtse yi/ /pad+me'i bcud la 'gro 'di rtag 'thung zhing / /skye dgu'i blo gros dpang ba'i lta zar ngos/ /brtse chen pad+me'i 'khri shing gis mdzes ra mi skur shog /phul byung shes rab snying rje'i snying po can/ /hūm̐ zhes gdul bya'i snying la skad cig gis/ /gsal mdzad 'jig rten dbang phyug la 'dud kyi/ /bdag gi blo gros rnam kun dge bar mdzod/ /hūm̐ zhes pa ni gsal bar byed pa ste/ sngar bshad pa'i srid mtha' 228

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4'gog byed ma ṇi'i don dang / zhi mtha' 'gog byed pad+me'i don te/lam de gnyis sgrub pa po'i rgyud la gsal bar byed par bskul ba'o//theg pa chen po'i lam gyi cha thams cad thabs dang shes rab kyi phyogs gnyis su 'du la/ de gnyis kyi sgo thams cad ma ṇi'i sngags don du dril ba 'di la zhib tu bsam nas yig drug chos kyi yang snying du gsungs pa la nges pa brtan par bya'o/ /'gro kun 'jig rten dbang phyug nyin re bzhin/ /hūṃ zhes bskul bas sgrub la 'jug byed cing / /de mthas yid can kun gyi blo gros la/ /༄mchog byed hūm̐ gi sngags don myur 'grub shog /'gro drug rgya mtshor bying bas nyam thag rnams/ /rlabs chen pha rol phyin drug spyod pa'i grus/ /sgrol mdzad snying rje'i lha khyod byang chub bar/ /bdag gi blo gros brgyan par mdzad slad bzhugs/ /oṃ/ ma/ ṇi/pad/ me/ hūm̐/ zhes re re nas phral ba'i drug po des dmyal ba la sogs pa'i 'gro ba drug sbyong bar byed cing / phyin drug gi yon tan rgyas par byed par mi tra dzo ki dang / dpal di paṃ kā ra sogs kyis bshad de/ bshes spring las/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang spyod pa yis/ /'gro ba nyam thag mang po rjes bzung ste/ /zhes pa ltar/ phyin drug gi sgo nas 'gro ba drug gi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa zhi bar byed pa'i don to/ /'dir don 229

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gnyis dang / gzhan don rnam pa thams cad pa sgrub pa sogs la ltos pa'i phyin drug gi grangs nges rnams kyang dran par bya ste/ yi ge so so'i don 'chad tshul gzhan yang yod do/ /de'ang sngags kyi mtshon don de dang de mdzub mos zla ba bzhin mtshon pa kho na yin nam zhe na ma yin gyi/ sngags kyi cha de dang de mtshon don ye shes kyi cha de dang de las sprul pa dang / de'i dbang gis sgrub pa po'i rgyud la yon tan de dang de sad par byed pa la so so so sor bsngags pa'i sgo nas lha sngags ngo bo dbyer med kyi nges shes drang dgos so/ /smin dang ma smin blo gros sgo nga'i bya/ /sangs rgyas byin rlabs drod kyis bskyed bsring bas/ /bsod nams lus zungs smin pa'i ye shes rtsal/ /rnam grol nam mkha'i rgyan du spyod par shog /yig drug lan re bton pas kyang tshe rabs du ma nas bsags pa'i las sgrib mang po byang zhing / gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams sgrub pa po'i lus la zhugs nas byin gyis rlob pa dang / de'i lus la gnas pa'i srin bu tshun chad bla med byang chub kyi skal ba can du byed pa la sogs pa'i phan yon mtha' yas pa rgyal po bka' 'bum du gsung rab mang po drang ba las shes shing / khyad par du rang re gangs can pa rnams la lha dang sngags 'di nyid grub pa lhag par myur ba'i rtags su/ tha na 230

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4byis pa lo gsum lon pa dang / mu to dbyug thogs yan chad kyi mgrin par rig sngags 'di nyid li shi la dri zhim ltar ngang gis thob cing / lha sngags gzhan ni sgom bzlas la brtson mkhan nyung zhing / cung zad yod pa rnams su'ang tshe 'di'i lag cha 'ba' zhig tu 'khyer mkhan kho na mang la/ 'di ni khyim pa pho mo yan chad kyi khrod na bye ba dang dung phyur sogs su zlo ba sa'i rtsi shing ltar mang zhing de yang 'jig rten phyi ma phan chad kyi ched du byed pa kho na mang ba dang / de lta na'ang tshe 'dir tshe ring ba dang / nad nyung ba sogs kyi phun tshogs 'thob pa la yang ma ṇi zlo mkhan rnams 'ba' zhig khyad par du 'phags pa sogs mngon sum du mthong bas/ bdag legs su 'dod na 'di la 'bad par bya zhing sngags don shes pa dang mi shes pa'i bzlas brjod la stobs che chung ches mi 'dra ba yod pas mdor bsdus shig bkod do/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ snying la mdza' ba mi phyed drang po'i blo/ /'dir bde phyi mar legs pa'i 'dun gros can/ /khyod dang tshe rabs phreng bar theg mchog gi/ /chos kyi 'dun sar lhan cig longs spyod shog /dge rgan sku drin can gyi bzhed pa dang mthun par bstan pa'i nyi mas bris pa'i re 'dod la 'jig rten dbang po'i spyan ras kyis 'tsho bar gyur cig /231

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄/ /thugs rje chen po'i brda don ni/ bshad 'grel chen mor/ zhal gcig ni sems can la thugs rje mi 'gyur ba/ zhes snying rje ngo gnyis pa dang / ngo bo rtag pa spangs pa/ sgrub thabs gcig skor du ni/ zhal gcig ni lhan skyes ye shes rang dang gnyis su med pa'i brda/ zhes so/ /'dzum mdangs ldan pa ni sems can la byams par mdzad pa/ spyan mi zum pa ni sems can la thugs rjes gzigs pa/ phyag bzhi ni/ tshad med rnam pa bzhi ldan pas/ /'gro don phyogs med mdzad pa'i rtags/ /zhes so/ /yang /gnyis med chos sku'i phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar/ /longs sku shes rab pad+ma g.yon na 'dzin/ /sprul sku thabs kyi bgrang phreng g.yas na 'dzin/ /zhes dang / zhal bcu gcig pa'i thad du/ rtsa ba chos sku'i phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar/ /yan lag longs sku'i phyag gi dang po na/ /skyon gyis ma gos pad+ma dkar po 'dzin/ /nying lag sprul sku'i phyag gi dang po na/ /'khor ba'i sems can 'dren pa'i bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /zhes te/ phyi ma gnyis ni/ mu tig gi phreng ba snying rje rgyun chad med pas sems can 'khor ba nas byang chub tu 'dren pa'o/ /pad+ma ni/ 'khor bar sems can gyi don mdzad kyang 'khor ba'i nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog gi skyon gyis ma gos pa'o/ /zhes so/ /phyag bzhi sku gsum dang sbyar bar ma zad/ phyag mtshan 232

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4de ltar sbyar ba'ang snang ste/ thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel las/dang po'i phyag gnyis stong nyid phyag rgya mdzadaḥ g.yas 'og shel phreng grags stong sngags sgra sgrogasaḥ g.yon 'og pad dkar sgyu 'phrul sprul pa 'gyedaḥ ces rdo rje gsum gyi bshad pa mdzad de/snga ma dang bsre rgyu min pa 'dra/ tshul khrims bzang po'i lugs las/zhal chos sku thig le gcig tu 'khyil/ /spyan thabs shes snying rjes zim bur gzigs/ /phyag tshad med bzhi ldan 'jam zhing mnyen/ /zhes so/ /sku mdog dkar po ni/ chos sku dri ma med pa'i brda/ /zhes dang / dkar 'tsher zhes pa/ chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa la 'khor ba'i rtog 'dzin gyis ma gos pa/zhes so/ /zhabs mnyam skyil ni/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i don la thugs mnyam pa nyid las mi g.yo bar bzhugs pa/zhes dang / zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i skyil krung bzhugs/ /mnyam bzhag don la ma g.yos rtags/ /zhes te/ zhabs gnyis chos dbyings dang ye shes gnyis sa med pa'i brda/ zhes dang / 'gro ༄ba'i don la thabs shes zung 'jug gis mnyam par bzhugs pa/zhes kyang ngo / /rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa ni/'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad la spyod kyang zhen med du sems can gyi don dang tshul bstun pa'i brda/ zhes dang / 'dod yon 233

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma spangs par chos nyid rol pa'i rgyan du shar ba/ zhes te/dgos 'dod phun tshogs 'byang ba'i rtags su'ang bshad do/ /ri ri //|) /rdo shenam mkha'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs su/ ri dwags — pags pa snying rje chen po dang ma bral ba/ dar gyi sham thabs ni chos kyi ngo tsha dang ldan pa/ zhes so/ /bar chad kun sel du/ sdug bsngal gdung sel dar gyi stod g.yogs dang ཿ nyon mongs dri mas ma gos sham thabs gsolaḥ dgos 'dod re skong rin chen rgyan gyis sprasaḥ snying rje'i ri dwags pags pa phrag na 'changaḥ zhes so/ /nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa ni/ thugs rje sems can la nyi zla ltar snyoms pa dang / 'khor ba'i skyon gyis mi gos pa'i brda'o/ /yum gsang ye ni/ gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma bral bas dkar gsal/'gro ba la rjes su chags pas dmar mdangs 'tsher ba/ phyag mtshan la/ thugs rgyud bde stong gi ros myos shing gang bas thod chang / ye shes des srid zhi bde stong sher phyin gyi rang sgras sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad g.yo/ sangs rgyas thams cad skul/ 'gro ba'i gnas thams cad skyod/sems can rnams gti mug gi gnyid las slong / thams cad skul zhing dbang du sdud pas ḍā ru ste/ ye shes dang / phrin las kyi khyad dam/ yang na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul nas bde chen gyi ye shes 'bebs pas ḍā ru/ ye shes kyi btung ba'i rgyun de zad mi 234

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4shes par 'chang bas na thod chang ste/ ban snod na gnas pa dang /myos par byed pa gnyis char bde ba chen po dang mthun no/ /dzab dbyangs nyer gcig ni mkha' 'gro gsang skor du bstan par zad kyi/ 'gro 'dul yid bzhin nor bu'i gzhung dkyas su bstan pa ni///༷sgo riri ༅bzla tshul drug ste/ d+ngha mdo sde ltar gzhan don du bzlas pa/ nang gsang sngags ltar bsnyen sgrub tu bzlas pa/ gsang ba mkha' 'gro mas byin rlabs brda'i tshul du bzlas pa/ bla ma dang lha la gsol ba gdab pa ma la bus 'bod kyi tshul du bzlas pa/ sgrib sbyong chos spyod kyi tshul du bzlas pa/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa mnyam bzhag bsam gtan gyi tshul du bzlas pa'o/ /de rnams la dzab dgongs drug /sngags don 'chad tshul drug /dbyangs kyi 'dren stangs drug sogs yod de bshad 'grel chen mo las shes par bya'o/ /235

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/spro/ /yi dam zhi ba'i zin bris kun tu bzang po'i gzhal med khang la 'jug pa'i sgo/yi dam zhi ba'i zin bris kun tu bzang po'i gzhal med khang la 'jug pa'i sgo zhes bya ba/ rje bla ma grub thob chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyir brgyud pa gsum gyis 'phags shing / gu rus snyigs dus kyi mthar byin rlabs kyi rno so 'byung bar dgongs pa'i dbang gis chos la gter chos rno/ de las kyang deng sang rang 'di'i dus babs kyi zab chos mchog ni rje'i zab gter rnams te/gter bka' de nyid la ltos pa'i 'bras bu'i dus ma yol ba'i bzang sgang yin/ ngas a pha/ a phas sangs rgyas dngos la thob ces smra chog pas brgyud pa nye/ rang nyid la thugs rje gzhan phan kun khyab phrin las rab brtan rnam par rgyal ba'i sde/ mchog brnyes pa'i grub chen rnams kyis skal ldan rtsa ba'i chos bdag tu dgongs pa gtad yod pas chos tshan 'di lhag par byin rlabs che/ lar sangs rgyas kyi gdul bya rjes sa 'dzin pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo ni brtse ba thags rje chen ri bca riri ༅po yin la/ de rgyu dang dmigs rnam dang rgyud kyi phye bas mtha' yas pa thams cad ga cig tu bsdus nas bzhin lag gi rnam par 236

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4shar ba ni 'phags pa 'di yin pas sgrub thag nye/ 'dzam gling 'di nyid kyi ri'i rgyal po gru 'dzin na da dung yang bzhugs shing /zur tho ltar bod kyi khyad par gyi lha skal yin pas kyang byin rlabs che/ de'ang rigs re re'ang rigs thams cad dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes gcig kyang ye shes lnga ka'i ngo bor bshad pa ltar skabs 'dir 'phags pa rigs drug tu phye ste/ rigs lnga'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad thugs rje chen po nyid kyi rnam par rigs bsdus nas sgrub pa dang / de bzhin gshegs ma rnams dang /sems dpa'/ sems ma/ khro bo khro mo/ gzhan yang mgron thabs kyi lha'i rnam 'gyur dpag tu med pa rnams kyang thugs rje chen po'i rigs dang rnam 'phrul nyag gcig tu byas pa'i sgrub lugs 'di ni/lha'i rigs thams cad dang / rigs kyi lha thams cad 'grub thag shin tu nye bas 'grub pa'i thabs mkhas chen po ste/ des na rigs nyi tshe ba'i 'gro 'dul gyi sgrub tshul rnams las kyang khyad par du 'phags so/ /de la skye 'chi bar do sku gsum du sbyong tshul sogs ni sgyu 'phrul ltar bya la/ phyag 'tshal skabs/ rtsa phyag thal mo sbyar ba ni rgyal po'i dbang po thams cad ces bya ba'i phyag rgya yin par za ma tog las gsungs/ bka' 'bum las/ phyag gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar/ /stong dang snying rje dbyer med pas/ /sems 237

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/can don la gnas pa'i rtags/ /rje mnyam nyid ngang la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces gsungs/ 'di la srong btsan gyis nam mkha'i rgyal po'i bstod par/ pad+ma'i 'dab 'dra dang po yi/ /phyag gnyis thugs kar thal sbyar nas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje rnams/ /bskul bar mdzad pa phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa sngags bla med skabs/ dgongs pa lung ston las/ phan tshun sbyor ba rdo rje sems/ /shes rab thabs kyi go 'phang mchog /thal mo sbyar ba tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad nges par 'gugs/ /ces sogs ltar bya rung ngam snyam/ dpal mos mdzad pa'i bstod par/ thugs rje dang ni shes rab gnyis/ /mnyam par sbyor ba'i thugs mnga' zhing / phyag gnyis thugs kar mnyam sbyor ba/ /nidapal ldan mnyam sbyor la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes so/ /bgrang phreng sngags kyi nor bu ste/ man+t+ra'i sgra las yid sdug bsngal rgyu bcas las skyob pa'i sher phyin te/ dpal mos/ sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po gtso/ /gsang sngags rgyal po'i bgrang phreng mchog /mu tig ltar dkar g.yas na 'dzin/ /rig sngags 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa las mi gsal yang mi tras ma ṇi la bshad pa'i rigs pa sbyar ba'o/ /gter phyogs las/ lus can 'khor ba dang ngan song las rgyun mi 'chad du 'dren pa'i brdar shel phreng 'dren par 238

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4 bshad pa'ang / sher phyin chos rgyal bka' 'bum las/ phyag g.yas mu tig phreng ba bsnam/ /thugs rje rgyun chad med pa yis/ /'khor ba'i gnas nas 'dren pa'i rtags/ /rje thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa dang mi 'grigs pas rtsings sam snyam ste dpyad/ gyi rnal 'byor de nyid gdul bya 'dren pa'i phrin las la rgyun mi 'chad du 'jug pa la bya dgos sam brtag /pad+ma dkar po'i rnam bshad zur du yod/ pad+ma dmar po'i de nyid rnal 'byor rgyud na shin tu rgyas par bzhugs kyang 'dir skabs su ma babs/ pad dkar gyi de nyid bsdus pa ni/ dpal mos/ 'khor ba'i 'dam gyis ma gos pas/ /dag pa'i shel ltar 'od gsal ba/ /pad+ma dkar po g.yon na 'dzin/ /phyag na pad+ma phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ grub chen mi tra ltar na snying rje chen po dang sbyor ba 'dra/de ltar na bgrang phreng chos sku sgrub byed kyi gtso bo ye shes kyi tshogs dang / pad dkar gzugs sku'i rgyu'i gtso bo bsod nams kyi tshogs dang sbyor bar 'thad de/ shes rab dang thabs kyi phyogs so sor 'gyur ro/ /phyag stong spyan stong gi mdor/ sems can thams cad kyis gces shing yid du 'ong bar 'dod na thal mo sbyar ba'i phyag dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mgo la phyag gis nyug cing lung ston par 'dod na sngags kyi nor bu thogs pa'i phyag dang /yon tan rnam pa sna tshogs kyi phyir ni pad dkar thogs pa'i phyag 239

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ la mchod cing blta zhes byed las kyi khyad par yang bstan no / /'di'i yum gsang ye ni/ thugs chen pad rgyal du/ yi ge drug ma gsang ba ye shes/ bka' 'bum bshad 'grel chen mor/ phyi ltar na yum yi ge drug ma/ nang ltar na gsang ba ye shes/ zhes so/ /zhes pa ltar lha mo yi ge drug mar shes dgos so/ /bzlas pa'i thad/ khyad par 'gro 'dul thugs rje che'iḥ byin rlabs dngos grub/ ces pa ni/ 'gro 'dul thugs rje'i dbang phyug 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi byin rlabs/ces dang / 'gro 'dul thugs rje'i dngos grub/ ces dngos grub ngos bzung ba gnyis ka la sbyar btub/ gzhung 'di'i gong 'og kun tu spyan ras gzigs brtse ba'i lhar bzung ste sgrub par gsungs pa 'di bzhin/ mdo rgyud mang po las mthong ste/ za ma tog las 'phags pa 'di'i rnam thar thams cad sems can sdug bsngal ba rnams la rjes brtser mdzad tshul kho na'i sgo nas bstan pa dang / sdong po bkod par/ bde gshegs sras po ngas ni rnam thar gcig bsgom ste/ /ye shes snying po rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje sdug /'gro ba thams cad bskyab cing yongs su bsdu phyir byung / /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa dang / chos yang dag par sdud pa'i gong 'og gnyis sa rje btsan 'dis ston pa'i spyan sngar rang gi rabye rabye rtogs pa brjod pa na snying rje chen po nyid kyi steng nas brjod pa 240

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4dang / spyod 'jug tu/ bdag gces 'dzin goms pa'i dbang gis rang la mi snyan pa chung ngu yang mi bzod pa ltar/ brtse ba goms pa'i shugs rgyas pa na gzhan gyi mi bde ba phra mo'ang mi bzod pa'i dper/ rje btsun 'di'i rnam thar drangs te/ de bas ji ltar sogs nas/ mtshan yang byin gyi rlabs/ ces pa'i bar ro/ /snying rje pad dkar las spyan ras gzigs zhes pa'i mtshan 'di yang snying rje chen po'i yon tan gyi sgo nas sngon gyi sangs rgyas kyis btags par gsungs pa dang / lag na rdo rje dbang bskur gyi gleng gzhir sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyis rje btsun la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thags rje chen po'i stobs kyi rdo rje pad+ma'i mchog gi ༄snying po byin nas gzhi dang snying po me tog gi rgyan bkod pa'i zhing 'di lus kyi sprin rnams kyis bkang nas snang bar byed du btang bar gsungs pa dang / de nyid bsdus par bdag cag gi ston pa rnam snang nyid snying rje'i nyams kyis 'dul ba'i sems can gdul phyir 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku bstan par 'gro ba 'dul ba 'i dkyil 'khor gyi thad du gsungs pa dang / spyan ras gzigs zhes pa'i sgra bshad kyang sor rtog ye shes kyi spyan gyis rang bzhin dag pa'i chos la rtag tu gzigs pa dang / thugs rje chen po'i spyan gyis 'jig rten thams cad la gzigs pa lhur len pa'i phyogs nas bshad tshul gnyis de nyid snang chen dang / ko sa la'i 241

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rgyan/ dpal mchog 'grel chen/ rnam snang mngon byang gi 'grel pa rnams su gsungs pa'i phyi ma dang / legs grub tu yang /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags/ /yon tan dam pu kun bsags pa/ /spyan ras gzigs zhes mtshan gsol ba/ /rtag par brtse la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sogs mtha' yas so/ /ri dwags kri:'i pags pas nu g.yon bkab par bshad pa'ang de ltar yin te/ dbu ma snying por/ snying rje'i pags pa gnag 'chang zhing / /zhes par 'dra'o/ /'dir lam kyi gtso bo snying rje chen por byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / mdo sngags khyad 'byed skabs/ gzhan don bzo khog dang /rdzogs byang sgrub pa'i lam thams cad de'i cha lag tu byed pa la theg chen gnyis 'dra bar bshad pa bzhin/ tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab gzungs spobs mngon shes sogs yon tan thams cad snying rje chen po'i bzhed don sgrub byed kyi 'khor kho ma/ra zad pas/ rin chen bdun gyi bdag po 'khor sgyur yin pa ltar/ yon tan de thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i bdag po snying rje chen po yin no/ /de'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi sa'i yon tan thams cad kyi gtso bo'am bdag po'ang skye la thugs rje chen po yin te/ 'bras dus kyi rnam bzhag mang po sngon gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i sgo nas byed par gsungs 242

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4pa bzhin no/ /de'ang slob lam du snying rje chen po de theg gsum gyi rtogs rigs mtha' dag dang 'brel bar sbyang bas mthar son pa na/ brtse chen gyi blo mngon gyur pa de nyid las gyi rnam pa ma lus pa'i ngo bor skye ba la gegs su gyur pa'i gnas ngan len gyi cha thams cad rgyun mtha'i rdor ting gis bcom nas/ de'i rnam grol lam la slar yang snying rje chen po mngon gyur du 'byung ste/ de ni stong nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa sogs lung rtogs kyi yon tan rnam pa thams cad pa'i mtshan nyid can du skye'o/ /dngos grub kyi snying po de ltar ngos zin pa de nyid rgya gang che nas sgrub dgos kyi/gzhan du dper na bla ma mkhas grub chen po dang mjal yang skar ma'i dpyad lta bu'i don dman pa zhig las ci yang ma dris na gdams pa'i mchog rnams zur tsam yang mi thob pa dang 'dra'o/ /spyir yang sgo thams cad nas snying rje la mang du gnas par bya ba ni spyan ras gzigs kyi sngags pa'i khyad par gyi dam tshig yin par phyag stong spyan stong gi mdo dang / rgyal po bka' 'bum/ kun bzang thugs gter sogs las nan tan du gsungs te/ de la brtson na 'phags pa dang brtul zhugs gcig la gnas par 'gyur bas 'phags pa dgyes pa'i de'ang spyir snying rje sgom pa tsam gyis mi chog gi/ de 'phags pa dgyes pa'i ched du dmigs nas sgom pa zhig dgos te/ 'di'i 243

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dam tshig khyad par bar 'gro lugs shes pa'i steng nas so/ dka' thub kyi nor can te/ rjes 'dzin gyi gnad ches chen po'o/ /thugs srog hrīḥyig gi don ni/ de nyid bsdus pa'i dum bu gsum pa las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje chos kyi dam tshig las byung ba'i byin gyis rlabs pad+mo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi dam tshig ces bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di rang gi thags ka nas phyang ngo / trīḥ de nas de phyang ma thag tu de bzhin rigab—rig rir zurar rir zurag da sna 155gshags pa thams cad kya thugs ka nas pad+ma lta bu' 'ad zar kha dog dang gzugs dang rtags dang spyod lam dang 'od rnam pa du ma byung ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 'dod chags la sogs pa rnam par dag pa dang / chos nyid kyi ye shes yang dag par sbyangs nas yang slar log ste 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i thugs kar zhugs so/ /zhes gsungs te/ snying po 'di la de thams cad kyi chos kyi dam tshig ces gsungs pa'i chos ni pad+ma'i rigs rnams te rang bzhin dag pa'i chos mkhyen pa'i sher phyin gyi ngo bo nyid yin pas so/ /dam tshig ni rgyu'i don te/ rigs de sprul pa'i rgyu yin pa'o/ /de pa thams cad kyi snying po zhes pa ni 244

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4thugs ka'i sems dpa'i rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid yin pa'o/ /de phyung ma thag tu sogs kyis ni trīḥ zhes bya ba'i snying po 'dis pad+ma'i rigs thams cad sprul tshul dang / sprul nas rang gi rigs dang mthun pa'i mdzad pa mdzad tshul rnams ston te/ kun snying ltar byas so/ /dpal mchog las kyang / de nas de bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ngo bo nyid dag pa'i chos nyid thob pas yang chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ye shes kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di gsungs te/ 'dod chags thams cad rnam par dag pa nyid kyis 'jig rten na zhe sdang thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro//dri ma thams cad rnam par dag pa nyid kyis 'jig rten na sdig pa thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /chos thams cad rnam par dag pas 'jig rten na sems can thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /shes pa thams cad rnam par dag pas 'jig rten na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa nas/ de nas byang chab sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ༄spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug don gyi gnas 'di nyid yang rgya cher ston cing bzhin rab tu 'dzum dmul te/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma kha 'byed pas 'dod chags la sogs pa'i dri mas mi gos pa la blta 245

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhing / 'gro ba thams cad kyi phyir pad+ma'i gzugs sna tshogs zhes bya ba'i snying po 'di gsungs so/ /hrīḥ de nas 'di gsungs pa tsam gyis pad+ma chen po de las de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa'i gzugs thams cad bcom ldan 'das spyanaras gzigs/ dang 'dra ba'i pad+mas mtshan pa'i gzugs can nges par byung nas bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rim pa dang po'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshul du bzhugs par gyar to/ /zhes gsungs te//lngange/ rigapa don gyi gnas 'a nyid ces pa ni/ 'dod chags rnam par dag pa sogs gong gi gzhung tshan bzhis bstan pa rnams te/ yang rgya cher ston cing zhes pa ni hrīḥzhes bya ba'i yi ge sprul pa'i sgo nas slar yang ston par mdzad pa'o/ /'gro ba thams cad ni pad+ma'i rigs rnams te/ de yongs su rdzogs par skyed pa'i phyir snying po 'bru gcig 'di gsungs pa'o/ /pad+ma'i gzugs sna tshogs pa zhes pa ni snying po'i yi ge hrīḥzhes pa 'di'i ming ngo zhes dpal mchog 'grel chen las so/ /pad+ma'i gzugs sna tshogs ces bya ba'i snying po zhes pa 'di la sher dum gyi 'grel par/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi gzugs su snang bas na gzugs sna tshogs dang / de ltar snang yang 'khor ba'i nyes pa rnams kyis mi gos pas na pad+ma/ de 'dra'i snying po dngos ni gzugs kunasnying gi/ thams cad nges par 246
