thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4ston pa'i ye shes nyid yin yang / de mtshon par byed pa'i trīḥyig la btags nas bstan gsungs/ 'di gsungs pa tsam gyis sogs ni/ snying po 'di'i mthus 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa thams cad pad+ma'i rigs kyi rnam par gyur nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi phyag mtshan pad+mo las byung zhes pad+ma'i rigs spro byed du gsungs pa'o/ /man snye las/ trīḥni gsal bar gyis shig pa ste/nye ba ma yin pa nye bar gyur pa gsal por gyis shig pa'o/ /zhes skabs gzhan du bshad de/ sher phyin gyi sa bon yin pa dang gsal bar byed pa la sbyar ba gnyis gnad 'dra bar mthong zhes dam pa dag 'chad/ de dpal mchog dang bsgrigs na/ pad+ma ltar gos pa med pa'i sher phyin gyi rigs kyi gzugs sna tshogs gsal bar gyis zhes par bshad dgos pa 'dra/ grol thig gter gzhung du/ chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus med par ston par byed pa'i yi ge hrīḥ zhes pa ltar na/ rgyud bla mar/ gzhal med grangs med mi mnyam dang / /sogs ngo bo nyid sku khyad par lnga ldan du gsangs pa ltar/ sher phyin gyi mthas chos kyi dbyings kyi gting riri rgya ris migayogs pa thams cad dang bral ba'i tshul gyis sa ler gsal bar gyis shig ces 'chad tshul yang yod dam snyam/247

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yig drug gi sngags don la/ oṃ ni a u ma gsum gyis sku gsung thags gsum mtshon la/ de gsum gcig tu sbyar ba'i oṃ ༄ yig gis rdo rje gsum dbyer med pa'i go 'phang mtshon te/ sngags don de ltar dran nas brjod pas mchog stsol zhing bsod nams len pa'i phyir nor bu 'dzin pa zhes rdo rje rtse mor ro/ /de nas ni/rdo rje gur gyi le'u bco lnga par yig drug 'di nad thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i sngags su gsungs pa'i 'grel par lha'i rigs kyi blo gros chen po sa/ ma ṇi zhes bya ba ni shin tu rin thang med pa'i nor bu dang 'dra ba'i so sor rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /ci ste ye shes so sor rtog pa yin na rtog pa dang bcas par mi 'gyur ram zhe na/pad+ma zhes bya ba smos te/ ci ltar pad+ma 'dam gyis ma gos pa ltar ye shes de rtog pa'i skyon gyis gos pa med do zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de nyid kyi phyir hūṃ phaṭa ces bya ba smos te/ hūṃ zhes bya ba ni gzung ba dang 'dzin pas stong pa'i yid do/ /phaṭa ces bya ba ni rnam par rtog pa 'dral ba'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ sor rtog ye shes nor bu'i rgyal po dang 'dra tshul ni mdo rgyan las/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni/ /shes bya kun la rtag mi thogs/ /ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs rnams kyi/ /gter dang 'dra ba kho na yin/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams su ni/ /'byor pa thams cad ston mdzad pa/ /248

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4the tshom thams cad gcod byed pa'i/ /chos chen char ni rab tu 'bebs/ /zhes 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi sa la brten nas bshad do/ /ye shes de so sor rtog pa yin na rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes su mi 'a thad do zhe na/ rtog pa ni mi gsal ba ste/ 'dam gyis sbags pas nag nog tu 'gyur ba dang 'dra'o/ /ye shes 'di ni sor rtog yin yang shes bya thams cad mngon sum du blta ba la bkra zhing shin tu gsal ba'i yon tan gyis mdzes pas sam/'khrul pa'i bag chags kyi gnyid ma lus pa sad pas shin tu rgyas shing kha phye bas na pad+ma lta bur bshad ces 'chad dam/ pad+ma 'dam las skyes kyang chu zhag dang nya lcibs sogs 'dam gyi nyes pa rnams kyis ma sbags pa ltar/ ye shes de ming tshig yi ge'i rnam pa can gyi rtog pa yongs sa gyar pa las skyes kyang / phyin ci log gi ༄༄cha thams cad log pa'i phyir gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i rtog pa gtan min zhes pa ste/ sangs rgyas la zhen rig gi rtog pa med kyang tha snyad byed pa'i blo rigs yod dgos te/ so rig bzhis shes pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gnyis snang gi 'khrul pa'i rab rib mtha' dag dang bral ba'i so sor rtog pa'i spyan shin tu gsal ba yin zhes hūṃ gis bstan to/ /'di ltar na sor rtog ye shes gcig po de gdul bya'i bsam pa rdzogs par mdzad pa'i cha nas nor bu dang / de 249

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nyid gdul bya'i bsam pa tha dad pa dang / de la ji ltar 'tshams pa'i chos kyi longs spyod sna tshogs pa thams cad ma 'dzings bar 'byed pa'i sor rtog yin yang / rtog pa'i skyon gyis ma gos par mi 'gal ba'i cha nas pad+ma ste gnyis kar 'jog par gsal lo/ /da dung go bder bshad na/ sor rtog ye shes ni rnam par rtog pa med pa'i phyir dang / 'gro ba'i re ba skong ba'i mthu phul du byung ba'i phyir ma ṇi ste nor bu'i rgyal po'o/ /de rnam rtog med par mi 'thad de/ sor rtog yin pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ de rtog pa las skyes kyang / rtog pa'i dri mas ma bslad par skyes te/ pad+ma 'dam las skyes kyang 'dam gyi nyes pas ma gos par skye ba bzhin no/ /der ma zad sor rtog de nyid kyi mthus gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i g.yeng ba'i gnas ngan len gyi cha ma lus pa 'joms shing 'gog pas na hūṃ zhes so/ /bde chen shes rab snying rje mchog /ces pa'i sgrub thabs su dpal mi tra dzo kis ni/ oṃ ma ṇi hūṃ/ shes rab chen po dri ma med/ /rnam par shes kun mtshan nyid de/ /ma skyes mi gnas 'gag pa med/ /gdod nas rnam grol mngon sum pa/ /oṃ āḥtrīḥpad+me hūṃ/ snying rje chen po lhun gyis grub/ /dmigs pa kun gyi mtshan nyid de/ /mi phyed mi 'gyar 'bral ba med/ /skyo med re ba ༄rnam spangs pa'o/ /zhes bshad de/ ma ṇi ni shes rab kyi phar phyin 250

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4te rnam rtog med cing / mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /pad+ma ni snying rje chen po ste/ 'dam rdzab lta bu'i 'khor ba la brten nas sam dmigs nas skye ba dang / sems can thams cad dga' bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /de'ang byang sems kyi mnyam bzhag tu ni snying rjes zin pa'i shes rab mngon gyur du 'jug ste/ spang bya dngos su spong ba sogs la 'di kho na dgos shing / snying rje'i mthu dang byed las gzhan yang de la yod do/ /rjes thob tu ni shes rab kyis zin pa'i snying rje ste dmigs med kyi snying rje chen po mngon du 'gyur te/ gzhan don gyi bya ba dngos su sgrub pa sogs la 'di kho na dgos shing / shes rab kyi mthu dang byed las gzhan yang de la yod do/ /sangs rgyas kyi sa na ni de gnyis ka blo gcig la mngon gyur du ldan pas srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i byang chub ces brjod pa yin te/ 'di dag ni lam dang 'bras bu'i dus kun tu ma ṇi dang pad+me gnyis mi 'bral bar phan tshun grogs su 'jug pa'i tshul lo/ /theg chen gyi bsam sbyor gnyis las bsam pa snying rje chen po pad+me dang / sbyor ba'am spyod pa'i gtso bo dang rab mchog sher phyin ma ṇir bzhag pas/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba dang sa bcu par bshad pa'i smon lam 'bum phrag grangs med bcu sogs pad+mer sdud cing / sbyin sogs phar phyin snga ma lnga 251

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma ṇir bsdu ba 'dra/ phyi ma cung zad bshad na/ dper na ma rig pa ni ma 'dres pa'i ma rig pa tsam du ma zad kyi/ chags sogs nyon mongs pa'i sgo sna tshogs dang bsdongs nas phyi phyir stobs rgyas par 'gyur bas/ chags sogs de dag ni ma rig pa'i dpung grogs so/ /de bzhin du sher phyin yang rang rkyang tsam sgom pa min gyi/ sbyin sogs rgya che ba'i spyod phyogs thams cad des ma zin pa med par byas te sbyang bas/ sgo sna tshogs shig nas sher phyin stobs rgyas par 'gyur te/ des na rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid ces ri mo mkhan du mas 'khor sgyur gyi gzugs gcig 'bri ba'i dpes mdo dang rgyud bla mar bshad pa'i rigs pas mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i sher phyin gyi rtogs pa rnyed pa ni tshogs mtha' yas pa la ltos pas/ tshogs de dag ni de'i don du gsungs so/ /rkang pa gnyis pa gnyis kyi don ni/ ma ṇir 'jog rgyu'i shes rab de shes pa rnam par dag pa rang don phun tshogs zab pa ye shes chos sku'i ngo bo nyid dang / pad+mer 'gro rgyu'i snying rje de dmigs pa'am shes bya rnam par dag pa gzhan don phun tshogs rgya che ba gzugs sku'i mtshan nyid dam 'jog byed yin pa ste/ de ltar na sngar phyag mtshan thad du brjod pa ltar byas kyang 'grigs pa yod/ pad+ma zhes bya rgyu la/ pad+me zhes sbyar ba ni bod pa'i don te/ nor bu pad+ma zhes 252

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4spyan ras gzigs la nye ba'i sgo nas bod pa'i don yin pas 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud rang la nye lhang ba lta bur yod par bsgom la bzla zhes rgyal dbang dge 'dun rgya mtshos bshad/ de'ang theg chen gnyis kyi than mong ltar yin la/ da dung ༄bya rgyud pa'i zab rgya che'i lam gnyis sgrub tshul nas/ sngags bla na med pa'i shes pa 'od gsal dang / shes bya ye shes kyi sku sgrub lugs kyi bar so sor sbyar nas bshad na rlabs che'o/ /yang sgrub thabs de nyid las/ rnal 'byor rgyal po shes rab thabs/ /rig 'dzin dkyil 'khor bla na med/ /dpal ldan pha rol phyin drug dngos/ /cho ga'i dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ gsang sngags rgyal po yi ge drug /lugs 'byung ba dang lugs bzlog las/ /rgyud drug 'gog dang lam drug sbyong / /'bras bu drug la rab sbyor nyid/ /de bzhin rgyud drug bskyed pa dang / /lam drug la ni sbyor ba dang / /'bras bu drug ni mngon du bya/ /gzi brjid drug pa zhes bshad do/ /zhes yi ge drug po pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi ngo bo nyid dang / 'gro ba drug sbyong byed sogs su gsungs te/ 'di ni srong btsan bka' 'bum dang /bka' gdams glegs bam sogs su'ang bshad do/ /srong btsan bka' 'bum na gzhan yang / rdo rje dang rin po che la sogs pa rig/sa lnga rigs thams cad bsdus pa dang bcas pa'i drug gi ngo 253

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bor sbyor tshul dang / ye shes lnga lhan skyes ye shes dang drug la sbyar ba dang / sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga'i byin rlabs so sor 'bebs pa/ byin rlabs thams cad thogs med du 'byung ba dang bcas pa'i drug la sbyar ba dang / dug lnga nyon mongs spyi dang drug sbyong byed du sbyar ba/ 'byung ba lnga so so dang thams cad 'dus pa ste drug la sbyar ba sogs ches mang du gsungs shing /phyin drug dang sbyor tshul la yang / oṃ sbyin pa nas/ hūṃ shes rab kyi bar go rim bzhin du sbyar ba dang / oṃ shes rab/ ma bsam gtan/ ṇi tshul khrims/ pad brtson 'grus/ me sbyin pa/ hūṃ bzod pa dang sbyar te bstan pa sogs de nyid du lta bar bya'o/ /lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs su/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po rtog pa'i sngags kyi rgyal po yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'di mtshan ma med pa'i sbyar bas blta zhing bzlas pa bya'o/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ zhes sogs rgya gzhung rnams las yig drug kho na 'byung yang / gter phyogs su yig bdun mang la/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang byang gter las/ phyi ni srog sbas zhi ba'i tshulaḥ yi ge drug pa rdo rje'i sgraḥ zhes pa nas/ gsang ba srog gi mtha' rten canaḥsnyigs ma'i dus sa srog mthar rten0 zhes gsangs te/ spyir yig mo ribasi༅ dzoḥmi riri sbyodrug rang yang thugs srog skul ba'i sngags las ma 'das mod /254

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4'on kyang skul byed yig drug dang / bskul bya srog yig gnyis ka dngos su sbrel nas bzlas na thugs rje gnad nas skul ba la lhag par rno bas/ sngags 'grub par dka' ba'i dus su 'di gtso bor gzung zhes pa yin nam dpyad/dzab dbyangs ni/ mos gus gdung dbyangs kyi dzab rnga mo bu stor ba lta bu sogs nyer gcig bka' 'bum du bshad/ sgrub sngags thad/ lha mo yi ge drug ma bla med lugs kyi bsnyen sngags yig bdun dang /sgrub sngags dhu ma gha ye la mdzad pa ste/ yi ge drug ma bla med lugs kyang mang po yod chog kyang gtso bo gcig gsang ye ste/ grol thig tu/ gsang ye 'di gos dkar mor yang bshad/ de ltar byas na sgrol ma bla med lugs kyi sngags yig bcur byas pa lta bur snang / bsnyen sngags gtso bo yab yum gyi thun mong dang / sgrub sngags so sor mdzad pa'o/ /bsnyen dus gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags gcig dril dang / sgrub dus so sor phye ste sbrel ba red pas yab yum gyi sku dril sgrub tu ma zad gsung yang dril sgrub tu 'gro pa'i zab khyad snang / yum gyi sgrub sngags la oṃ logs su med pa ni sgrub sngags kyi thog ma'i o de yab yum sngags gnyis ka'i thun mong gi mgo 'dren du mngon te/ klong snying bde rgyal las tshogs su sgrol ma'i yig bcu tshang bar mdzad rgyur snang yang oṃ gcig gis mtsho rgyal dang sgrol ma gnyis char gyi mgo 'dren go chod mdzad pa lta bu/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum gyi gsang ye'i sngags kyis dpyod tshul yang yod/ chos dbyings kyis mtha' klas pa'i snang grag rig gsum thams cad 'phags pa'i gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i 'khor lor bltas nas sgom pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs kyi khyad par gyi rnam par sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la 255

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ sngags kyi cho ga'i sgo nas slob tshul ngo mtshar ba yin cing / sgyu 'phrul dang sbyar na/ dag pa'i snang zhen rtsal rgyas ched bsam yas lhun grub kyi rgya spros sogs sgom pa dang gnad 'dra'o/ /yum gsang ye lha mo yi ge drug ma yin na de'i sngags kyang yig drug nyid du rigs kyi/ dhu ma gha ye'i sngags zur du ston mi rigs so zhe na/gsang ye ni 'phags ma yi ge drug ma nyid sngags bla med kyi sgos lhar bstan pa yin cing / de bzhin du dhu ma gha ye'i sngags kyang yig drug nyid bla med kyi lhan cig skyes ma'i sgos sngags su sprul pa yin zer ram brtags/ las sbyor skabs/ yi dwags su skye ba'i rgyu la ser sna gtso che yang des khyab pa ni gtan min pas 'gro ba der smin rgyu'i las nyon 'bras gsum thams cad 'dir pra yig tu dril nas nor ba'i rigs kyi 'od zer gyis sbyong ba yin la/ des rdo ༄rje'i rigs kyis sbyang bya la khong khro rgyu 'bras kyis ma khyab pa sogs kyang 'gre/ de la a n-i sogs sa bon drug po ni rlung sems dang bcas pa'i thig le'i snyigs ma rigs drug ste/ dṛ yig tu 'jog rgyu'i rlung sems kyi thig le'i steng na thog med nas brgyud pa'i mi'i gnas lus longs spyod spyod tshul sogs mdor na mi'i 'gro ba'i phyogs kyi tha mal snang zhen gyi nus pa'i cha rnams brten nas gnas pas/ mir skye ba'i las nyon gyi cha thams cad de'i steng du sog 256

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4cing / las nyon de dag gis bskyed pa'i phyi snod kyi rgud pa dang /nang du rmongs dang brjed ngas/ dig lkugs/ dbang po nyams pa/dbul phongs/ nad mang / grags ngan/ 'khrugs rtsod sogs 'jigs pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad yi ge de las mched pa'i snang ba yin no/ /des gzhan lnga yang shes/ de'ang snyigs ma'i rlung sems dang 'grogs pa'i thig le rigs drug po de/ yi ge drug tu mos nas sbyong ba yin la yi ge 'di drug 'gro ba drug la sbyor ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ nges tshig gi bshad pa la brten par mngon la/ 'gro ba gang gi yi ge yin pa de 'gro ba de'i gnas skabs skyed pa'i thig le'i mtshan mar yang 'thad do/ /mi'i gnas skabs skyed pa'i thig le mi'i nges tshig dang ldan pa'i yi ge'i rnam par byed pa sogs so/ /'di dag klong gsal sogs las rkang mthil la sogs pa'i gnas drug tu so sor brten par bshad kyang / thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i gnas mthar thug pa ni snying ka yin par sgyu 'phrul skor las rgyas par bshad do/ /de'i phyir 'di dag bkrus na 'khor ba'i snod bcud kyi rgud pa mtha' dag bkrus par 'gyur zhing / de dag gi bag chags ni shes sgrib yin pas de sbyang na srid zhi'i rgud pa thams cad sbyang bar yang 'gro ste/ rten 'brel sgrig tshul tsam bshad par zad kyi shes sgrib bskyed bzlas tsam gyis ga la 'dag /'byang 'gyar gyi dmyal ba'i sdug bsngags sogs sbyong dmigs la ༄ ༄257

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'bad pa ltar/ ma 'ongs pa na gsog 'gyur dang byed 'gyur gyi las sgrib rnams/ 'byung 'gyur gyi nad sman bcud kyis lan gyis bkag pa bzhin du rgyun gcod pa'i phrin las kyang gal che mod/bsags zin sbyong ba rkyang las ma go ba mang / de ltar na las sbyor 'di ni chos kyi dbyings kyis gar khyab kyi 'jig rten mtha' dag rang gi gdul zhing du byin gyis rlob pa'i man ngag khyad par can yin pas thad kar wa shaṃ ku ru zhes ma bzlas kyang khams gsum gyi dbang phyug sgrub pa'i las sbyor chen po ste/ tshan che la bkra shis pa/dbang sdud stong gi nang na ri rab bzhin du 'phags pa yin no/ /yo gar rje btsun 'dis dmigs med kyi brtse ba'i sgo nas khams gsum gyi dbang po brnyes par gsungs pa de gzhung 'dir phyag len la btab 'dug go/ /ma ṇi'i sngags don stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang snying rje zung 'brel gyi sgo nas bshad pa dang / yig drug phyin drug dang sngags kyi lha'i rigs drug la sbyar ba ltar sngags de lam 'bras kyi chos de dag gi rang bzhin du nga rgyal brtan po bzhag ste sngags de'i 'od zer rigs so so'i tshul khrims bzang po'i yig drug sgrub thabs ltar/ kha dog dang byed las can gyis gzhan don de ltar byed pa'i rnal 'byor la sbyang na rang nyid byang chub kyi bar du stong nyid snying rje'i thabs shes zung 'jug gam/258

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4phyin drug gi chos kyi 'od zer gyi snang ba stug pos zhing rab 'byams kyi 'gro ba'i rgud pa mtha' dag 'phrogs nus kyi dpa' bo chen por sgrub pa dang 'di ni thub bstan sgo thams cad nas rgyas par byed pa'i dbang phyug gi mthu sgrub byed du 'gro lugs so/ /rang nyid la brten nas 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang rin po che sogs rigs drug gi rnam par thar pa'i sgo thams cad nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi 'gro 'dul gyi phrin las dus kun tu rtag pa dang phyogs kun tu khyab pa dang /'bad med lhun grub tu rgyas par 'gyur ba'i thabs dam par yang 'gro bas mkhas pa sgrub byed dang / mngon shes kyi mthu can dang /tshul khrims dag pa dang / dpal 'byor mi zad pa sogs pad+ma'i rigs sam dam pa'i chos kyi rigs kyi phrin las kyis 'gro ba thams cad rnam par dag par lta ba'i bsam gtan la gnas pa ni dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa'i rnam par thar ba sgrub tshul rmad du byung ba'o/ /sgrub thabs kyi man ngag ci yang zur du btsal mi dgos so/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'jig rten ma lus pa snying rje chen po'i ye shes sgyu ma'i rig sngags kyis shin tu rnam dag gi gzags ༄su sprul par byed pa'i bsam gtan yin pa'i phyir sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la lhag par rtsal sbyang bar yang 'gyur la/ der ma zad rang nyid gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i zhing sbyong ba sogs rdzogs smin sbyang gsum gyi gnad bsdus pa'i man ngag kyang yin te/ nyi ma 259

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mkha' khyab/ chu bo dbyings khyab/ g.yos khang zas sbyor la sogs pa 'gro 'dul gyi las tshogs gzhan mang po'i gnad kyang 'di la ma tshang ba med do/ /rgyal ba'i yum sogs las byang sems kyi 'khor bsdu ba/ lha'i 'khor gyi dregs pa 'dul ba/ ngan 'gro sbyong ba sogs thub pas mdzad pa phal cher 'od zer gyis sgrub par gsungs pa dang / 'od zer kun tu bkye ba bstan pa dang /dkon mchog ta la las 'od zer gyi rab dbye dang rgyu dang bya ba'i khyad par rgya cher bstan pa dang / sngags kyi dag pa bzhi lam byed kyi thad na/ 'od zer gyis reg pa tsam gyis sems can grangs med pa rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang la 'god pa la sogs pa'i mdzad pa dang / zhes pa sogs kyis 'od zer spro bsdu'i dmigs rim la nges pa drang bar bya'o/ /'jig rten du nad dang / gdon dang /ltas ngan dang / dbul phongs dang / 'thab rtsod dang / 'byung bzhi'i 'jigs pa sogs 'jigs pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad zhi nas/ bde skyid bkra shis kyi dpal 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i las sbyor la'ang 'di las zab pa med de/ rgyal po 'od chen po'i rnam thar bzhin no/ /las sbyor 'di tshang ma sngags sham med par yig drug rang rkyang bzlas nas sgrub lugs kyang / grub dbang tshul khrims bzang po'i lugs dang / thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel sogs na yod do/ /rtags mthong 'gyar0 zhes pa'i rtags ni ༄ 0260

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4thugs sgrub tu/ dngos nyams 'phags pa'i zhal mthong zhing ཿgzhan phan snying rje rtsol med skyeḥ rmi lam rnag khrag mi gtsang 'babaḥ khrus byas gos dkar gyon pa dang ཿ mkha' la 'phur dang chu steng bgrodaḥ nyam nga'i gnas las 'gro mang bsgralaḥ de sogs dge ba'i mtshan ma rnamasaḥ sgrib dag gzhan phan ltas su shesaḥ zhes sogs sgras/ gangs ri mthong zhing der 'dzegs pa/nyi zla shar ba/ rol mo 'khrol ba/ shel phreng dang me tog dkar po rnyed pa sogs gzhan las mang du gsungs pa rnams so/ /gzhan phan gyi phrin las 'byung ba'i rgyu thun min nas kyi sa bon lta bu ni/ gzhan phan gyi bsam pa nyid yin te/ bsam pa de mthu ji ltar lhag pa de ltar 'bras bu gzhan don yang lhag par 'gyar ro/ /de'ang theg chen nas gsungs pa lta bu'i gzhan phan rari ba //de/ 11re///bye 13)dro bye/sne/thug med 'grub pa la bsam pa mthun phyogs d+nghas pas mi chog gi/ rnam pa thams cad nas rgyas dgos la/ de ltar rgyas byed du sbyin sogs spyod pa thug med la slob pa yin pas spyod pa de dag ni bsam pa de'i grogs sam dpung ngo / /bsam pa de phul du dbyung du med par mthar phyin pa de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi rgyud la grub zin pa rnams lha gcig gi rnam par bsdus pa ni rje btsun 'di yin pas/ de'i sngags kyi zla zer rang rgyud la gdod 261

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nas bzhugs pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi chu shel la bcug nas sgrub lugs 'dis ni 'gro 'dul phrin las kyi dngos grub yas bab thog rgyag lta bu'i tshul du 'thob par nus so/ /de bzhin du yig drug phyin drug dang sbyor skabs kyang / lha sngags kyi mthus phyin drug gi rtogs pa stsol bar ma zad/ phyin drug gi 'bras bu'i yon tan longs spyod dang lus 'khor rtsom pa phun tshogs sogs 'phral la thod rgal du ster bar yang 'gyar te/ 'di ltar don chen po de ༄dag 'o skol rang gi mthus sgrub pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pas thog ma med pa nas bsgrubs zin pa'i snying rje dang phyin drug rig sngags kyi rnam par shar ba la brten nas sgrub pa gnyis ni tshul lam lugs mi gcig ste/ rig sngags 'di grub pa ni bde ba can du skyes pa dang 'dra/ de'i tshe de 'dra ba'i dngos grub mang po la myur ba der dbang sgyur nus pa ni zhing der sangs rgyas byang sems kyi 'byor pa bsam mi khyab la ci dgar spyod du yod pa dang 'dra/rig sngags la ma brten na grub pa de dag tshe rabs mang pos kyang 'thob tu med pa ni zhing de'i longs spyod de dag gdul bya'i dge rtsa'i rang stobs kyis sgrub dgos na shing lo gcig kyang bskal pa du mar yang 'grub mi nus pa dang 'dra bas so/ /'on kyang phar phyin gcig gi bya ba la'ang lhag ma rnams kyis phan 'dogs pas rtsom pa 262

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4phun tshogs tsam sgrub kyang yig ge drug ka tshang ba tshan che'i/brtson 'grus kyi yi ge rkyang pas ni min no/ /mdo las yig drug 'di lha mo yi ge drug ma'i srung bar bshad cing / 'di'i de nyid phar phyin drug gi re rer yang drug drug tshang bar bsdus nas sgrub pa la go cha'i sgrub pa zhes mi mthun phyogs kyis mi brdzi bas rgyal sras rnams kyi go cha yin par gsungs te/ de ltar bzlas na 'jigs pa mtha' dag srung ba'i sngags kyi dam par yang 'gyur/sngags 'dis longs spyod dang shes rab dang srung ba sogs gang sgrub kyang don de dang de'i ched du 'dun stobs dang bsam gtan gyis lde kha sgyur ba ni nges par dgos nor bu chu shel tshon gang la nye ba de'i kha dog tu snang ba bzhin no/ /so/ /las tshogs rab 'byams gzhan yang sgrub lugs ni/ nyang gi 'gro 'dul sogs las shin tu mang ba bshad kyang 'dir bla ma zhi ba ltar las bzhir dril na/ rgyal po bka' 'bum du yig drug rkyang pa de dmigs med dbang gis las so sor byed par gsungs pa ltar ram/ nyang gi 'gro 'dul las so so'i sham sngags sbrel bar gsungs pa ltar na bla ma zhi ba ltar sbyor/ gang ltar yang ting nge 'dzin gal che bas/ de la rgyal po bka' 'bum sogs su lha'i sku mdog kyang las kyi kha dog tu sgyur bar bshad kyang / de ma 263

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bsgyur bar 'od zer las mdog can gyis phrin las so sor mdzad par bltas pas kyang 'grub par pad+ma zhi khror bshad pa bzhin bya/gal te las bzhi'i cho ga de las rgyas pa la dga' na/ pad+ma zhi khro'i sa ts+tsha dang chu la brten pa sogo/sa sbyar na legs par mthong ngo /srung 'khor 'bri na rgyal po bka' 'bum ltar dang / tshe sgrub byed na bla ma zhi ba nas blang /gter gsar gyi gzhung la lar/ mi zab pa'i bskyed rim gyi 'og tu lus dkyil lam zab pa'i bskyed rim sgom par bshad kyang /'dir ma gsungs te/ lar 'di'i lha bskyed ltar rten dang brten pa'i 'khor lo thams cad phung khams dag pa'i bde chen ye shes kyi dag ldog so so'i steng nas sgom pa 'di la rtsal 'byong bar byas kyang phung khams 'od gsal du deng pa'i rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du lus dkyil sgom pa'i go chod pa zhig yod 'dra ste/ dus 'khor bzhin no/ /der ma zad 'di'i rtsa gzhung bla ma zhi bar/ phung po khams dang skye mched kunaḥ gdan gsum sgyu 'phrul zhi khro yiḥzhes sogs ltar phung khams thams cad la sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i lha rnams gzugs sogs nang gi chos de dang der shar ba'i snang zhen 'jog pa'ang gal che'o/ /snang zhen 'jog pa'i gzhi la/ rags pa phung sogs dang / phra ba rtsa khams kyi khyad yod pa ma gtogs pa yum ka la'ang tshul 'di 'dra'o/ /bya ba spyi'i rgyud dpung bzang 264

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4dang legs grub gsang ba spyi rgyud/ bye brag gi rgyud don zhags cho ga zhib mo dang phyag stong spyan stong gi gzungs mdo sogs/ spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon byang / yo ga de nyid bsdus pa dang dpal mchog /bla med gsang 'dus dang bde mchog mngon brjod bla ma dus 'khor sogs kun tu gsungs pas 'di ni rgyud sde bzhi ka'i lha yin/ 'di de kho na nyid la blo rgyas par byed pa'i blo 'phel gyi lhar bsngags te/ de nyid snang ba dang dpal mchog 'grel par/sems can gti mug shas che ba rnams sbyong byed du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo nyid 'gro 'dul pad+ma'i rigs sprul par gsungs pa dang / rang bzhin dag pa'i chos la sor rtog ye shes kyi spyan gyis gzigs pa'i cha nas spyan ras gzigs su brjod tshul dang / sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo dang don zhags sogs mang por sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi steng nas sgos kyi che ba bstan pa sogs/ gsung rabs kyi mdzod thams cad kyi bdag por sgrub pa'i lhar bsngags pa'ang / rnam snang mngon byang dang yo ga dang bla med rgyud kun tu 'di sor rtog ye shes kyi lha mthar thug tu bshad cing / ye shes de sngon chos bstan pa'i rgyu las byang zhing /༄chos kyi longs spyod rgyas pa'i byed las can yin tshul mdo rgyan las dang / de nyid bsdus par/ 'di nyid dang por rgyal ba thams 265

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/cad kyi dam pa'i chos kyi 'od zer las sprul tshul dang sangs rgyas rnams kyis pad+ma byin nas badz+ra dharma zhes ming gis dbang bskur tshul/ sangs rgyas gsang ba dang shākya mi tras/ mdo sde bshad pa'i mthu rnyed pa'i phyir/ zhes sogs du ma/ gsang 'dus sogs las 'di nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i ljags lha'i rnam par shar bar gsungs te/ ljags ni gsung rab chos phung thams cad kyi bdag po yin tshul bsngags 'os bsngags bstod kyi bcu gcig pa ltar/'di'i rigs kyi dam tshig tu'ang / dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung / /zhes 'byung / gzungs kyi sgo tshad med pa sgrub par yang bsngags te/ mdo rgyan las sor rtog ye shes la dag gzungs rnams kyi/ gter dang 'dra ba/ zhes dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi gzungs kho na gzungs chen por 'jog pa dang chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin gyis chos 'dzin pa sogs rje btsun 'di ting nge 'dzin gyi lhar bsngags tshul 'chad 'gyur dang sgrigs la soms/ sgra rig dang de'i 'khor snyan ngag sogs la mkhas pa dang / rtsod pa smra ba'i khyu mchog sogs sgrub pa yang bsngags te/ theg bsdus dbang 'byor lnga'i thad/ 'du shes gyur bas smra ba la dbang 'byor bar gsungs shing 'di 'du shes dag pa'i rigs kyi 'khor sgyur du bshad pa/ 'dus pa'i ngag byin rlabs skabs so rig bzhi gsung 266

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4rdo rjer sbyar ba/ dbyangs can ma'i byung ba/ yo gar rdo rje glu ma'i thad/ 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje'i ljags kyi lhar bstan pa sogs kyis so/ /bstan pa dang 'gro ba la rgya cher phan 'dogs pa'i mthu ni mngon shes la ltos shing / de sbyin par yang bsngags te/ ko sa la'i rgyan las rdo rje chos dang rnon po gnyis kyi go rim skabs/ 'di ting nge 'dzin gyi lhar khyad par du bstan pa dang /a ba ta rar mngon shes kyi dngos grub 'jig rten dbang po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis sgrub par bshad pa/ mdo rgyan las ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo bsam mi khyab rnams sor rtog ye shes la sbyar ba/ sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis bsngags tshul gong bzhin dang / za ma tog 1(1 :jordo /khro/las kun tu bzang dang ting 'a na rtsal 'gran tshul sogs rgya cher gsungs pa'i rigs pas so/ /sa gsum gyi 'gro ba dbang du byed par yang bsngags te/ rdo rje snying po rgyan du/ 'jig rten gsum gyi rgyal srid ni/ /sogs dang / bshes spring du/ 'jig rten kun gyi rnal 'byor dbang mdzad nas/ /zhes pa rtsa 'grel dang / yo ga'i mkhas pa gsum gyis/ pad+ma'i de nyid la gzigs pas khams gsum gyi dbang po brnyes tshul rgyas par bshad pas so/ /'di nyid rang las ni/ 'brel tshad don ldan gyi phrin las sgrub par bsngags te/ sdong po bkod par/ sems bskyed gdul bya 267

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'dren pas chu lha'i zhags pa lta bur gsungs pa dang lhag par sdong po bkod par/ ri rab kyi dpe dang / rtsi thams cad bsdus pa'i dpes gsungs pa gnyis 'byor/ kun tu bzang po'i smon lam thams cad kyi sdom sems bskyed du bshad pa sogs mtha' yas shing / 'di sems bskyed kyi lhar bka' gdams glegs bam sogs las bshad pa dang / nor bzang rnam thar las 'brel tshad smin par mdzad tshul gsungs pa/kri yog sde gsum kun tu pad+ma'i de nyid snying rjer bshad pa/ yo gar 'di'i mtshan 'gro ba 'dul ba zhes bshad pa/ rnam snang snying rje'i nyams kyis 'dul ba'i sems can la 'gro 'dul du bstan pa sogs mtha' yas/ bar do'i 'phrang dang ma'i mngal/ snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i yul dus sogs su yang de dag gi nyes pas mi gos shing / der ma zad de dag dge chos kyi grogs su 'gyar bar rlob ༄pa'i lhar khyad par du bsngags te/ dpal mchog dang por 'di'i rnal 'byor 'chang ba la/ nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi nang na 'dug kyang pad+ma lta bur sogs gsungs/ 'di ni ji ltar pad+ma dmar po 'di/ sogs pad+ma'i de nyid las shes dgos te/ yo ga na shin tu rgyas shing / rnam snang mngon byang 'grel par yang yod/dpal mo'i bstod pa dang / srong btsan bka' 'bum sogs kun tu pad dkar mi gos pa'i de nyid dang sbyar yod/ 'jigs pa 268

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 444thams cad mi 'byung la/ gzhan 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i mthu ster bar yang bsngags te/ dam chos pad dkar dang / nor bzang rnam thar/ za ma tog /bcu gcig zhal gyi mdo gzungs rnams na gsal zhing rgyas/ spyod 'jug las kyang / 'khor gyi 'jigs pa'ang bsal ba'i phyir/ /sogs dang / 'di byams brtse'i lha yin cing rgyal po byams pa'i stobs kyis mnga' ris bsrung ba dang / ston pas bdud dpung byams pas btul ba/sgrol ma'i sngon byung sogs kyis shes so/ /'phags pa 'di'i spyan chab las sgrol ma dang khro gnyer gyi rgyud las khro gnyer can/ mche ba las dbyangs can ma sogs byung tshul 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang gos dkar mo dang / rma bya chen mo/ yid kyi shing rta ma/ longs spyod ldan ma sogs/ za ma tog sogs las gsungs pa dang /dpal mchog 'grel par/ brgya byin/ khyab 'jug /drag po/tshangs pa/ sa'i lha/ rgya mtsho'i lha/ nyi ma/ rlung gi lha'i gzugs can gyi rje btsun sogs gsungs te/ 'dis 'jig rten dbang phyug ceg pa'i sgra bshad kyang shes/ spya na ras gzigs zhes pa'i mtshan 'di nyid 'chang ba'i sku la yang / bcu gcig zhal/ mkha' spyod/ seng ge sgra/ mgrin sngon/ 'phrog byed gsum la zhon pa/ hā la hā la sogs mtha' yas te/ sgyu ma'i rnam par thar pa bsam 269

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gyis mi khyab pa'i mtha' la dad par bya'o/ /rdo rje snying po rgyan las/'jig rten dbang phyug thub chen po/ /bcom ldan rnal 'byor can grub na/ /dpa' bo thams cad stsol 'gyur zhing / /rang gi dngos grub mchog rnams dang / /rnal 'byor thams cad 'dzin nyid dang //rnam par rgyas pa'i nor ster 'gyur/ /rig pa 'dzin dang 'khor lo can/ /sa dang pha rol phyin sogs dang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyang stsol 'gyur na/ /dngos grub gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dam chos pad dkar las/ de bzhin gshegs pa gaṅga'i klung drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi bye ma snyed kyi mtshan nas brjod cing phyag byas pa dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan lan gcig brjod cing phyag gcig byas pa bsod nams mnyam par gsungs te/de'i rgyu mtshan yang / rtog ge 'bar bar/ phar gyur pa'i phyir dang / zhes sogs ltar ro/ /za ma tog dang sdong po bkod par nad kyi 'jigs pa sel ba'i lhar bsngags shing / rdo rje gur las yig drug nad thams cad zhi ba'i sngags su gsungs pa dang / ma ṇi bka' 'bum las nad 'don drug dang brtul zhugs drug dbyug bcos sogs nad gdon sel ba'i phrin las kho na rtsal du bton yod pas nad gso ba la ches rno/ khyad par du gso rig las mig 'byed par zab par gsungs shing / nyang gter mig 270

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4'byed sogs/ rnam thar zangs gling mar nad pa'i don du rkyen zlog rim gro smam dpyad ci byed pa bas ma ṇi stobs che gsangs// ༄'di dag rje nyid nas zin tho lta bur btab yod pa rnams gzhan du 'khyar gyis dogs nas rjes 'jug 'ga' zhig gis phyogs gcig tu bsgrig khul byas te phyag bris ji lta ba bzhin bcos bhaslad med par spar du bskrun pa dge legs 'phel/ / 271
nga 9

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄7//bla ma bde ba chen po mchod//rta khyung 'bar ba'i zin tho la/chos 'di rig 'dzin bla ma byin rlabs kyi sgrub skor yin pas byin rlabs tshan che/ de la skor tsho bzhi las yang gsang drag po phrin las kyi skor yin pas phrin las rno la myur/ de'ang gur drag phal cher be har btul dus kyi lo rgyus dang 'brel/ 'di ni gdug pa klu btul ba'i mdzad pa dang 'brel ba'i gur drag yin te/rdzas gter gnam lags thog rgod kyi lo rgyus las/ 'di slob dpon chen pos mal gro cabatul ba'i phur ba yin zer/ /zhes sogs kyis shes la/ dbu gtsug nas rta khyung gi zhal gnyis phyung ba'ang gu ru nyid klu gshed du bzhengs pa'i brdar snang zhing / sbrul gdan dang g.yon pa'i phyag mtshan sogs las kyang shes so/ /rdzas gter gyi lo rgyus des chos bka' 'di kun mkhyen gyi gdung grangs re drug pa'i 'phrang sel ched byung ba las/ de gong lha sngags kyi rnam pa 'di med dam snyam pa'i dogs pa'ang sel lo/ /gu ru rin po che dang por bod du spyan 'dren pa'i gleng gzhi yang klu yin te/ ar+ya pa gling gi se phung la gnas pa'i klus bod kyi lha 'dre bskul nas bsam yas brtsig tu ma ster ba'i dbang gis sa 'dul la spyan drangs par bshad pas so/ /rgyal po sogs rgyud gsum 'byung po'i nang na klu rgyud tshan che zhing /gnam sa bar snang thams cad klu gnyan sa bdag gsum gyis ma 274

rta khyung 'bar ba'i bsnyel tho/ pod/ 4khyab pa med pas/'di nyid las/mdor na snod kyi 'jig rten kunaḥsogs gsungs la/ mal gro'i lus ngag dam la thogs kyang yid ma thogs pa ltar gdul dka' shos kyang klu rgyud yin te/ glen pa klu zhes zhe gnag pa'i dper grags so/ /de'i phyir 'di ni log 'dren 'dul ba'i lha sngags kyi mchog tu grub cing gtso bo'i gdul bya la bsam nas de ltar bshad kyi/ rgyal bsen dam sri gzhan gyi'ang gnyen po stobs kyi lha phul du byung ba ste/ gnod byed sde brgyad thal bar brlagaḥ ces dang / rdzas phur gyi gter 'byung du/ chos 'di byin rlabs shin tu myur bas dam sri'i bar chad bzlog /tshe 'phrang bsal zhes chos 'byung thad/ dam sri ras gos can btul ba'i lo rgyus kyis mtshon nus shing / lhag par slob dpon rgyud kyi lha srung zer ba'i dpe ltar kun mkhyen bla ma nyid kyi sku tshe'i gegs 'phrang bsal ba'i rten 'brel gyis rang cag chos brgyud 'dzin pa rnams la shin tu shis pa'i zab chos khyad par can no/ /de'ang dam sri 'byung po 'dul ba la sgos su bsngags pa ni rdo rje khro lod yin la/'di'ang rdo rje khro lod kyi bye brag yin par/ 'jigs byed rdo rje gro krodha lo kot+tar zur chag pa ste khro bo 'jig rten mchog zer ba yin gsungs/ bo lodaḥces so//'dir gur drag sku/rta skad gsung / mkha' lding thags kyi //he/ snye/bye/ //nge lhar byed pa gzhung du gsal tsho/ sku gsung thugs bsam —sa 275

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khyab pa'i dbu gsum dang ldan pa zhes pa dang phyogs 'dra zhing / gur drag rtsa ba'i lha/rta mgrin rigs bdag /bya khyung rgyal mtshan gyi tshul du byas kyang rung ba 'dra/ yang rta mgrin dang rdo rje mkha' lding ni bsgrub bya'i lha dang / gu ru ni sgrub byed rig 'dzin gyi tshul du 'phrul pa ste/ sgrub byed nyid bsgrub bya'i ngo bo son pa dang / bsgrub bya nyid sgrub pa po'i rnam par bzhengs pa yin pas/ don la bsgrub bya sgrub byed tha mi dad pa ste/ bsgrub bya'i sku nyi zer rnon po dang /sgrub pa po'i tshul ba stan me shel gyi nor bu lta bu/ de gnyis mnyam dipar sbyar nas sgrub pa'i drag sgrub 'a nyi zer me shel la bcug nas me sgrub pa lta bu ste/ bgegs kyi spra skam sbyong ba la ches rno ba yin no/ /'di rtsa rgyud thod dum la brten no/ /bshad lugs kyi rnam grangs tsam yin gyi/ gu ru nyid bsgrub bya'i gtso bo yin pa ni bshad ci dgos/ dum bu dang po lo rgyus kyi skor tsho'o//sgrub thabs kyi thog mtha'i las gzhung da lta kun gyi kha rgyug 'di/chos 'di'i bka' babs kyi skyes bus mdzad pa khyad 'phags yin mod kyi gter gzhung gi tshig zin dngos ni rig 'dus kyi dkyus bzhin byed pa nyid yin te/ zhi khro ngan song sbyong ba'i tshogs mchod dus/ bzhengs shig rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i lhaḥ sogs la 'don pa sgyur mi dgos pa rgyu mtshan dang bcas te kun mkhyen nyid kyis 276

rta khyung 'bar ba'i bsnyel tho/ pod/ 4gsungs pa ltar/ rig 'dzin zhes pa gar byung du rta khyung zhes sgyur ba sogs dgos par ma go/ bsnyen pa mtshams bcad dam du byaḥzhes pa ni/lus bcad rgya/ ngag smra bcad/ sems gzhan du ma yengs pa rnams te gal che/ gdon 'grol las/ rdo rje srung ba'i gur gyis dkrigasaḥ zhes dang / las gzhung gi mtshams gcod ltar srung gur gyi dmigs pa dang don dam pa'i srung ba rgyun du gces/ spyir 'di las sgrub kyi lha'i bye brag tu snang yang /sgrub thabs 'di la 'chi srid chos skur sbyong byed de ting dang / bar do longs skur sbyong byed kun snang / skye ba sprul skur sbyong byed phyag rgya phra rags kyi ting nge 'dzin te mchog sgrub kyi gnad che ba rnams tshang bas rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du 'gro ba'ang byar yod/ lha sku'i rnam pa ni/ thags rjes sems ༄can la chags pas sku mdog dmar po/ thig le nyag gcig gi rang bzhin rtsa ba'i zhal gcig /gong smos ltar ram/ dbang drag gi las gnyis mdzad pas rta khyung gi zhal gnyis phyung ba/ dus gsum gzigs pas spyan gsum/ skye shi rtsad gcod mche ba gcigs pa/snang srid zil gyis gnon pas gsang gos dang phod chen/ pha rol phyin drug rdzogs pas rus rgyan/ rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis dpa' bas stag sham/ sems byung lnga bcu srog bral du gyur pas mgo phreng mnabs pa/'dir gsang phod kyi steng na stag sham rus rgyan sogs 277

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gsol ba mdzes 'dra/ bris cha rnying pa 'gar ni gsang phod kyi nang du mnabs pa byas snang / ye shes lnga'i thod skam gyis dbu rgyan pa/rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ral pa gyen du brdzes pa/ 'khrul snang gi brag ri 'joms pas phyag mtshan rdo rje/ gur drag kha cig la phyag mtshan gser rdor byed kyang / 'dir gnam lcags kyi rdo grub dbang gzhung du 'byung zhing / rwa dgu par yang des bshad de/ rwa gdangs me 'bar bya'o//phrin las thogs pa med pa'i brdar g.yon me khyung / de'ang bsdigs mdzub phyir bstan gyi rtser khra thabs su 'gyed par zin bris rnying pa zhig tu bshad/ snang stong gi mtha' gnon pas zhabs gnyis g.yon brkyang gis bgrad pa/ rnam rtog gi mtshon cha las rgyal bas khyung gi go tshags/ 'di rta mgrin gsang sgrub ltar mgrin pa nas long bu'i bar la byas na bde/ bzod par dka' ba'i ye shes kyi snang ba rnon po spro bas/stobs kyi 'od zer me ru 'baraḥ zhes pa ltar me phung gi klong na brjid pa/ lung 'dis rdo rje me'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rang gi sgo gsam la nus pa skyed tshal niring raring shes/ rig pa ye shes kyi khro bos gti mug las gyur pa'i rten 'brel yan lag rnams ldang ba'i go skabs bcom pas sbrul gdan la 'gying ba/sbrul rnams kyi mjug ma nang dang / mgo bo phyir bstan du bsnol ba'i mgo rnams zhabs kyis brdzis par yig rnying zhig tu 278

rta khyung 'bar ba'i bsnyel tho/ pod/ 4snang ba bde bar mngon yang / rdo grub dbang chog las mgo bo nang du bsnol bar bshad pas dpyad/ 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos thabs shes 'brelaḥ zhes pas pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan no/ /tshogs brgyad las gyur ma rig gdonaḥ klu chen brgyad po zhes pa phyogs mtshams su 'god lugs dang / sku mdog sogs klu chog spyi'i skabs dang 'dra'am snyam la/ thams cad kyang thal sbyar can du bshad do/ /de'ang kun gzhi'i rmongs cha las mched pa'i glo bur tshogs brgyad kyi rlung sems mtha' dag zang thal rig pa'i khro bo'i bka' 'bangs sam gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i brda rtags so/ /gnas gsum byin rlabs kyi lha rnams rigs dang sku mdog gi khyad min pa 'dra'am brtag /'jam dpal gyi spyi bor oṃ/ pad+ma'i mgrin par āḥyang dag gi thugs kar hūm̐/ chos rgya yi ge de gsum/ ye rgya rnga yab gling sogs sku gsum gyi zhing na bzhugs pa'i ye shes sems dpa'/las rgya lcags kyu sogs tshad med bzhi'i phyag rgya'i rnam pa can gyi 'od zer/ dam rgya dam tshig pa'o/ /mchod pa'i tshig rkang dang pos 'dod yon drug dang / gnyis pas de rnams bde ba'i rol par blta ba bstan zhing / bzhi pa'i don la bde chen rig ma'i 'dod yon spros nas snyom 'jug gi mchod pa 'bul ba yang yod par mngon pas de'i dus su bde ba'i thabs byas pa'i lhan skyes kyi de 279

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/kho na nyid la blo bzhag cing / de nyid dag pa'i snod bcud du shar ba'i nga rgyal skyong ba ni bskyed rim gyi lam gnad zab pa zhig ste/las sgrub la'ang 'di yod na khyad che'o/ /dum bu gnyis pa lha bskyed la sogs pa'i skor tsho'o//thugs ka'i sngags phreng zhal nang bstan du dbang chog rdo rje pha lam las te/ zhal ni dang po gang nas klog pa'i phyogs la bstan pa de yin gyi leb ngos min no/ /bsnyen yig tu sngags 'khor gyi gzugs sgra la dmigs pa gtso bor gsungs te/ de dag la sems ci tsam goms pa de tsam du gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs rlung sems la zhugs nas bzlas brjod kyi nus pa skye bas thog mar de la bslab dgos te/ sngags 'khor dang lha la snang zhen sbyong ba rdzing du chu bskyil ba lta bu/'od zer spro bsdus las sgrub pa rdzing chu yur bar )dro1 /khyen the(1'dren pa lta bu/ snga ma la rtsal ma na par ma gtso ra byas kyang rdzing na med pa yur bar 'dren pa lta bur 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /lha sngags ngo bo dbyer med du lta ba'ang shin tu gnad che/ de nas 'od zer spro bsdus sangs rgyas kyi spyi mdzad la rtsal sbyang ba dang / sgos mdzad klu 'dul gyi dgongs pa la bslab pa gnyis las/ dang po ni sngags 'khor las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas dang / khyad par zangs mdog dpal rir gu ru rin po che 280

rta khyung 'bar ba'i bsnyel tho/ pod/ 4rig 'dzin ḍāk+ki'i tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i thugs rgyud bskul/sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dngos grub 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus nas bdag don ye shes 'bebs pa dang / yang 'phros sems can thams cad la phog pas de rnams kyi gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba'i zug rngu mtha' dag bsal/ snod bcud thams cad rig 'dzin drag po'i dkyil 'khor du sbyang bar bsam nas gzhan don phrin las kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa ste/bsnyen pa'i gnad byang las/'od zer spro bsdus don gnyis byasaḥ zhes rtsa tho yod pas chad du mi rung / klu gdon sogs kyi sdug bsngal dang gnod sems zhi ba'i dmigs pa 'bur dod byed na'ang phyi ma 'di'i khongs su bcug pas 'grub/gnyis pa ni/ sngags kyi 'od zer me stag lta bu dang / sku'i cha thams cad nas khyung gi tshogs 'phros pa'i 'od kyis gnod byed thams cad rdzas la me mched ltar tshig par bsam par gter gzhung gi mchan bur gsungs te/ 'di'i don sngags las 'bar ba'i 'od zer dang khyung gi tsha tsha 'phros pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang / nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad lhag med du sbyangs te/ba spu'i sgo nas phyir spros/ log 'dren rnams kyi lus gong bzhin bsreg par bsam zhes zin bris rnying par 'byung ba/ me dmigs 281

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/kyis dang por lus gdon/de nas gnas gdon/mthar stong gsum gyi bar gyi bgegs sbyang ba'i me dmigs skor gsum gter kha gzhan du yang 'byung bas legs cha yod kyang / mchan bu'i sku'i cha thams cad las zhes pa las gzhung gi /ba spu'i bu ga thams cad kyang ཿ khyung gi tsha tshas gtams shing 'phroḥ zhes pa ltar bya rgyur mngon pas/dogs pa phre'u yod/'dir steng zhal/go cha/phyag mtshan bcas bya khyung gis mdzad cing / lhag par sgos mdzad gtso bo des bsgrubs pas khyung gi dmigs pa la rtsal 'don par snang ste/'jig rten na sman sngags kyis sbyong sgyur sogs la mi ltos par klu'i dug la rjen zas nus pa'i mchog nam mkha' lding yin pas de dang sgo bstun pa ste/ rta mgrin khams gsum rol pa'i gtor zlog tu/ bya khyang 'bar bas klu gnyan rgum bur 'thuḥ zhes so/ /khyang gi kha dog skurab spu(tho shāje( /ste/ 1(thocharangaskurab /steste (1)la ga na pa— phyag mtshan thad/ khyung dmar zhas ba tshon ga tu gsungs la/ gnod 'grol las/ bya khyung nag po'i khra thabs gtongaḥ zhes 'byung bas/ rgya rong rin po ches/ sreg byed khro chu zhun pa'i lus can/ zhes gsungs pa ltar mthing dmar lcags sreg gi mdog lta bur byas na 'grigs par mngon/slar yang dbu gtsug rta zhal gyis 'tsher skad drag po byung bas srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i gnas thams cad shig shig yom yom byed cing / phyogs skyong bcu 282

rta khyung 'bar ba'i bsnyel tho/ pod/ 4sde ris dang bcas pa'i lus sems cher g.yos/ snying rtsa bsgul/dpa' zil chag /dran pa myos/ bya spu rlung khyer ltar rang dbang brtan pa dang bral te/dbang gi 'od dmar lcags kyus zhabs 'og tu bkug nas 'gul mi nus par bsam la gzir/ de'ang gnod byed dngos bya khyung gi bsad sreg byed cing /de dag gi gab khung lta bu'i bsdong zla dang rgyab rten phyogs gtogs rnams rta mgrin gyis dbang du sdud pa'i dbang drag sbrags ma yin nam snyam/ 'di ltar na rnam snang mngon byang 'grel par/ khro gnyer can gyi rgyab tu mthu chen thob 'god pa ni dpung bya ba'i phyir ro zhes pa'i rigs pa ltar/klu 'dul gyi las byed dngos bya khyung dang / de'i dpung grogs rta mgrin/ gur drag de gnyis kyi rtsa ba'i lhar byed dam dpyad/ gnod 'grol dus/ bzlas pa'i tshe khyung dmigs mi byed par rta skad kyis 'jig rten g.yo zhing sgul ba dang / 'od zer gyis klu gdon zhabs 'og tu drangs te zil gyis gnon pa tsam byed pa dbu'i yig chung gi don du mngon pas dkyus dang mi 'dra yang / de ni/ zhi bas brngan dang drag pos gziraḥ zhes sogs ltar klu gso ba dang /'khon gcug sbyong ba'i las rim dang 'brel bas dang po nas bsad sreg mi byed pa yin par gsal te/ spyir btang dmigs bsal lta bu'i khyad do/ /rgyal bsen lta bu sgos su 'dul na/ khyung gi 283

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tsha tshas log 'dren sregaḥ zhes pa'i log 'dren gyi mtshan gzhir rgyal bsen bzhag pa rang gis chog ste/sri kegs/thel 'gong /rbad 'dre sogs gzhan la'ang des 'dres('gres) sbyor zhing / steng gdon 'dul dmigs bsnyen yig gi mchan du blta'o/ /bgeg sa rnams bsregs gzir byas te sa gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i nga rgyal yun ring du bzung ba'i mthar/ gnod yul gnod byed gnyen por snang ba'i spros pa thams cad rmi lam gnyid kyi klong du rang grol ba bzhin gdod nas rnam dag rig pa'i klong du bsres te/ de'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag cing / de nyid kyi rang mdangs rig 'dzin bla ma drag po'i dkyil 'khor du lam me ba'i rgyun skyong ba ni lhun grub rig 'dzin gyi dgongs pa dmar 'byin byed tshul yin te/ las gzhung gi /snod bcud sbyangs nas sogs dang / bsnyen yig gi/gdon kyang rang sems 'khrul ba'i rtsalaḥ sogs rtsa 'grel du sbyar ba'i lugs so/ /de ltar nad gdon sogs ma dag pa'i dngos snang dngos 'dzin thams cad chos dbyings zhi ba chen po'i klong du na bun yal ba ltar deng nas ka dag gi rig pa gcer bur song ba nyid hur phyung ste sgom pa ni gnas lugs don gyi kun bzang pad+ma 'byung gnas zhal blta tshul dang / rta skad thang gcig gi dgongs pa dang /rdo rje nam mkha' lding gi nges don mthar thug pa yin zhing /284

rta khyung 'bar ba'i bsnyel tho/ pod/ 4gzhom med kyi btsan rdzong 'dzin tshul zab pa'ang yin no/ /bzlas sngags kyi a rtsig ni shin tu khros pa/ ni rtsig ni rab tu khros pa zhe sa dgongs 'dus rnam bshad las gsungs/ rta gur khyung gsum dril ba'i sngags dngos ni/ oṃ hrī hūm̐ khri phaṭa ces pa la ngos bzung dgos te/gdon 'grol du yang yang 'byung /lhag ma gu ru drag po'i sngags so//de rnams la srog sdom gzer bzhi brtsi tshal yang shes par bya ste ༄sla'o//dum bu gsum pa dzab dgongs kyi skor tsho'o//dus nam yang gu ru rin po che mkhyen snyam pa'i mos gus dung nge ba dang / rig 'dzin he ru ka'i zhing sku'i snang zhen mi 'bral ba srog ltar gces/skabs ci rigs par 'di nyid kyi thugs dam skul ba'i gsol 'debs grangs gsog byed na dbang gi gnad yig ltar tshig bdun gsol 'debs la bya zhing / bsam pa myur 'grub kyang shin tu 'tshams/ thun mtshams su yang me dmigs rgyun mi gcod par yang yang gso ba la slob zhes mkhas grub gter ston mnga' ris/ chen po dag gsungs te/ phyir gtsub shing gi me sgrub pa la ngal bso med pa'i 'bad rtsol dgos pa bzhin du nang bsam gtan gyi me la'ang 'dra bas gnad che bar go/ nad gdon mar lta bu 'ga' zhig bzlas brjod kyi me mthu chung dang yun thung gis kyang bzhu bar nus so/ /lcags lta bu 'ga' zhig bzhu ba la stobs ldan 285

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dang yun bsring ba dgos pas ngang thung mi bya/ gdon dang por bslang rtags/ bar du chum rtags/ tha ma thul rtags so sor 'ong bar bshad pa'i rnam dbye'ang phyed dgos/ re dogs mang na bgegs 'jug cing /gdon byings che na rtags mtshan phyin ci log gis mgo skor 'ong ba yang bshad pas rtags bzang ngan ci byung yang re dogs dang dga' brod 'jigs zhum gang yang ma shor bar nam mkha' mdung bskor ltar bya/ nyam nga rnam rtog cher za dus/gong du drangs pa'i gdon kyang rang sems 'khrul pa'i rtsalaḥ sogs ltar/gang shar rig pa'i rang rtsal dang /rang snang ye shes kyi 'khor lor rtsal sbyang bya zhing / thog rdzis kyi brtul zhugs kyang rgyags/ de tsam du ma zad/ dngos 'dzin gyi me ro skad cig kyang mi slong bar spyod yul thams cad sgyu mar shes pa'i rnal 'byor gyis zil gyis gnon pa ni 'og min bgrod par lam khyer shes pa bcu gsungs pa'i gnad don yin/ rig 'dzin bsnyen yig tu mtshams kyi kun spyod pha rol phyin drug dang sbyar nas gsungs pa dang / gab byang las kun bzang spyod pa lngas bsnyen sgrub kyi gnas dang yo byad sngags g.yog dam tshig sogs bstan cing /'og min bgrod par lha sngags dang sgrub thabs ster ba'i bla ma la mos gdung rgyun mi gcod pa dang / snod min la gsang ba mi ston pa sogs dam tshig drug 286

rta khyung 'bar ba'i bsnyel tho/ pod/ 4poragasungs pas mtshon bsnyen dus kyi spang blang ston pa'i skor rnams la bshar sbyang gtong /kha skong gi sbyin sreg byed na ye shes me lce sbyor/lha sngags las rung gi drod tshad rnyed pa la rtag 'grus gnyis po 'dzom dgos pas bsnyen mtshams bsdams pa nges par dgos shing /phyis su'ang lha'i thugs rgyud 'khul ba dang / byin rlabs kyi rgyun gso zhing gong du 'phel ba sogs kyi ched du 'chag med kyi dam bca' bzung / der ma zad gdon thul rtags dang / lha nye ba'i mtshan ma ci rigs mthong nas rang la bar chad kyis mi tshugs snyam pa yod de/ g.yul du mtshon chas mi chod pa la go cha yod pas mi chog//lus la gyon dgos pa ltar bzlas sgom mi g.yel ba gal che/ bsnyen pa rdzogs nas gsang rdzogs kyi rgyud las gsungs pa ltar 'od zer spro bsdus lde kha sgyur tshul dang / sngags la spel tshig gang 'dod sbyar ba tsam gyis las sna tshogs shig 'grub la/ lhag bsam dag pas de lta bu'i tshul gyis bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher spyod pa'ang o rgyan rin po che'i mdzad phrin gyi 'phro bskyang bar 'gyur bas legs mod kyi/skal ldan mchog ni tshe thung 'dir las sgrub kyi nang du mgo mi 'khor bskyed rim brtan pas spring yig byed na phyogs bcu'i gdon tshogs la spring ba lha ma yin gyi gtsug tor sbyar na 'thad do/ /bar mthong ba'i chos la rig 'dzin gyi sa bgrod pa'am/ de ma byung yang phyi ma zangs mdog 287

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dpal rir thogs med du 'gro ba'i gsal lam dam par bzung nas dngos grub mchog gi 'byor pa rgyas par byed do/ /dum bu bzhi pa rjes spyod sogs kyi skor tsho'o//lar klong chen snga phyi'i chos 'di dag dgongs gter gyi rgyal po yin te/ snga ma gzhan du shes/ phyi ma chos kyi babs lugs kyi sgrom nas 'od gsal snying thig gi lam gnad la mi 'phyug pa'i gzer bu thebs nges pa rtogs brjod chu zla na bzhugs te blta shes na ya mtshan po yod/ gter kha so sor bka' babs kyi sgos khyad re yod pa las/ kun mkhyen phyi ma 'di rdzogs chen snying thig dang rig 'dzin bla ma'i sgrub skor gyi bka' babs su lung bstan bka' rgyas bstan par rang nyid kyis gsungs te/'di'i thugs rje chen po dang /bka' brgyad/seng gdong sogs la bla ma'i gsang sgrub/rig 'dzin thugs sgrub/rig 'dzin yum ka'i gsang sgrub sogs zer ba de yin no/ /yang rje 'dis dgongs rnam rtsom dus dbu gtsug nas rta skad 'tsher ba/gu ru rin po ches pad+ma dbang chen zhes mtshan btags pa/mthe bong thugs srog h+ya yis mtshanaḥ zhes pa mkha' 'gros ngo sprad pa/ rta mgrin gyi rnal 'byor la brtson pa'i skabs su rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i chos nyid kyi bden don gzigs par gsungs pa sogs kyi rgyu mtshan las rta mgrin grub pa'i dpa' bor shes so/ /288

rta khyung 'bar ba'i bsnyel tho/ pod/ 44klong snying 'dir gur drag mthing dmar gnyis gsungs pa'i drag mthing bla ma bka' brgyad du byas nas dang / drag dmar rta khyung gnyis dang sbrags nas gsungs la/ bya sla 'khyer bde byin rlabs cheḥzhes pa lta bu ni phyi ma ste/pad+ma gsung la rtsal 'don na lhag par yang de zab bo/ /de ltar na rig 'dzin chen po 'di'i dgongs gter gyi bla ma rig 'dzin rta mgrin dang sbrags pa'i sgrub gzhung zhig nyams su len rgyu byung na rno nus gzhan dang mi 'dra zhing / rta mgrin khams gsum rol pa sogs kyang rig 'dzin thugs sgrub kyi skor yin yang /de la gu ru zhi drag gang gi'ang ming 'dogs mi byed kyi/ khyad par de rnams rdzogs pa la rta khyung 'bar ba 'di rang phul du byung bar mthong ngo / /des na las gzhung dang gnad yig gnyis kar/ shin tu yang zab thugs kyi gteraḥ zhes gu ru nyid kyis zab par bsngags pas/ pha mes kyi rdo lag brgyud tsam ma yin par brgyud pa dang chos kyi rgyus la byang bar byas na dad pas khams sos par 'gyur ro//rje btsun bod 'bangs 'gro la dus kun brtse/ /da dung bod 'dir gdul bya'i lhag ma mchis/ /'di ltar spyan 'dren sbyor ba bshams nus na/ /pad+ma'i 'dzum zhal myur du mjal bar nges/ /rta khyung 'bar ba'i bsnyel tho rin chen sgron me zhes bya ba/ bya rgan 289

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'tshogs pa'i nags rgan mar/ rdo rgan gyis bris pa/ sngags rgan mang pos brdung rgyu'i rnga rgan du gyur cig /lcags phag khrums zlar byas/spring yig byed na/ steng du phyag rtags/ 'og tu spring yig 'bri/ phyag rtags ni phyag mtshan gnyis sam/ bsdu na rdo rje rwa gdangs me 'bar gcig pu bya/ sgo gong ngam gnod pa'i phyogs su bstan no// // 290
ba bdud das phur thongargyan zhes

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄tsho//khyab bdag bla ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo//phur pa bdud dpung zil gnon la bsnyen sgrub byed par 'dod pas/ dang por byin rlabs kyi sgo 'byed bla ma'i rnal 'byor la zhag nyer gcig sogs ma mthar byas pa'i bar du brtson pa ni med du mi rung / de nas 'di rig 'dzin thugs sgrub kyi bye brag yin pas rtsa sgrub zhi drag gnyis kyang sngon du gtong nus na legs shing / ma nus kyang chad skyon med/ bcas shom thad/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bdag nyid canaḥ sogs rkang pa gnyis bsnyen dus dang sbyor zhing / sgrub dus dkyil 'khor sogs gsum sgrub dang sgrub chen gyi mdun dkyil 'god tshul yin/ zhi mchod drag mchod sogs kyi rnam bzhag spyi dang 'dra/ dngos gzhi'i ting 'dzin gsum gyi tshig don ni/'khrul snang gi spros pa mtha' dag 'joms pa'i stobs mthar phyin pa'i phyir rgyal ba'i ye shes chos sku ni rdo rje khros pa ste/ de bsgom pas zhe sdang bag chags dang bcas pa gcod do/ /zhe sdang gis nyon mongs pa gzhan yang mtshon mod/dngos su de 'ba' zhig smos pa ni/lha 'di zhe sdang gi rigs yin pas zhe sdang sgrib bral du byed pa'i rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ldog pa nas bstan to/ /ye shes de la tshur zhe sdang sogs kyis mi brdzi ste/ thags kyi ye shes de ni 'gyar ba med :relngardortejo:tre /ste :nge :jotsho no༅ shān ra༅pa ci ༄ nga 'a na nyid ces 'ba' ga tu yang dag par 292

phur bu'i zin bris sogs/ pod/ 4ram rnam pa thams cad du gyur pas nyes pa'i glags med pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes te/ stong nyid dang bar du spros pa phra mos kyang ma chod pas rnam par mi rtog pa dang /de'i spyod yul ji bzhin du rtog pas mtshon mi nus pas na rtog las 'a das pa ste/de lta bu'i mnyam bzhag las gtan mi g.yo ba'o//de la nga rgyal bzhag ste sgom pa ni de ting ngo //de ltar ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba rnams snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig chen po'i tshul ni/sems can de dag bsad cing mnan par bya'o snyam pa lta bu'i rnam pa can ma yin te'am min gyi/ de dag gi phung sogs tha mal pa'i chos thams cad sbyang bar bya'o snyam du ma dag pa'i phung po dang khams sogs gar yod du dmigs med kyi snying rje bde ba chen po'i ngo bor mi phyed pa'i rdo rjes gtams pa ste khyab par byas nas/dgos pa de sgrub phyir du rang gi rnam par shes pa rdo rjer te hūṃ du sgom zhes pa dpag ljon dang bstun nas bshad la/ kun snang gi ting nge 'dzin kho nar sbyor skabs/ 'gro ba rnams kyi phung po ste lus ni rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyis gtams pa ste tha mal pa'i go sa phrogs nas/de dag gi rnam par shes pa ni bde stong gi ye shes chen po'i rdo rjer sbyang bar bya'o zhes bsgom pa la bshad kyang rung ngam brtag /snying rje des bskul te/ mtshon cha chen po rdo rje'i de nyid 293

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/thags rdo rje'i ngo bo hūṃ yig sngon po nyi ma ltar 'bar ba ni/ chos kyi ༄dbyings kyi nam mkha'i dkyil nas thigs pa lta bur rang shar ro/ /de'ang yul dus nyi tshe tsam du shar ba min gyi/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi srog gi go ru shar ba ste/'khor 'das thams cad kyi srog ni stong nyid yin la/ stong nyid de dang ro gcig pa'i bde chen yang stong pas gar khyab tu 'jug cing / bde chen de nyid hūṃ du shar ba yin pas so/ /de ltar shar ba dang / de'i rtsa ba'i rgyu gang yin zhe na/sngar de ting skabs rang gi phung khams thams cad snying ga'i thig ler bsdus shing / thig le de thugs rdo rje'i ye shes nam mkha' lta bur bskyed nas/ de nyid slar yang hūṃ du bsgom pa yin pa'i phyir/snying gi go ru bsgom par bya/ zhes 'chad dam snyam/ 'on kyang sgrub thabs ljon shing dang bkol dum ltar na rgyu ting la yig 'bru bzhag nas/ kun rdzob byang sems rdo rje'i bdag nyid du bskyed pa zhes pa /hūṃ byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang ཿ sogs kyi skabs su yig 'bru phyag mtshan du bsgyur ba 'dra la/ gzhung 'dir/ mtshon chen thugs kyi rdo rje niḥ yig 'brus mtshan pa rgyu yin noḥ zhes kun snang gi 'og tu hūṃ yig gis mtshan pa'i rdo rje sgom pa dang / de nyid rgyu ting du mdzad par mngon pas cung zad mi 'dra bar snang / yig 'brus mtshan pa'i phyag mtshan las lha bskyed pa yin na sngon du sa bon gyi 294

〉nga〉 /ru/shā se /du//bye( /je can/ ༷dro//sa/ the2/rngo//spras// skyorngo//pa// 〈mi'iyig ge ma bskyed kyang cho ga gsum skyed du 'gro ba mi 'gal bar 'og min bgrod pa las gsungs pas 'dir bshad pa'ang cho ga gsum bskyed du byar rung ngo //de ltar na mtshon chen sngon po 'bar ba zhes pa'ang yig 'bru rkyang pa la mi gzung ngo //bdag sras gzhan sras skabs/ rdo rje'i cho ga gsum gyis zhi ba longs sku rdor sems dang / de nyid sprul sku'i khro bor bskyed pa ni/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams chos sku las rdo rje gsum gyi khyab bdag longs spyod rdzogs sku dang / de las sprul sku zhe sdang rdo rje shin tu khros par gyur pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i cho gas rang nyid he ru kar bya ba yin pas na gzhan gyi sras su bdag bya ba dang /rang nyid 'bras bu'i he ru kar byas pa'i steng nas sangs rgyas thams cad tī la ya rigs lnga'i rnam par sras su skyed pa ni bdag ni sras su gzhan bya ba ste/ brda dang brda lan gyis bskul nasaḥ zhes sogs su phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams bde ba'i 'od kyis 'gugs pa mi gsal yang dpag ljon ltar dgos pa 'dra ste/de gzhan sras kyi go don yin pas so//phur srung dgod pa'i mu ran ni dkyil 'khor phyi rol gyi de yin gyi nang khyams min no/ /gnas gsum byin rlabs ni/ yig 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa'i phyag mtshan bskyed pa tsam gyis mi chog gi/de yongs su gyar pa las rdo rje gsum gyi lhar bsgom pa dpag ljon ༄295

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dang bkol dum ltar dgos te/ rtsu āḥ.oṃ gyis mtshan pa lasaḥ zhes pas so/ /de nas mkha' khyab kyi rgyal ba rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gsum gyi srog ye shes su dbang bskur ba dang / dkyil 'khor gsum gyis khams gsum gyi srog la dang / ye shes sems dpa'i srog la lhan skyes ye shes chen po'i dbang bskur ba gsum gyi dmigs gnad dpag bsam ljon pa ltar shes par bya/ rak+ta tshar gsum ni dam can lcam dral la mngon spyod kyi phrin las mdzad ched gzi byin skyed pa'i cho ga yin pas dam can nye bsnyen dang ngan sngags nye bsnyen gyi gzhi sgrub par yang 'gro ste/'di'i dgos dbang skabs kyang / smad las sgrol dbang la phur bu gtad cing las drug gi rnam dbye bshad nas rak+ta tshar gsum 'bul du gzhug pa kho na las gzhan mi 'byung ba bzhin no/ /des na tshar dang po'i 'bul tshig gi don la las drug gi rnam dbye tshang tshul smad las spu gri rlung 'khor ltar shes dgos/ rak+ta tshar gsum phur pa'i sgos chos su bshad pa'ang / pho nya la bka' bsgo ba'i don du 'bul ba sogs gsum la byed dgos kyi/tshar gsum tsam la mi rung ste/de sgyu 'phrul khro bo la'ang mthong ba'i phyir ro/ /bzlas pa'i dus dzab bskul ni mdun bskyed med na mi dgos/ bsnyen sgrub kyi dzab dgongs skor rgyud phur ltar bya ste bsnyen pa'i dmar byang dang yang shin tu mthun/296

pha'itshone /phyazeb sdonā:re dranazug lngagothag theṭatha/thag/ 25rngad/ rtenabasnyen pa'i skabs dzab khang dbye ba dang / sngags phreng las rang 'dra sogs do li'i dmigs rim byung /sgrub thabs dpag ljon las de gnyis bsnyen dmigs kyi thog mar smos pa ni sgrub chen kyi skabs su bsnyen sgrub bzhi rdzogs par byed pa'i skabs la dgongs par rig 'dzin gzhung lam las so/ /nyer sgrub skabs/ bdag bskyed kyi bzlas pa 'od zer spro bsdu'i mthar thug par byas nas/ gtso bo dang rnam rgyal gyi bar du dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi bdag nyid can gyi sras mchog bskyed pa dang / de las 'od zer spro bsdus khams gsum rdo rje phur ba'i ngo bo nyid gcig tu sgrub pa dang / de ༄nyid la dmigs nas skabs ci rigs par do li'i bzlas pa'ang skyel tshul rnams rig 'dzin gzhung lam ltar bya/sngon du sras mchog lnga bskyed dus nas de dag rdzas phur dang dbyer med du blta ba tsam yod kyang / 'dir ni bsnyen phur bsgrub gzhir byas nas sras mchog tu bskyed pas khyad che zhing / bsnyen phur gcig po de snga nas rigs lnga dang dbyer med du mos zin na/ 'dir bsgrub gzhi mi rnyed do snyam du yang mi bsam ste/ dper na phyogs gzhan du lus rten gyi dkyil 'khor du sngar bsgoms nas/ slar yang brten pa'i lus dkyil sgom pa bzhin no/ /rig 'dzin gzhung lam gyi sgrub pa'i thad du yang / rnam par rgyal ba dang gtso bo'i bar du mdun bskyed 297

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sgom pa zhig bshad kyang / de ni nye sgrub skabs dang sgom tshul ye mi gcig ste/ de'i gong du mdun rten la lha phur rgyas par dgod pa dang / sbam phur 'jog pa'i phyogs gnyis bshad nas sgrub dus mdun bskyed sgom tshul bshad ma thag pa dang / sgrub thabs che 'bring las bshad pa gnyis gang byas kyang rung bar gsungs pa las/ so sor ma sbyar bas/ de 'dra'i mdun bskyed sgom tshul de lha phur tshang bar bkod pa la yang sbyor rung bar gsal la de'i tshe nye sgrub skabs ltar phyi dbyibs kyi sras mchog gcig las mi bskyed na phur bu lha grangs bkod pa don med pa'i phyir dang / mdun bskyed de ltar bsgom pa na cho ga gcig gis bdag mdun me long gnyis la gzugs brnyan dus gcig tu shar ba ltar bsgom par bshad cing / de'i mdun bskyed la sras mchog gcig las mi 'jog na bdag mdun bskyed chog cig tu byar mi btub pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'di ltar yin te/ rdo rje phar ba'i sgos chos gtso bo ni/ phar pa riri pho ni mi phrin las kyi sgrub sde zhes grags pa ltar thal 'byin gyi phrin las yin la/ de sgrub pa la dkyil 'khor gsum gyi nang nas kyang khyad par du bsngags pa ni sras mchog yin te/ thogs pa med pa'i las mdzad 'dus pa lngaḥ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir te/ thogs pa med pa'i phrin las dang thal 'byin gyi phrin las skabs 'dir don 'dra'o/ /298

phur bu'i zin bris sogs/ pod/ 4de'i phyir dang por sras mchog rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor la mthil gtad nas dngos grub kyi nus pa skyed pa'i ched du nye sgrub byed la/de nas dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha yongs rdzogs la brten nas dngos grub blang ba'i don du ni sgrub par byed de/ rim bzhin sgrub sde 'di'i rtsa ba'i dngos grub sgrub pa dang / de'i nus pa sgo thams cad nas skyed pa'i ched do/ /nye sgrub 'di sras mchog la ltos nas sgrub pa dang /dkyil 'khor gsum yongs rdzogs la ltos nas bsnyen pa tsam du 'gyur ba'ang des shes so/ /de'ang rdzas phur la brten nas bsgrub par khyad med kyang rnal 'byor pa'i blo rtse gtod tshal gyi ༄khyad par las/ phyi yul snang char dgra bgegs gnyis la thebs/ /zhes dang / nang du rang rgyud nyon mongs dug lngar thebs/ /ces sogs ltar thal 'byin gyi nus pa thon phyogs mi 'dra ba du ma 'ong bar snang ngo / /de ltar na bsnyen sgrub gsum la bdag bskyed tsam dang / mdun bskyed sras mchog dang / dkyil 'khor gsum yongs rdzogs la brten pa'i lha'i khyad par dang /'bru dgu dang /'bru bcu bzhi pa dang / bcu bdun pa la brten pa'i sngags kyi khyad par chen po yod la/ gal te mdun bskyed kyi rim pa'i dbye ba de ltar mi 'byed na ni/ sgrub thabs bkol ba'i dum bu ltar/ nye bsnyen gyi dus nas sgrub pa'i skabs bzhin dzab khang phye ste/ mdun bskyed dkyil 299

khuX / shrī'i rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'khor yongs rdzogs la brten nas/ do li'i dmigs bzlas bya ste/'di la ni sgrub pa dang nye bsnyen gyi khyad par dzab la dngos grub bsdu ba'i sngags sham yod med tsam gyis 'byed do//de yang dza0zhes 0mkha' khyab kyi rgyal ba rnams kyi dngos grub mdun bskyed sngags kyi lha la sdud/ hūm̐ gis de yang bskul te rang nyid la sdud/ āḥs sngags kyi dngos grub dang sgrub pa po'i rgyud 'bral mi rung du brtan par byed par gsungs pa'i steng nas dngos grub bsdu sngags la 'bru bcu bdun pa 'jog pa'i don shes dgos so/ /sgrub thabs dpag bsam ljon pa'i dngos bstan gyi bsnyen sgrub gsum yang /chos nyid dang sbyar te bzla ba bsnyen pa/ lha dang sbyar ba nye bsnyen sogs kyi bshad pa'ang yod mod kyi/ gtso bo ni bzla bya'i sngags mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas khyad par bstan tshul 'di dang 'dra bar gsal lo/ /'bru bcu bdun pa 'di rgyud kyi dngos bstan la mi gsal bar rig 'dzin gzhung lam las gsungs shing / de bzhin du gter gzhung 'dir yang tshig zin ma byung mod/ 'on kyang rgyud phur du man ngag gis kha bskang ba ltar/ 'dir yang bsnan na phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur bar sems/tshogs mchod ni bsnyen pa'i dus su yang7ma chag na bsod nams che bas legs pa yin te/ rig 'dzin gzhung lam las/ thun 300

phur bu'i zin bris sogs/ pod/ 4tratha ma la tshogs mchod re grub na legs shing zhes so//lhag par sgrub pa'i skabs su ni nyin re bzhin tshogs mchod rgya gang cher bya ba nges par dgos te/ de nyid las/ srod thun la tshogs mchod rgyas pa re bya zhing / bye brag pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i tha snyad smos na/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /phyogs 'dir phur pa'i de nyid legs par shes nas des snang spyod thams cad la rgyas btab ste sgom pa ni lam gyi srog tu snang bas/ de'i tshul ni/ spyi chings drwa ba sdom par rgyud kyi lung drangs pa las/ de la phur pa'i lta ba ni sogs dang /byang chub sems kyi phur pa yis/ /srid gsum 'khor ba gdar sha gcod/ /ma btab bzhin du lhun gyis rdzogs/ /zhes dang / bsnyen sgrub mdzod khang du'ang / de la chos nyid phur pa ni/ zhes sogs drangs pa ltar dbyings stong pa nyid dang / rig pa ye shes dbyer med pa'i 'od gsal byang chub kyi sems ni gzung 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa thal mar 'bigs shing gcod pas na phur bu ste/ zab pa'i phyogs so/ /srid pa gsum gyi chos thams cad rig pa byang chub kyi sems de las mi gzhan pa dang / rig pa de nyid he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor 'ba' zhig tu 'char ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ srid gsum tha mal du snang zhing zhen pa'i mthu 'phrogs par byed pas na phur bu ste/snang phyogs so/ /'di yang spyi chings drwa ba sdom par/ srid pa gsum 301

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/po lha sngags ye shes kyi phur bur sgrub tshul bshad pa sogs dang bsgrigs nas shes par bya'o/ /de la gter gzhung 'di'i lugs kyi gtso bo'i phyag mtshan phur pa spu gri sogs dang mthun yang / smad las kyi bsnyen pa ni spu gri la bsten pa'i phyogs min par bsnyen pa'i dmar byang las shes pas/rgyud phur ji bzhin du bya dgos so//der dam can nye bsnyen gyi las byang gnyis 'byung ba ni/ bzhi snying dril ba'i steng nas smad las kyi khog srong tshul rgyas par ston pa la smad las kyi srog shing dang / gtso bor gsol kha'i las rim rgyas par ston pa'i dbang du btang ste ma mo mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung mdzad la/ de gnyis kyi bzlas sngags mi 'dra ba ni/ phyi dha ti dang /gsang ba bsdu yig la brten pa'i khyad yin par gnad yig dang mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung bsgrigs na shes shing / gnad yig na nang 'dus pa la brten pa'i ngos 'dzin yang yod do/ /bzhi snying gi ngos 'dzin go slar byas na/ go gnon bsnyen sngags dang gcig/ thams cad 'dus pa ri rab dang gnyis/ dam can 'dus pa dang gsum/mjug sdud khro bo 'dus pa'am sgrub sngags dang bzhi ste/ de'i nang nas gnyis par phyag rgya bzhi'i yi ge rkyang pa las med skabs/dmigs bya rten la 'gugs 'ching bsdams nas/ dril ba'i sgra'i de ༄nyid sher phyin gyi nus pas las nyon sdug bsngal gyi rnam rtog ldang 302

phur bu'izinabrisasogs/ pod/ 4 ba'i go skabs bcom nas stong pa'i dbyings su brgyal zhing myos par byed pa nyid la smad las kyi zab gnad 'dzin pa stong par sgrol ba'i go don/ rang rang 'dzin pa kun bcom nas/ /dngos med nam mkha'i rang bzhin gnas//zhes pa legs par tshang bas thams cad 'dus par 'gro zhing / ri rab kyi don tshang ba ni sla'o/ /thams cad 'dus pa'i don dngos mi tshang yang spyi ming phyogs gcig la btags zhes sam thams cad 'dus dang ri rab dang zhes pa'i dang sgra snga mas de gnyis gang rung gi don yod na chog pa'i gdam ngar bstan ces byas kyang zer rgyus ma phongs tsam 'ong bar snang ste/snga ma bzang bar sems so//bzhi snying gi 'brel bsgrigs na/ tshar bcad kyis 'dul ba'i yul rnams dang por ye shes lha'i phyag rgyas mnan pas byin rlabs che zhing /de nas dam can pho nya'i tshogs la drag po'i las kyi gnyer gtad pas phrin las myur ba yin nam snyam/ smad las srog shing gi dam can 'dus pa ni/ ka tai ka ye lus sgrol byed sku'i snying po/ dza ye bi dza ye ngag sgrol byed gsang gi snying po sogs nas/ ta na ye ming ༄po gsum dang sbyar ba'i bar du sngags don gyi bshad pas nges par byed tshul gnad yig tu rgyud drangs pas ston la/ srog shing rang gi nyin mo gtor te bzla ba'i rbad bsad kyi thad na ka tai sogs shwa na 303

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma/dza ye sogs bse mo//a dzi te sogs bdag nyid ma/ma ra sogs ming po dang sbyar te/mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung gi da ti 'bring po la de ha'adra'i bshad pa gsal po gzhung 'dir mi snang / las gzhung srong tshul skabs gnad yig tu nag mo bzhi'i sgos sgrub ston pa'i rgyud kyi lung / rgyan dang ldan par rab tu bskyed/ /rang bzhin spyan drangs mchod pa 'bul/ /bstod dang smon lam legs par bya/ /de nas bdag nyid sngags dang ni/ /mched bzhi'i gsang sngags swā hā can/ /bar bcug bar bzlas srog snying dpog/nus pa dag dang ldan par bya/ /bar bar mchod bstod gnad la dbab/ /rang rang dam rdzas legs par bstabs/ /zhes drangs pa'i rkang pa snga ma gsum dang mthun par las rim spro ba'i tshul ni mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung las gsungs shing / tha ma gnyis ltar bar skabs su gtor ma 'bul ba ni smad las srog shing du bshad de/ des mtshon nas mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung la rkang pa phyi ma gnyis kyi don dang / smad las srog shing la rkang pa snga ma gsum ltar sbyor ba'ang shes par bya mod/ smad las srog shing gi dgongs pas sngon du spyan 'dren mchod bstod zur pa mi dgos par mngon te/ man ngag gis spro bsdu byed tshul bstan pa 'dra'o/ /de bzhin du mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung la/ smad las srog shing nas bshad pa'i 'bod pa'i dus kyi bzlas dmigs kyang nges par 304

phur bu'i zin bris sogs/ pod/ 4zhe trasbyor dgos pa sogs shes sla/srog shing gi shom gyi thad na/mi bzad phur pa drug rnams ni/ /zhes yod kyang de dag lha gang du bskyed pa de rang na mi gsal/ 'on kyang spu gri rlung 'khor las sras mchog gi ngo bo mi bzad pa'i phur pa drug ces bshad pa dang 'dra bar gsal bas sras mchog bdun du byas pa yin pa 'dra zhing / de gang du bskyed pa'i gnas ni rtsa dkyil gyi phyi'i mu ran la sras mchog dam can dang bcas pa'i las dkyil sgom pa yin nam snyam ste /sras mchog yin yang rtsa dkyil gyi phyi rol tu sgom pa mi 'gal ba ni snga 'gyur bka' ma'i gzhung mang por lhag ma'i dkyil 'khor la de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'god pa bzhin no/ /de'ang rdzus phur la brten nas gtor dril gyi ba zlas pa thams cad tshang bar byed na smad las srog shing ltar dang rdzas phur la brten yang dril te bzlas pa'i bsnyen pa rkyang pa'i mthar bskul dang gdab kha tsam byed pa yin na mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung ltar bsnyen pa bskyal na dngos bstan dang 'byo ra bas legs/ gal te gtor ma dang mthun rdzas tsam la brten nas dam can nye bsnyen bsdus pa byed na ni/ bsnyen sgrub mdzod khang ltar shes dgos te/ de'i shom la/brub khung du zan ling bcug pa'i khar mañdzi la dam can spung gtor 'god/ bse yi lha mo'i rdzas rnams ni/ /zhes sogs smad las srog shing du drang ba 305

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ltar gyi mthun rdzas gang 'byor bshams/de dag sngags pa rang las dma' bar bshams dgos te/ dam can bka' 'og tu 'du ba'i rten 'brel yod/ de nas bsnyen tshul dngos la/ smad las srog shing na gtor ma dang mthun rdzas tsam la brten nas gzhung de rang du bstan pa'i bzhi snying dril ba gzhir bzhag gi sgrub pa'i tshig zin yod cing /bsnyen sgrub mdzod khang gi dgongs pa yang /sngon du spyan 'dren mchod bstod zur pa sogs med pa'i srog shing lugs dang nye bar mngon pas/ smad las srog shing gi dril te bzlas pa'i bsnyen pa khol 'don byas la/ bsnyen sgrub mdzod khang rang gi/dkyil 'khor gyi mu ran la bka' sdod ltar sogs dang lto sbyar te nyams su blang ngo / /'dir gtor ma lhar shes pas dam can lcam dral gsal btab ste bzlas pa byed cing / slar yang gtor ma kha gsos te mchod par shes nas bar skabs su gtor 'bul byed pa 'dra/ 'di'i thad kyi bsnyen sgrub mdzod khang du/ gtor ma la shes pa gsum dang ldan pa las/ zhes dang / de'i tshe sngon gyi phur pa mkhan po rnams la grags pa'i shes pa gsum gyi man ngag las/ zhes shes pa gsum gong 'og gnyis bshad pa ni don mi gcig par mthong ste/'og ma de la ni gtor ma shes tshul cang mi snang bas/ ru lu shes pa bcu zer ba ltar bzhi snying dril ba shes tshul du mngon no //306

phur bu'i zin bris sogs/ pod/ 4yang bsnyen phur dang sgrub phur dang gtso phur du grags pa de dag gcig gam/ mi gcig /de dag gdab las la 'jug tu rung mi rung yang ji lta bu zhe na/ 'di la spu gri rlung 'khor las/ bsnyen phur ni sras phur nyid la byed pa dang / sngags pa 'gro na sked dang /'dug na sngas su mi 'bral rgyu'i phur bu'ang de la byed pa dang /phur bu gzhan las bsgral ba'i rnam dag mi rdzogs pas gdab phur nyer lnga'i gtso bor 'jog rgyu'ang de yin pa dang / sgrub phur ram lha phur ni gdab las la mi 'jug pas bsnyen sgrub kyi rdzas phur tha dad yin pa dang /des na sgrub phur yin yang gtso phur yin mi dgos pa 'khor gyi lha phur gyis shes shing / bsnyen phur la'ang gtso phur gyi tha snyad tsam yod kyang / lha phur gyi gtso bo dang mi gcig par bshad pa sa der zhib tu blta ste/ 'bra la spang gi phur bu sras mchog la 'jog pa 'di dang / sngar nye sgrub kyi thad du bshad pa gnyis bsgrigs shes na nges pa ster ro/ /'on kyang bsnyen sgrub kyi phur bu gcig las med na/ phyis ngan sngags nye bsnyen dus sras phur du byas nas 'debs pa la ni nyes pa med dam dpyad par bya'o/ /stod las smad las tshang bar bsnyen pa mdor bsdu sa byed tshul ni/bsnyen phur dang / sman raka gtor gsum tsam la brten nas/ ci tsam sgrub pa'i dus kyi sum cha dang por bsnyen dmigs rkyang pa dang / phyi ma 307

r+sha pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gnyis la nye sgrub kyi dmigs rim dang sbrags/ gsum gar yig 'bru bcu bzhi pa'i bzlas pa kho na bya zhing / mthar zhag bdun sogs su bzhi snying dril ba'i bzlas brjod dang / gtor bsngo byas pas 'grub par bsnyen sgrub mdzod khang las/gal te snyigs ma lnga yi sogs nas/gtor bsngo byed pa dam tshig go zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan to/ /yig 'bru bcu bzhi pa'i grangs 'dren ni/ badz+ra dang / sarba gnyis re rer bgrang / gzhan rnams so sor brtsis pa ste/ oṃ ni dpal chen yab yin teḥ sogs rkang pa bcu bzhi po ltar yin no/ /da dung blo ldan rnams kyis gus pas legs par dpyad na pad+ma'i ring lugs 'bras ldan dus kyi nyi ma ltar gzi brjid je gsal du 'ong ngo / /phur thogs mgrin pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba phur bu'i lugs srol gzhan dang ma 'dres par rang gzhung rkyang pa la brten nas cung zad dpyad pa'i zin tho/rab tshes shing 'brug lo'i sngags pa zor 'phen gyi zla11pa'i zad mthar bris pa/ bdud sde nag phyogs kyi zla ba ltar zad de/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyal zla'i yar ngo ltar 'phel rgyas 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig / 308

phur bu'i zin bris sogs/ pod/ 4༄/ /srog gi zhal gdams nyung gsal ni/srog gang yin shes par bya ba/ shes nas dgug cing dbang du bya ba/ dbang du gyur nas phan gnod kyi dgos pa la sbyar ba ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ ye shes lnga'i dang / 'jig rten dreṭa pa'i srog gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ lha rang rang gi rtsa sngags dang snying po'i sngags sogs te/ de'ang ye shes lnga'i srog dngos ni so so'i thugs rig pa byang chub kyi sems yin la/ de nyid rjes 'jug gis kyang thob cing mngon du bya ba'i phyir rgyal ba nyid kyis rig sngags kyi rnam par byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dang / lha srin sde brgyad sogs 'khor 'das thams cad kyi srog gam gnad mthar thug pa ni chos kyi dbyings yin la/ ye shes lha'i thugs de ni chos kyi dbyings la dbang sgyur mthar phyin pa yin pas sde brgyad thams cad kyi srog kyang sangs rgyas kyi srog gi gzhan dbang kho nar song ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gshin rje'i lcags kyi spyang ki bung ba tsam bse sgrom nag po lcags kyi tha ram can du dang / ma mo'i zangs kyi bye leb skyigs mo'i mgo bo tsam g.yu sgrom lcags kyi thar ram can na bcug ste gnas pa sogs so so'i las kyis grub pa'i bla rten 309

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/srog mkhar tha dad kyang gsungs mod/ gtso bo ni ya ma sogs ming sngags rnams so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan sde brgyad de dag ming kho na'i dbang gis yod par zad kyi/ ming la ma brten par de dag gi yod pa 'tsho mi nus pas ming yig srog tu bzhag gam dpyad/ sde brgyad rnams rang rang gi ming de dag gi sgo nas nga'o snyam du ming don gcig tu sre ba'i tshul gyis zhen nas gnas te sems kyis ji ltar zhen cing brjod pa ltar/ de'i 'gya char gyar sto ༄pa'i rlung gis kyang rjod par byed de/ 'di ni de dag gi rlung sems ming yig gi rnam par gnas pa'i tshul lo//der ma zad de dag gis dpal gyi spyan sngar yang rang srog ming sngags su byas te phul zhing /dpal gyis kyang de ltar thugs ting nge 'dzin gyis bzung ba yin pas/ srog dang ming sngags rnams ni mdud pa brtan pos bsdams pa ltar mi phyed pa yin no//gzhan yang lha 'dre'i mi 'gyur ba'i srog tri yig dang / 'dren pa dang btags pa'i srog ming yig /gnas pa'i srog ming yig dang po ste srog bzhi dang /phyi snyigs ma las gyur pa sha khrag gi srog nang dwangs ma las gyur pa rnam shes kyi srog /rjes su dran pa'i srog /rang dbang med pa'i srog ste bzhi'i rnam bzhag dang / bla tshe srog gsum gyi rnam dbye sogs shes par bya'o/ /chags pa khrag gi srog dang / gnas pa don gyi srog /'khrul pa yid kyi srog /rtsa rlung byang sems kyi srog ste bzhi dang / rang bzhin gyi srog dang / gnas pa srog gi snying po/ myur ba 310

pharu /ru/shā du /du//bye/ khranacan/ /dro/lhas/ thes/ཿ//zlas// :dra/sprerwa/ / 〈mi'isrog gi snying po/ ngo bo nyid kyi srog gi snying po ste bzhi sogs bshad/ gtso bo ye shes lha'i srog ni thugs srog dang / snying po'i sngags gnyis su dang /'khor sde brgyad kyi srog ni srog yig dang / srog sngags gnyis su 'du shes bla mas gsungs/gnyis pa la'ang / ye shes pa dang / 'jig rten gyi srog 'phrog thabs gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi gzer sogs bzhi ste/ de dag la srog sdom gzer bzhi zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rang gi sgo gsum bya ba dang bcas pa dang /lha'i rdo rje gsum phrin las dang bcas pa gnyis srog gam rang bzhin gcig tu bsdams nas/sangs rgyas kyi rdo rje bzhi rang gi dngos po bzhi las gzhan du mi g.yel zhing / rang gi lus sogs kyang lha'i rdo rje bzhi'i ngo bo nyid las gzhan du mi 'phyugs par byed pa'i gzer bu zhes par mngon/ de'i dgongs pa mi 'gyur ba'i gzer gyi skabs su/ snang srid thams cad rgyal ba'i srog rang rig byang chub kyi sems su ro gcig par shes nas bsgom pas/ lha srin dregs pa rnams kyang rang shugs kyis dbang du gyur nas/ grogs la mi 'khu/ rang la mi ldog /bkra shis/snying nye/ bka' nyan pa'i phyir 'jig rten pa'i srog gi lde mig kyang ye shes lha'i srog 'phrogs pa nyid yin par bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni gsum ste/ phyi srog gsang sngags zab mos 'phrogs pa zhes he ru 311

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ka'i ting nge 'dzin gsal bas/ gang la bya ba'i lha 'dre de'i sngags bzlas pas 'dir yi dam gyi sngags kyang bzla dgos/ sngags kyi sgra dang 'od kyis don gnyis byas nas/ sde brgyad la phog pas so so'i snying ka'i bla srog gi sgrom bu rnams mar gsar nyi mas bzhu pa ltar zhu/ de na gnas pa'i dwangs ma lnga 'dus kyi thig le ming sngags kyis bskor ba de mchil pas nya drang ba ltar drang bar bsam ste/ 'di la ni bzlas brjod gtso bor byed pa yin no/ /nang srog ting 'dzin brtan pos 'phrogs pa zhes gong non gyi ting nge 'dzin dang / dregs pa dbang sdud kyi ting nge 'dzin gsal zhing brtan na bzlas pa sogs la cher mi ltos pa'o/ /gsang srog lta dgongs zab mos 'phrogs pa zhes lha srin dregs pa thams cad rang gi rig pa byang chub kyi sems su shes pa'i gdeng tshad brtan na ting 'dzin dmigs pa'i rno so mang po yang gdags mi dgos pa'o/ /de'ang sngags kyis dregs pa'i srog 'drong nus pa'i tshad ni/ sngags de zlos byed kyi ngag la bden pa 'grub dgos te/ gang bsam bden mthus byed pa'i drod ci rigs rnyed pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyis 'drong ba la ni/ reg mthong gi mtshan ma brtan pa dang / lta bas 'drong ba la ni/ snang rig 'dres pa'i stobs kyis gzhan snang zil gyis non pa dgos so/ /de lta bu'i sngags pas srog 'dren byas na ni/ shing lo bral ba rlung gis 'das ༄312
